The sentence does not force a child, so the cloze itself is too loose if this sense is ever revived. I had no tools to run the planner.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense: same headword, POS, register and pronunciation as 39880, with the same meaning (年幼的孩子). The split does not mark a real sense distinction, so two exercise sets would teach one sense twice.; variants.A.level_3.options[0]: “即使是婴儿，也需要为家庭贡献一份力量”语法通顺，婴儿是一个defensibly正确的答案，而不只是干扰项。

definition: 娃娃是一种玩具，像一个小人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 39883, not for a sentence defect. Sentences use the doll sense consistently. Level 3 B 玩笑 and 空气 are weak distractors but not defensibly correct. Level 6 and 7 indices match the plan. I had no tools to run the planner.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense: 娃娃 meaning 玩偶/玩具 is already covered by 39883, whose gloss is more precise (模仿婴儿或儿童外形的玩偶，常作为儿童的玩具). Keeping both would teach the same sense twice.

definition: 表示长度或距离非常大。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用：与 39910 同为“很长”的同一义项（长度或距离大），两者的定义、level_3 正确答案、level_6 与 synonym_antonym 的判断完全重合，学习者会在两个义项下遇到同一题。应保留一个义项（建议保留 39910）并删除或合并另一个，本次不做修补。除重复外，句子和练习块本身没有明显缺陷。

definition: 造东西时用的办法。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only because it duplicates sense 39915. The blocks themselves are mostly sound. Minor points: the level_3 A explanation for 游戏 is labeled 搭配, but the error is really semantic. In level_6 A, “工程技术正在检查病人” fails on animacy rather than on the 医生 contrast.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 39915. “造东西时用的办法” and “建造…实际工作中使用的科学方法和技能” are the same meaning of 工程技术, and the fingerprints do not separate them. Keeping both would teach one sense twice and create duplicated exercises.

definition: 连词，连接并列的词或短语，表示联合；也可作介词，表示共同参与。
reviewer_notes: 判为 reject 的理由：该义项的核心本身有误。它把并列连词与“与…一起”的介词用法合在一个义项中，pos 标为连词对大多数句子不成立，并且与 85657 在并列用法上重复。仅靠修补 block 无法解决，需要新建介词义项、重写句子，并重新运行计划（级别和锚定句都会变化）。上述 block 层面的问题（黑、好、“付钱”、并列主语句式、level_7 解释）也需在重新生成时一并修正。我没有对该义项做补丁，请以重新生成为准。
reviewer_issues: core.pos, core.definition, core.sense_fingerprint: 同一义项混合了连词（并列）与介词（“与某人一起”）两种用法。约 6/10 的句子（0–4、9）是介词用法，pos 标为“连词”对大多数句子不成立。这违反“每句只用一个义项”的核心要求。; core.sentences[5], core.sentences[6], core.sentences[7], core.sentences[8]: 这四句的 和 是并列连词，与 85657 的义项完全重叠，造成两个义项在并列用法上重复。sentences[6] 还被用作 B 组 level_3 的锚定句，因此 B 组 level_3 也需一并修改。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “你可以和我们付钱。”在“和+人+动词”的结构下可理解为“与我们一起付钱”，并非明确错误，不能作为干扰句。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0], variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1], variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2], variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 这几句都是语法正确的并列主语句（如“他和书放在桌上了”“他和自己的努力成功了”），只是语义荒谬。解释却归因于“和不能引出某成分”，把学习者引向错误的诊断。; variants.B.level_1.options[1]: 黑 hēi 与 hé 的韵母和声调都不同，不是可混淆的干扰项。; variants.B.level_1.options[2]: 好 hǎo 与 hé 的韵母和声调都不同，不是可混淆的干扰项。; variants.B.level_7.error_description: “和需要连接两个成分”描述的是并列连词。在介词“与…一起”的用法中，和 需要的是宾语，这一解释不准确。; core.sentences[8].furigana: 只有这一句带有 furigana 字段，其他句子都没有，字段不一致；另外拼音末尾多了一个“。”。; active_levels: active_levels 包含 2，但两个变体都没有 level_2 块。

definition: “这”是用来指离我们很近的人或东西。
reviewer_notes: The option blocks are otherwise sound: the distractors are real tone and initial contrasts, and the level_6 and level_7 errors are clearly wrong. The rejection is for the sense slot, not for the blocks. No mined sentences.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicates sense 85666. Both are pronoun 这 in the near-deictic sense, with the same definition restated, the same fingerprint, and the same anchor sentence “这是我的书。”. The ladder would teach one meaning twice.; core.register: Register 口语 conflicts with the sibling sense 85666 (中性) for the same meaning, and 这 is not specifically colloquial.

definition: 连词，表示并列联合，相当于“和”；也可作介词，表示“跟”。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as it stands because it covers two senses. The downstream blocks (for example, the A level_6 anchor 他与朋友一起去了北京 versus the conjunction-framed wrong sentences, and the B level_3 comparison anchor) inherit the mismatch. It also duplicates 85671's conjunction sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition and sense_fingerprint combine two senses: the conjunction (=和) and the preposition (=跟). The sentences also mix them. Indices 0–2 are conjunction uses. Indices 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 and 9 are preposition uses (与朋友一起, 与我无关, 与我的不一样, 与经理联系, 与自然相处, 与去年相比). This breaks the one-sense rule. pos 连词 is also wrong for most of the sentences.

definition: 方位词，表示较高的位置，或某物的表面；也表示由低处向高处。
reviewer_notes: Reject. Regenerate as a direction-only entry, distinct from 85677. Directional sentences that can be reused: 0 (请往上看), 1 (他向上看了一眼), 3 (电梯正在往上走), 5 (孩子们沿着楼梯往上跑), 7 (从这里往上走). A level_3 (请往上看cloze), A level_6 (电梯正在往上走) and A level_7 (他沿着楼梯上走 to 往上走) are directional and reusable. Rebuild the plan after regeneration, since the required blocks will change.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses: locative 上 (较高的位置，或某物的表面) and directional 上 (由低处向高处). The locative half is the same sense as entry 85677, so this entry is not a distinct single sense.; core.sense_fingerprint: The fingerprint 较高处、表面 repeats the 85677 fingerprint, so the sense is not pinned.; core.sentences[2],[4],[6],[8],[9]: Five of ten sentences use the locative sense (山上的空气, 屋顶上落着一只鸟, 请把行李放到架子上, 他站在山顶上, 他把帽子戴到了头上). They do not teach the directional sense this entry is supposed to lock.; variants.B.level_3: The cloze sentence 请把行李放到架子上 is locative, not directional.; variants.B.level_6.correct_sentence_index: The correct sentence 他把帽子戴到了头上 (index 9) is locative. The semantic-discrimination answer would be wrong for the locked directional sense.; variants.A.level_7.correct_sentence_indices: Index 2 (山上的空气特别新鲜) is locative. The spot-the-error set mixes senses.; variants.B.level_7.correct_sentence_indices: Indices [6,7,9] mix locative (架子上, 头上) and directional (往上走) sentences.

definition: “我们”是说我和别的人在一起。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用：两个义项是同一用法的重复切分，合并比修补更合理。若决定合并，85681的例句可并入85682作为补充例句，但需先去重。仅就其变体看，level_3、level_6、level_7的正确句与错误句基本可用，level_1声明无最小对立对也可接受，但这些都不能挽救独立义项的前提。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与85682语义完全重叠：二者都指“说话人与他人（或说话人一方）的多个人”，85681的定义“我和别的人在一起”未划出任何独立界限，学习者无法区分两个义项

definition: “月”有两个意思。一个是夜里天上亮亮的月亮。一个是一年里的一段时间。
reviewer_notes: Reject：核心不可用。句子本身质量尚可，但定义和指纹描述的是两个义项，而句子只覆盖时段义，月亮义没有句子。建议删除本义项；若需要月亮义，应单独建立义项并配月亮句子。
reviewer_issues: /core/definition: 定义是元叙述“月有两个意思”，同时描述“夜里天上的月亮”和“一年里的一段时间”。十个句子全部只用时段义，月亮义没有任何句子支持，违反“一个句子一个义项”。; /core/sense_fingerprint: 指纹混合两个义项，与句子实际用法不符。; /core/sentences: 十个句子都是时段义，与85684几乎完全重复，形成两个实质相同的义项。; /variants/A/level_1/options/1: “决”（jué）与 yuè 的声母、韵母、声调都不同，不构成听感混淆，在听音题中无效。

definition: “后”是说在另一个东西的背面，或者时间比较晚。
reviewer_notes: Rejected: the core is unusable as one sense. The gloss merges 方位 and 时间, and the document duplicates 85696. Patching sentences would not fix the sense split, so no patches are returned. On regeneration, use one locative sense and one temporal sense with disjoint sentence sets. The plan's blocks match the document (A L3=0, A L6=3, B L3=6, B L6=9, synonym A=3, B=9, L7 indices [0,1,2] and [6,7,9]), but the plan will need rerunning after regeneration. Level_6 wrongs mix collocation errors (明天后, 昨天后) with 后面/后来 compounds; these are not sense-based and would need rebuilding with the split.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss joins two senses with 或者: locative 背面 (门后, 房子后, 桌子后, 那棵树后, 山后) and temporal 之后 (下课后, 三天后, 饭后, 一个月后, 毕业后). The document therefore violates 'one sense per document' because the sentences mix both readings.; core.sentences: Sense 85696 has the same lemma and essentially the same gloss, and many sentences overlap (三天后, 下课后, 饭后/吃饭后, 一个月后/一年后). Two sense_ids cover one meaning, so exercises would duplicate.; core.definition: The definition is a meta-description (“后”是说…) rather than a gloss, unlike the other senses in this set.; core.semantic_class: abstract here, function in 85696, for the same lemma and essentially the same meaning.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 门中有一只小猫 is loosely defensible (a cat in the doorway?), so 中 is a borderline distractor.; variants.A.level_1.options[2]: 号 hào differs from hòu in two segments (a/o and o/u), not in a tone-only or one-phoneme contrast. Borderline.

definition: 方位词，表示背面的位置，或指较晚的时间。
reviewer_notes: Rejected: the core is unusable as one sense and duplicates 85695. If the split keeps 85696 as the directional sense, the L1 (B: 好 → 喉), L3 (A: 内) and directional sentences need revision. Correct indices and plan blocks match the document (A L3=0, A L6=3, B L3=6, B L6=9, L7 [0,1,2] and [6,7,9]). The 往后 sentences fit 背面的位置 only loosely (direction vs position). Level_6 A and B wrongs mix collocation errors (明天后, 昨天后, 一个月后面) with 后面/后来 compounds; they are not sense-based and should be rebuilt with the split.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss joins directional 背面 and temporal 较晚的时间 with 或指. Sentences 0, 1, 4, 7 (往后) are directional; sentences 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9 are temporal. The document violates 'one sense per document'.; core.sentences: Duplicates sense 85695: 三天后我要去北京 ≈ 三天后，我要去北京; 下课后 and 吃饭后/饭后 and 一年后/一个月后 overlap. Two sense_ids cover one meaning.; core.semantic_class: function here, abstract in 85695, for the same lemma and essentially the same meaning.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 内 fits 请往内退一步 defensibly (往内 is written-register but acceptable). The explanation's register argument is weak, so the distractor is not clearly wrong.; variants.B.level_1.options[2]: 好 hǎo differs from hòu in both tone and vowel (ao vs ou), so it is not a tone-only or one-phoneme confusable. The explanation itself admits both differ. This fails the keep rule for listening confusables.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 一年下 is not grammatical without 来 (一年下来), so the distractor is borderline. Explanation is accurate.

definition: 疑问代词，用来询问事物或原因；也可表示不确定的事物。
reviewer_notes: The core is incoherent, so the exercise blocks cannot be pinned to one sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two distinct senses: asking a reason (你笑什么) and indefinite reference (想吃点什么). The sentences split between them, and sentences 5 (什么也没说) and 7 (有什么就吃什么) drift into a third use, universal reference (任指).; variants.*.level_6 / level_7: level_6 tests the interrogative 'who vs what' use (sense 85703). level_7 tests 任指 什么也+negation. Neither tests this sense.

definition: “日”是太阳，也是一天的意思。
reviewer_notes: The core conflates the 'sun' and 'day' senses, so no variant can be pinned to one sense. Regenerate after splitting. The level_1 distractors (立, 意, 四, 是, 字, 历, 亿, 寺, 世) are acceptable one-phoneme initial contrasts with the same tone.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition pins two separate senses: 太阳 (sun) and 一天 / 日期 (day). The sense_fingerprint does the same. A ladder must teach exactly one sense.; core.sentences: The sentences mix the two senses. Sentences 0, 1, 7 and 9 use 日 as 'day'. Sentences 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 8 use it as 'sun'. Sentence 0 (一日之计在于晨) is a fixed proverb, which fails the 整义 test. Sentence 5 (夸父追日) is a set idiom or myth reference.; core.sentences[3]: Register and naturalness. 看见日 and 日已经下山了 (sentence 4) are unnatural; modern speech uses 太阳. Plain T3 sentences also clash with the declared 书面语 register.; core.sentences[0].furigana: A furigana field holds pinyin on a Chinese sentence (also on sentences 7 and 8). This is a wrong-language field.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences: The wrong sentences are wrong for reasons unrelated to the word's sense contrast (这个日很好吃). The level_7 correct_sentence_indices also mix the two senses.; variants.A.level_3: The anchor is the fixed proverb 一日之计在于晨, so the blank tests idiom recall, not the word.

definition: 太阳；也指白天，或二十四小时的一天。
reviewer_notes: 核心与 85705 高度重复，两者都覆盖太阳与一天。在 85705 之外保留本核心会造成重复练习。这里的核心不可用，因为其定义没有覆盖超过一半的核心句，所以不作补丁。若课程决定保留日期义，应重新界定义项边界并重新规划。上面列出的变体问题在义项重划之前不必修补。
reviewer_issues: core.sentences[0,2,5,7,8]: 五个核心句（三月八日、四月二日、六月一日、十二月三十一日、写好年月日）用的是日期义，而定义与指纹只写了太阳、白天、二十四小时的一天，未列日期义。该义项与 85705 的“一天，也用于日期”几乎完全重叠，两个义项无法区分。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “天上挂着一只日”的错误是量词误用，属于 level_7 的错误类型，不是义项辨析。level_6 应考察语义误用。; variants.B.level_1.options[3]: 惹（rě，三声）与日（rì，四声）声调和韵母都不同，不属于声调混淆或最小对立对，不应作为听音辨字的干扰项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “我会说日，也会说英语。”中的日指日语，是另一个义项，句子在该义项下语法上也勉强可接受，不是这个义项的干净错误句。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2].explanation: 解释称“日”单独不作副词表示每天，但“日益”“日渐”等固定组合中日是副词，此说法不严谨。

definition: 指示代词，指较近的某个人或事物。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的理由是重复，而不是内容不可用：与 85707 为同一义项（指示代词，指离说话人近的人或物），发音相同，练习结构与 B 级 6 的错误句几乎逐字相同。请只保留一个 sense。若保留本条，上面的问题需要修正。本次未打补丁。
reviewer_issues: variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 说明称“俺”与“此处的书面语气不合”，但锚定句“这个是我的新手机。”是中性口语，此说明不准确。真正的错误原因是指说话人自己，不能与物品对应。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “你这个高”在口语中可用“这个＋形容词”表程度，母语者可能接受，不能确定为错误句。

definition: “她”是说一个不在这里的女孩或女人。
reviewer_notes: No patches, since the core is a duplicate. If 85715 is kept despite this, apply the 85716 patches to it. No sentence has source 'mined'.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This is a duplicate of sense 85716 (the same third-person female pronoun 她). The restriction “不在这里” is also contradicted by sentence 4 “她在看书，你别说话”, where 她 is present.; variants.A.level_1.options[3]: “那”（nà）与 tā differs in both initial and tone, so it is not a minimal pair or a pure tone confusion.; variants.B.level_1.options[1-4]: 打, 拿, 大, 答 each differ from tā in both initial and tone. None is a minimal pair or a pure tone confusion, so the B listening block has no valid distractors.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “你今天的表现很好，她一定会高兴”can read 她 as a third party, so it is not clearly wrong.

definition: “之”和“的”差不多，用在两个词中间。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 85736, which has the broader definition and covers the same meaning. Regenerate only if the pipeline wants a distinct 之 meaning (for example pronoun 他/它), which would need new sentences. Level_6 is a semantic-discrimination exercise, but a single structural sense gives it no sense contrast, so its wrong items are register-based and weak.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 85736 (结构助词，相当于“的”). The two cards share identical level_1 and level_3 options and near-identical level_6 and level_7 items, so this is a duplicate sense.; core.definition: “用在两个词中间” is imprecise, since 之 joins a modifier to its head, and the definition is circular (“和“的”差不多”).; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “我们学校之图书馆很大。” is grammatical in written Chinese. The explanation itself only says 不自然, so this is not a wrong sentence.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “他的学习之成绩很好。” is grammatical in written Chinese. The explanation only says 不自然.

definition: 助词，用在动词后面，表示动作已经完成或曾经经历。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as an independent sense, so no patches. If the sense is rescoped, A's level_3 needs a fix: 着 gives a grammatical sentence (我吃着早饭了，你吃了吗？), so it is not clearly wrong. B's level_1 decline is not reported here.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 85739. Its definition (表示动作已经完成或曾经经历) and most sentences (见过, 学过, 住过, 听过) teach the same experiential 过. Only sentences 0 (吃过早饭了) and 5 (做过了) are completion readings. Two senses for one grammatical use would teach the same thing twice.

definition: “由”是说事情是谁来做，或者是从哪里来的。
reviewer_notes: This is a multi-sense core: agent, source/route, and material. Regenerate after pinning one sense. The level_1 distractors in A and B are clean tone contrasts. The level_7 items (被由, 在由) are valid single errors and could be reused if they fit the pinned sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition and fingerprint combine at least two distinct prepositional senses. One is 由 introducing the agent (由小李安排). The other is 由 = 从, a starting point or route (由公园门口进去). The sentences also use a third use, 由…做成/组成 for material or composition (sentence 6).; core.sentences[2]: In 这条路由南向北, the characters 路由 read as the compound 路由 ('router'), a segmentation trap. The sentence is also the source/direction sense.; core.sentences[5]: In 故事由一个小男孩说起, 由 is ambiguous between agent and starting point.; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: Index 3 is the source sense while A.level_3 tests the agent sense. The variant does not teach one sense.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: In 我由你买了一本书, the explanation is muddled: it says 由 would be read as 'you bought the book'. That makes the sentence arguably interpretable rather than cleanly wrong.

definition: 介词，表示行为的施动者、来源或起点，相当于“被”“从”。
reviewer_notes: 核心存在两个结构性问题。第一，两个核心句（3 与 6）使用的组成义不在定义之内，而且它们分别是 A 的 level_6 正确句和 B 的 level_3 挖空句，所以不是局部错误。第二，本义项与 85747 重复。任何一个单句替换都会牵动 level_3 的被选项或 level_6 的正确句，因此不适合用补丁修复。其他区块中，A 的 level_1 与 B 的 level_1 无误，level_7 的被由双标错误成立，但它们依赖的核心句已不可用。
reviewer_issues: core.sentences[3]: “这个班由二十个学生组成。”用的是组成（构成）义，定义与指纹只写施动者、来源、起点，并相当于被、从。组成义不在其内，且“被”不能替换它。; core.sentences[6]: “水由氢和氧组成。”同样是组成义，与定义不符。它也是 B 的 level_3 挖空句，且 level_7 B 的 correct_sentence_indices 依赖它。; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: A 的 level_6 以组成义句作为唯一正确句，而该句不在本义项的定义之内，正确句的依据不成立。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 被是 B 的 level_3 选项之一。目前“水被氢和氧组成”不通，所以被是正确的干扰项；但若把句子换成可被动的施动者句，被就会变得同样正确。; core.sense_fingerprint: 本义项与 85747 基本重复，二者都是由引出施动者、起点，并用于同一批句型。两个 由 义项没有可区分的边界。

definition: 助词，用在动词前，与“为”“被”等配合，或与动词构成名词性短语。
reviewer_notes: The core fails the one-sense requirement and overlaps 85757. It needs regeneration rather than patching. The individual option blocks are otherwise mostly sound: the 为……所 L3, L6 and L7 items are correct. B.level_1 is declined; that is final.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition bundles two distinct uses: the passive 为……所 and the nominalizing 所+V. Sentences 0–2 and 9 are passive; sentences 3–8 are nominalizing and duplicate sense 85757. A single sense is not pinned, so the exercises mix senses. For example, B.level_3 (nominal) and B.level_6 (passive) teach different things.

definition: 指示代词，指示较远的人、事物、时间或地点。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core duplicates 85763. No patches are supplied; the issues above are listed in case the sense is re-cut later.
reviewer_issues: core: This sense duplicates 85763. Both define 那 as pointing to a distant person or thing, and the level_1 distractors are identical. The time and place uses are not a separate sense, so a learner gets two senses teaching the same contrast.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 那个杯子离我很远 contradicts 却握在我的手里. The sentence is wrong for a reason unrelated to 那.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 那朵花离我很远 contradicts 却开在我的窗前. The sentence is wrong for a reason unrelated to 那.; variants.B.level_1: B declines with no_minimal_pairs, but 那 has real tone and initial minimal pairs, as the A block shows.; core.sentences[9]: The B level_6 correct sentence 那是谁的手机？放在桌子上。 ends with a bare imperative clause that is awkward and weakens the anchor.

definition: 代词，指代前面提到的人或事物，相当于“他（她、它）的”“他们的”。
reviewer_notes: The sentences mostly pass L1, L3, L6 and L7 on their own, but the sense cannot stand alone because it duplicates 85769. Do not patch; merge into 85769 instead.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates sense 85769 (其 = 他的 / 它的 / 他们的). Chinese 其 does not mark number, so a plural antecedent is not a separate sense. The core and fingerprint differ only in the number of the referent.; sentences[5]: “公司提出了新计划，并说明了其目的。” has a singular antecedent (计划), which contradicts the fingerprint's claim that the sense covers 含多数 referents.

definition: 连词，表示转折，引出与前文相反或有所限制的意思。
reviewer_notes: 内容大体与 85785 相近，因整体舍弃而未做修补。若将来需要保留其中的部分句子，A 的 level_7 句“天很冷，但是所以孩子们还在外面玩。”等可作参考。计划 active_levels 含 2 而无 level_2 块，与其他义项相同。
reviewer_issues: sense: 与 85785 重复：同为转折连词“但是”，定义和指纹几乎相同，学习者会在两个义项中学到同一个义项。

definition: 前缀，加在数词前面表示次序。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 85787. Retire 85788 and keep 85787, which has the fuller definition and the cleaner blocks. The B-side blocks (level_1, level_3 第一次见面, level_6, level_7) are otherwise sound, but duplicating a sense adds nothing and doubles exposure to the same contrast.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicates 85787. Both describe the same sense: ordinal prefix before a numeral. Two senses for one meaning produce redundant exercises and overlapping sentences (第一天 / 第一次 cover the same ground as 85787).; core.pos: 助词 is wrong for 第; it is a 前缀.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 首 is defensibly correct in 首一天上课 under a register-only objection. The explanation admits only a register difference.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 这家门第很高，很讲究礼数 is natural Chinese (门第 = family background), so it is not an error.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 那座府第很高 is natural Chinese (府第 = residence), so it is not an error.

definition: 连词，连接并列的词语或短语，常用于最后一项之前。
reviewer_notes: 内容与 85791 相近，并有同样的错误：A 的 level_6 错句“这道题连老师以及学生都不会做。”的解释称“以及”表示“甚至”，这是错误的。B 的 level_7 错句“我们买了面包、牛奶、以及水果。”中的“、以及”是否属于明确错误存在争议，若保留需换成更明确的错误。因整体舍弃而未做修补。
reviewer_issues: sense: 与 85791 重复：同为并列连词“以及”，定义和指纹几乎相同，学习者会在两个义项中学到同一个义项。

definition: 代词，指所说事物以外的别的人或事物。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 85795. The level-specific issues above apply only if this sense is retained. Plan blocks match the document. Declined blocks (level_1 A and B) were left alone.
reviewer_issues: variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 我有一个其他的朋友住在上海 is acceptable Chinese, so it is not a clean wrong sentence.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 他是我的好朋友，其他很喜欢我 has a coherent reading (the others like me), so the stated reason is false.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 我的东西都很贵，其他便宜 is grammatical with a coherent meaning. The explanation that 其他 cannot be a predicate is false.; sense 85796 as a whole: This sense duplicates 85795 (same meaning 'other than what was mentioned', same fingerprint, same morphological forms). Two senses for one meaning would teach the same item twice.

reviewer_notes: 拒收仅因义项重复。其 variants.A.level_6 的错误句“这所学校今天都举办一次运动会。”与 85921 完全相同。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 85921 义项重复：“说话时的这一天”与“我们现在过的这一天”指同一义项，两条练习会把同一义项教两次。

definition: 量词，用于计算年龄。
reviewer_notes: 判为 reject 的理由是重复义项，并非内容有误。其余内容（句子、level_1、level_3、level_7）经检查基本合格。若该义项被保留，应按上述第二条问题修改 A 的 level_6。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 85923 是同一个义项：「岁」作计算年龄的量词（同为 量词、function，指纹同样是计算年龄的量词）。这是重复义项，不应作为独立的练习单元存在。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 「这台电脑已经买了三岁了」与 85923 的同类问题相同：物品用「岁」的说法在口语中可以接受，且「买了三岁了」的搭配也很生硬，不是干净的错句。

definition: 副词，表示不确定的时间，如果有一天；也指一天之间。
reviewer_notes: The sentences are grammatical for the conditional sense, so the content is not wrong; the sense is redundant. No patches are proposed. Do not merge its blocks into 85941 without checking them against 85941's, since they test the same meaning.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 85941: same conditional adverb 一旦 (假设…就…), same kind of sentences, and an equivalent sense_fingerprint. The second clause 也指一天之间 is not exemplified by any sentence and is a different (noun) sense, so the definition bundles two senses in one document.

definition: 悬在高处；使物体借助钩子等悬空。
reviewer_notes: This is a core problem, so I am rejecting the sense rather than patching it. 85952 and 85951 are the same lexical sense. The only difference is that 85952's sentences are the 挂着 stative use, which is aspect and not a separate dictionary sense. Keeping both makes the level_1, level_3, level_6, level_7 and relation exercises teach the same contrast twice, and the two senses would compete for the same distractor logic. The sentences can be reused as additional examples under 85951. Borderline items for the merge: sentence 6 他的包挂在椅子上 does not clearly show 高处, and B level_6 wrong sentence 他把被子挂在身上
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 85951. Both define the same meaning (hang something up so it is suspended in a high place). The second clause 使物体借助钩子等悬空 is the causative meaning already carried by 85951.; core.sense_fingerprint: The fingerprint 物体悬在高处的状态 is a grammatical state (挂着) of the same sense, not a distinct sense. The 挂着/挂了 contrast is aspect, which the morphological_forms already cover.

definition: 像雪一样的颜色；与黑相对。
reviewer_notes: Blocks would otherwise pass review (level_1 real-word distractors, level_3 options with one correct, level_6 color errors, level_7 on-target errors, antonym options with 黑 as the only antonym). No patches are proposed because the sense is redundant, and patching a duplicate would only keep two copies of the same exercise.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 85955: both gloss 白 as the color of snow/white (像雪…的颜色). 与黑相对 is an antonym relation, not a second sense, so the sense is redundant with 85955.

definition: 介词，引出动作或态度所针对的对象。
reviewer_notes: 该义项与 85957 是同一个介词的重复切分，且定义与自身的层级 6 解释矛盾。若要保留“态度对象”这一用法，需要重建：定义限定在“对某人或某事的态度、感情”，去除话题框架句，重新设计层级 3 的干扰项（“面对”需替换），并确保 variants.A.level_6 的解释与定义一致。这些改动会改变大部分句子和练习块，因此不做局部补丁。建议优先并入 85957。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义称“对于”引出“动作”所针对的对象，但本文档自身的 variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0] 解释为“‘对于’不能引出说话的对象”。定义与该文档自身的语法判断相矛盾。; core.sense_fingerprint: 与 85957 的“引出所谈论的人或事”属于同一功能（“对于X来说”/“对于X”）。这一义项是对同一介词的过度切分，学习者无法可靠地区分两者。; core.sentences[9]: “对于老人的要求，我们要认真对待”是典型的话题框架句，属于 85957 的义项，不是态度对象义项。; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: “面对”可以填入“妈妈___我的选择没有意见”，语法成立且意思接近（面对……没有意见），是可辩护的正确选项，违反干扰项要求。

definition: 计时的小型器具，多戴在手腕上；也指表格。
reviewer_notes: Rejected: the core covers two senses and cannot be used as one. Regenerate as a 表格-only sense with form sentences and form morphology, then rerun fat_seed_runner plan and rebuild the blocks. The plan must be regenerated because the sentences and morphological_forms change.
reviewer_issues: core.definition and core.sense_fingerprint: Merges two senses in one entry: 计时的小型器具 (wearable watch, which is sense 85963) and 表格 (form). This fails the one-sense rule at the core.; core.sentences[2], core.sentences[4], core.sentences[5], core.sentences[8]: Watch-sense sentences (手腕上的表, 快了十分钟, 买了一块便宜的表, 妈妈的表停了) sit in a document otherwise about 表格.; core.morphological_forms: 块 (watch classifier) and 手表 (watch compound) belong to the watch sense. A form-sense entry would carry 张 and 表格.; variants.A.level_1.options[2], [4], [5]: 飘, 票, 包 each differ from 表 by two segments, and 报 differs in medial and tone. None is listening-confusable.; variants.B.level_1.options[1-4]: 百, 边, 比, 变 each differ by two or more segments. None survives the minimal-pair test.; variants.B.level_7: The error (“填了好”) sits on the verb complement and does not involve the target 表, so it fails the target-involvement check.

definition: 领是把别人带着走，或者把东西拿过来。
reviewer_notes: Rejected: two senses are merged in one core, and the sense overlaps 85972. Regenerate after the sense inventory is deduplicated. Borderline and not reported as a defect: B level_7 “他把包裹领了走” is colloquially heard, but “领走了” is the standard form, so the error is weak.
reviewer_issues: core.definition and core.sense_fingerprint: Merges two senses: 带领 (lead; sentences 0, 1, 2, 5, 6, 8) and 领取 (collect; sentences 3, 4, 7, 9 such as 领钥匙, 领包裹, 领书, 领票). One document cannot teach both.; sense inventory (cross-document): The 带领 sense is duplicated in 85972, and 领取 overlaps with 85972's 接受/取得 sense. The same meaning is spread across two sense IDs.; variants.A.level_1.options[4]: 林 (lín) differs from 领 in final (-in vs -ing) and tone, two segments, so it fails the minimal-pair test.; variants.B.level_1.options[2], [3]: 连 (lián) and 立 (lì) each differ from 领 by two or more segments. B level_1 keeps only 礼 and 灵, which is below the three distractors a four-option item needs.

definition: 带领；引导；也指接受、取得。
reviewer_notes: Rejected: two senses are merged, and the sense overlaps 85971. Regenerate after the sense inventory is deduplicated, then rebuild the level_1 and level_7 blocks.
reviewer_issues: core.definition and core.sense_fingerprint: Merges two senses: 带领引导 (lead; sentences 3, 5, 6, 8) and 接受/取得 (receive; sentences 0, 1, 2, 4, 7, 9). This fails the one-sense rule.; sense inventory (cross-document): Duplicates 85971: the 带领 sense appears in both, and 接受/取得 overlaps 85971's 领取.; variants.A.level_1.options[3]: 林 differs from 领 by two segments (final and tone).; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “我去财务处回领了押金”: 回领 is an established verb (凭票回领, 回领押金), so this 'incorrect' sentence is arguably acceptable. The item fails the validity check.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 吃: “吃工资” is a colloquial idiom, so the distractor is borderline with 领工资 in this blank.; variants.B.level_1.options[2], [3]: 连 and 立 differ from 领 by two or more segments. B keeps only 礼 and 灵.

definition: 名词，指说话时的这一段时间。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of sense 85977. The sentences are otherwise fine and the level_6 and level_7 blocks are mostly sound, but a second copy of the same sense would teach the same item twice. Keep 85977, whose patched level_7 covers the defect that this document shares.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as sense 85977 (说话时的这段时间 / 现在这个时候). The two documents teach one sense twice.; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: For the anchor sentence 目前我住在上海, 以前我住在上海 is grammatical and natural as a past-fact sentence. The explanation that it contradicts the 现状 reading is contestable, so the distractor is not clearly wrong.; variants.B.level_7.error_description: The rule that 目前 cannot take 的 is overgeneralised. The document's own correct sentence 他目前的工作很忙 uses 目前的 as a modifier. Only 的 before 很 and an adjective is wrong here.

definition: 较低的位置；也指接着的部分。
reviewer_notes: Reject. The core fuses two senses, and the locative half duplicates 85987 (core sentence 0 我住在二楼，朋友住在我下面 is the same use as 85987 sentence 7). The L6 contrast cannot be defined against a definition that covers both senses. Patching would effectively invent a new sense, so split the sense inventory first, then regenerate.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 较低的位置；也指接着的部分 merges two senses. The locative half duplicates sense 85987, and the 接着 half is a different use.; core.pos: pos is 名词, but the sequence uses (下面请…, 下面是…, 下面我来说…) are adverbial. variants.B.level_7 explanation itself calls it 副词性用法, which contradicts the pos field.; core.sentences: Sentences 0, 4, 5, 7 and 8 use the locative sense, while 2, 3, 6 and 9 use the sequence sense. Sentence 1 (请大家看下面这张图) is ambiguous. The sentence set is not one sense.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 我下面的房子很大 is a legitimate locative use under the definition this record gives, so it cannot be a wrong sentence.

definition: 路、途径；也指方法、道理。
reviewer_notes: Reject. Half the sentence set (2, 3, 4, 7, 9) uses the concrete road sense already taught in 86011. The blocks keyed to index 3 (level_6 A) and index 9 (level_6 B) therefore point to the wrong sense. Fixing this needs regenerated method or principle sentences rather than node patches, and the sense also needs to be kept distinct from 86011. Several level_6 distractors (道观, 道歉, 道义, 道人) are natural Chinese in other senses and cannot be treated as errors.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences[2]: 山里的道很窄，要小心 is the concrete road sense, not the 做事的路子 sense in sense_fingerprint. It fails the one-sense rule.; core.sentences[3]: 这条道通向山顶 is the concrete road sense. It is also variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index and synonym_antonym sentence_index, so the taught answer is keyed to the wrong sense.; core.sentences[4]: 前面的道断了，我们回去吧 is the concrete road sense.; core.sentences[7]: 这条道太远，咱们换条近的 describes a physical route, not a method.; core.sentences[9]: 你别挡着道，让大家先过去 is the concrete road sense. It is also variants.B.level_6.correct_sentence_index, so the taught answer is keyed to the wrong sense.; core.sentences[1]: 他走的是另一条道 is ambiguous between the literal road and the method sense.; core.definition: Overlaps 86011 (道 = road). Half the sentences here are road usages, so the two senses are not separated in practice.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 这座道观香火很旺 is natural Chinese (道观 = Daoist temple). It is not an error.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 他向大家道了歉 is natural Chinese (道歉 uses 道 = 说). It is not an error.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 这人太不讲道义了 is natural Chinese (道义). It is not an error.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 庙里来

definition: 连词，表示一件事结束后紧接着发生另一件事。
reviewer_notes: 判为 reject 的主要理由是重复义项。其余内容：A 和 B 的 level_3、level_6 正确句、level_7 纠错句均经检查，A 的 level_7（「再然后」）与 B 的（「然后然后」）均为唯一错误，正确句索引无误，未发现 mined 句子。若该义项被保留，应按上述第二、三条修改 B 的 level_6。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 86021 是同一义项：「然后」作连词，表示先后相继的两个动作（指纹「连接两个先后发生的动作，后一件紧跟前一件」与 86021 的「做完一件事，再接着做另一件事」实质相同）。这是重复义项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 「他很认真，然后很努力」语法上勉强可读，母语者可能接受，不是干净的错句。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 「孩子一边哭，然后一边笑」与 86021 B 的同类问题相同：两个动作是先后相继的，句子可接受，解释「同时进行」与句意不符。

definition: 国王是一个国家里最大的人，住在城堡里。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 86024. The sentences are otherwise fine. Also, variants.B.level_7 incorrect sentence 宝藏国王藏起来了 can read as a grammatical topic-comment (宝藏，国王藏起来了) without the comma, so its error is not clean. Not patched because the record is rejected.
reviewer_issues: core: This record duplicates 86024: both give the monarch-as-ruler meaning. The only difference is register (口语 vs 中性), which does not make a separate sense.; core.definition: 国家里最大的人，住在城堡里 is not an accurate gloss. Kings are not necessarily the biggest person in a country, and living in a castle is a stereotype, not part of the meaning. The sense_fingerprint repeats this.

definition: 担任组织、带领工作的人；作动词时指带领、率领。
reviewer_notes: 核心问题在于义项本身：名词与动词合并为一个 sense，并与 86045 的名词义项重叠，无法通过补丁修复，因此判为 reject。level_7 的错误句（量词“本”、体标“着”）本身是干净的，但在重新编目后需要重新验证。plan 未重新运行。
reviewer_issues: core.pos / core.definition: 同一义项混合了动词用法（如“他领导这家公司”“谁来领导这个项目”）与名词用法（如“大家都选她当领导”），core.pos 仅标“名词”，与超过半数句子的词性不符。; core.sentences[8]: “在他的领导下”中的“领导”指“领导工作”（抽象义），超出“担任组织、带领工作的人”的定义，属于义项漂移。; core.sentences[2,3,5,6,9]: 名词用法与 86045 的名词义项几乎完全重复，两个 sense_id 之间没有清晰的义项边界。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “妈妈领导孩子过马路”中的“领导”可理解为“带领”，定义中已包含该义，句子在此义下可接受，不是确定的错误句。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “这家饭店的领导每天都很早来开门”中的店主可理解为带领员工的人，并非确定错误。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “这家理发店的领导手艺很好”中的店长或主理人符合“带领工作的人”的定义，句子并非确定错误。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “这条街的领导每天很早就打扫街道”可理解为带领清洁队，句子在定义下可接受。

definition: 党是有很多想法一样的人聚在一起的组织。
reviewer_notes: Reject: the sense has no valid, separable meaning, and its examples are the political-party sense. Keeping it alongside 86052 creates a homograph trap. Its level_1 and level_3 options are sound, but they depend on a sense that should not ship. Sense 86052 covers the word.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The sense 想法一样的人聚在一起的组织 / 想法相同的人自愿聚在一起形成的小团体 is not a separate dictionary sense of 党. It is a loose extension of the political-party sense and duplicates sense 86052.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 班里的同学组成了一个党 fits this sense's own definition (a group of like-minded people), so the sentence is not wrong by the sense taught. The explanation says 党 means a political organisation, which contradicts the definition in the document.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 我们班的党 has the same defect as wrong[0]: a class of like-minded people is acceptable under this definition, and the explanation contradicts it.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 这个党每个星期都打篮球 describes a sports club of like-minded members, which fits the sense as written, while the explanation calls this a sports club and says 党 cannot mean one.; sentences: Most sentences are political (主张保护环境, 讨论政策, 减税, 大学时加入一个党 as 入党). These read as the 86052 sense, not the club sense. Sentence 2 is ambiguous to a Chinese reader, who would take 加入一个党 as joining the Party.

definition: 量词，用于书籍、本子等。
reviewer_notes: The block items read as correct on inspection, so the reject rests on the duplicate core alone. No patch offered because the core is unusable as a separate sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 86061: 量词 for 书/本子, with the same pos, register, pronunciation and fingerprint scope. Two senses for one measure-word meaning would give learners two identical items.

definition: 四个方向之一，太阳升起的方向；也指亚洲。
reviewer_notes: The core cannot be used as written. Other defects will matter on regeneration. In A L6, '我去过一只东方 → 亚洲' is a bad item: the swap is a near-synonym, and the error is the classifier. A L3 ('东方是四个方向之一') and B L7 ('东方的天空') test the direction sense, not the region sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses: the compass direction and 'Asia / the East'. The sentences then split between them. Sentences 0, 1 and 9 use the direction sense, and sentences 2–8 use the region sense. This breaks the one-sense rule. The direction sense also duplicates 86073.

definition: 副词，立刻。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of sense 86087, which has the fuller definition. If the pipeline needs both entries, rewrite core.definition as a real gloss and make sense_fingerprint distinct; I did not review variant patches because the core is rejected. Sentences 5 and 8 carry furigana fields that the other senses lack, so check the pipeline accepts them.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 86087 为同一义项（立即＝立刻，表示马上）。定义“副词，立刻。”是循环的，且没有实际释义。两个义项教同一个意思，会把学习者的练习拆散。

definition: 把东西放进容器中；也指打扮、假装。
reviewer_notes: Reject rather than patch: the core covers two senses, so editing options cannot make the block set valid. Re-author the 假装 sense as its own sense row with its own sentences, re-plan it, and rely on 86091 for the container sense. The issues above are recorded for reference.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition and fingerprint merge two senses: container-filling (把东西放进容器) and pretend/dress-up (假装、打扮). Sentences 3, 6 and 8 use 假装 and the rest use the container sense, which breaks the one-sense rule. The container sense also duplicates 86091. 打扮 has no example sentence at all.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 装了自己的紧张 is acceptable Chinese, and the explanation that 装 cannot take a feeling as object is false (装镇定, 装高兴 are standard; sentence 6 itself uses 装得很高兴).; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 纳 fits the blank in meaning (收纳/纳入) and is ruled out only on register, so it is defensibly correct. Same defect as 86091.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 装在墙上 can read as mounting or installing, so the sentence is not clearly wrong. The same applies to variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1] (装在门上, which can read as installing).; core.morphological_forms[4]: The label mixes traditional 為 into a simplified-script label. Listing 装 as its own morphological form is also redundant.

definition: 不只是说不但是这样，还有别的。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core duplicates sense 86098, so one of the two should be dropped. Per the reject rule, no patches are given. If the team keeps this sense instead of 86098, the four listed issues need patches. The plan blocks match the document.
reviewer_issues: core.sense_fingerprint: This sense has the same 不仅 meaning as sense 86098 under a second ID. The two documents duplicate each other, so a learner would be tested on one meaning twice.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: The explanation says 不只是 means 仅仅是. That is false: 不只是 means not merely, which is the opposite of the limiting sense of 仅仅.; variants.A.level_7.error_description: The claim that 不只 must be followed by 是 or a 分句 is muddled. 不只 can directly precede a verb phrase, as in 不只会说英语，还会说法语.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “不只是我的错，而是你的错” is acceptable. 不只是……而是…… is a standard pattern meaning not merely A but B, so this is a false wrong sentence.

definition: 动词，叫、称呼；也指用秤量重量。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项不可用：一个 sense 混合了两个读音、两个义项。补丁无法修复，需要拆分为称重义（chèng）和称呼义（chēng），后者并入 86099。因为核心不可用，各变体未逐一判题。该 sense 的 level_3 句子“请你把这袋米称一下”在称重义下是合理的，可在拆分后的新 sense 中复用。
reviewer_issues: core.pronunciation: “用秤量重量”这一义项的读音应为 chèng（第四声），不是 chēng。core 中 pronunciation 与 ipa 均按 chēng 标注，对该义项是错误的。; core.definition: 同一个 sense 合并了两个义项：“叫、称呼”（chēng）与“用秤量重量”（chèng）。违反每个句子只用一个义项的规则，sense_fingerprint 也同样合并了两者。; core.sentences: sentences 0 到 4 是称重义（请你把这袋米称一下、称了两斤苹果等），sentences 5 到 9 是称呼义，两种义项混在一起。sentences 5 到 9 与 86099 的称呼义句子大量重复。; variants.A.level_1.options[2]: 干扰项“秤”（chèng）恰好是目标字在称重义下的读音，不是中性干扰项。按 chēng 发音的 level_1 题会让学习者在错误的读音基础上作答。

definition: 厂是很多人一起做东西的大房子。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only because it duplicates 86102. If the sense inventory intends two entries, this rejection should be reversed and the issues above fixed. I could not run the planner.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 86102 (制造或加工产品的场所). Both gloss the same 'factory' meaning, so a learner would get one meaning as two lessons. The sentences overlap; e.g. 我们厂做的鞋卖到很多国家 is 86102's meaning.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences: All three wrong sentences are measure-word errors (一把/一条/这台), not sense errors, so this semantic_discrimination item tests classifiers instead.

definition: 副词，表示合乎情理、没有疑问。
reviewer_notes: The answer-sense content (你可以来吗？当然可以。, 当然没问题, 当然，我会准时到。) is valid and worth keeping, but this document cannot be patched into a clean sense because its definition and most sentences belong to 86107. Regenerate the sense with a distinct definition and sentence set. Plan not re-run (no tool access).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Definition 合乎情理，没有疑问 is the same meaning as 86107 (理应如此). Sentences 2 through 8 (他是中国人，当然会说汉语 and the rest) use 当然 in the 理所应当 sense, not the answer/affirmation sense this definition names. The sense duplicates 86107 for most of its content.; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: In 冬天到了，天气___会冷, 便 (and 果然) fit both grammatically and in meaning, so the anchor sentence has more than one defensible answer. The sentence itself also uses 当然 in the 理所应当 sense, not this sense.; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: 诚然 can mean 确实 and can answer 可以 in a literary register, so 你可以来吗？___可以。 has a weak distractor. The stated reason (no 但是 partner) is not the only reason it fails.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: The fix 大概 yields 答案大概一定是三, which is self-contradictory because 大概 and 一定 cannot both qualify the same claim. definition: 把外面的东西拿回来；接受；聚拢。
reviewer_notes: The level_6 wrong-sentence explanations cite 'put away' while the sense says 'accept', so they are inconsistent. Sentence 5 carries a stray 'furigana' field, which does not apply to zh.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition bundles three distinct senses: 拿回来, 接受 and 聚拢. The sentences span them all: accepting (收钱、收礼物), harvesting (收麦子), putting away (收伞、收被子 — which duplicates 86123) and collecting (收作业). The rule is one pinned sense per document.

definition: 日里是白天的时候。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 86128. Other issues are recorded for the case where the sense inventory keeps this entry instead. Declined blocks were left alone.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 86128 (白天；日间). Both entries teach 白天 with the same fingerprint, so this is a duplicate sense.; core.sentences[0]: 日里是白天，不是晚上 is a definitional sentence that restates the gloss. It is used as the level_3 cloze and as a correct item in level_7, so the answer can be read off the sentence.; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 深夜 is borderline. 深夜妈妈去上班 is a plausible night-shift reading, so it is not clearly wrong.; core.sentences[5]: Only sentence 5 carries a furigana field. The field is inconsistent across the sentence list.

definition: 监狱是关坏人的地方。
reviewer_notes: 除重复外，句子与各题块也已核对：level_3、level_6、level_7 的选项与解释均成立，无可辩护的正确干扰项。该文档的 morphological_forms 中裸量词“座”与 86142 存在相同问题。应以 86142 为准。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 sense 86142 重复：两者都描述“监狱”的唯一义项（关押犯人的场所）。86141 的释义“关坏人的地方”较口语、模糊，义项指纹也较粗。两个 sense 会产生两套几乎相同的练习。

definition: 阅读书报刊的人。
reviewer_notes: 作为独立的 core 不可用。保留 86147 即可。除重复问题外，其余 L3、L6、L7 的选项与解释也都是干净的。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 86147 实为同一义项（阅读书报刊的人）。本义项的十个句子同样指阅读者本人，学习者会学到两次同一个义项。

definition: 副词，表示有一定程度，比一般稍高；也作动词表示对比。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as one sense. Keep the adverb sentences in 86149, which is already the cleaner adverb sense. Create a new 动词 sense for 比较 as 对比, with its own sentences, plan, and blocks. Its morphological forms (比较了, 比较过, 比较比较, 比较一下) are relevant there. Plan: not run, since this sense is rejected.
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: 一个 sense 同时包含两个义项：副词“有一定程度”与动词“对比”。其中 sentences 0, 1, 4, 6, 7, 9 为副词，2, 3, 5, 8 为动词，违反“每句只用一个义项”的核心要求。; core.definition: 副词义与 86149 完全重复，形成两个 sense_id 教授同一义项。; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: 正确句 index 3（“我们来比较一下这两家店的价格”）用的是动词对比义，而其余错误句都在检验副词用法（如“比较唯一”“比较绝对”）。这使语义辨别题没有统一的义项基础。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “这块石头比较完整，我没有扔掉它”中“比较完整”是自然可接受的副词用法，被标为错误句，与 86149 的同类问题相同。

definition: 旅馆；也指卖酒和饭菜的店铺。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is not separable from 86155, so no patch can fix it. The re-scoped sense needs new sentences and blocks. Also noted: core.sentences[8].furigana is only the bare word reading (jiǔdiàn), unlike the full-sentence pinyin used elsewhere, and sentence 8 is about 22 characters, which is long for T3. Sentence 8 is not used in any block.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss 旅馆；也指卖酒和饭菜的店铺 includes the lodging meaning that sense 86155 already covers. Two senses now share one meaning, so the lesson would teach lodging twice.; core.sense_fingerprint: The fingerprint 旅馆，或卖酒和饭菜的店铺 cannot separate this sense from 86155, so disambiguation fails.; core.sentences[0]: Sentences 0, 1, 2, 6 and 9 (rooms, cheap hotel, front desk, staying a night) use the lodging meaning, not the restaurant/bar meaning. Sense-pinning fails for them.; variants.A.level_3: The A anchor (sentence 0, 这家小酒店只有十个房间) tests lodging, so the exercise re-teaches 86155.

definition: 副词，表示动作行为正在进行中。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 86169, not for a content defect in its own right. Keep one sense only.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates sense 86169: both define 正在 as the progressive adverb for an action happening now, with the same pronunciation, register, and sentence type. Two senses with the same meaning will produce duplicate exercises and contradict each other.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 我正在学校，下课来找我吧 is colloquially acceptable, so it is not a clean wrong sentence (same defect as 86169 B).; variants.B.level_3: The anchor 我们正在开会，晚点再说 also fits 即将 and 刚刚 (about to hold, or just finished, a meeting, then talk later), so the blank has several defensible answers. The 将 in A level_3 has the same near-future problem.

definition: 量词，用于可以重复出现的事情。
reviewer_notes: 本义项与 86195 重复，不应同时保留。若决定保留 86196 而非 86195，除上述问题外，其余句子（第 0、1、2、4、5、6、7、8、9 句）都是清晰的计数用法。注意 active_levels 中 level_2 的情况与 86195 相同。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 86195 为同一义项：两者都是计数动作或事件重复次数，指纹无法区分。学习者无法分辨两个义项，属于重复义项。; core.sentences[3]: “这次考试不太难”中的“这次”是指示词加量词，指一个场合，并非计数次数，与所教义项不一致。该句又被 A 的 level_6 用作正例。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “他去年搬两次家”的错误是漏掉“了”，不涉及目标词“次”。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0].explanation: 解释称“次”不能数“事”，过度概括，与 86195 的问题相同。

definition: 事情多，没有空闲。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 86197. The variant issues are listed for the record only; no patches are given because the sense is rejected. If the duplicate decision is overruled, these issues need fixing before publication.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. Definition (事情多，没有空闲), POS, semantic_class, register (口语), pronunciation, morphological_forms and antonym 闲 are the same as sense 86197. Teaching the same sense twice produces redundant exercises.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “听到敲门声，他忙跑过去开门”用的是急忙义，是地道的句子。它不是错句，学习者可据此判错。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “电话一直忙”是地道的占线说法，不是错句。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “读完这封长信，他忙把信收进抽屉”用的是急忙义，是地道的句子，不是错句。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “电话总是忙”是地道的占线说法，不是错句。; variants.B.level_1.options: 梦, 满, 马, 猛 each differ from 忙 in both final and tone, so they are not listening-confusable minimal pairs. A strict judge rejects them as L1 distractors.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: “这家店周末特别高兴”personifies the shop. It is borderline and a learner could defensibly accept it.

definition: 女人是长大了的女孩。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用：与 86206 释义重复，且 sense_fingerprint 与多数例句不符。例句本身大多可用，可在合并时复用到 86206。B 变体 level_3 中“树”作“穿红衣服、站着”的拟人化解读风险较高，合并时注意。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 86206 同为“成年女性”，属重复义项。“女人是长大了的女孩”也不是词典释义。sense_fingerprint“由女孩长大而成”在多数例句中不成立，例如第 1、4、5、7、8 句只表示成年女性。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “班里的女人都很认真学习”可指成年学员（如夜校），并非明确错误。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “请问女人”的缺陷在于礼貌和语用，而非义项错误，属于借口式的错句。; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: “老太太”作“长大了”的续接，语义牵强；其错误理由依赖体貌推断。

definition: 动词，指组织、机构等建立起来；也指理由站得住。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝理由：核心释义同时包含两个义项，无法锁定。组织义与 86207 高度重叠，因此即使拆分，也只需保留「理由站得住」一义，并补充其独立的 level 设计。该条目还存在次要问题：definition 与 sense_fingerprint 开头的「动词，」为冗余标注。两个 synonym_antonym 的拒绝理由均不成立，已在 issues 中注明。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 同一条目的释义同时包含两个义项：「组织、机构建立起来」与「理由站得住」。义项未被锁定，违反单义项教学的要求，level_6 等练习无法据此判定正误。; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match: 以 no_relation 拒绝，但「理由站得住」的反义词为 站不住，与「组织建立」一义的反义词 解散 均可成立，拒绝理由不成立。; variants.B.synonym_antonym_match: 以 no_relation 拒绝，但「组织建立」一义下的反义词为 解散，拒绝理由不成立。

definition: 形容词，指居第二位的、辅助的。
reviewer_notes: 与 86213 重复，不应同时保留。若决定保留 86214，除上述问题外：level_6 中 A 的“一副电脑”“一副兔子”“三副房子”，B 的“一副蛋糕”“一副台灯”“一副书”均使用量词“副”（成对量词），与 86213 的情况相同，属于第二种用法的教学风险。level_7 A 的“经副理”和 B 的“的副在”错误清楚，可接受。active_levels 含 4，但 plan 中没有 level_4 块，同样需要确认。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 86213 为同一义项（居第二位、辅助正职）。定义与指纹等价，学习者无法区分两个义项。; core.sentences: sense_fingerprint 称“用在职务名称前”，但 10 句中没有一句使用“副＋职务名称”，全部为“副的”或数量式“一正三副”。

definition: 日用是每天都要用到的。
reviewer_notes: 本 sense 本身的句子与选项基本成立，但与 86224 重复，无保留价值，故 reject。如果决定保留 86223 而撤下 86224，则需按 86224 的同一套问题重新审核。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 86224 释义实质相同（“每天都要用到的”与“日常生活中使用的”），修饰对象、语境与例句均相同。同一义项被拆成两个 sense，两者的 L3/L6/L7 练习会教同一个意思。; plan.active_levels: active_levels 含 4，但 blocks 中没有 level_4，而 morphological_forms 已列出日用品、日用百货两个复合词。; core.definition: 释义“日用是每天都要用到的”以词条自身开头，属于循环释义。

definition: 区别词，指多种多样的，不同的种类。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用：与 86237 重复。例句（如“动物园里有各种动物”“妈妈为客人准备了各种点心”）本身质量尚可，合并时可把有用的例句和练习并入 86237，并应用 86237 的修正。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 86237 为同一义项，属重复义项，两个 sense_id 教授同一含义。; core.pos: pos 写作“形容词”，但 definition 写的是“区别词”，两者矛盾。; variants.B.synonym_antonym_match.options[1]: “相同”与“不同的种类”构成可辩护的反义，与正确答案“单一”并列为双正确。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “这家商场卖各种的鞋子”的错误是“的”，在区别词后加“的”，该错误成立，无需修改。

definition: 名词，指某一段时间之内。
reviewer_notes: 问题在于核心冗余，而非内容错误，因此应停用而不是修补。若将来保留此文档，还需注意 variants.B.level_6 的“她出生期间很健康”并不干净，因为“出生期间”是常见的医学用语，判为错句有争议。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 sense 86243 是同一个“一段时间之内”义项，sense_fingerprint 只多了“某事进行”的限定。两个 sense ID 教授的是相同内容，每个块都会重复。

definition: 加快速度跟在后面，想赶上。
reviewer_notes: Rejected for redundancy, not because the items are wrong. I found no item-level errors beyond sentence 6 ('小王追着大家的脚步往山上走'), where 追 with 脚步 is awkward. The level_6 and level_7 wrong sentences are valid. The reject is a recommendation for a human to decide on the pair; the content can be reused if the senses are merged.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 86249. '加快速度跟在后面，想赶上' and '在后面快快跑，想要赶上前面的人' describe the same meaning, and every sentence here fits 86249 equally well. Learners would see the same sense twice and the sense-pinned exercises cannot be told apart.

definition: 使开着的东西合上；也指停止营业。
reviewer_notes: 因核心义项不成立而拒绝，不做局部修补：义项并集导致句子集合、各练习块的句子索引全部失效。停止营业义的内容（2、3、6、8句及其level_6、synonym_antonym_match的“开放”答案）可在重新划分后复用。题块本身（level_3、level_6、level_7的干扰与解释）在单独看时没有明显缺陷。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义是两个义项的并集：“使开着的东西合上”（即86255的义项）与“停止营业”。该义项与86255重叠，不是独立义项。; core.sentences: 10句中0、1、4、5、7、9为“合上/关掉”义（如“请关闭手机”与86255“飞机上要关闭手机”相同），与86255重复。仅2、3、6、8为“停止营业”义。

definition: 了却是把心里的事做完。
reviewer_notes: 因与86258义项重复而拒绝，不做局部修补，建议合并入86258。除重复外，level_7的错因（把字句）与同批次86255的判断相矛盾，level_6的一个错句不干净。B.level_7的“了却着”错句本身有效，合并时可保留。synonym_antonym_match声明no_relation是可接受的（了却无明确反义词）。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 义项与86258重叠：本义项的指纹“把放在心里的事情做完”完全落在86258的“了结、解决心事、债务、恩怨等”之内；本义项全部10句都是心事/心愿，86258也包含这些句子（如“了却多年的心愿”“了却这桩心事”）。两者不是可区分的独立义项。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “母亲终于把这件心事了却。”的错因不成立。同批次86255的A.level_7把“请把门关闭”判为正确句，说明“把+动词”不需要补语，本句并非错句。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “了却了这项工作”并非明显错误：“了却公务”是书面语中可接受的用法，作为错句不够干净。

definition: 不止一个；若干个。
reviewer_notes: No patches, since the core is a duplicate. If this sense is restored, these fixes are also needed: (1) A level_3 options[3] 诸多 has the same problem as in 86265 and should become 一个. (2) B level_3 options[1] explanation says 少数 cannot modify 比赛, which overstates it. 少数比赛 is attested, so the explanation must be rewritten to rely on the quantity mismatch (少数 means few, the anchor says many). (3) A level_6 wrong sentence 0 (他买了多个鞋) claims 多个 cannot modify 鞋 at all. The real error is the measure word (双/只), so the explanation should say that.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 不止一个；若干个 has the same meaning and fingerprint as sense 86265 (不只一个，有好几个), so the same word and meaning would be taught twice.

definition: 就算是说就是这样，也没有关系。
reviewer_notes: Sentences are individually sound, but the core definition is garbled and the sense duplicates 86272. Retire this sense. Not patched, because the core is unusable and 86272 already covers the meaning with a clean definition.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义“就算是说就是这样，也没有关系。”语义不通，无法界定让步义，学习者看不懂该义项。; core: 与 86272 为同一让步义项（同为“让步/即使”，指纹实质相同），属重复义项，会让学习者面对两份等价练习。

definition: 海是又大又深的水，里面有很多鱼，水是咸的。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 86298, which is kept. The item-level content is sound: the level_1 distractors are real sound-alikes, the level_6 and level_7 errors are valid and single, and the classifier errors (条/个/座 for 海) are correct. Since the core is redundant with 86298 and its definition is inaccurate, it should not ship as a separate sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 86298: both gloss 海 as the sea. The definition also makes an overgeneral, non-defining claim ('里面有很多鱼'), which is not true of all seas and is not what distinguishes the word.

definition: 学校里学生编成的组织；也指工作的一段时间。
reviewer_notes: Reject with no patches, because the sense itself conflates two senses. Most of the level content (level 1 options, level 3 options, level 6 and 7 errors) is sound and could be reused in the split. Sense 86301 already covers the student-group sense, so 86302 duplicates it. A shift-sense document needs to be written from scratch.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses: 学校里学生编成的组织 and 工作的一段时间. The core must describe one sense, so the core is unusable as written.; core.sentences[8]: 今天我的班是下午两点到晚上十点 uses the 工作时段 sense, mixed into a set otherwise about the student group.; core.sentences[9]: 他的班从晚上八点开始 uses the 工作时段 sense, mixed into a set otherwise about the student group.

definition: 的确是说真的是这样。
reviewer_notes: 句子干净、L3 与 L7 结构正确，但 L6 的若干错句（如 A 的“他的确也许明天来”、B 的“他看起来很开心，的确心里很难过”）可接受性存疑，问题与 86312 相同。因为是重复 sense，故 reject，不单独修补。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 86312 同义（确认、确实、表示肯定），sense_fingerprint 也只是换了说法。两个 sense 会教同一个意思，属于拆分错误。; core.definition: 释义“的确是说真的是这样”以词条自身开头，属于循环释义。; plan.active_levels: active_levels 为 [1,2,3,6,7]，但 blocks 中没有 level_2。

definition: 男人是长大了的男孩。
reviewer_notes: reject：本 sense 与 86316 同为成年男性义项，定义“长大了的男孩”不准确，且全部例句都用于同一义项。核心无法用补丁修好，应删除并合并到 86316。上述 issues 仅供合并时参考，未输出补丁。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义“男人是长大了的男孩”不是“男人”的词义。成年男子不是“长大了的男孩”。该义项与 86316（成年的男性）实为同一词义，两者会把同一词义教两次。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹“男孩长大后成为男人”与 86316 的“成年男性，泛指成年男子”指向同一义项，无法区分。; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: “男生”在 18 岁男性的语境中可被辩护为正确（年轻男性、男孩），并非干净的干扰项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “表格的性别一栏应填男人或女人。”在表格语境中并非明显错误，母语者可能接受，不宜作为错误句。; core.morphological_forms[1]: “男人们”的“们”是复数词缀，标为“复合”不准确。

definition: “只要”是说只要有这个，事情就能做成。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for bad sentences. The core is redundant with 86322, so it is unusable as a separate sense. No patches. Otherwise the sentences are clean, and the sentence set was not used to justify any edit.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 86322 (充分条件，常配“就”). Here 只要 has one sense, and this document teaches it a second time with a narrower fingerprint. The two senses are not distinct.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: Treats 只要有耐心，才能学好 as an error. 只要…才… is attested in ordinary usage, so the error claim is contestable.

definition: “经过”是从一个地方走过去，或者做完一件事。
reviewer_notes: 表示“通过某处”的句子（variants.A.level_3、variants.A.level_6、variants.A.level_7 的正确句、variants.B.level_6）本身是干净的，但与 sense 86334 中“通过”的句子（索引 3、4、6、8）重复。此处的问题在于义项边界错误，需要重新生成，不适合用补丁修复。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “做完一件事”并不是经过的独立义项。variants.B.level_3 的句 6（经过大家的努力……）以及句 7（经过两次练习……）用的都是“经历某个过程”的读法，即 sense 86334 的义项。定义是对同一多义现象的错误切分。; core.sense_fingerprint: “做完某件事、完成某个过程”与 sense 86334 的“经历某个过程或阶段”重叠，两个义项无法区分。

definition: 动词，指从某处通过，或经历某个过程。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as a single sense, so the exercise blocks were not patched.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition and sense_fingerprint combine two distinct senses of 经过: (a) physically passing through a place, and (b) undergoing a process. The sentences split between them. Sentences 3, 4, 6 and 8 use the spatial sense. Sentences 0, 1, 2, 5, 7 and 9 use the process sense. This breaks the one-sense rule, and every downstream block mixes the two senses (e.g. A level_3 anchors on the process sense, B level_3 on the spatial sense).

definition: 把事物转移给别人；也指结识。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the core is unusable as one sense. Sense 86343 already holds the hand-over meaning, so 86344 should be regenerated as 结识 only (definition, fingerprint, ten sentences), then a new plan run should set the blocks. Do not patch the variants until the core is fixed; the current A and B blocks would have to be rebuilt either way.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses (把事物转移给别人；也指结识). Sense 86343 already covers the hand-over meaning, so this document is not a single sense.; core.sense_fingerprint: The fingerprint lists both meanings, so the sense cannot be disambiguated.; core.sentences: Sentences split between senses: 0, 1, 4, 5, 7, 9 are hand-over; 2, 3, 6, 8 are 结识.; variants.B.level_6.correct_sentence_index: The correct sentence (9, 请把房租交给房东) is hand-over, while the wrong sentences misuse 结识. The block discriminates across senses, which breaks the single-sense rule.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0].explanation: Says 这里应该用〈结识〉, but the sentence already uses 交 in the 结识 sense. The error is the object (a city cannot be made friends with), so the explanation misleads.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0].explanation: Same misleading 〈结识〉 correction in the B variant.

definition: 代词，指全体中的任何一个。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 86353. The variant defects above are listed for the record only. Other variant items are structurally sound. A.level_6 wrong_sentences[1] “只有每个人通过了考试” is borderline, but I have not patched it because the sense is rejected.
reviewer_issues: core: 与 86353 为同一义项：均为代词“每个”的逐指/全称用法（释义分别为“逐个都有”与“指全体中的任何一个”），例句句式相同，会重复教授同一义项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “每个学生打碎了玻璃”语法正确且有合理字面读法（每位学生都打碎过玻璃），判错只依赖情理，属于可接受的句子。

definition: 面向南方时东边的一侧；与右相对。
reviewer_notes: Core is a duplicate, so no patches are proposed. Variant issues noted for any rewrite: B L3 上 (把车往上开一点儿 is defensible on a slope) and A L3 下 (往下拐 is overstated as impossible; it is only weak). A L6 and B L6 and the L7 errors are single-error and acceptable.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 面向南方时东边的一侧 is the same referent as 86369 (和右相反的一边). The fingerprints duplicate each other. All 10 sentences use generic 左 and none sets up a south-facing reference, so no sentence pins this sense apart from 86369. Sense pinning fails.

definition: 助词，用在假设的分句末尾，表示假设语气。
reviewer_notes: reject：应合并入 86393，不应单独保留。A L7“有空呢的话”错误明确，合并时可保留。若日后单独恢复本条，B L7 与 A L3 的问题需先修复。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 86393 为同一义项（假设条件的“的话”），两者的释义和指纹几乎相同，同一知识点会被教两遍。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “堵车了的话”中的“了的话”是常见的假设说法（如“下雨了的话就别去了”），并非明显错误，错误描述不成立。; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: “可以吗，请把门关上”可作口语中的委婉请求，“吗”干扰项不是明确错误。; variants.A.level_1: 干扰项与“的话”只在韵母或声母加声调上不同，并非最小对立对。

definition: “送”是把东西拿给别人，或者陪别人走一段路。
reviewer_notes: Rejected at core level because the senses are conflated. The issues listed for the option blocks should also be fixed when the two split senses are regenerated.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition and fingerprint combine two senses of 送: (1) giving or delivering a thing, and (2) seeing someone off or escorting them. The sentences mix both. Sentences 0, 1, 4, 6, 7 and 8 use the giving sense. Sentences 2, 3, 5 and 9 use the escorting sense. No exercise can rest on one pinned sense.; variants.A.level_1.options[3]: 从 (cóng) differs from sòng in both initial and tone. It is not a minimal pair. 纵 (zòng) also has a different initial.; variants.B.level_1.options: 聪, 总 and 宗 differ in initial, and 聪 and 总 also differ in tone. None of them is a tone-only confusion.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 「朋友回国那天，我们都去机场送他」 is acceptable. The friend is leaving to go back to his own country, so 送 is correct here and the sentence is not wrong.

definition: 动词，把东西交给对方；也指陪伴人离开。
reviewer_notes: 驳回的理由是重复义项，而非句子质量；这些句子与练习本身基本合格（A/B level_6 与 level_7 的错误句都成立）。若最终保留本义项而非 86395，需要应用 86395 中的反义词修补，并处理 B level_1。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 86395 为同一义项：定义与指纹都是「把东西交给对方」加「陪人离开」，属于重复的义项，无法通过 sense_fingerprint 区分。; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match: 以 no_relation 放弃，但「送」的反义词「收」存在（同 86395）。; variants.B.level_1: 干扰项「聪」「从」「宗」都只差声母与声调，不构成严格的最小对立对，仅「怂」合格。

definition: 挺是说很，非常。
reviewer_notes: Core is a duplicate, so no patches are proposed. If the sense were kept, these would also need fixing: A L3 甚 is a 书面 synonym of 很 and is defensible in meaning. A L3 才 can give 我才喜欢 a grammatical reading. B L3 却 and 曾 are weak without preceding context.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This is the same lexical sense as 86400 (挺 副词, 很/相当, high degree, 口语). The fingerprints are near-identical, and the sentences are the same pattern 挺+adjective. Both senses can be supported by the same sentences, so the sense is not locked. The gloss 挺是说很，非常。 is also not a dictionary-style definition.

definition: “一个人”是说只有一个人，没有别人跟他在一起。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of sense 86402. Keep 86402 as the survivor. Its level_6 and level_3 content is mostly sound, but its pronunciation is wrong, which has been corrected in the 86402 review. The pos 名词 label is questionable for this sense. Most examples are adverbial (独自), so a human should confirm it.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 86402 (“单独一人；没有他人陪伴”). The two senses cannot be taught apart. Their example sets also overlap: 86401 sentences 0 and 9 (只有一个人) are the quantity reading, and 86402 sentence 3 is the same reading.; core.pronunciation / core.ipa: Tones are wrong. In 一个人, 一 becomes second tone before 个, and 个 is neutral tone, so the reading is yí ge rén. The IPA also has first tone on 一 and fourth tone on 个.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “山上只有他一个人，他却带着一群朋友。” is wrong because of its second clause, not because of 一个人. Its explanation claims 一个人 is misused and that 大家 is the fix, which is false.

definition: 名词，指国家机关或企事业单位内部的管理工作。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant duplicate of 86425. Its variant defects are the same ones found in 86425 (A level_1 行长 is háng zhǎng; B level_1 is declined though 新政 is a minimal pair), so they need no separate fix here.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 86425. Both define 行政 as administrative management work, with the same pos, semantic_class, and morphological forms, and near-identical fingerprints. The two senses cannot be taught as distinct.; core.definition: The definition begins with the formatting artifact “名词，”.

definition: 向银行等借的、需要还本付息的钱；借钱。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant duplicate of 86427 with a mixed definition. The level_3, level_6, and level_7 blocks in both variants checked clean. If the operator merges into 86427, those blocks could be reused after the L1 declines are fixed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 86427 (向银行借的要还的钱). The definition also appends a verb sense “借钱”, which no sentence uses, while pos is 名词. It mixes two senses under one entry.; variants.A.level_1 and variants.B.level_1: Both declined as no_minimal_pairs, but minimal pairs exist (代管, 带宽, 大款, 到款), the same as in 86427.

definition: 连词，表示结果，所以。
reviewer_notes: 因核心义项重复，未对其练习块作修改。若最终 86447 也被弃用，则需要重新生成因而的义项。另可注意：sentences[1]“这里空气好，因而住的人很多”的因果关系不自然，这一点在重新生成时也应避免。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 86447 的义项完全重复（“连词，表示结果，所以”与“因为……所以”均指同一因果结果义）。同一个词的两个相同义项会让学习者重复学习同一用法，属于核心层面的不可用。

definition: 指政府或政府部门一方；也指由政府出面的、正式的。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，故不做补丁。供清单维护者参考，块级问题同样存在：A level_7 的「一个官方消息」与 86455 的问题相同，属临界。A level_6 的「这家官方很有名，员工超过一千人」以及「我昨天去官方看病，医生很耐心」在政府机构语境下可能成立，属于可辩护的正确句。B level_6 的「我每周末都去官方超市买菜」同样可能是政府所办超市，属可辩护的正确句。B level_6 的「我们的活动由官方组织，但政府完全没有参与」是逻辑矛盾，与目标词义项相关，保留。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义合并了两个读法：名词「政府或政府部门一方」与形容词式「政府出面的、正式的」。POS 标为名词，与形容词读法不符，且 sense_fingerprint 也混合了两者。; core.sentences: 十句中多数与 86455 的名词义项完全相同（如「官方说，明天不会下雨」「官方没有回答记者的问题」），形成重复义项。

definition: 面积、空间宽阔；人数众多。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 86463. Both documents gloss the same two meanings (area/space and number of people), and sentences overlap in sense (草原/平原, 农村/农民, 沙漠/平原). Keep one sense and drop the other. Other findings, in case the duplicate is resolved in this document's favour: L7 A correct sentence index 2 '这本书受到广大读者的喜欢' uses 喜欢 as a noun after 的, which is unidiomatic; 喜爱 is the standard form. L1 is declined with no_minimal_pairs, which needs the same check as 86463 (光大 exists).

definition: 时下是现在这个时候。
reviewer_notes: Core sentence 6 has a stray 'furigana' field, which is a Japanese-only field. The L7 blocks repeat the same '时下了/时下过' pattern used in 86480.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 时下 means 'nowadays / at present', referring to the current period or trends. It does not mean 'this exact moment'. Many core sentences use it for a clock-time moment and are unnatural to native speakers: '时下是下午三点', '时下正忙，你晚点再来吧', '时下已经是深夜', '时下正是晚饭时间'. These should use 现在 or 眼下. The sense also duplicates 86480.

definition: 演出是在台上给大家表演。
reviewer_notes: This is a duplicate sense. The definition 在台上给大家表演 is the same meaning as sense 86488, 表演（戏剧、歌舞等）给观众看, and the sentences overlap. Merge it into 86488 rather than teaching two indistinguishable senses.

definition: 改变旧的制度、做法或事物中不合理的部分，使之更合理、更进步。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 86489. Both glosses describe the single dictionary sense 改革 (change an old system or method so it becomes better). The split by object (办法 vs 制度/做法) is not a real sense distinction. Sentences overlap in meaning, e.g. 86490 #3 '改革旧的做法' vs 86489 #1 '改革旧的工作方法'. Keep one sense (86489 if its L7 fix is applied). If this document is kept instead, its content is otherwise clean: L7 A '正在改革过旧的制度' is a clear error, L6 and the antonym key 守旧 hold, and L1 decline is consistent with 86489.

definition: 西部是太阳落下去的那一边的地方。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable: the sense has drifted from 西部 to 西边/西方 and duplicates 86520.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition treats 西部 as the direction ‘the side where the sun sets’, which is really 西边 or 西方. It also duplicates sense 86520 (西边的地区). Several sentences use 西部 where native usage requires 西边: “太阳落山的那边是西部”, “从西部看太阳落下去”, “学校的西部有一片树林”.

definition: 看问题的出发点；也指两条线相交所成的大小。
reviewer_notes: Core is unusable as written. Re-author as two senses: the geometric 两线夹角 sense (sentences 3 and 7 plus new ones) and, if needed, the perspective sense already covered by 86523. Then rebuild all blocks and re-run the planner. Several level 3 and level 7 items are clean, but they depend on a sense boundary that does not exist.
reviewer_issues: /core/definition: The definition fuses two senses: 看问题的出发点 (perspective) and 两线相交所成的大小 (geometric angle). Sentences 3 and 7 are geometric; the rest are perspective. The sense is not single.; /core/sense_fingerprint: The compound fingerprint mirrors the merged sense, so no single sentence set can be checked against it.; /variants/A/level_6/wrong_sentences/1: “桌子的角度磕坏了” is arguably acceptable under the geometric 两线夹角 meaning this document itself teaches, so it is not a clean wrong option.

definition: 机关是办公事的地方，里面有很多上班的人。
reviewer_notes: reject 的理由是义项本身不成立，无法靠补丁修复。建议删除86525，保留86526。B 变体的 level_3 与 level_7 本身没有问题，但依附于一个不成立的义项。无法运行 plan 命令（本次无工具），仅对照所给 plan 检查了 block 集合；plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但没有对应 block，需要核实。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与86526实为同一义项。「办公事的地方」与「办理公务的单位」几乎等义，10个例句全部指政府或办事单位，学习者无法区分两个义项。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 按本义项的定义（办公事的地方），「他在一家外资机关工作」可以说得通，不构成明确的错误句。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 同理，「销售机关」按本定义可解为办公场所，错误句不成立。

definition: 指中心的位置；也指国家最高的领导机构。
reviewer_notes: Reject, not patched. The core is two senses, and one of them duplicates 86541. Re-scope to the institutional sense, then regenerate the sentences and blocks. Do not patch the position-based blocks in place, because they would have to be rebuilt from institution sentences anyway.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition names two senses in one row: 中心的位置 and 国家最高的领导机构. This breaks the one-sense pinning rule. The position meaning duplicates sense 86541 almost word for word, and sentences 5, 6, 7 and 9 are position usages.; variants.B.level_3: The cloze sentence 他把花放在桌子中央 uses the position sense, and its explanation says 指桌面的正中间位置. That is off-sense for this row.; variants.B.level_6: The correct sentence 房子中央是一个大院子 uses the position sense, so the discrimination exercise is off-sense for this row.; variants.B.level_7: The incorrect sentence 他把钥匙放在桌子上中央 and the correct indices 6, 7, 9 are all position usages.; variants.A.level_1.options[2]: 重洋 is read chóng yáng, not zhòng yáng, so the explanation is wrong. The initial also differs, so it is not a valid sound-alike.; variants.B.level_1.options[1]: 重阳 (chóng yáng) differs from zhōng yāng in its initial as well as its tones, so it is not a valid sound-alike.; variants.B.level_1.options[3]: 重样 is read chóng yàng, not zhòng yàng, so the explanation is wrong. The initial also differs.

definition: 助词，用在一个或几个并列成分之后，表示“等等”“之类”。
reviewer_notes: Reject, not patched. The row duplicates 86545, so the defects above are listed for the record only. If the sense inventory keeps 86545 alone, these defects disappear with the row.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition, 用在并列成分之后，表示等等、之类, is the same sense as 86545 (什么的放在几样东西后面，是说还有别的像这样的). The two rows duplicate each other, so this row should not exist as a separate sense.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 他是干什么的？ is a natural question using 干什么的 and is not a wrong use of 什么的. The label 'wrong' is false.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 公园里有个什么的，我没看清。 is acceptable Chinese, using 什么的 as an indefinite pronoun, so it is not wrong.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 她是做什么的？ is a natural question using 做什么的 and is not wrong.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 我在家看书、做饭什么的了。 is contestable, because the colloquial sentence-final 了 can be acceptable. The error_description overstates the rule.

definition: 棋类、球类等比赛的一场；也指机关部门。
reviewer_notes: 判定为 reject，理由：要把此文档锁定为单一义项，就必须删去约一半句子并重建两个变体的全部块，实际上等于重新生成。建议拆分为两个单义项文档，并让比赛义与 86547 的量词义对照处理。plan 的 active_levels 含 4，但两个变体都没有 level_4 块，重写后需重新运行 plan。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 一个义项内同时定义了两个义项（“棋类、球类等比赛的一场”与“机关部门”）。句子也混用两义：第 0、1、2、6、9 句为比赛义，第 3、4、5、7、8 句为机关义。这违反了锁定唯一义项的要求。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹同样混合两义，无法消歧。; core.sentences: 比赛义“比赛的一场”与 sense 86547 的量词义“下棋或比赛的一场”实质重复，同一个意思在两个文档中各教一次。; variants.A.level_7.error_description: 文字中混入乱码字符“ا”（“前面ا的数量词”）。

definition: 指自己或他人生的男孩，是父母对男性子女的称呼。
reviewer_notes: This is a redundancy verdict, not a content defect. The sentences and variants are individually clean: level_3 options are exactly 4 with 1 correct, the level_6 and level_7 indices match the sentences, and the wrong sentences fail for the right reason. Keeping both senses would teach the same meaning twice. If the lexicographer decides the senses are distinct, this sense can be accepted only after its definition and fingerprint are made distinct and it is reviewed again.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 86557 为同一义项：两者都定义为父母的男性子女（86557 为“爸爸妈妈生的男孩子”，86558 为“父母对男性子女的称呼”），sense_fingerprint 也无法区分。同一义项被教授两次。

A clean distance-only sense can be regenerated. Regenerate and rerun the plan before reviewing again.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义混合两个义项：“指说话前不久的一段时间”（时间义，与 86563 重复）和“距离最短”（空间义）。违反“每句只用一个义项”的核心标准。; core.sentences[6],core.sentences[7],core.sentences[8]: 三句为时间义（最近这段时间 / 我最近一次去北京 / 最近一个月），与锁定的“距离最短”义项不符。; variants.B.level_3: B 变体的 level_3 锚句（sentence 6）和全部选项都依赖时间义（最远这段时间 / 最高这段时间），在距离义下不成立；level_7 的 correct_sentence_indices [6,7,9] 也包含两句时间句。; variants.A.level_6: 锚句“去机场，坐地铁是最近的路”与干扰句“坐地铁是最近的方法”都可读作“最快”，距离义不清，无法判定唯一正确答案。

reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 86567. Block-level issues are not itemised because the core is redundant.

The antonym pairing with 这里 that this definition states could be carried into 86575 if the plan adds a synonym_antonym block. The option blocks were not reviewed further, because the document is rejected.

definition: 指现在所处的这一年。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 86577 and rejected on that basis. The listed issues would need fixing if this copy were kept.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 86577 (今年是现在这一年 / 指现在所处的这一年). Redundant core.; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: 明年 is explained as clashing with 了. 「明年我二十岁了」 is grammatical, because 了 can mark an anticipated change. definition: 每一天。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 86597. If the pipeline keeps it anyway, apply the two fixes listed above. The plan's active_levels include 2, but there is no level_2 block.

The two senses are not distinct, so one drill would teach the same sense twice.; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: Explanation says 从来 must take a negative word, which is false (从来都 is affirmative).; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “妈妈天天的给我做早饭” rests on an overbroad 的 rule and is not clearly wrong.

definition: 内部充满，不空；真实。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用：同一文档混合两个义项，无法用补丁修复。物理义已由 86599 覆盖，建议把本条重建为只含「真实/诚实」义的独立 sense（重写句子、定义和全部练习），或直接删除。重建时注意「空」只能作为物理义的反义。B level_3 的干扰项「漂亮」（「塞得漂亮」）也有一定可接受性，重建时需一并检查。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义合并了两个义项：「内部充满，不空」（物理义）与「真实」（为人说话真实不假）。sense_fingerprint 也同时描述两者。; core.sentences: 10 句中，0、1、2、6、7、9 为物理义，3、4、5、8 为「真实」义，违反「每句只用一个义项」。; variants.A.level_6: 正确句 index 3 是「真实」义，而干扰句是物理义的误用，义项不统一。; variants.B.level_6: 正确句 index 9 是物理义，与 A 变体的义项不一致。; variants.B.synonym_antonym_match: 反义答案「空」只对物理义成立，对「真实」义无反义，与文档的义项不一致。; variants.A.level_7: A 变体的纠错句为「他这个人做事很实」（真实义），但 correct_sentence_indices [0,1,2] 全是物理义。B 的 [6,7,9] 同样全是物理义。两个变体的纠错句用的义项不一致。

definition: 照是光亮落在东西上，或者用相机拍下来。
reviewer_notes: Further defects: sentence 5 carries a stray 'furigana' field containing pinyin. B.level_7 marks 照了一个相 as wrong, but it is colloquially acceptable, and its error is a classifier on 相 rather than on the target word. A.level_6 and B.level_6 mix the two senses.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two distinct senses: light shining on something, and taking a photograph. The sentences alternate between these two senses. definition: 光线射在物体上；拍摄；对着镜子看。
reviewer_notes: The B.level_6 anchor (index 9) uses the mirror sense, while the A.level_6 anchor uses the shine sense. B.level_6 wrong sentences 0 and 1 both correct to 喝, which is redundant. Rebuild everything after the split.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses: light shining on something, and looking in a mirror (照镜子). The sentences alternate between them, for example sentences 2, 4, 7 and 9 versus sentences 0, 1, 3 and 5. This means the target sense is not pinned. The 照镜子 sense also overlaps the sense split in 86615.

definition: 离开居住地到别处游览、观赏风景名胜。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 86617. If the pipeline keeps it anyway, apply the three fixes listed above. The plan's active_levels include 2 and 4, but there are no blocks for either.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same leisure-travel sense as 86617 (离开居住地去别处游览 vs 离开家去外地玩看风景). Keeping both would teach one sense twice.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 考察 is defensible in the anchor sentence: 很多外国人来中国考察，想看长城 reads naturally for visiting researchers. The explanation is register-only.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 他们秋天去桂林旅游着 rests on the same false 着 rule as 86617 variant A and is not clearly wrong.

definition: 不采取行动，直到所期望的人或事出现。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 86625. Keep 86625 as the surviving sense. If the two were ever to be retained, each must state a distinct, testable feature; none is present here. No patches are offered because the core is redundant.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 86625. 「不采取行动，直到所期望的人或事出现」 and 「留在原地，直到想见的人或事来到」 describe the same wait-until-arrival meaning, and sense_fingerprint is essentially identical. The learner cannot distinguish the two senses.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 「孩子们在院子里等待着，一边踢球一边聊天」 is acceptable: intransitive 等待 with another activity going on is natural. It is not a clear wrong sentence.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 「老师在讲台上等待着，一直讲到下课」 is contradictory but grammatical and can be read as waiting before a lesson. It is not a clean distractor.

definition: 对待是用什么样的态度和别人相处。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on structure, not sentence quality. Blocks checked: level_3 (A and B), level_6, level_7 and the level_1 and synonym declines all hold up. Nothing was patched, so no planner rerun is needed for this sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. “用什么样的态度和别人相处” is a strict subset of sense 86682's “以某种态度或行为处理人或事”. All ten sentences use 对待 with a person as object, which 86682 already covers. Two active senses teach the same meaning twice.

definition: 篇是数文章、书页的词。
reviewer_notes: 若该义项必须另行保留，还需修正 variants.B.level_3：例句“这一篇比上一篇容易。”语境不足，干扰项“场”（这一场比上一场容易）和“幅”（这一幅比上一幅容易）在句子本身中也能成立，不符合“唯一正确答案”的要求。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义写“数文章、书页”，“书页”不是“篇”的常用量词对象（书页多用“页”或“张”计）。sense_fingerprint 又写“数书中的篇章”，与定义不一致，且 10 个例句全部只用于文章、课文、日记，没有一句体现“篇章”或“书页”。; core: 与 86700 为同一义项（数文章的“篇”），两个义项会让学习者重复学习同一用法，并生成几乎相同的练习（level_1 的干扰项、level_7 的错句类型都高度重叠）。

definition: 按是用手往下压。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is a duplicate of 86702 and cannot stand as a distinct teaching sense. The other issues are listed so they can be fixed if the author keeps this sense. The plan's B level_3 cloze (sentence 6) is the most serious defect and would have to be rebuilt from scratch.
reviewer_issues: /core/definition: 用手往下压 is wholly contained in sibling sense 86702 (用手或指头压住；往下压). Every sentence here (门铃, 八楼, 灯, 喇叭, 桌子, 肚子, 肩膀, 头) fits 86702's gloss, so this split teaches no distinction and the sense is not independently usable.; /variants/B/level_3/options: The anchor 医生用手按了按我的肩膀 accepts 摸 (摸了摸, palpation), 拍 (拍了拍) and 推 (推了推) as natural. Three of the four options are defensibly correct. The 拍 explanation (拍了按 is not valid) targets a bad collocation, because the blank covers the reduplicated 按了按.; /variants/A/level_7/incorrect_sentence: 他用力按上了开关 is acceptable, since switches are often pushed up to turn on. The claim that 按开关 must be downward is false for switches, so this "error" is defensibly correct.; /variants/B/level_7/corrected_sentence: 他把行李按在箱子里 is stilted. The missing piece is a directional complement (按进), not a preposition, so the explanation 介词缺失 misidentifies the error.; /variants/A/level_6/wrong_sentences/1: 他按了几下门，里面没人应 can be read as pressing or knocking on the door. It is not a clear misuse of the sense.

definition: 哺乳动物，体形巨大，鼻子很长。

reviewer_issues: core: Same sense as 86703 (象 = elephant). The definition 哺乳动物，体形巨大，鼻子很长 and the fingerprint 科普 register differ only in genre, so learners are taught one meaning twice. The distractor pools overlap: 香 and 响 in L1; 我和爸爸下了一盘象 in B L6 of 86703 and A L6 here; 今天的象很好 in both.

definition: 美国的货币单位，也是国际上常用的一种货币。

definition: 时间单位，一小时的六十分之一。

definition: 黑人是皮肤颜色比较黑的人。
reviewer_notes: 86727应当删除而非改写：整个义项都没有依据，十个句子都把“黑人”当作种族或族裔名词用，与定义矛盾。如果要复用其中的任何句子，必须先逐句对照86728重新审核。

definition: 商品开始在市场出售；公司股票开始公开买卖。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is unusable as a single sense.
