The core is not a single sense, which breaks the one-sense rule. sense_fingerprint has the same merge.; core.sentences[4]: 新产品下个月在全国上市 is goods sense, not stock. It duplicates 86731 and fails the one-sense requirement.; core.sentences[5]: 这家工厂的新牛奶下周上市，价格不贵 is goods sense. It duplicates 86731 and fails the one-sense requirement.; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match: Declined as no_relation, but 退市 and 下市 are real antonyms of 上市 in the stock sense. definition: 哦是听到事情以后，说出的一个声音。
reviewer_notes: Rejected: the sense is mis-specified (acknowledgment definition on an ó pronunciation) and its sentences overlap 86734. Core and pronunciation contradict each other.; core.sentences[0,2,3,4,7,8,9]: Most sentences use 哦 as acknowledgment (哦，是吗 / 我“哦”了一声), not the ó questioning/surprise usage. reviewer_issues: core: 与 86737 为同一义项（core.definition 与 86737 实质相同：“从别处/别的地方返回原来的地方”；fingerprint 亦相同）。两个义项会让学习者重复学习同一用法，并生成重叠的练习。

definition: 规模大、人员多的公司。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only as a duplicate; the block content was otherwise reviewed. If it were kept, B-level_7 (「我妹妹一家大公司工作。」) would have the same off-target 介词遗漏 defect as 86769 B-level_7 and would need the same fix. A-level_7 (这个园区里有很多只大公司) is valid, and the L3/L6 distractors and wrong sentences are acceptable.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 86769 (「规模大、人员多的公司」 vs 「很多人一起工作的、很大的公司」). Two senses for one meaning means the same word is taught twice, with two exercise pools that cannot be told apart.

definition: 对内是对着里面的人。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable, so every downstream block is also invalid. Several L6 'wrong' sentences additionally depend on door-physics reasoning rather than on word meaning.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The pinned sense '朝着里面的方向' is not a real use of 对内. The standard meaning is 'internal / domestic', as in 对内政策 or 对内改革, contrasting with 对外. Native speakers say 向内开 or 往里开, not 对内开. Nearly every sentence is built on this unnatural 门对内开 pattern. The register is declared 书面 but the sentences are colloquial.

definition: 只有一个的；独一无二的。
reviewer_notes: This is a duplicate of 86781. There are further defects if it is kept: sentence 0 '世界上唯一的一幅画' is semantically odd. The level_6 A[0] explanation '用〈的〉代替〈唯一〉' is nonsense. The level_7 B explanation makes the same false 个 claim as 86781.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense is indistinguishable from 86781: both mean 'only one'. The two fingerprints do not separate them, so it is a duplicate sense.

definition: 很是的意思和“非常”差不多。
reviewer_notes: 作为独立 sense 不成立，故 reject，不做补丁。86788 的定义更清楚，应保留它。若作者认为两者应当各自成立，需要给出可区分的义项证据，而本文档中没有。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 86788 重复。两者都是“很是”作程度副词、约等于“非常”，修饰形容词或心理动词，sense_fingerprint 实质相同，例句构式也相同，属于同一义项被拆成两个 sense。; core.definition: “很是的意思和‘非常’差不多”是循环的、元语言式的释义，不是定义。

definition: 像鲜血或熟透的苹果的颜色。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because it duplicates 86801 (same colour meaning, no contrast). No patches. The variants are otherwise valid: A-level_6 and A-level_7 errors hold, and B-level_3 distractors are clean. If the pipeline decides to keep this sense instead of 86801, its definition and sentences must be rewritten to a distinct meaning first.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 86801 (red as a colour; 像鲜血或熟透的苹果的颜色 vs 像苹果和太阳那样的颜色). Several sentences (0 她最喜欢红色, 4 我想买一件红色的衣服, 7 妈妈今天穿着红色的外套, 8 你喜欢红色还是蓝色, 9 桌子上有一个红色的杯子) are generic colour uses, not evidence of a blood/apple-specific sense, so the sense cannot be taught as distinct.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 玉体 is excluded mainly because it cannot be the object of 喜欢 at all. The register explanation is only a partial reason.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0..2]: All three wrong sentences are classifier errors, the same error type as B-level_7. The item is valid but redundant.

definition: 副词，表示以前有过某种行为或情况。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because it duplicates 86805. No patches. Borderline items if kept: B-level_3 总是一起工作过 is marginal and could be replaced; B-level_6 我曾经刚刚下班 is probably wrong but is borderline. Other items check out: A-level_3 distractors, A-level_6 and B-level_7 errors are valid.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 86805 (以前有过 meaning, same sentence pattern). The gloss also begins with a redundant POS label, 副词，.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 我的朋友们曾经一起旅行了。 is grammatical. 曾经去了北京 is standard usage, so the claimed error is false. The explanation that 了 cannot express past experience is wrong.; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 刚 fits defensibly: 刚…过 (e.g. 我刚去过北京) means a recent past experience. The stated reason is wrong.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 我曾经很快乐地吃过饭。 is acceptable, and the explanation itself admits it is not an error.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 这本书曾经很快就读完了。 reads as a plausible past experience, so it is not reliably wrong.

definition: 时间的早晚；一个接一个地。

definition: 失去生命；生命终止。

definition: 人子是人的孩子。有的书里，人子是一个人的特别叫法。
reviewer_notes: Core is unusable: the sense is invented and overlaps 86892. Rebuild from attested usage, or drop it and let 86892 cover 人的儿子 and the Biblical sense. No sentence here has a mined source, so none was edited.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The second clause (有的书里，人子是一个人的特别叫法) and the sense_fingerprint (书中对某人的特别称呼) describe a sense that is not attested. definition: 联合是几个人合在一起做一件事。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 86912. The level_1 decline (no_minimal_pairs) is acceptable. Keep 86912 as the single sense and fold any usable sentences from this document into it.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates sibling sense 86912 (使几方面共同行动). “几个人合在一起做一件事”is the same concept. Sentences here such as 三家小店联合办了一次大减价 and 两位画家联合办了一个画展 fit 86912 equally well, so the two senses cannot be taught as distinct.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “这两个零件可以联合在一起。”uses the 结合在一起 gloss that belongs to sibling sense 86912, so it is not a clean wrong-sense distractor.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “几位同学联合来办了一场晚会。”is borderline: 联合来 can be parsed as “come together to hold”, so the error is not clear.

reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 一群想法一样的人组成的队伍，他们想要管理国家 has the same meaning as sense 87038 (以取得或维持国家政权为目标的政治组织), and all ten sentences use 政党 in that same sense. Teaching both would repeat one item under two IDs.

definition: 介词，表示为某人服务或代某人做事，相当于"给""为"。
reviewer_notes: 只有情感或为某人着想的子集（如“替你高兴”“替他担心”“替他着急”“别替我担心”）与 87041 可区分，若作者需要，可作为独立义项重新撰写定义与例句。这需要重写定义和大部分例句，超出补丁范围，所以判为 reject 而不是 rewrite。请以 87041 为准。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 义项与 87041 的“帮别人做事，或者代替别人”高度重叠，定义中的“代某人做事”正是 87041 的义项。两个相邻义项无法在同一题库中区分。; core.sentences[2]: “老师替我们准备了礼物”属于代为做事，与 87041 的“妈妈替我买了一本书”同义，并非独立的为某人义。; core.sentences[3]: “她替大家把窗户关好了”是代人做事，与 87041 的代替义相同。; core.sentences[4]: “医生替病人签了字”是典型的代替义，87041 的代替义也能完全覆盖。; core.sentences[8]: “老板替我们订好了房间”是代人做事，与 87041 的代替义相同。

definition: 由高处到低处来；也表示动作从过去延续到现在或事物固定下来。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝而非修补。延续、固定义（第 2、3、4、5、6、9 句）是有效的独立义项，应在重新撰写时单独建立。改写时需重写定义与指纹，pos 改为动词，并替换方向义句子。在此之前，其变体块不可用。
reviewer_issues: core.pos: “方向补语”是句法角色，不是词性标记，不符合 POS 词元规则。应为“动词”。; core.definition: 定义同时包含方向义（由高处到低处来）与延续、固定义，违反单义项要求。sense_fingerprint 也是复合的。; core.sentences: 第 0、1、7、8 句（他从楼上走下来了、小鸟从树上飞下来、他从山上爬下来、请把书从架子上拿下来）为方向义，与 87051 完全重复。

definition: 副词，书面语，指不久；过几天。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的理由是重复义项，不是句子质量。若需保留本条目，请先修复以下问题：(1) variants.B.level_3 中的“已经”在“新同学已经就要来班里了”里可以成立（“已经就要……了”是常见说法），不是干净的干扰项，可改为“从来”（与“就要”冲突）。(2) variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0] 的解释以语域为由（“口语中一般不用”），而非语义冲突，且替换词“马上”与原句的语义问题不完全对应。(3) variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1] 的替换词“前几天”与“去年”搭配矛盾。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 87055 为同一义项：释义“不久；过几天”，指纹“副词；书面语；指不久、过几天”，与 87055 的“过几天就要”实质相同，属重复义项。

definition: 天空的中央；天的中心。
reviewer_notes: 核心内容重复，不需要修补。若决定保留本 sense，它同样存在 87057 中的 L1 甜心说明错误（韵母并不不同，只是声调不同），以及 L7 B「天心里」的规则概括过度问题。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87057 是同一义项：定义「天空的中央」与「天空最中间的地方」相同，fingerprint「天的中央」与「天空最中间的位置」相同。同一个义项被拆成了两个 sense，没有区分度。

definition: 简称是把一个很长的名字说得短一点的叫法。
reviewer_notes: 因为义项重复而驳回。保留 87076 作为“简称”的正式义项，87075 的内容无需单独保留。驳回后仍列出了块级缺陷，供重做时参考。A 的 level_1 中检查 jiǎn chá 是弱干扰项，但其余三个干扰项已足够。文档没有 source 字段。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 87076 重复：两者都指较长名称省略后的简短称呼，区别只在语域或语境（日常 vs 机构、地区），不是两个义项。两个定义说的是同一个意思，把同一义项切成两份会让学习者学到两次同一个词义。; core.sentences[2]: “这家饭店的简称是“老王”。”中的“老王”不是由饭店全名省略而来，把它作为简称的正例不成立。A 的 level_7 正确句索引 [0,1,2] 也包含此句。; variants.A.level_1.options[3]: 减轻的说明有误：qīng 与 chēng 都是第一声，声调并不不同。; variants.B.level_1: declined 为 no_minimal_pairs，但本义项自己的 A 版已给出有效最小对立对（建成、剪成、减轻），该拒绝不成立。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “他有个简称叫大熊。”被判为错误，但 core.sentences[1]（“朋友们给了他一个简称”）和 B 的 level_6 对同一义项的接受范围相互矛盾。; variants.B.level_7: 错误句“我们班的简称短很”的错误是程度副词位置，并不涉及目标词，目标词只是主语。

definition: 骂是对别人说很难听的话，让人听了不高兴。
reviewer_notes: This sense duplicates 87084: the same verb sense of 骂 (saying insulting words to someone). This definition is only a learner-level paraphrase of it. Both ladders teach the same thing, and the level_1, level_6 and level_7 content overlaps heavily (for example 骂很难听 vs 骂很厉害). Merge into 87084.

definition: 安全期是女人一个月里，不容易有小宝宝的那几天。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant sense, so no patches. Its wrong sentence 司机开车前一定要系好安全期 near-duplicates 87086's 司机出发前要系好安全期. If the inventory intentionally keeps two senses, both definitions must be re-differentiated first.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87086 实质相同（都是女性每月不易受孕的时期）。两个等价义项会让学习者在同一词上遇到两个答案相同的义项，属于重复义项。; core.sentences[2].furigana: 仅本句带 furigana 字段，且内容为拼音，与其它句结构不一致（furigana 是日语标注概念）。

definition: 不喜欢；对人或事物产生厌恶的感觉。
reviewer_notes: 作为 87087 的重复义项拒绝。全部例句（如“我讨厌下雨天”“哥哥从小就讨厌数学课”）都是同一个“不喜欢”义。其变体块单独看并无明显问题，但因义项重复而无意义。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “不喜欢；对人或事物产生厌恶的感觉”与 87087 是同一个“不喜欢”义。人与事物之分不构成义项边界，sense_fingerprint 也与 87087 重叠。; core.morphological_forms[2]: 同样误列了繁体字形“討厭”。

definition: 证券是写着钱的数目的纸，可以拿去买或者卖。
reviewer_notes: Reject. The core is a duplicate of 87096 and its sentences mostly use the financial sense, so the sense boundary itself is invalid. Do not patch: retire 87095 and move any usable concrete-sense material into 87096. The variant B level_6 wrong sentence also could be correct. Blocks should be regenerated after the merge.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The concrete sense (a paper bearing a money amount) nearly duplicates sense 87096 (有价凭证 / securities). The gloss 写着钱的数目的纸 is not how modern usage defines 证券, and splitting one word into 'paper' vs 'abstract instrument' is not a valid sense boundary.; core.sentences[1]: 「这种证券可以拿到市场上卖」 uses the market/financial sense of 87096, not the paper-with-amount sense.; core.sentences[2]: 「她想用存款买一些证券」 is the financial-instrument sense of 87096.; core.sentences[4]: 「证券的价格昨天涨了」 uses the market sense (price movement), not the concrete sense.; core.sentences[5]: 「他每个月都看证券的新闻」 is financial-market sense.; core.sentences[6]: 「哥哥用攒下的钱买了几张证券」 is investment sense; it is the block sentence for variant B level_3.; core.sentences[8]: 「买证券有风险，不要借钱买」 is investment-risk sense.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 「请您保存好这张证券，以后可以报销」 is arguably acceptable under this sense's own definition (a paper with a money amount could be a reimbursable voucher). A 'wrong' sentence that is defensibly right fails the level_6 check.

definition: 国家对资金的收入和支出的管理活动。
reviewer_notes: 与 87099 为同一义项（都是国家收支）。87099 的定义更清晰，句子也更一致，因此保留 87099。即使另立义项，学科义的例句也不属于本义项的定义范围，需要重写例句和题目。判为 reject，不做补丁。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “国家对资金的收入和支出的管理活动”与 87099 的“国家怎么收钱、怎么花钱的事”是同一个义项，题库中会出现两个相同的义项。; core.sentences[3]: “他在大学学习财政”中的“财政”指学科（财政学），不是定义中的管理活动义，属于义项漂移。; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: level_6 A 的正确句恰好是上面这个学科义的句子，导致辨义题的正确答案本身不在所教义项内。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 错句“这只财政报告很详细”的错误在量词“只”与“报告”的搭配上，与目标词无关。

definition: 工业设计是想好机器和用品应该做成什么样子，再让工厂去做。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for its block content. Its level_3 blocks, level_7 blocks, and the other level_6 items are clean. Keep 87108 instead.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 87108. Both gloss 工业设计 as the work of designing how mass-produced products look, function, and get made. The two senses teach the same meaning twice.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: "这款游戏的工业设计很有创意" is arguably acceptable. Game consoles and controllers have industrial design, so a judge could count this as correct and make the level_6 answer ambiguous.

definition: 代词，指自己或说话对方以外的人。
reviewer_notes: 因核心本身与 87113 重复而拒收，无需也未提供补丁。若要保留「自指」义项，需要新的例句与新的 plan。87113 的 B 级 level_6 中的自指例句已被替换，因此两个义项之间的边界需在重新生成时统一确定。
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: 全部 10 个例句都是第三人称用法，没有一个体现定义中新增的自指义项（「指自己」）。因此该义项在教学上与 87113 完全重复，学习者无法区分两者。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 「做错了事，要对您说对不起」是自然的句子，「您」在该语境下可以正确填入，因此干扰项实为正确答案之一。其解释所依据的「没有敬语语境」也不成立。; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 「自己没有请你，你别去了」中「自己」可被读作「我」，句子虽别扭但并非明显错误，干扰项较弱。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 「我们村有五个人家」的错误是量词问题（应为「户」），且句子使用的是名词义，与 level_6 语义辨析的练习目标不完全吻合。

definition: 前日是昨天的前一天。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 87118. The remaining items are listed so the owner can fix them if the sense is kept anyway. Sentences all use 前日 correctly as 前天. Level_3 cloze and level_6 wrong sentences are otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 87118. 前日 = 昨天的前一天 is 前天, the same meaning 87118 states as "昨天的前一天；前天". The two senses are indistinguishable.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: The explanation suggests 〈上个月〉 for the sentence "这封信前日一年才到". 上个月 is a point-in-time expression and does not fit 一年 (a duration), so the suggested fix is inconsistent with the sentence.; variants.A.level_7.error_description: The rule "后面不能直接加“的”" is false. 前日的作业 (sentence 7) and 前日的会议 (in 87118) are grammatical, because 的 can attach to 前日 when modifying a noun. The error in 我前日的才看见他 is the 的 before 才, not after 前日.

definition: 通过长期培养或反复练习而形成（习惯、作风、性格等）。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项不可单独用于出题，因此不对其 variants 作补丁。作风、性格类例句（如“军队的严格训练让他养成了好作风”）是唯一与 87119 不重叠的部分，若编辑决定保留它，需要另写义项。level_1 与 synonym_antonym_match 的 declined 块未评。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 sense 87119 的习惯义重叠：两者都指“反复做或长期培养后形成习惯”。87120 的习惯类例句（如“经过反复练习，他养成了准时上课的习惯”“小时候…养成…习惯”）同样符合 87119 的义项，学习者无法判断所指义项，level_6 与反义词配对的题目也会失去单一义项。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹“经长期培养或反复练习，形成习惯、作风、性格”几乎包含 87119 的指纹“天天重复做一件事，后来变成自己的习惯”，无法用于消歧。

definition: 厉害是很强，很了不起，也可以是很凶。
reviewer_notes: Reject. Sense 87123 is a strict subset of 87124, and two of its ten sentences belong to the degree sense that 87124 covers. Its definition, sentences and level_6 explanations contradict each other. Fold the usable sentences (0–7) into 87124, which already covers them. Regenerate blocks after the merge.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 「很强，很了不起，也可以是很凶」 is a subset of sense 87124 (本领强 / 凶猛). The two senses duplicate each other, so one word is taught twice with overlapping glosses.; core.sentences[8]: 「风刮得厉害，窗户一直在响」 is the 程度深 (degree/intensity) sense, which this definition does not cover and which sense 87124 already owns.; core.sentences[9]: 「我今天饿得厉害，想先吃点东西」 is the degree sense. It is used as variant B level_6 correct_sentence_index 9, so the 'correct' sentence does not illustrate this sense.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 「这首歌很厉害，我每天都听」 is acceptable under this sense's own definition (很了不起). The explanation 「不能用来评价歌曲的好坏」 is false for this sense, so the 'wrong' sentence is defensibly right.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 「这杯茶很厉害」 is ambiguous: 厉害 can mean strong or intense for drinks, so the 'wrong' label is not clean.

definition: 形容程度深、本领强，或者性格凶猛。
reviewer_notes: The core is not pinned to one sense, so all downstream blocks are contaminated.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition bundles three distinct senses: severe degree, highly skilled, and fierce. The sentences mix them: a fierce dog/tiger (0, 9), skill (1, 4, 6, 8), and degree (2, 3, 7). This breaks the one-sense rule.

definition: 高难是很难很难，不是人人都能做到。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，所有下游练习都会被污染。
reviewer_issues: core: “高难”基本是黏着的定语成分，常见用法是“高难动作”“高难度”，一般不作谓语，也不受“太……了”“……得很”“……极了”修饰。这个义项的例句（“跳舞实在太高难”“画这幅画高难极了”“高难得很”等）都不地道。另外，这个义项和 87128 实际上是同一个义项。

definition: 疑问代词，询问时间的长短。
reviewer_notes: Blocks otherwise pass: L3 options are single-correct, L6 and L7 sentences are valid. Borderline: the L6 wrong sentence 你是多久出生的？ is odd rather than clearly unacceptable. If this sense is kept instead of 87143, replace it. Plan active_levels includes level 2, but no level_2 block exists.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 87143. Both define 多久 as an interrogative pronoun asking how long, with the same usage. The ladder would repeat the same exercises under two sense ids.

definition: 副词，表示最理想的选择或希望；也指程度最高的。
reviewer_notes: Core is not a distinct sense. Sentence 4 also carries furigana while no other sentence does. Do not patch: the duplicate should be merged or deleted.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87147 同为「最好」的建议/理想用法，义项重叠。多句（如「我们最好今天就给他回信」「这件事最好今天做完」「你们最好能在六点以前到家」）实为建议义，与 87147 无法区分。另含「也指程度最高的」，但没有任何例句使用该义，定义与所用义项不一致。

definition: 队伍、阵地或飞行物的左侧部分；在政治上指倾向进步或激进的一派。
reviewer_notes: The core mixes two senses, so it is unusable. The political sense is also abstract and fairly hard for a T3 learner.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition and fingerprint combine two separate senses: the physical left side of a formation, position or aircraft, and the political left. The sentences split between them: 2, 3, 5 and 8 are military or aircraft; 0, 1, 4, 6, 7 and 9 are political. Because of this, the blocks test different senses. A/level_3 uses the political sentence. A/synonym_antonym_match explains 右翼 as an aircraft's right wing. A/level_7 mixes indices 0, 1 and 2, which cover both senses.; variants.A.level_7.corrected_sentence: The corrected sentence 这股左翼很有影响力 is unnatural. A native speaker would say 这一派左翼 or 这些左翼人士.

definition: 主教是教堂里管事的大人。他带着大家一起祈祷。
reviewer_notes: 判为 reject，理由是与 87154 重复。上列问题仅作记录，因整个义项应当删除，故不给出补丁。若团队决定保留 87153 而非 87154，上列问题须逐一修复，并重新运行计划器。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87154 指同一所指（神职人员主教），全部例句都是同一义项。这是同一义项被切成两条，且定义是口语化释义，并不构成独立义项。; variants.A.level_7: 错误句“主教讲很清楚”的错误是补语缺“得”，不涉及目标词“主教”，不符合 level_7 的要求。; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: “老大”可指群体的领头人，“老大站在教堂前面，带大家祈祷”勉强可通，因此可能与正确答案构成竞争。解释只以语域立论，理由不充分。

definition: 年内是在这一年的时间里。
reviewer_notes: The core sentences use 年内 unnaturally, so the downstream blocks inherit that defect.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: 年内 is almost always forward-looking: a deadline within this year. Retrospective sentences read unnaturally to native speakers, where 今年/这一年 is expected. Examples: 「他年内搬了两次家」, 「我年内一直在学做饭」, 「小王年内很忙」, 「这个城市年内下了很多雪」. The sense also barely differs from 87166.

definition: 供飞机起降、停放，并为旅客上下飞机提供服务的场所。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 87169 (airport). Its exercises were otherwise checked and no independent defects were found, but they are moot after deduplication. Do not patch.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87169 指同一义项（机场），只是把服务功能展开描述，义项重复，无法作为独立义项教学，会产生重复练习。

definition: 份额是分给每个人的那一份。
reviewer_notes: This core is unusable. The variants inherit the same unnatural food-portion usage.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: The sense 'a portion given to each person' (food portions such as cake, dumplings or fruit) is not how 份额 is used. Native speakers would say 那一份 or 份儿. Using 份额 for a person's share of cake is unidiomatic, so the core teaches a misuse. The sense also duplicates 87176, which is the real sense of 份额 (an entitled share of a whole).

definition: （股票等）开盘价低于前一交易日收盘价；比预期的起点低。
reviewer_notes: 拒收，核心不可用，不做局部修补。各块本身结构正确，但会把 87193 的同一义项重复教授两次。若要保留引申义，需要的是新的、以非股市语境为主的句子集，并同步重建 plan 的各个块。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把「开盘价低于前一交易日收盘价」与「起点比预期低」合并，而前半句与 87193 完全重合。sentences 0-5、7-9 都是股市义，只有 sentence 6（票房）体现引申义，引申义几乎没有练习覆盖。

definition: 副词，用反问的语气表示没有必要。
reviewer_notes: The core is a duplicate, so no patches are offered. The variants are otherwise internally sound: I found no distractor that is defensibly correct, and the level_6 and level_7 items hold up. The definition begins with '副词，', a POS label that does not belong in a gloss. The active_levels point about level_2 applies here too.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same single sense as 87201 (rhetorical 何必 meaning 'no need'). The fingerprint and all ten sentences teach the same meaning, so a learner would get two near-identical ladders.

definition: 指某事发生的那个月，或现在所处的这个月。
reviewer_notes: The individual sentences and blocks are mostly clean, but they teach the same sense as 87213 and cannot be made distinct without inventing a second meaning. Rejected as redundant, not for a sentence-level defect.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates sense 87213. Both definitions say the same thing ('说话的这个月/某事发生的那个月'), the fingerprints are near-identical, and the sentences use the same deictic and anaphoric frames. Shipping both would teach one meaning twice and split the item bank.

definition: 使身体或物体受到伤害或破坏。
reviewer_notes: 作为独立义项不可用，因此直接拒绝，无需补丁。若日后恢复，其反义块应使用修复，而不应以 no_relation 拒绝；其他块也需要按 87217 的标准重新核对。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87217 义项重复：释义同为把/使东西或身体弄坏、弄伤，十个例句的用法也相同，两个义项无法区分，会产生两套相同的练习。

definition: 在水上行驶的交通工具。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate sense. Its definition, 在水上行驶的交通工具, has the same meaning as 87219 (在水上走的东西，人和东西可以坐在上面), so both would produce near-identical exercises. Reject this one and keep 87219, which has the patches. If 87220 is kept instead, its A level_1 explanation for 床 has the same defect and needs the same fix.

definition: 搞钱是想各种办法去弄到钱。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so no patches. Defects that would need fixing if the sense were reinstated: variants.B.level_6 wrong sentences such as 他在收银台搞了钱 and 店员搞钱后给我找零 read as acceptable 'obtain money' usages, so the 收/付/退 contrast is not a clean error. variants.B.level_7 他正在想办法搞钱了 can be defended with sentence-final 了 (change of state), so it is not a clean error either. The declined blocks were not reviewed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense is a near-verbatim duplicate of sense 87226 (想各种办法去弄到钱 vs 设法弄到钱财). Both senses license the same sentences, so distractors and level_6 judgments cannot be sense-specific.

definition: 量词，用于定期的会议、毕业的班级等，表示次序。
reviewer_notes: Rejected for sense overlap, so no patches. The graduating-class sentences (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9) are otherwise clean and reusable once the sense is re-scoped. The other blocks read as correct but are not patched because of the reject. Declined blocks were not reviewed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition includes 定期的会议, which overlaps 87239 (定期举行的会议或比赛的第几回). Sentences 6 (第十四届人民代表大会) and 8 (这个大会每两年开一届) are meeting editions that 87239 already covers, so the two senses cannot be separated.

definition: 全马是一种很长的跑步比赛，要跑很远很远。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for block defects. If the owner keeps this sense anyway, B level_3 distractor 游戏 is weak: 跑 has a computing sense (跑游戏 = run a game on a machine), so the explanation calling it nonstandard is shaky. Replace it with a clearly wrong option such as 作业 (跑作业 is ungrammatical in this use).
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicates sense 87284. 全马 has one real meaning here (the full marathon), and 87284 defines it precisely. This sense's 'a very long running race' is the same meaning in vaguer words, and all ten sentences fit 87284 equally well. Two senses with identical sentences produce duplicate exercises and make sense-pinning meaningless.

definition: 加入某个政党并履行党章规定的人。
reviewer_notes: Blocks otherwise pass: L3 distractors (婴儿/党费/党校; 会员/学生/团员) are wrong, L6 wrong sentences fail for stated reasons, and L7 errors (台→位, missing 是) are valid. Plan active_levels includes levels 2, 4 and 9, but no matching blocks exist. Re-run the plan command if this sense is kept.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 87291. Both define 党员 as a member of a political party. The ladder would repeat the same exercises under two sense ids.

definition: 动乱是很多人吵闹打架，社会不平静。
reviewer_notes: The core sense is not a real, separate usage of 动乱. The anchor sentences would teach unidiomatic Chinese.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: This sense is pinned to a small, local brawl or crowd scene. That is not how 动乱 is used. 动乱 means large-scale social or political turmoil, and that meaning is already covered by sense 87310. Several sentences are unnatural for native speakers, who would say 骚乱 or 混乱 instead: 球迷之间发生了动乱, 有人大喊大叫，动乱越来越大, 广场上突然发生了动乱, 不要在人多的地方制造动乱 (should be 制造混乱).; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: This item marks '几个人之间发生了动乱' as wrong. That contradicts this sense's own core sentence 1, '球迷之间发生了动乱'.

definition: 吃穿是吃的东西和穿的衣服。人每天都需要。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable: the definition and most sentences rest on an unidiomatic, concrete reading of 吃穿. It is also redundant with 87350.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition treats 吃穿 as concrete, countable goods (food items and clothes). 吃穿 is a collective, abstract noun meaning basic livelihood. This sense duplicates 87350 with a drifted concrete reading.; core.sentences: Several sentences are unidiomatic because they treat 吃穿 as purchasable or mailable goods: [1] “寄来很多吃穿”, [2] “买了很多吃穿”, [3] “商店里卖的吃穿，样样都很便宜”, [5] “送去了吃穿”, [9] “把自己的吃穿分给了邻居”. Native speakers would say 吃的穿的 or 食物和衣服.

definition: 副词，用于追问；表示究竟；也表示最终。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项混杂，无法通过修补解决。追问义与 87353 重复，建议重新生成一个只含“终于/最终”义的义项。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把两个义项捆在一起（追问“究竟”和“终于/最终”）。句子 3、4、8、9 是“终于”义，其余是追问义，违反“一个义项”的原则。level_6 的正确句（索引 3）也属于“终于”义。; core.sentences[5].furigana: 中文句子不应带 furigana 字段（这是日语专用字段）。

definition: 生吃是没有煮熟，就直接吃。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的理由是重复义项，不是核心不可用。若编排者保留本条而非 87374，须先修复 A 组 L3 干扰项。L1 以「no_minimal_pairs」放弃，但「省吃」(shěng chī) 是声调近邻的真实词，可考虑生成选项而非放弃。
reviewer_issues: core: 定义与指纹（没有煮熟就直接吃）与 87374（不经烹煮而直接吃）描述同一义项，同一词条被拆成两个 sense，会产生重复练习。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 「啖食」本义即「吃」，填入「这种鱼可以___，很新鲜」语义上仍可成立；解释只说语域不协调，干扰项并非确实错误。

definition: 指事情发生的当天晚上。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的理由是重复义项，不是核心不可用。87379 更干净，应保留它。若保留本条，须修复 A 组 L3 的「当年」干扰项。其余各块（L6、L7 及 B 组）检查无误。
reviewer_issues: core: 定义（事情发生的当天晚上）与 87379 同义，同一词条被拆成两个 sense。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 「比赛结束后，他当年就回家了」语法通顺，「当年」的整年义与「就」并不冲突；解释称「当年」不能与「就回家了」搭配，这一说法不成立，干扰项并非确定错误。

definition: 送回；传回。
reviewer_notes: 判为 reject，理由是核心义项与 87387 重复。上述问题是即使保留该义项也需要修正的内容，我已一并列出，供保留时参考。句子本身的义项都是“送回”，目标词为整词，语域为中性。A.level_3 中“修”和“挂”、A.level_6 的三个错误句、B.level_6 中的“摘”和“搬”，都是明确错误。计划的 block 与本文档的句子索引一致。无法运行 fat_seed_runner.py，因此计划未重新生成。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与义项 87387 重复。两者都是“把东西或消息送回来源处”，词性、语义类别、句子覆盖的语义都相同。同一义项出现两次，学习者会看到两道完全相同的题。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “她被发回了上海”不是明确错误。“被发回”用于人员遣返或调回原籍，句子可以被接受。解释“发回不用于人员调动”是错误的。; variants.A.level_7.error_description: “着”的错误被归因于与“昨天”冲突，但“发回”是有终点的动作动词，无论有无“昨天”，都不能与“着”搭配。解释不准确。; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 干扰项“拆”存疑。“把它拆回工厂”可以理解为拆开后运回工厂，母语者可能接受，因此它可能是可辩护的正确选项。; core.sentences[7]: “学生把借来的书发回了图书馆”作为 B.level_7 的正确句不自然。归还图书馆的书通常说“还”，“发回”用于此处很别扭。; core.sentences[7].furigana: “学生”的第二个音节标为 shēng，正确应为轻声 sheng。

definition: 报告或宣布得分。
reviewer_notes: 核心即重复，故拒收，无需补丁。若保留本条，A 的 level_6 第 0 个错句「早操时，老师让同学们依次报分。」与 87393 的问题相同，在本义项下可以成立。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 「报告或宣布比赛得分」与 87393「把得了多少分大声说出来」为同一义项，且 10 个例句均与 87393 相同的用法一致。两个义项重复会让同一个词在两道练习中重复出现，干扰项与错句也无法区分。

definition: 精神生活是心里快乐的事，比如看书、听音乐。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable because of the drifted definition and unnatural collocations (精神生活很快乐/很满足). It is also redundant with 87410.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition '心里快乐的事' misdescribes 精神生活, which is a domain of life, not a pleasurable activity. As a result, many sentences treat it as a countable activity or a feeling. Examples: '周末去图书馆，是我的精神生活', '音乐是她最好的精神生活', '精神生活很快乐'. These are unnatural for a native speaker.

definition: 工资以外额外得到的收入。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的理由是义项重复，而不是单个句子有问题。87415 已覆盖同一用法，并且它的 level_6 干扰项更站得住。若 owner 决定保留本义项，必须先为它写出能与 87415 区分的释义，然后替换上面列出的三个 level_6 干扰句。A 与 B 的 level_3、level_7 和更正句本身没有明显问题。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “工资以外额外得到的收入”与 87415 的“做完正事以外，多得到的钱”是同一个意思。两个义项的句子无法区分，例如“他把外水都存进了银行”在两个义项下都成立。义项不能被锁定，这是核心缺陷。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “他退休后每月领一笔外水。”：按本义项“工资以外额外得到的收入”，养老金也是工资以外额外得到的收入，所以该干扰句可能正确。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1..2]: 利息（“朋友多还了一笔外水”）和彩票（“中了彩票，拿到一笔外水”）同样落在“工资以外额外得到的收入”之内。解释中“不是靠劳动得到”的理由不在释义里，所以这两个干扰句在本义项下都可能正确。; core.sentences[6]: 只有第 6 句带有 furigana 字段，且使用 ASCII 逗号，其它句子没有这个字段，结构不一致。

definition: 青年是年纪不大不小、有力气的人。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable, so no patches are offered. The variant blocks (A and B) would pass in isolation, but their explanations rely on the invented criterion (for example, the A level_6 explanation for 七十岁的老人). The sentences are otherwise grammatical and the level_7 errors are single, so the sentence set is not the problem. If 87419 is merged into 87420, the 87420 blocks already cover the same usage.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition makes 有力气 a criterion of the word. 青年 has no such sense; its lexical meaning is an age range (about 15 to 30). The sentences use the same ordinary young-person sense as 87420, and nothing in them pins a separate 'strong person' sense. The sense is a duplicate with a false gloss.

definition: 经过；路过。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for its exercise content; the blocks themselves were checked and are sound. If it is kept in place of 87433, core.sentences[9] ('这班公交经行医院门口，你可以在那儿下车。') is colloquial for a 书面 sense and needs the same register fix. That sentence is used by B level_6, B level_7 and B synonym_antonym_match, so changing it would also change those blocks.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. Its definition ('经过；路过') and fingerprint ('途中经过、路过某地') describe the same meaning as sense 87433 ('从一个地方走过去'). A learner cannot tell the two senses apart, and the same anchor sentences are correct under either.

definition: 在重要文件上正式签名，表示同意或认可。
reviewer_notes: Reject 的理由是重复义项，而非内容有误。已假定较小的 sense_id（87435）为规范义项，请对照义项清单确认。若该义项被保留，上述问题需一并修正。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87435 为同一义项：定义“在重要文件上正式签名，表示同意”与 87435 的“在重要的纸上写下自己的名字，表示同意”实质相同，sense_fingerprint 也几乎一致。两个义项无法在教学上区分，学习者会得到两套重复练习。; variants.A.level_1.options: A 的 level_1 选项与 87435 的 A level_1 完全相同（签署、签收、前述、钱数、签售）。; variants.B.level_3.options: B 的 level_3 选项（煮、咬、跳）与 87435 的 B level_3 完全相同。另外，正确项与干扰项的解释都写“在协议上”，但题干“他签署过很多重要的文件。”中没有“协议”，解释语境与题干不符。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “他们昨天签署着那份协议。”中的“着”表示过去某段时间内的持续动作，叙事中可以成立，错误不够干净，不能作为错误句。

definition: 县城是一个县里最热闹、政府所在的那个城。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the sense duplicates 87440. Keep 87440. morphological_forms lists measure words (个, 座) as forms; they are not morphological forms. B level_3 distractors (海底/太空/火星) are very easy but pass the stated rules. This review could not run the plan command, so plans must be regenerated after any change.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as sense 87440 (the county-government seat town). Two senses for one meaning split the exercise pool. The gloss '最热闹' is an unsupported claim, not a defining feature.; variants.A.level_7: error_description says the fix is 座 or 个, but the corrected sentence uses 次 ('去一次县城'), which is a different repair.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 乡镇 is not clearly false. Some county seats are themselves 镇, so '乡镇是县政府所在的地方' can be read as true.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: '我们县城有十个乡镇' is colloquially used to mean 'our county', so it is not a clean error.

definition: 老路是以前走过的路，或旧的办法。
reviewer_notes: Reject: the core conflates two senses and most of the B variant tests the figurative meaning, so no surgical patch fixes it. Regenerate as road-only. Sense 87448 already owns the figurative reading, so the two must be fixed together. No sentence in the document carries a 'mined' source marker, so none is protected from editing. Re-run the plan after regeneration.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges the concrete road reading with the figurative 'old method' reading (旧的办法). The figurative reading is the separate sense 87448, so this document is not a single sense.; core.sentences[4], core.sentences[5], core.sentences[6], core.sentences[7], core.sentences[9]: Five of ten sentences use the figurative sense: 这次比赛，我们不能再走老路; 他做生意总是走老路，不敢试新办法; 要想进步，就不能一直走老路; 老路走不通，我们得想新办法; 公司还是照着老路做事。 Sense pinning fails for a concrete-labelled sense.; variants.B.level_3 (plan sentence_index 6): The B cloze sentence (要想进步，就不能一直走老路) tests the figurative sense, not the concrete sense this document is labelled with.; variants.B.level_6.correct_sentence_index = 9: The correct answer (sentence 9, 公司还是照着老路做事) is figurative, so the semantic-discrimination item teaches the wrong sense.; variants.B.level_7.correct_sentence_indices = [6, 7, 9]: All three pool members are figurative sentences in a concrete-sense document.

definition: 正式向公众发布，使大家知道。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only because it duplicates 87449. Other defects that would still need fixing if it were kept: (1) A L7 incorrect sentence 「老师已经公布期末成绩。」 is acceptable. 「已经公布＋宾语」without 了 is standard news phrasing, so it is not a valid error. (2) The synonym_antonym_match decline is wrong for the same reason as 87449: 保密 is the antonym. (3) Lower priority: B L6 wrong 「她每天公布自己的心情」 is only weakly wrong for the 「公布」 reason.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 正式向公众发布，使大家知道 has the same meaning as sense 87449 (把事情正式告诉大家). The two fingerprints, sentence sets and exercises would teach one meaning twice.

definition: 没有听见；声音传不到耳朵里。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the sense duplicates 87455: both mean 'cannot hear'. The cause-based fingerprint (噪音、阻隔或设备问题) is context, not a separate sense. Keep 87455. If the inventory keeps both anyway, apply the A level_3 anchor fix above and the level_6 fixes, and regenerate the plan.
reviewer_issues: variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 听得到 is defensibly correct in the anchor '电话里有杂音，我听不到你说什么': '电话里有杂音，我听得到你说什么' is a natural concessive reading. The explanation's claim that 杂音 contradicts 听得到 is false.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: '这是什么乐器，我听不到。' can be read literally (the sound is too faint), so the error is not clean.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: '他说得太快，我听不到' is weaker than the intended 听不清, so the error is borderline.; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match and variants.B.synonym_antonym_match: Both are declined as no_relation, but 听得到 is a clear antonym of 听不到 in this sense.

definition: 她们是说好几个女孩子或女人。
reviewer_notes: Item content is otherwise sound: L3 options, L6 wrong sentences, and L7 spots check out. The 她們 繁体 entry in morphological_forms is a script variant, not a morphological form, and would need removing if this sense survived. Furigana appears only on sentence 7; no other sentence has it. The reject rests on duplication alone. Re-review only if the operator keeps this sense instead of 87466.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. 87466 has the same meaning (第三人称复数代词，指一群女性) and an equivalent fingerprint. 好几个 vs 两个以上 is not a sense distinction, so both senses would teach the same thing and produce identical correct answers.

definition: 用手拿着东西的一端，使它垂着；也指说起。
reviewer_notes: Reject: this sense is two senses. The definition and fingerprint combine carry (用手拎着) and mention (谈起). The carry sentences duplicate sense 87471. Because the core is not pinned, the blocks cannot be patched piecemeal. The level_6 and level_7 correct examples also rely on the carry sense. Regenerate as a mention-only sense and run plan on it. I could not run plan (no tools).
reviewer_issues: core.definition, core.sense_fingerprint, core.sentences: Two senses are merged: 用手拎着东西一端使其下垂 (carry, which duplicates sense 87471) and 也指谈起某事 (mention). Sentences 0, 1, 7, 8 are carry sense; sentences 2-6 and 9 are mention sense. This violates sense pinning.; variants.B.level_7.correct_sentence_indices: Correct sentence index 7 (她总是提着一个蓝色的小包) is carry sense, so it is not a valid correct example for this sense.; variants.A.level_3.options[0]: 抱 is defensibly correct: 一只手抱着 is idiomatic (e.g. 一只手抱着孩子), so 一只手抱着一个旧袋子 is acceptable. The explanation 「抱要用双臂环住」 is false.; variants.B.level_3.options[2] and options[3]: 陈述 and 发表: 什么也没陈述 and 什么也没发表 are grammatical and close in meaning to 说, so a native speaker could accept them. Their only stated reason is register, which is weak. This is a second defensible answer.; variants.B.level_3.options[0]: 见: the explanation 「前后语义矛盾」 does not hold. 什么也没见 is grammatical, so the stated reason is false.; variants.B.level_7: 他从来没提着这个计划 has the 着 aspect error, and 提着计划 is also a carry-sense misuse in a mention sense. That is more than one error.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 妈妈每天都提我带伞: 提 as mention or remind (cf. 提他一句) is colloquially acceptable

definition: 艾滋病是一种很厉害的病，会让身体不能抵抗别的病。
reviewer_notes: 核心问题是与 87474 重复。A 层级的错误句和干扰项均合格，B 层级的 level_6 与 level_7 也合格。若决定保留本条目而非 87474，需先处理上述 B level_3 的两个干扰项。

definition: 展示、观赏花卉的集会；也指民间节日里的表演活动。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable because two senses are conflated; regenerate it pinned to the folk-performance (民间花会) sense.

The sentences split between them: 0 and 8 use the flower sense, while 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 and 9 use the performance sense. This violates the one-sense rule.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences: All three wrong sentences can parse as 花 + 会 (will) and are then acceptable, e.g. 院门口的花会长得很高 and 院子里的花会开得很香.; variants.A.level_7.correct_sentence_indices: The block has [6,7,9], but the plan names [0,1,2].

definition: 对年长妇女的尊称；也指伯父的妻子。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项不可用，故拒收，无需补丁。由于 B 的 level_3（句 6）、level_6（句 9）与 level_7（索引 6、7、9）都依赖尊称句子，收窄后需整体重做。A 的亲属义项例句（如「我大妈是我爸爸哥哥的妻子」）本身没有问题。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义「对年长妇女的尊称；也指伯父的妻子」把两个义项合并在一条里。sense_fingerprint 同样合并两者，违反「一个义项一个 sense」的要求。; core.sentences[6]: 「大妈，您要买什么？」与「那位卖菜的大妈很热情。」是尊称义项的用法，不属于亲属义项。; core.sentences[9]: 「对门的大妈每天都给花浇水。」两种义项都可以理解，无法确定其所指。

definition: 很大的数目；也指数量庞大的整体。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的理由是重复，而不是单个句子的错误。大部分句子（如“这个大数太长了，我读不出来”“一亿是个大数”“把这些小钱加起来，也是个大数”）都可以在 87491 下正确解释。level_3 的干扰项（歌曲、脾气、体温；颜色、外貌、手机）和 level_6 的错句在各自义项下基本成立，但它们只为一个复合释义服务。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “很大的数目；也指数量庞大的整体”是两个义项挤在一个定义里。第一个分句与 87491 完全相同。第二个分句（“数量庞大的整体”）没有在句子中形成与之区分的用法：“宇宙里星星的数量是个大数”等句子同样可以解释为 87491 的义项。这违反一个义项对应一个释义的规则。; variants.B.level_1: 与 87491 相同：B 声明 no_minimal_pairs，但 A 给出了三个声调最小对立干扰项。

definition: 大雨是下得又多又快的雨。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only because of the duplicate sense. Other defects, moot if this sense is dropped: (1) B level_1 is declined as no_minimal_pairs, but A uses 大鱼/大于/打鱼, which are tonal contrasts with 大雨, so the decline is invalid. (2) The wrong sentences 山上积了厚厚一层大雨 and 农民用两桶大雨浇地 appear verbatim in 87496. If the lexicon instead keeps this sense, its gloss must first be made distinct from 87496, and then B level_1 needs the same fix as 87496.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. '下得又多又快的雨' and sense 87496's '雨量大、雨势猛的雨' describe the same lexical sense of 大雨. Both senses would teach the same word with the same kind of sentences.

definition: 年轻的女子。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项重复，不可补丁。句子及 A、B 各块的选项本身没有明显错误（已核对）。保留哪一条由编辑决定。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87499 同义（“年轻的女子”与“年纪轻轻的女孩子”几乎相同）。同一义项被拆成两个 sense_id，学习者无法区分，两套练习教的是同一个义项。

definition: 由保险公司收取费用，在发生约定的事故时赔偿损失的一种经济制度。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项与 87503 重复，因此不可单独发布。若裁决方向相反（保留本义项、删除 87503），则需对 87503 做同样的判断，本文件的其他检查不影响裁决。仍需注意：B level_6 错误句 1“他把书放进保险里”与 87503 同样存在保险柜的口语风险；A level_6 错误句 3“把存折保险在抽屉里”的保管义可能是方言用法。这两处在删除前不必修改。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87503 指同一个义项（保险作为收费赔偿的制度）。两个义项的 sense_fingerprint 都是“收费/先交钱并在出事时赔偿”，例句也是同一种用法（如“买保险以前，要看清楚合同”与“买保险就是先交钱”）。作为独立义项，它会造成重复教学。

definition: 副词，每一个地方；处处。

Sentences 0, 2, 5, 6 and 9 use the same 遍布 construction (到处是/都是) as 87511, so no judge can separate the two senses.; core.definition: The definition has a stray part-of-speech label (副词，) inside the gloss and is glossed by a synonym (处处).; variants.A.level_1: The level_1 options are identical word-for-word to 87511's A.level_1, which is a copy.

definition: 博物馆是放着很多旧东西的大房子，人们可以去看。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用的原因是重复义项，而非句子有误。各变体本身干净：L3 四个选项唯一正确，L6 三个错句均因场所错误而错，L7 错误单一且为量词“只”，修正句正确，L1 的 no_minimal_pairs 声明可接受。若需保留，只能并入 87518 名下。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87518 指称相同（收藏、陈列文物的场所）。“放着很多旧东西的大房子”只是 87518 的口语复述，同一意义被教授两次。

definition: 形容词，指是同一个，没有分别。
reviewer_notes: 无补丁，核心重复。若义项保留，还需处理：A level_7 的“同一个医院”→“同一家医院”，个与家对医院的使用较弱，口语中“一个医院”也常见，应换成更清楚的量词错误；A level_6 的“她是家里同一的孩子”与 87523 A 的“这是他同一的机会”同类，含义是“同样的孩子”，并非明确错误；B level_6 的三个“同一”动词用法干扰句与 87523 B 的问题相同；level_1 的放弃不成立。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87523 的定义和指纹实质相同（都是“同样的、没有分别”）。“同一个城市”“同一天”与 87523 的“同一个人”考查的是同一个义项，学习者无法区分两者；“不同”对两者都是正确反义，干扰项设计也无法分开。核心不成立。; core.definition: 定义以词性标签开头（“形容词，指是同一个……”），这是标签而不是释义。; variants.A.level_1: 以 no_minimal_pairs 放弃不成立（同意、同音可用），与 87523 相同。

definition: 朝好的方向发展。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, so no patches. Its blocks are otherwise well-formed. The A level_7 「形势慢慢向好下来」 has the same complement issue as 87529. Recommended action: keep 87529 and merge any market or situation sentences into it.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87529 为同一义项（情况朝好的方向变化）。fingerprint 只在主题上不同（市场/形势/环境 对 天气/病情/关系），学习者无法区分两个义项，同义反义和完形题的答案也完全相同。

definition: 无论是说，不管怎么样，结果都是一样的。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 87536. Every sentence here is the same sense as 87536, so keeping both would give learners two identical exercises. The core definition is also garbled. Do not patch; 87536 is the surviving sense. The plan's active_levels [1,2,3,6,7] includes level 2, which has no block. The A level_3 distractor 「虽然」 and the A level_6 wrong sentences are acceptable on their own, but they are moot once this sense is dropped.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 「无论是说」不成句，定义首句不通顺，不能作为教学用释义; core: 与87536是同一义项的重复切分：定义、指纹（「不管怎样，结果都相同」与「条件不同而结果不变」）和全部10个例句均属同一义项，同一个词被教两次; variants.B.level_7.error_description: 规则“就”不能与“无论”搭配”过度概括；“无论…就…”在部分语境下并非绝对不成立，错句的错因应表述为「无论」应与「都/也」呼应

definition: 事物变动的大小范围或程度。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 87539, not for the content of its blocks. Sense 87539 passed review, so this is the one to retire.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition restates sense 87539 ('变化的大小'). The two senses cannot be told apart, so learners would meet the same meaning twice.

definition: 计算；核算；也指当作、认作。
reviewer_notes: The core mixes two senses, so the sense must be split and regenerated.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two distinct senses: 计算／核算 and 当作／认作. The sense_fingerprint does the same. Sentences 0–3 and 8 use the 'calculate' sense. Sentences 4–7 use 'regard as / count as'. Sentence 9 (算进去, 'count in') falls between the two. This breaks the one-sense rule, and every exercise inherits the ambiguity. Variant A teaches 'calculate' and B teaches 'regard as', so they test different senses.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: In '我来算一下明天的天气' 算 can be read as 推算／占卜. The sentence is not cleanly wrong.; variants.B.level_1.options[2]: 炫 xuàn differs from suàn in both the initial and the medial (üan vs uan). It is a weak listening confusion.

definition: 做事；办理事情。
reviewer_notes: 因重复而 reject，不做补丁。B 变体的 level_7（再行事了）与 87549 的 B 错句相同，同样存在重复。请以 87549 为准，本条的其他问题仅供参考。

reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把行政单位说成“部门”，但举例“县和市”是行政区划而不是部门。sense_fingerprint 同样有此矛盾。; sentences: 多数句子（0、1、3、4、5、6、7、9）使用的是“区划”义，与 87557 完全重复。句 2 和句 8 又把它当作“办事机构”，句 2“每个行政单位都有自己的政府部门”也说明它与“部门”不是同一个词。义项混杂。

definition: “卫星电视”的简称，指通过卫星传送节目的电视台。
reviewer_notes: 计划中未安排 synonym_antonym_match，但 variants.B 含有已声明放弃（no_relation）的该块，不一致。另外 variants.A.level_3 的干扰项“学校”并非明确错误（校园电视台确实存在），若保留该义项应替换。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87563 为同一义项：定义、sense_fingerprint 基本相同（“卫星电视的简称／用卫星传节目的电视台”）。卫视只有这一个义项，此文档是重复的义项，会让同一义项被教两次。

One meaning would be taught twice, with overlapping sentences (开元 here, 贞观 in 87570).; variants.B.level_1: Declined as no_minimal_pairs, but variant A's distractors 连号, 年报 and 年货 are valid sound-alikes for the same headword, so the stated reason is inaccurate.

reviewer_notes: 各练习块（level_1 A、level_3、level_6、level_7）单独看基本合格，但核心义项重复，学习者会在两个义项中学到同一含义。请并入 87582。

reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87603 的义项完全重合（猪肉作为食用的肉），同一义项被拆成两个。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “奶奶昨天在超市买了两条猪肉。”中的“条”对五花肉等说法可以接受，错句不干净。
