definition: 转身回去；转往别处。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，因此拒绝。例句 0–2、5–9 与 87631 是同一义项（改变去向）；例句 3–4 是“改行／改学”的用法，定义没有描述。此外，A 组 level_7 的解释同样有“决定……了”的问题，与 87631 B 组相同。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “转身回去；转往别处”与 87631 几乎完全相同，同一义项被拆成两个。; core.sentences[3]: “这家公司……转去做电脑了”表示改行，是定义未涵盖的另一种用法。; core.sentences[4]: “后来转去学音乐”同样是改学的用法，定义中没有。

definition: 向好的方向变化。
reviewer_notes: 因重复而拒绝。上述 level_7 问题与 87637 相同，仅在保留本义项时才需要修复。core、L1、L3、L6 的内容与 87637 基本一致，且无额外问题。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87637 为同一义项：“向好的方向变化”与“从不好变得好起来”描述的是同一变化。两个义项对同一批句子都成立，学习者无法区分，会造成重复义项。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “他的身体慢慢转好着”不是干净的错误，着可表示持续状态。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “两个人的关系最近慢慢转好过”中的过表示经历，语法成立，且 core.morphological_forms 将“转好过”列为有效形式，故不是错误句。

definition: 推送是把新的消息送到你的手机上。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not rewritten, so the blocks were not itemized. If the owner wants a separate phone-notification sense, it needs a contrast that its sentences actually demonstrate and a full re-review of every block. No patches are proposed because the core is unusable as a separate sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 87642 (主动将信息、内容发送给用户). 把新的消息送到你的手机上 is one instance of it, and the two senses cannot be told apart. Their sentences test the same meaning, for example 87641 sentence 0 (手机每天都会推送新闻) and 87642 sentence 2 (公司每周都向用户推送一次新内容). Sense-pinned items would have more than one defensible answer.

definition: 办事处是一个机关在外地设的办事的地方。
reviewer_notes: No patches, since the core is redundant. If it were kept instead, the definition 机关在外地设的办事的地方 conflicts with sentence 0 (公司在上海有一个办事处) and sentence 1 (这家银行在北京设了办事处). The fingerprint says 机关或公司, so the gloss and sentences disagree. Otherwise the level_3, level_6 and level_7 items check out. Declined blocks were not reviewed.
reviewer_issues: core: Sense duplicates 87644. Both describe an off-site office set up by an organisation for handling affairs. The split between premises (87643) and institution (87644) is not a dictionary sense distinction.

definition: 到处寻找。
reviewer_notes: 判定为 reject 而非 rewrite：核心义项与 87647 重复，任何句子或题块补丁都无法使其成为独立的教学义项。应合并或删除。以上块级问题仅供参考，若该义项被保留才需处理。未输出补丁。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87647 为同一词、同一义（「到处寻找」与「到处找」），指纹实质相同：同一义项被切成两个，学习者无法区分。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「救援队搜寻的一艘失踪的渔船」是名词性片段，作定语的名词短语本身合法，不是可辨认的句子错误；解释所称的「搜寻的一艘」错误不干净。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「搜寻着了」与 87647 相同的问题：与「找着了」同构，错误不干净。; core.sentences[9]: 「医生在资料里搜寻这种病的原因」滑向「查究/研究」义，不是「到处找」义，不宜作本义的正确例句。

definition: 连作是在同一块地里，一年又一年种同一种菜。
reviewer_notes: This sense duplicates 87650. If it is kept anyway, it needs the same fixes as 87650: the L1 distractors 连锁, 廉租 and 兼作 are not sound-confusable; the 单作 explanations are wrong; and sentence 7 has a stray furigana field.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This is the same sense as 87650 (continuous cropping), narrowed to 菜 (vegetables). It is a duplicate or drifted sense, not a distinct one.

definition: 进学是去学校读书，或者学问越来越多。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as a single-sense seed: two senses are mixed and the document duplicates 87656.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition combines two senses: 去学校读书 (enrolling in school) and 学问越来越多 (making progress in learning). The sentences split between them. Sentences 0–5, 8 and 9 mean 'enroll'. Sentences 6 and 7 mean 'make progress'. This breaks the one-sense rule, and the level_3 and level_7 blocks inherit the ambiguity.; core: This document duplicates sense 87656: same lemma, same combined definition.; core.register: The register is 书面语, but most sentences are plain spoken modern Chinese. Also, 进学 in its attested use is literary or historical (科举 entry into the county school), not ordinary 'go to school'.

definition: 入学读书；学业有所长进。
reviewer_notes: The sense-pinning failure is in the core. This sense also duplicates 87655.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: '入学读书；学业有所长进' is two senses. Sentences 2, 5, 6 and 8 use the 'progress' sense; the others use 'enroll'. Variant B's level_3 anchor (sentence 6) is in the progress sense, while level_6 and level_7 explanations assume the enrollment sense. As a result, A/B exercises teach different senses.; core.register: The register is 书面语, but the sentences are colloquial modern contexts. 进学 is literary or archaic for these situations.

definition: 向外发出（气味、热量、光等）；分发。
reviewer_notes: B 变体（分发）的例句与各练习块本身合格，可直接用于新的「分发」义项。A 变体的「发出热量、光」例句与 87659 重复。整体需要拆分，不能通过补丁修复。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 同一义项混合了两个义项：「向外发出（气味、热量、光等）」与「分发」。变体 A 的例句（发出热量、光）与变体 B 的例句（分发传单、材料）属于不同义项，违反「每句只用一个义项」。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹同时包含两个义项（「向外发出热量、光」「分发材料」），无法用于消歧。; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: 正确句「月亮散发着白白的光」与事实不符：月亮反射太阳光，并不发光。

definition: 忘记；对过去的事物不再记得。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，因此拒绝。它与 87661 重复。其他问题仅作记录：A 组 level_7 的“遗忘了了”过于明显，几乎不构成判断。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “忘记；对过去的事物不再记得”与 87661 的“以前的事想不起来了”实为同一义项，被拆成两个。; core.sentences[5]: “想把那些难过的事遗忘”“请不要遗忘”是有意忘记或叮嘱的用法，定义未单列。

definition: 遗迹是很久以前的人留下来的旧东西或旧房子。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 87668. Apart from that, the blocks mostly check out: L1 distractors are real tone or minimal-pair confusables, L3 has exactly one correct option, and L6/L7 explanations match the sentences. Active levels 2, 4 and 9 have no blocks in the document or the plan. Confirm with the plan command before reinstating any sense.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicates sense 87668. Both cover the same meaning (ancient remains or ruins), with the same POS, pronunciation and measure-word logic. Sentences such as 这处遗迹每年吸引很多游客 and 游客可以参观这片古老的遗迹 fit both senses, so the one-sense-per-sense check fails.; core.register: Registered as 书面语, but several sentences are colloquial (我们在遗迹前拍了一张照片。, 大雨把那里的遗迹冲坏了一部分。).; variants.A.level_7.error_description: Says 遗迹 must take 座 and that omitting it is the error. Correct sentence 2 uses 片 (这片遗迹), and sense 87668 teaches 处, so the measure-word claim is overstated.

definition: 刚刚上任的；新担任某种职务的。
reviewer_notes: The blocks were checked and read cleanly apart from the duplication. A level_1 repeats the 欣然 distractor, which fails the minimal-pair rule (vowel and tone both differ). B level_1 has the same false no_minimal_pairs decline as 87677.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 87677 (刚上任、新担任职务的人). The lemma would carry two senses with identical meaning, so a learner gets two indistinguishable senses for one word.

definition: 针是又细又尖的小铁棍，缝衣服时用。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a subset of 87680. Apart from the overlap, the blocks are sound: the L1 minimal pairs (zhěn, zhèn, shēn, zhēng) are valid, each L3 has one correct option, the L6 wrong sentences are wrong for stated reasons, and the B L7 error (missing 的) is real. If the inventory should keep a sewing-only sense, narrow sense 87680's definition to injection and reinstate this one. As delivered, the two overlap. Active levels 2, 4 and 9 have no blocks; confirm with the plan command.
reviewer_issues: core: Subsumed by sense 87680. 87680 defines 针 as 缝纫、注射等用的细长而尖的工具, which already covers sewing. This sense's definition and fingerprint (缝衣服用的针) sit entirely inside it.; variants.A.level_1: Level 1 options are identical to sense 87680's level 1 options, so the same listening items would appear under two senses.

definition: 法庭是一个大房间，里面有人来说谁对谁错。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用的原因是重复义项。变体本身基本干净：L3 与 L6 的错句均有明确错因，L7 单一错误且修正正确。风险提示：B 的 L3 干扰项“菜市场”在打烊后也可能安静，但“没有人说话”使其仍基本不成立；若保留此义项，应替换该干扰项。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87688 指称相同（法院审理案件的场所）。“一个大房间，里面有人来说谁对谁错”是其口语版，同一意义被教授两次。

definition: 星际是说星星和星星中间的地方。
reviewer_notes: Core unusable: it pins a noun use that is not idiomatic. Every downstream block inherits the defect.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: In modern Chinese, 星际 works almost only as an attributive modifier (星际旅行, 星际空间, 星际物质). As a standalone noun meaning 'the space between stars' it is unidiomatic. That makes 来到了星际, 飞向星际, 去过星际, 进入星际, 星际一片漆黑 and 广阔的星际 all unnatural, so the core teaches a usage native speakers would not produce. Natives would say 星际空间 instead.; core.morphological_forms: The listed forms (星际空间, 星际物质) are exactly the attributive compounds that show 星际 is not a free noun. The sense also overlaps 87702.; variants.A.level_7: The 一颗/一片 measure-word contrast presupposes that 星际 can be counted as a noun. 一片广阔的星际 is itself unnatural, so the 'corrected' sentence is still wrong.

definition: 天体之间的；星球与星球之间的。
reviewer_notes: The core misrepresents the attributive sense and overlaps 87701. Both senses should be rebuilt as a single 星际 (attributive) sense.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: The sense is attributive ('天体之间的'), but 9 of the 10 sentences use the pleonastic 星际之间 ('between-the-stars between'). That treats 星际 as a noun plus the locative 之间, which is not the taught adjectival use. The real use (星际旅行, 星际飞船, 星际航行) never appears. Sentence 1 (学习星际的通信方式) is unnatural; native speakers say 星际通信.; variants.A.level_7 / variants.B.level_7: The errors concern a missing 的 after 之间. They do not involve the target's own usage, and the 'corrected' phrase 星际之间的X is still pleonastic.; variants.A.level_3.options: The explanation for the correct answer endorses '星际之间' as the normal form, which teaches the redundancy.

definition: 介绍赛马马匹情况、供人参考的出版物。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is not distinct from 87711, so it cannot be taught as a separate sense. Merge or retire. The issues above are recorded for the record and were not patched. If the inventory keeps 87712 instead of 87711, apply those fixes and re-review. The sentences are grammatical and the level_1, level_3 and level_7 distractors are otherwise valid.
reviewer_issues: core (sense as a whole): Sense 87712 duplicates 87711. Both are a publication giving horse-racing information. The sentences fit either definition, so a learner cannot be taught two distinct senses.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: The 诗集 explanation cites register. The actual failure is semantic: a poetry collection does not record horse speed.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: The correction is given as 〈杂志〉, but 学做新菜 is naturally 食谱. The explanation's answer is ambiguous.

definition: 生活在海洋中的大型凶猛鱼类，牙齿锋利。
reviewer_notes: 因重复而拒绝，内容本身不予修补。其余块（A 的 level_1、level_3、level_6、level_7；B 的 level_1、level_3、level_6）未发现其他问题。declined 块未审查。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 87719（鲨鱼）为同一义项：定义“生活在海洋中的大型凶猛鱼类，牙齿锋利”与 87719 的“海里很凶的大鱼，牙齿很尖”几乎相同，指纹也重叠，同一词条下出现两个重复义项。; variants.B.level_7: 与 87719 相同：错误句“渔船旁边的鲨鱼游很快。”的错误在谓语，不涉及目标词。

definition: 使完整的东西受损，出现裂口或碎开。
reviewer_notes: 按照严格标准，本义项的核心不可用：它与87737重复，不应作为独立义项存在。建议合并到87737；若需要保留皮肤、蛋壳的用法，应另行生成一个窄义项，并避免与87737的物体用法重叠。本文档中的各层级选项在别处可以通过审核，但不会被采用。另外，核心的active_levels包含2、4、9，但文档与计划中都没有这些层级，也没有拒绝记录；重新规划后请核对。
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: “使完整的东西受损，出现裂口或碎开”与87737“东西被弄坏了，有了洞或者裂开了”几乎是同一义项，两者无法作为独立的教学义项区分。; core.sentences: 10句中至少有6句（船底、墙上、皮球、雨衣、窗上的纸、鞋底）描写的正是87737已经教授的“物体出现洞或裂口”。定义中的“碎开”也没有任何例句支持。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0..2].explanation: 解释分别虚构“破”为“花”“客气”“辞”的义项，这些义项并不存在，解释不真实。

definition: 副词，表示根据观察所作的推断。
reviewer_notes: Taken on its own, the content is fine: the blocks are well formed, the distractors are wrong for the stated reasons, and the level_7 error is real. It is rejected only because it duplicates 87739. Keeping both would give learners the same meaning twice. The plan also lists level 2 as active with no level_2 block.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 「根据观察所作的推断」 is the same sense as 87739 (「看了以后觉得可能是这样」). Both senses are the inference adverb 看来.; core.sense_fingerprint: 「根据观察到的情况作出推断」 cannot be told apart from 87739's fingerprint, so the disambiguation signal is empty.

definition: 机车是拉着很多车厢跑的火车头。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only as a redundant core; its content is otherwise sound. The sentences are correct and the level_1/3/6/7 options and explanations check out. If the merge decision is reversed, the document needs only optional furigana: only sentence 3 has it, while 87701 has it on every sentence.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 87741 (拉着很多车厢跑的火车头) and 87742 (牵引列车的动力车辆，即火车头) both gloss the same locomotive sense with the same pos, semantic_class, and morphological forms. A learner would be taught one meaning twice.

definition: 作为凭证的纸片，凭它可以入场、乘车等。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant core, so no patches. If the sense were kept anyway, variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1] (「他忘了带票，手机没电了。」) would need replacing: 票 is used correctly there and the two clauses are unrelated, so the sentence is acceptable and not a valid wrong sentence.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 87745. The definition (「作为凭证的纸片，凭它可以入场、乘车等」), fingerprint, morphological forms, IPA, and level_1 distractors are effectively identical to 87745. Two senses teaching the same meaning would show learners the same item twice.

definition: 从飞机上下来。
reviewer_notes: The blocks are internally clean (A level_3, A/B level_6, A/B level_7, antonym), so the only defect is redundancy, and a patch cannot fix that. If the entry is kept anyway, sentence 0's furigana has inconsistent syllable spacing (fēijī instead of fēi jī).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 87751. 「从飞机上下来」 and 「下飞机是从飞机上走下来」 are the same meaning; the fingerprints differ only in wording. Two entries would teach one meaning twice.

definition: 结论是想了很久以后，最后得到的答案。
reviewer_notes: The sense cannot be taught separately from 87754. Learners would see the same meaning under two fingerprints, and the level_6 wrong sentences would be defensibly correct under one of the two definitions. Recommended fix: merge into 87754 and drop 87753. The level_3, level_7, and level_6 blocks are otherwise well formed. The plan also lists level 2 as active with no level_2 block, and level_4 as active with no level_4 block.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 「想了很久以后，最后得到的答案」 overlaps almost entirely with 87754's 「分析、研究之后得出的最后判断」. Every example in this sense (「我想了一晚上，终于有了结论」, 「这个结论我想了很久，不会改」) is also a judgement that 87754 covers.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences: The explanations treat 结论 as 「分析研究后的判断」, which is 87754's definition, not this sense's. Under this sense's own definition (「想了很久后得到的答案」), 「比赛的结论出来了，我们赢了」 and 「这道数学题的结论我算错了」 are not clearly wrong, so the distractors are not safe.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences: Same defect as variant A: 「大家对这个方案提了很多结论」 and 「老师给我提了很好的结论」 are judged against 87754's definition, not this sense's.

definition: 人的数目。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 87755. If the team keeps 人的数目 wording, merge it into 87755 rather than regenerating it.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 人的数目 duplicates sense 87755 (有多少个人). The two senses cannot be taught apart, so the sentence pool and exercises overlap.; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: 数量 is arguably acceptable in "公司里的数量一年比一年多".; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 人群 is defensible in "这次活动的人群有限制" (cf. 限制人群).

definition: 把书籍、报刊、图片等印制后向公众发行。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 87763. If merged, the broader scope here (报刊、图片) is the coverage worth keeping.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 把书籍、报刊、图片等印制后向公众发行 duplicates sense 87763 (把书印出来，让大家都能买到).; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 这份报纸每天出版 is grammatical. The error rests only on the object 一条新闻, so the sentence is weak as a wrong example.

definition: 回来，返回。
reviewer_notes: If the duplicate call is overruled, these also need fixing. A level_7 「他上海归来，带了很多礼物」 is not clearly ungrammatical: 「X归来」 is attested in colloquial and 海归-style phrasing, so a native judge may rate it acceptable (score 1-2). B level_7 「归来了了」 is a typo-level error. B level_6 wrong sentence 2 「这条河每年春天都归来」 is verbatim the same as 87765's B level_6 wrong sentence 2.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 87765 (回到原处 after leaving). 回来，返回 and 离开一段时间后又回到原来的地方 describe one meaning, so the lemma would carry two indistinguishable senses.

definition: 在中学就读的学生。
reviewer_notes: 核心不成立：与 87767 为同一义项，按规则判为 reject。若最终保留本义项而非 87767，还需修复：B level_3 的“童子”可以构成可辩护的正确搭配（“童子要努力学习，准备考大学”语法成立），应换成“幼儿”。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义与 87767 完全重复（在中学就读的学生 / 在中学里读书的学生），两个义项无法区分，学习者无法判断以哪一个为准。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0..1]: “这所幼儿园里有很多中学生。”与“我妈妈是中学生，每天在学校教书。”两句与 87767 的 B level_6 完全相同。

definition: 从生到死的整个过程；终身。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 87769, which should be kept. The core is redundant rather than broken, so no patches are offered. Also, level_1 is declined as no_minimal_pairs in both variants, which is wrong for the same reason as 87769 (医生 yī shēng is a tone minimal pair). The level_7 A error sentence 「他一生了都热爱音乐」 reuses the template from 87769, which is minor. If the sense were ever kept, both the core and the level_6 sentences would need rewriting.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 「从生到死的整个过程；终身」has the same meaning as 87769's 「一个人从出生到死去的整个时间」. The sentences use 一生 with the same meaning (noun 'lifetime' and adverbial 'throughout life' both appear in 87769 and 87770), so the split is not a real sense distinction.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences: Several 'wrong' sentences are not clearly wrong. 一生就 + completion can mean 'in one's whole life, only', so 「我一生就学会了游泳」 and 「我们一生就做完了作业」 are at least arguably acceptable. The stated error (一生 cannot express a short duration) does not match the actual defect.

definition: 在一定的数量、时间或范围之内。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for sentence quality. If it were kept, it would still need fixes: variants.A.level_7 uses 这间教室的面积在一百平方米以内了 as a 体标 error, but 了 is grammatical here and room area does not change, so the explanation is wrong. variants.B.level_7 (这次活动的费用五百元以内) repeats 87775's 介词缺失 error.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. Its definition (在一定的数量、时间或范围之内) and fingerprint (表示数量、时间或空间的界限之内，不含超出的部分) describe the same meaning as 87775, and all ten sentences use the same 'within a limit' reading. Two senses for one meaning would produce duplicate exercises.

definition: 意外发生的、造成损失或伤害的事情。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate; the choice of which copy to keep is a judgement call, and 87785 has fewer defects. If this copy is kept instead, fix these: (1) variants.B.level_3 distractor 声 is arguably sensible in 为了不出声，工人每天都检查机器, so it may be defensibly correct; replace it. (2) variants.B.level_7 incorrect sentence 报告到了警察 is marginal, and its error is a verb/preposition choice rather than anything involving 事故, which the checklist flags. (3) variants.A.level_3 explanation for 演讲 overclaims: 演讲 can be a subject, and the real problem is that 这起 is a classifier for incidents. The planner was not run.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 87785. Both define the same accident sense (没有想到的坏事 / 意外发生的坏事) with near-identical fingerprints and overlapping sentence content.

definition: 血液从身体伤口流出。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate. Both the definition and sense_fingerprint describe the same sense as 87789 (blood flowing from a wound), so the learner would be taught the same meaning twice. Keep 87789 instead. If this sense were kept, it would still need: (1) variants.B.level_3.options[1] 挂彩 replaced, because it is a near-synonym meaning wounded and fits the blank; (2) level_1 declined as no_minimal_pairs in both variants, though 留学 and 牛血 exist.

definition: 随手写的简短书信或字条。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as redundant, not for a content defect. If the human chooses to keep 87800 instead of 87799, these must be fixed first. (1) variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1], 他给我写了一张长便条，讲了很多往事, is only weakly wrong: 长便条 is contradictory with the sense's brevity but native speakers accept it. (2) variants.B.level_3.options[3], 通知, can fit 邻居留下一张___，上面写着谢谢 and is a register argument, not a meaning one.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 87799. Both define 便条 as a short handwritten note, and the sentence sets overlap in substance. Two senses that cannot be told apart make the sense-specific exercises ambiguous and teach the same meaning twice. 书信 in this gloss also blurs the boundary with a letter.

definition: 什么时候是问哪一天、几点。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项与 87802 重复，不应作为独立练习保留。逐句、各级练习的正确句与错误句本身无误，plan 与文档的句子索引一致。level_1 声明 no_minimal_pairs 合理。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87802 为同一义项（疑问代词，询问时间），属重复。定义「问哪一天、几点」过窄，「什么时候」还可问年、月、季节，如「你什么时候出生的」。; core.sentences[9]: 该句多出 furigana 字段，其余句子没有，结构不一致。

definition: 火力是火的热力，也指枪炮打出去的力量。
reviewer_notes: 拒收：核心不是单义。87813 与 87814 覆盖相同的两个义项，句子交叉。修复需要重建，不宜打补丁。热力义可用句 0–5（炒菜、炉子、煮汤），枪炮义可用句 6–9。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 一条记录合并了两个义项（“火的热力”与“枪炮的力量”）。87813 与 87814 的定义重叠，且各自的句子都混合了两义：句 0–5 为烹饪热力，句 6–9 为武器。; variants.B.level_1.options[1]: 国力、互利、火炉与火力的听感差距超过一个音位（声母或韵母加声调），不是纯声调混淆，听力题不合格；火炉还含目标字“火”。

definition: 枪炮等武器发射弹药所产生的杀伤力；火焰产生的热力。
reviewer_notes: 拒收：核心不是单义，且与 87813 重复。修复需统一重建两条记录，不宜打补丁。枪炮义可用句 0–4、7–9，热力义仅有句 5–6，需补充。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 同样合并两义（武器的杀伤力；火焰的热力），与 87813 重复。句 0–4、7–9 为武器，句 5–6 为热力，两义混杂。

definition: 信息学是学怎么收集、存放和用好信息的学问。
reviewer_notes: 因重复而拒绝，且书面语域与句子不符。应保留 87816，其句子语域与声明一致。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87816 为同一学科的重复义项：“学怎么收集、存放和用好信息的学问”与“研究信息的获取、处理、存储与传递的学科”指同一对象。; core.sentences[9].text: 声明语域为书面，但多个句子是口语：“信息学让我知道怎样快点找到需要的资料。”（快点）。; core.sentences[6].text: “信息学老师说，好的资料要放对地方。”口语化，与书面语域不符。; core.sentences[5].text: “学了信息学以后，我会整理电子文件了。”为口语，与书面语域不符。

definition: 反而是结果和你想的不一样，是相反的。
reviewer_notes: 保留 87820。87819 的各项选项与句子本身基本可用，但与 87820 重复，两者都保留会让学习者重复学习同一义项。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 87820 为同一义项（出乎预料，与常理相反），属重复。; core.sense_fingerprint: 「做了某事，结果和想要的相反」限定为行为结果，遗漏 87820 中「天气没那么冷了」「路上的人少了」等非行为结果的情形。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 「他一向很认真，学习反而很好。」与 87820 的 variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2] 完全相同，跨义项重复干扰句。

definition: 国家的最高领导人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as redundant with 87831. Its option blocks are otherwise well-formed, but a second sense for the same head-of-state meaning, with a less precise gloss, would only create confusion.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 87831, which describes the same head-of-state sense. Also, 国家的最高领导人 can be read as head of government, which contradicts core sentence 4 (有的国家，元首和政府首脑是两个人。).

definition: 明亮耀眼的；形容伟大、灿烂。
reviewer_notes: 因重复而拒绝，内容本身不予修补。另外，B 的 level_3 干扰项“辛辣”搭配“一生非常辛辣”也较牵强，但这一点不影响结论。declined 块未审查。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 87839（光辉）为同一义项：定义“明亮耀眼的；形容伟大、灿烂”与 87839 的“很亮的；很了不起”含义相同，指纹覆盖同样两种含义，属重复义项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “他为家乡赢得了光辉。”中“光辉”作名词，未必是错句，与 87839 的同一问题相同。

definition: 副词，表示将来可能出现。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate sense, not as a sentence-level defect. The sentences are the same future-time use as 87843, and the 'possibility' gloss is not a lexical property of 将会. If a probability sense is wanted, it needs a different lemma (e.g. 可能 or 也许), not this one. Minor: the definition begins with a part-of-speech label ('副词，'), which should not appear in learner-facing text.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “表示将来可能出现”把“可能”写成了词义，但将会不表达可能性。所有例句（如“天这么黑，晚上将会下雨”）用的都是 87843 所述的确定的将来义。; core.sense_fingerprint: “表示将来可能出现某种情况”与 87843 的“表示事情以后会发生”无法区分。学习者找不到任何词汇或句法上的差异来区分两个义项。

definition: 公认是大家都觉得是这样。
reviewer_notes: Reject. The sentences are fine as attributive uses, but the sense itself is a grammatical form of the verb in 87846. If the team wants to keep it anyway: variants.A.level_3 option 个人 (“大家个人的好办法”) and option 秘密 (“大家秘密的好办法”) are not clearly wrong in their anchor sentence, and variants.B.level_3 option 偶然 (“偶然的聪明人”) is only weakly wrong. Those would need replacing. Also, the morphological_forms entry 繁体 (公認) is a script variant and is not a morphological form.
reviewer_issues: core.pos: 形容词不成立：“很公认”“这个办法很公认”都不通，所有例句都只用“公认的”作定语。这是动词“公认”的定语形式，不是独立的形容词词类。; core.definition: 与 87846 是同一义项（大家一致承认），属于重复切分。两个义项的 sense_fingerprint 都描述“大家都承认”。

definition: 军队中由若干部队组成的大单位；也指有军事性质的生产组织。
reviewer_notes: Cannot survive as written. Do not merge it back into 87849, because 87849 has no production-organisation sentences and the production meaning would then be unsupported. The existing blocks were built on the blended sense (A level_3 uses a military sentence, B level_3 uses a production sentence), so they are not reusable as-is.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses with 「；也指」: the military large unit and the 生产建设兵团 agricultural/military-production organisation. A sense entry must cover one meaning.; core.sentences: Sentences mix the two meanings. 1, 4, 6 and 9 are the production organisation (新疆的兵团, 北大荒, 农场, 父母都是兵团人). 0, 3, 5, 7 and 8 are military. Sentence 2 mixes both (种地 with 保卫边疆).

definition: 离开国境或某个区域的边境。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用：本义项是 87859 的近重复，其两个变体的错误句与干扰项都建立在与 87859 相同的语义上，且存在的边界区分无法通过补丁修补，因此整体判为 reject，不提供补丁。变体中的个别问题（例如 B 组 level_6 的“过了这座桥，车就出境了”作为正确句，其边界语义并不明确）在重建时一并处理即可。mined 句：无。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87859 义项重叠：两者都指离开本国或越过国境，区别只在于是否“去别国”，同一义项被切分为两个，学习者无法区分。; core.sentences: 十句中绝大多数（如“车队从北边出境，进入邻国”“逃犯想出境”“李先生开车出境，很快回国了”）都完全符合 87859 的义项，并不能体现 87860 的独立用法。; core.sentences[7]: “大雪封住了山口，车队无法出境”中的“山口”并非国境或区域边界，句子所示的是通行受阻，而非越过边界离开。

definition: 出面是自己站出来，去办一件事。
reviewer_notes: 作为独立义项不成立，应删除。删除后下列问题无需处理。A 的 level_3 干扰项“动身”和 B 的“睡觉”都属边界情况（“一睡觉”不如“睡一觉”自然），若恢复本义项，需交由裁判判定。synonym_antonym 的 no_relation 声明可能过早：“袖手旁观”可作为该义项的反义候选，需复核。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 87864 实为同一义项：两者都是“亲自站出来去办事”，例句用法没有区别，属于重复义项。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: “出血”可指付出大笔钱财（如“这次终于肯出血”），“他一出血，问题就解决了”并非明确错误，因此该干扰项不成立。解释“出血指流血”也不完整。

definition: 分析处理是先把事情弄清楚，再想办法解决。
reviewer_notes: 作为独立义项不成立，应删除，保留 87868。删除后下列问题无需处理。各块干扰项本身未发现问题，但语域问题集中在句子层面。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 87868 实为同一义项：“先把事情弄清楚，再想办法解决”与“先对问题进行剖析，再加以处理”含义相同，指纹也高度重合。; core.sentences[6]: 语域不符：声明为书面，但“家里的矛盾，你来分析处理吧”口语化明显。; core.sentences[5]: 语域不符：“妈妈遇事冷静，总能分析处理好”口语化明显。; core.sentences[2]: 语域偏口语，且 furigana 字段仅出现在第 2、8 句，各句字段不一致。

definition: 待人亲切、积极、充满热忱。
reviewer_notes: 其 L3、L6、L7 和反义词题与 87869 高度重复，不应单独保留。若要保留“积极、充满热忱”这一义项，需要先另写能体现该义的例句，再重新送审。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87869 的义项“对人很好、让人暖和”几乎同义。所有例句都只表达待人亲切，没有“积极、充满热忱”的用法，学习者无法区分两个义项。

definition: 长度单位，一米的十分之一。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so the core is unusable as a separate sense. Its B L1 decline has the same unsupported 'no_minimal_pairs' problem as 87871.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 87871: same lemma, pos, definition, sense_fingerprint and morphological forms. Two sense IDs teach the same meaning.

definition: 总部是一家公司或一个团体里管所有事情的地方。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the core is a duplicate of 87878. Keep 87878 as the surviving sense. If this sense were kept instead, the issues above would need patching. Plan mismatch: plan B has no synonym_antonym_match block, and active_levels lists 2, 4 and 9 with no blocks. Confirm whether those levels are intentionally empty when the plan is regenerated. Sentence objects carry no source field, so mined status could not be verified.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. The definition (管所有事情的地方) and fingerprint restate sense 87878 (机构或企业的最高领导和管理部门所在地). Two senses with the same meaning cannot be taught as separate items.; variants.B.synonym_antonym_match: The correct option 次等 is not an antonym of 总部 in this sense. The explanation discusses 上等, which is not the target word. The plan has no synonym_antonym_match block for B, so this block is spurious and factually wrong.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 这支救援队在山区设了几个总部 is defensible. Regional HQs (地区总部) exist in the plural, so the explanation 总部只有一个 is false.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 这家快递公司在每个城市都有总部 is defensible as regional HQs. It is not clearly wrong, so it breaks the level_6 contrast.

definition: 股东是拿钱买了公司一小块，因此也算公司主人的人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected in favour of 87892. This definition (拿钱买了公司一小块，因此也算公司主人的人) describes acquisition and mentions only people, whereas 87892 covers persons or entities holding shares. The other blocks I checked were clean apart from the L1 decline. The planner was not run.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 87892. Both describe the shareholder sense, and 87892's definition is the more accurate one.; variants.A.level_1: The decline no_minimal_pairs is factually wrong. 古董 (gǔ dǒng) differs from 股东 (gǔ dōng) only in the tone of the second syllable.; variants.B.level_1: Same false no_minimal_pairs decline as variants.A.level_1.

definition: 素材是写文章或画画时，用来做材料的东西。
reviewer_notes: Core is redundant rather than unusable on its own, but two senses that cannot be separated by any test item fail the one-sense-per-sense requirement. The level_6 wrong sentences here also rely on the claim that 素材 is creative-only (「我们用钢铁素材造了一座桥」「这些素材可以做成一顿好饭」), which is contestable because 金属素材 and 烹饪素材 are attested. Not patched because the sense is rejected. Level_1 declines (no_minimal_pairs) look plausible but were not checked against a dictionary. The plan lists active levels 2, 4 and 9 with no matching blocks; I could not run the plan command to confirm this, so it is unverified.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Sense 87919 (写文章或画画时用来做材料的东西) duplicates sense 87920 (创作文学、艺术等作品时所用的原始材料). Both cover the same creative-material meaning, and the sentences are interchangeable across the two (e.g. 87919 #0 我在生活中找写文章的素材 vs 87920 #3 作家从生活中选取创作素材). A learner cannot tell which sense a distractor or wrong sentence is testing.

definition: 传统戏曲中扮演中老年男子的角色；也指留级的老学生。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the core bundles two senses: the opera role (中老年男角) and the 留级 student. Sentences 0-4, 8, and 9 are opera uses, while 5-7 are student uses. This breaks the one-sense rule and the sense_fingerprint covers both. The opera part duplicates 87935, which is already a clean single-sense entry. The 留级 gloss also looks narrower than common usage, where 老生 generally means a continuing (non-freshman) student; check the gloss. Fix upstream by splitting the entry. A separate student sense would need new sentences, which JSON patches cannot supply.

definition: 集在一起的人或组织；也指球形的东西。
reviewer_notes: Do not patch; regenerate after the split. After the split, rerun the plan for each new sense (PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python scripts/fat_seed_runner.py plan RUN --source reviewed --senses <sid>) and read plans_reviewed/<sid>.json. Two level_6 wrong sentences in the current document are borderline and should be rechecked in the new sense documents: 大家团在一起吃了晚饭 (团 as an intransitive verb is marginal; 团聚 is the usual form) and 我们团赢得了比赛 (team usage in sport prefers 队, but 团 as a group is not clearly ungrammatical). The lump-sense sentences 5-8 and the 量词 blocks are otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Two senses are combined in one document: 人的团体 (我们团, 入团, 导游带着我们团) and 球状的一团东西 (一团毛线). The sentences split the same way: 0-4 and 9 are group, 5-8 are lump. The one-sense-per-document rule fails, and this cannot be repaired by patch.; core.morphological_forms[0]: 個 is the traditional form of the measure word 个, not a form of 团. Labelling it 量词 under 团 points learners to the wrong character in a simplified-character course.

definition: 反间是想办法让坏人那边自己人吵起来。
reviewer_notes: This is a redundant sense with an unidiomatic police/坏人 framing. Teach the word through 87962 only.
reviewer_issues: core: This is a duplicate of sense 87962 (same lemma, same meaning) with a childish gloss. The definition reframes 反间 as police acting against 坏人, but the word belongs to military and historical stratagem contexts. Sentences such as 好人想办法反间坏人 and 电影里的警察常常反间坏人 are unnatural and drift from the real usage.

definition: 大会是很多人聚在一起开的大型会。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 87966; retire this sense rather than patch it. Also, in level_3 variant A, 篮球赛 is excluded only by the 礼堂 venue cue. The sentence is weak, so the sentence should carry a stronger cue if this sense is ever revived. The level_1 distractors and level_6/level_7 blocks are otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 87966 为同一义项（「很多人聚在一起开的大型会」与「人数多、规模大的会议」相同），两个义项会生成几乎完全相同的练习块。

definition: 用绳子等把东西悬挂起来。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate. If it were retained, its synonym_antonym_match declines would have the same unsupported 'no_relation' problem as 87971.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 87971: both define 吊 as hanging something up with a rope, with the same pos and semantic_class.

definition: 左右是左边和右边，也可以说差不多。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项捆绑了两个义项，无法单独锁定，因此判为 reject，无需补丁。拆分后请对每个新义项分别重跑 plan，并核对 active_levels 中的 2、4、9 是否需要块。与 87978 为同一组义项，应一并拆分。
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: 释义把两个义项并列（“左边和右边，也可以说差不多”），句子 0、1、5、7、8 为方位义，2、3、4、6、9 为“大概”义。义项没有锁定，无法作为单一教学义项。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: “整”（我每天七点整起床）语法成立，句子本身不能排除它。; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: “出头”（七点出头起床）本身就是一种大致时间的说法，原解释“一般不用于描述大致时间”不成立，属于可成立的替代答案。; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: “以后”语法成立，但改变了时间范围，句子本身无法据此排除。这一干扰项也只是表面不同，区分度不足。; variants.B.level_1: 声明 no_minimal_pairs，但“座右”（zuò yòu）为声调对立的真实词，可能存在可用的 L1 干扰项。; core.sentences[7].furigana: 只有这一句带有 furigana 字段，其余句子没有，格式不一致。

definition: 左边和右边；也表示大概的数目。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项捆绑了两个义项，判为 reject，无需补丁。A 的 level_3/level_6/level_7 及 B 的 level_6/level_7 已核对，句子结构和正确句索引无误。拆分义项后请对每个新义项重跑 plan。
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: 释义同样捆绑了方位义与“大概”义（“左边和右边；也表示大概的数目”），义项未锁定，与 87977 重复。; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: “有余”表示“二十多”，是书面的近义表达，放在“教室里有二十个人___”中可以成立，不能作为错误项。; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 解释“‘之外’前不能直接接数量短语加名词”不成立：“除这二十人之外”是正常说法。句子不通的原因是“之外”缺少前置范围，而不是这一语法限制。

definition: 声音杂乱、喧闹；也指争吵。
reviewer_notes: Reject. This sense mixes an adjective (noise, 6-7 sentences) with a verb (quarrel, 3 sentences). It also duplicates 87979's noise sense almost completely, so patching it would just produce a second copy of 87979. Recommended path: keep 87979 as the sole noise sense; if the quarrel sense is wanted, create a new 动词 sense with its own definition, fingerprint, and sentences. The variant-level errors above (L1 distractors 操/槽, mixed-sense L3/L7) are real but secondary to the core problem.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition joins two senses: noise (形容词) and 也指争吵 (quarrel, a verb sense). A learner-facing gloss covering two senses breaks the one-sense rule.; core.sentences[6], core.sentences[7], core.sentences[8]: Three sentences use 吵 as the verb to quarrel (隔壁的邻居又吵起来了 / 你们别吵了，有话好好儿说 / 他们为了一点儿小事吵了一个小时). This contradicts pos 形容词 and the noise fingerprint.; variants.A.level_7 and variants.B.level_7: Spot-the-error exercises mix senses. A's corrected sentence 吵起来了 and B's corrected sentence 吵过 and sentence 6 are quarrel-sense uses, so one exercise tests two senses of 吵.; variants.B.level_3: The cloze sentence (隔壁的邻居又吵起来了) is the quarrel sense, not the noise sense the record describes.; variants.A.level_1.options[4]: 槽 (cáo) differs from 吵 (chǎo) in both initial and tone. It fails the L1 distractor rule.; variants.B.level_1.options[3]: 操 (cāo) differs from 吵 (chǎo) in both initial and tone. It fails the L1 distractor rule.

definition: 用手臂围住（人或物）。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 87981, not for block-level errors. The A and B distractors and L7 indices are otherwise sound. Keep the hug meaning only if the sense is rebuilt with new sentences and a new definition.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Definition 用手臂围住（人或物） and fingerprint 用手臂围住并拿着人或物 duplicate sense 87981 (两臂把人或东西围在身前). Sentences 1, 2, 3, 4 and 8 are hold/carry uses that 87981 already covers, so the two senses teach the same meaning and generate duplicate exercises.; variants.A.level_3: Anchor 妈妈抱了抱孩子。 contains 抱 twice. The blank position is unspecified, and the explanation refers to 第二个抱, so the cloze is ambiguous for a learner.

definition: 广场是城里一大片没有房子、可以玩的空地。
reviewer_notes: The individual sentences are clean and all use 广场 in the open-space sense, so the defect is sense-level redundancy. If the owner decides the play-space meaning is genuinely distinct, it needs its own definition and fingerprint before any item can be judged.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 87986. Both define 广场 as a city's open public space for people to use. The 'play' vs 'civic activity' split is not a separate meaning, so a learner gets two indistinguishable senses and relation or collocation items cannot be checked against one without also matching the other.

definition: 自行车的另一种说法。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as the redundant copy of 87987, which is the sense to keep. The level_6 defects above are moot if this sense is dropped. Level_3 and level_7 blocks were otherwise clean. Declined blocks were not reviewed.
reviewer_issues: core: Redundant sense. 自行车的另一种说法 is the same bicycle meaning as sense 87987, so the learner gets the same answers from two senses.; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: The correct option 周末我们去公园骑单车吧。 has no classifier, but the wrong options are 只/条/张 errors whose explanations say 应该用〈辆〉. The discriminator is absent from the correct sentence.; variants.B.level_6.correct_sentence_index: The correct option 路边停着很多单车。 has no classifier, while the wrong options are 座/块/把 errors with explanations saying 应该用〈辆〉.

definition: 四下是四边，周围各个地方。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant duplicate of 87996, not for content quality. Other blocks were checked and are otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: core: Same sense as 87996: identical meaning (周围各处), near-identical fingerprint, same target and same kind of sentences. Keeping both teaches one sense twice.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 远处 is defensible in 他____看了看，没有一个人 when read as looking from afar. Not a clean distractor.

definition: 晚是时间过得很多了，比应该到的时间慢。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on the definition defect and as a duplicate of 87998. The sentences and option blocks are otherwise well built (for example, the level_1 tone pairs 玩/万/满/往 are correct), but the core cannot be kept with a garbled definition.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义「晚是时间过得很多了，比应该到的时间慢」不通顺。「时间过得很多了」描述的是夜深之义，「比应该到的时间慢」用「慢」代替了「迟」，与所教的迟到义不符。; core.sense_fingerprint: 与 87998 同为「迟于规定或预期的时间」，义项重复，会生成几乎相同的练习。

definition: 出发或动身的日期。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on duplication alone. If the inventory keeps both, the same B level_1 decline fix applies, and B level_7 (“这次行期推迟三天”, missing 了) carries the same borderline risk as 88007 A level_7.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 88007 (“出发或动身的日期” vs “要出门走的那一天，指动身的日子”). The sense_fingerprint is equivalent and the sentences test the same meaning, so two documents would drill one sense twice.

definition: 为着是说做一件事的原因，或者为了谁。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate sense, not as a sentence-level failure. Sentences 0-9 are otherwise natural and the L1/L3/L6/L7 distractors are sound, but the sense split is not justified. If a maintainer wants a separate beneficiary sense, that is a sense-inventory decision requiring a rewritten definition and a separate sentence set.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 88010 (为着 = 为了, purpose/reason). The 'beneficiary' reading ('为了谁') is not a separate dictionary sense, and the sense_fingerprint nearly duplicates 88010's. The definition is also ungrammatical ('为着是说做一件事的原因').

definition: 地步是事情变成的某种坏的样子或程度。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 88012. Its sentences and level_7 errors were otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: core: Same sense as 88012: 事情发展到的坏的样子或程度, 常说「到了……的地步」. Two entries teach one sense.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 他的汉语进步到了能看小说的地步 uses 地步 for a positive change. That use is attested (e.g. 发展到令人惊叹的地步), so the 'wrong' sentence is acceptable.; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 时候 in 他的汉语差到了听不懂老师说话的____ is awkward but reads as a possible fit.; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: 样子 in the same blank reads as 'looking like he cannot understand', a possible fit.

definition: 网址是上网时，一个网页的名字。
reviewer_notes: Rejected: the core definition is factually wrong (名字 instead of 地址) and the sense duplicates 88016. Most of the URL-meaning sentences are fine, but the sense cannot stand on its own. Keep 88016 and drop this one.

The sense also duplicates 88016 (互联网上网页的地址).; variants.A.level_3.options[0]: Correct-option explanation says 网址是找到网页的名字, which teaches the wrong meaning.; variants.B.level_3.options[0]: Correct-option explanation says 网址是找到这个游戏网页的名字, which teaches the wrong meaning.; core.sentences[9]: Sentence 网址是网页的名字，每个都不一样。 states the wrong meaning. definition: 针对是对着某件事或某个人去做。
reviewer_notes: 义项本身有问题（见 issues[0]），所以判为 reject，不做逐块修补。若清单只保留一个 针对 义项，请与 88026 择一，而非两个都保留。A 的 level_1 以 no_minimal_pairs 拒答可以接受；synonym_antonym_match 以 no_relation 拒答可以接受。plan 中 active_levels 列出了 2、4、9，但没有对应 block；我无法运行 plan 脚本，作者需用 fat_seed_runner.py plan 核对。A、B 的 level_6 与 level_7 的错误句在其余方面基本成立。
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: 与 88026 义项重叠。88025 的句 0（他说的话是针对谁的？）和句 2（这条新规定是针对迟到的人定的）是“指向对象”义，与 88026 的指纹一致；88026 的句 1、2、4、5、8 则是“对某事采取行动”义，与 88025 的指纹一致。两个义项的指纹互相覆盖，句子无法按锁定义项归类。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 干扰项“替”：“他说的话是替谁的？”可以理解为“代谁立言”，语法上可接受，因此不能确定它是错误选项。; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: 干扰项“从”：“他的批评是从工作，不是从人”可以理解为“批评从工作出发”，属于自然说法，与正确答案同样成立。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 干扰项“凭”：“凭工作”作依据解较为牵强，属于临界干扰项。

definition: 对着某个对象或目标。
reviewer_notes: level_6 的 A、B 错误句都是真实的误用，level_7 的 A、B 都只有一个错误，B 的 level_3 干扰项基本可以接受，但这些都无法挽救义项重叠的问题。
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: 与 88025 义项重叠，原因同 88025 的 issues[0]。句 1、2、4、5、8 属于“对某事采取行动”义，不符合“指向对象/目标”的指纹；句 0、3、7、9 才是目标义。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 干扰项“冲”不成立：“这篇文章是冲小学生写的”是自然的正确说法（冲着小学生写的），干扰项与正确答案同样成立。解释“冲表示朝着某个方向冲去”也不准确。

definition: 词语是说话和写字时用的一个个字词。

definition: 大致；基本上。
reviewer_notes: 因与 88033 重复而拒绝。两者中保留哪一个属于判断问题，本次保留 88033。若改为保留本文档，上面列出的 2 至 5 项都需要修正。按 reject 的规定，不提供补丁。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88033 为同一义项：同为副词“大体”，释义均为差不多、大致、基本上，sense_fingerprint 也几乎相同，两个义项重复教学。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “请大体加入两勺糖”在菜谱中可表示大约用量，句子并非明确错误。; variants.B.level_1.options[1]: 大地、大力、大戏与大体只有首音节相同，第二音节的声母和声调都不同，听感上不混淆。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “我大体明天到”可作“大概”的口语用法，句子不一定错；解释“不能用来推测将要发生的事”不准确。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “这座楼大体有三十层”是自然的约数说法，句子并不错。

definition: 钱财和物品的总称。
reviewer_notes: The reject follows from the duplication with 88047. If upstream keeps both senses, the borderline wrong sentence above must be fixed, and the missing level 9 block must be resolved by rerunning the plan, as in 88047. The rest of the content is clean.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 88047. 钱财和物品的总称 and 钱和值钱的东西 describe one meaning, with overlapping sentences and fingerprints.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 这栋房子是他的财物 is borderline. Legal usage can extend 财物 to some property, so a judge may find the sentence acceptable.

definition: 连词，表示联合关系，“及”和“其”的合用。
reviewer_notes: Reject. Sense 88062 duplicates 88061 and contradicts it. Its definition describes coordination (和), but the sense 88061 blocks and this sense's own wrong_sentences teach that 及其 can only introduce a part of the preceding item. Its sentences mix both uses (公园及其附近, 书及其作者, 问题及其原因). Either merge its genuinely part-whole sentences into 88061 and delete this sense, or redefine it as a distinct sense with its own sentences and regenerate its blocks from the plan.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “连词，表示联合关系，‘及’和‘其’的合用”不是词义释义，而是字源式描述。它与 88061 的“前面的事物及其一部分”直接冲突。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 本义项自身矛盾：定义说“及其”表示联合（和），而同一 block 判定“我及其朋友”为错误，理由是朋友不是“我”的一部分。; core.sentences[2].text: “请介绍一下这本书及其作者”“我们研究了这个问题及其原因”等句中，后项并非前项的一部分，实际用的是并列义，正是 88061 L6 判为错误的用法。; variants.A.level_1.options: A、B 两个 level_1 选项集与 88061 的 B、A 逐项相同（仅顺序互换），属于复制。

definition: 表示动作或情况在不久以后就会发生。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant sense, not for sentence errors; the sentences fit the gloss. If the sense were kept, the B level_3 distractor 不断 for 学校___放假 is arguably natural. Whether to merge is a human decision.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss '表示动作或情况在不久以后就会发生' is the same sense as 88063 ('过一会儿就会发生'). A learner cannot use the difference, and the level_3, level_6 and level_7 items test the same contrasts (将要 vs 已经, 将要 with 会, 语序) as 88063.

definition: 召集人开会，并使会议举行。
reviewer_notes: 义项冗余，因此没有逐块审核。注意 A 的 level_1 与 88067 完全相同，合并时应只保留一份。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88067 义项重复：两者都表示“召集/举行会议”。句子如“这次会议是谁召开的？”“大会已经顺利召开了”“会议将于明天上午九点召开”同时符合两个义项，无法锁定单一义项，学习者会看到两个相同的义项。

definition: 身体的后面；也指死后。
reviewer_notes: 义项混杂，带来以下连锁问题：B.level_6 的锚句（句 9）、B.level_7（“身后的人”）和 B 的反义题都落在方位义上。另外，“死后”义的反义词应为“生前”，而不是“身前”。把“身前”作为死前之义，这一说法存疑。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义同时包含“身体的后面”和“死后”两个义项，违反了单一义项规则。句 7、8、9 用的是方位义，与 88071 重复。

definition: 本国以外的地方；外国。
reviewer_notes: Every sentence and block is internally consistent, but the core duplicates sense 88075. Rejecting it avoids teaching the same sense twice. The level 3 distractor 家乡 is judged wrong, though 前后矛盾 is a loose reason. Plan active_levels [1,2,3,4,6,7,9] include 2, 4 and 9, which have no blocks here. This does not change the verdict, but the plan should be checked.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 本国以外的地方；外国 and the fingerprint 本国以外的地方，指外国 describe the same meaning as sense 88075 (自己国家的外面，与国内相对). Two senses for one meaning would produce duplicate exercises.

definition: 培养；使人成才；也指创造出成就。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core fails one-sense pinning and duplicates 88087. Other items, if the sense were kept: the same B level_1 decline inconsistency (minimal pair 早就 exists, as in 88087), and the level_7 A/B errors “造就了过” are clear.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Blends two senses: 培养人 (already covered by 88087) and 促成 or 创造出成就. A standard dictionary gloss gives only 培养使有成就, so the second sense is not a clean separate sense. Sentences drift into it (“时代造就英雄”, “这份工作造就了她的事业”, “他靠自己的双手造就了一番事业”).; core.sense_fingerprint: The fingerprint 使人成才，或促成、创造出成就 cannot pin one sense, and it overlaps 88087's 培养人才.

definition: 逼和是下棋时被对方逼到不输，最后和对方一样。
reviewer_notes: 该义项的核心（释义、指纹与例句）内部互相矛盾，且与同词的 88094 重复，无法通过局部补丁修复，因此判为 reject。应保留 88094。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义说“被对方逼到不输”，即施力方是对手，受力方是说话人。而 sense_fingerprint 写的是“下棋快输时设法逼成和棋”，即快输的一方主动施力。两者对施力方的判断相反，文档内部自相矛盾。; core.sentences: 几乎所有例句（如“我的棋快输了，他最后把我逼和了”“这局棋我快输了，他怎样才能把我逼和呢”）都描述占优的一方使快输的说话人和棋，这与“逼和”的通常含义（处于劣势的一方迫使对手接受和棋）相反，句子本身也存在逻辑矛盾。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: “歼灭”在“我的棋快输了，他最后把我歼灭了”中语义通顺，且体育报道中常说“歼灭对手”，在锚定句中也可成立，因此不是明确错误的干扰项。解释称“歼灭”是军事口语以外的用语，与事实不符。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 解释称“救活”不用于棋局，但“救活这盘棋”是常见说法，因此该干扰项的解释有误，且其在句中的可用性存疑。; sense_inventory: 与 88094 为同一词、同一义项的重复，且 88094 的释义和例句与“逼和”的通常含义一致。

definition: 此次是说这一次。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 88096. Separately, A.level_1 says 此词 means 这首词, which is wrong: 词 here means 'word'. The same issue appears in 88096.
reviewer_issues: core: This is a duplicate sense. Its definition (这一次) and its fingerprint are identical in meaning to sense 88096 for the same lemma 此次. The two documents also reuse the same level_1 block and near-identical level_6 sentences.; core.sentences: The declared register is 书面, but several sentences are colloquial (此次我只想休息一下, 此次的天气比上次好). The definition 此次是说这一次 is also malformed.

These would need fixing only if the sense were kept.

definition: 发行是把书、钱等做好后，拿出来给大家。

Rejected only because the core duplicates 88104. The plan lists active levels 2 and 4 with no corresponding block. The plan and document agree, so nothing was added, but the planner's active_levels look inconsistent and should be checked.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 88104. Both define the same meaning (书刊、钱币等向大众发行/发售) with near-identical fingerprints, sentence sets and distractors, so learners would be taught one meaning twice.

definition: 拍出是用手或相机，把东西弄出来。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as written because one sense is taught through two meanings. Exercises built on it, such as the level_6 explanations that say 「拍出只用于相机…或用手拍打」, teach a conflated sense. Restructure this sense together with 88122: give one the photography sense and the other the patting sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 「用手或相机，把东西弄出来」 merges two different senses into one: 拍摄出 (taking a photo or film) and 拍打使…出来 (patting or beating something out). The sentences reflect the merge. Sentences 2, 4 and 8 use the patting sense (灰尘, 一团灰, 土). Sentences 0, 1, 3, 5, 6, 7 and 9 use the photography sense. Sense 88122 has the same merged definition, so the two senses are near-duplicates.; variants.A.level_7.correct_sentence_indices: The indices [0,1,2] mix both senses: index 2 is the patting sense and indices 0 and 1 are the photography sense.

definition: 拍摄出；用手拍打使之发出或出来。
reviewer_notes: Reject together with 88121. The two documents conflate the same two senses and duplicate each other.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 「拍摄出；用手拍打使之发出或出来」 explicitly lists two senses. Sentences 4, 5, 6 and 8 are photography or filming. Sentences 0, 1, 2, 3, 7 and 9 are patting. The sense overlaps almost completely with 88121.; variants.B.level_3: The anchor sentence for this block, 「她拍出的照片…」, uses the photography sense, while variant A teaches the patting sense.; variants.B.level_7: In the corrected sentence 「他用力拍桌子，拍得出很大的响声」, the potential complement 拍得出 is unnatural in a narrative clause; 拍出了 is the natural form. As written, the correction teaches a questionable form.

definition: 闪电是下雨时天空里一下子亮起来的光。
reviewer_notes: reject 的理由是义项重复，而非核心定义本身不可用。若团队保留此义项而非 88124，上述 issues 的修正适用。我没有工具，无法运行 fat_seed_runner plan。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9 但没有对应 block，morphological_forms（道）是否需要 level_4 block 也需重新核对。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88124 义项重复：二者指同一对象（闪电），「下雨时」只是常见语境，不构成独立义项。同一义项会生成两套几乎相同的练习。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 「我看到一条闪电。」：「一条闪电划过夜空」在书面语中有实际用例，不能保证是干净的错误句。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「刚才天边有一条闪电。」与上条相同：「条」的用法可接受，不是唯一、明确的错误。

definition: 形容词，各种各样的。

reviewer_issues: core: 与 88139 为同一义项。两者定义都是“很多种/各种各样”，词性相同，指纹与例句高度重合。两个课时教同一个义项，L1 和 L3 的干扰项也会重复，靠补丁无法区分。; core.definition: 定义中含有词性标签“形容词，”，这不是释义内容。; core.pos: pos 标为形容词，与 88139 修正后的区别词不一致。

definition: 从文章或谈话中摘出的要点。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝：本义项与 88149 重复，且例句展示的是“文档”义，无法用补丁修正为“要点”义。建议删除，或重新生成确有区别的义项后再审。其余 L1 拒绝合理。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “从文章或谈话中摘出的要点”与 88149 实为同一义项。本义项的例句多用“文档”义，如“请在论文前面写一段摘要”“这篇文章的摘要只有一百字”“报告的摘要放在第一页”“这本书的摘要写得很清楚”“摘要太长了，请再改短一点”，并非“要点”义。; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: “手机”的解释有误：手机上有可读内容，“看完手机”并非毫无内容可读，且该干扰项并非明显错误。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 错误是补语语序“完读”，不涉及目标词“摘要”。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences: “煮熟”“拍照”两句与 88149 的干扰句重复。

definition: 不管是说，怎么样都一样，结果不会变。

reviewer_notes: Rejected for redundancy only. I checked the A and B level_3, level_6 and level_7 blocks, and they are otherwise sound. definition: 物体来回颤动；使人受到强烈触动。
reviewer_notes: Reject: the core is two senses in one entry and overlaps 88159, so no patch can make the blocks pinned to one sense. The other L1, L3, L6 and L7 problems are listed above for whoever authors the figurative sense. L3 A/B and L7 A/B are otherwise sound. L6 A's wrong sentence 「震动了他一跳」 is an odd collocation but is wrong for the stated reason.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses in one entry: physical 「物体来回颤动」 and figurative 「使人受到强烈触动」. The sentences mix both. Sense pinning requires one sense, and the physical half duplicates 88159.; variants.A.level_1.options[3]: 震荡 (zhèn dàng) is a near-synonym of 震动 (violent vibration), so it is not a valid listening distractor.; variants.B.level_1.options[2]: 振荡 (zhèn dàng) means oscillation or vibration, a near-synonym of 震动 in its physical sense.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 「他震动了一下头，表示不同意」 is borderline. 摇头 is the natural form, but the sentence is not clearly unacceptable, so it may be rated as acceptable by a native speaker.

definition: 方法学是研究做事办法的学问。
reviewer_notes: This is a near-duplicate of 88166, with a drifted, non-standard gloss. Learners could not tell the two senses apart.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 「研究做事办法的学问」 drifts from the real meaning of 方法学, which is the methodology of a discipline (sense 88166). Sentences such as 「方法学告诉我们，做事要先想办法」 and 「学了方法学以后，我做事更有条理了」 treat it as everyday problem-solving know-how, which is not attested usage. This document also duplicates 88166.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: This sentence, 「…社会调查的方法学的价格」, is built on sentence 4 of 88166, which shows the two senses are not distinct.

reviewer_notes: reject 的理由是义项重复，且定义不合格。若团队选择保留此义项而非 88176，上述 issues 的修正适用。我没有工具，无法运行 fat_seed_runner plan。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9 但没有对应 block，morphological_forms 有四项，level_4 是否需要请以 planner 结果为准。

definition: 没有光线；比喻社会腐败或没有希望。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is not a single sense. Its literal gloss is identical to 88187, and most of its sentences are literal. definition: 更张是把旧办法换掉，用新的。
reviewer_notes: This sense duplicates 88190 (same sense, simplified definition). Its sentence core is unnatural and in the wrong register. Reject it and use 88190.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: The declared register is 书面语, but the sentences are colloquial ('老板说……应该马上更张', '他就更张，换了一个新的'). Transitive uses such as '更张了旧办法' and '更张一下' are not idiomatic. In modern Chinese, 更张 lives almost only in 改弦更张 and in formal statements about systems or policies.; core.sentences[5].furigana: This is a stray non-zh field (pinyin stored as 'furigana').

definition: 呀放在话的最后，让话听起来更好听。

Items otherwise look clean: the level 1 distractors 牙, 哑, 亚, 雅, 芽, 痒, 样 differ by tone or segment, and level 6 and level 7 errors are register or ordering errors tied to 呀. Plan active_levels [1,2,3,6,7] include 2, which has no block. I could not run the plan command. Verify against plans_reviewed/88193.json if the sense is rebuilt.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss 呀放在话的最后，让话听起来更好听 is an impressionistic description, not a description of the particle's function. It also overlaps with sense 88194 (疑问、感叹或使语气缓和).; core.sentences[3]: 老师，您早呀！ and 这朵花真美呀。 are exclamatory uses. They belong to sense 88194's 感叹 meaning, so the sense is not distinct from it.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: The explanation says 罢了 cannot follow a verb to express tone. That is false: V罢了 is a common structure (说说罢了). The real reason it fails here is that it does not fit a summons.

reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 88195. Both are 今天晚上 time nouns with the same POS, register (口语), and fingerprint. Keeping both would produce identical exercises.

Sense 88327 already covers the clarify meaning. Plan active_levels also lists 2 and 4 without blocks.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Merges two senses into one: 使事情弄清楚 (clarify) and 使混浊的液体变清 (clear water). The sense is not pinned to one meaning, and the clarify meaning duplicates sense 88327.; core.sense_fingerprint: Same merge as the definition; the disambiguating fingerprint is a union of two senses.; core.sentences[2]: 他想澄清事实 uses the clarify sense, not the water sense.; core.sentences[3]: 公司已经澄清了网上的错误消息 uses the clarify sense.; core.sentences[5]: 医生澄清了病人对药的误会 uses the clarify sense.; core.sentences[6]: 请你澄清这个问题，免得大家再猜 uses the clarify sense.; core.sentences[8]: 我们要澄清错误的说法 uses the clarify sense.; core.sentences[9]: 老板出来澄清，公司没有裁员 uses the clarify sense.; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: The 'correct' sentence (index 3) is a clarify-sense sentence, so it is not pinned to the water sense.; variants.B.level_6.correct_sentence_index: The 'correct' sentence (index 9) is a clarify-sense sentence.; variants.A.level_7.correct_sentence_indices: Index 2 is a clarify-sense sentence, so it is not a correct water-sense example.; variants.B.level_7.correct_sentence_indices: Indices 6 and 9 are clarify-sense sentences.; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: Explanation is false: 请你逃避这个问题 is grammatical.

definition: 身体；躯干。

definition: 球场是大家踢球、打球的地方。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 88358. 88358 has the dictionary-style gloss and is the sense to keep. Plan active_levels lists 2, 4 and 9 with no matching blocks.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 88358: both mean the place where ball sports are played (大家踢球、打球的地方 vs 进行球类运动的场地). The distinction is cosmetic, so the sense is not distinct.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 这个球场草很绿 is acceptable Chinese (topic-comment, possession omitted, as in 这座城市人很多). It is not a valid error.

definition: 内存是电脑里的一个地方，用来放正在用的东西。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of sense 88360 (the same computer-RAM meaning; the only real difference is the register label). Keep 88360. If the maintainers decide to keep both senses, the two issues above need patches. The level 1 decline is accepted: I could not find a clean minimal pair for 内存 among common words. The only tone-only candidate, 内寸, is trade jargon rather than a standard word.
reviewer_issues: variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 网速 is a borderline distractor. 「我的电脑网速太小」 is understandable and could be defended, and the option's own explanation concedes it is not idiomatic.; core.sentences[1]: 「这台手机的内存很大，能同时开很多软件」 moves the sense to a phone. The defined sense is 「电脑里放正在用的东西的地方」. In everyday Chinese, 手机内存 usually means storage capacity, so the sentence mixes two meanings. It is also used in the level 7 correct set.

definition: 被选拔参加比赛的人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 88361; there is no distinct sense to patch. reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88361 为同一义项（被选出来参加比赛的人），定义“被选拔参加比赛的人”与指纹“经过选拔参加比赛的人”仅是改写，句子也都在同一义项下。

definition: 女性分娩，把婴儿生下来。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only because it duplicates 88365. reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 88365 (女性分娩 vs 妈妈把肚子里的宝宝生出来). It is the same sense.

definition: 黄金是一种黄色的、很贵的东西，可以做成首饰。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，原因是义项重复。保留两者会让学习者无法区分两个义项。A/B 练习也与 88370 高度重叠，例如“一只黄金”的量词错误题和“一块黄金”的正确句。另外，level_1 声明 no_minimal_pairs 存疑：黄精（huáng jīng）与黄金仅韵尾 -ng/-n 不同，属于最小对立对。

definition: 各国就是每一个国家。
reviewer_notes: The blocks are otherwise clean: the level_1 decline is acceptable, and the level_3, level_6 and level_7 items are sound. reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 各国就是每一个国家 pins the same meaning as sense 88372 (各个国家的总称, all countries). Two senses that cannot be told apart for a learner duplicate each other.

definition: 用以是用它来做某件事。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，属于重复义项，不宜单独修补。88374 的定义更接近词典写法，建议保留它。若要保留 88373 的“用某物来做某事”，需要另建一个确有区别的义项，而不是现在这样的同义重复。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88374 是同一个义项（“用来做某事”，书面，同样的句法框架和同样的句子类型）。同一词义被切成两条，学习者无法区分两套练习的答案，干扰项设计也会互相冲突。

definition: 三更是古时候说的半夜，天最黑的时候。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用：与 88378 为同一义项，且本义项的解释（三更是时刻、不表示时长）与 88378（三更是二十三点到次日一点的时段）直接矛盾，学习者会得到相互冲突的信息。建议删除本条，以 88378 为准。若必须保留，需整体重写释义与所有解释。plan 的 active_levels 含 2 和 4，但 blocks 中没有对应块，请确认。本次无法运行 fat_seed_runner plan。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义“古时候说的半夜，天最黑最静的时候”与 88378 的“三更相当于半夜（二十三点到次日一点）”是同一义项，两条重复。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0].explanation: 断言三更是“时刻”，不能用“一个”计数；与 88378 所述“二十三点到次日一点”的时段定义相矛盾。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1].explanation: 断言“三更不表示时长”，与 88378 的时段定义冲突。; variants.A.level_7.error_description: “三更是一个时刻，不能用‘一个’修饰”与 88378 的时段定义冲突。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “夜里三更里”的错误判定依据是“时刻词后不加方位词”，这一说法不成立（如“半夜里”“三更半夜里”均常见）；修正句“夜里三更”也累赘，错误并不干净。

definition: 各个地方。
reviewer_notes: 因与 88379 重复而被拒绝。即使保留，level_3 的四个选项中至少有三个存在可辩护的错误（公司、学校、本地、这儿），需要全部重写。plan 的 active_levels 与 88379 相同，存在相同的块缺失问题。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 sense 88379 重复：同为名词、具体类、中性语域，且定义（各个地方 / 每一个地方）与句子几乎无法区分，同一义项被拆开。; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: “春节时，公司的人都回家过年”自然通顺，公司 可作正确答案，解释“公司指一个机构”不成立。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: “春节时，学校的人都回家过年”可接受，学校 可辩护为正确答案。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: “下雨了，本地的路都不好走”自然通顺，本地 可作正确答案。; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: “下雨了，这儿的路都不好走”自然通顺，这儿 可作正确答案。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “我买了各地的一本书”可被读作“从各处买到的一本书”，判错理由薄弱。

definition: 就在事情发生的地点和时间。

definition: 一个一个地举出来。

definition: 前意识是平时没想到，但一想就能想起来的事。
