definition: 插入语，表示按照说话者本人的观点。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项与88463相同，无法单独成立。level_7中“在我看见”“在我看了”的错误模式也与88463重复。88463可以保留；本义项不宜修补。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与88463重复：两者都指句首引出说话者本人观点的用法（“开场语”与“插入语”只是名称不同），练习的干扰项类型和句子也高度重叠，学习者无法区分两个义项。

definition: 返回原来的地方。
reviewer_notes: 核心重复，故 reject，无需补丁。若要保留，其余问题如下：A 的 level_3 中“归家”在“天黑了，我想归家”中语义可通，仅语域偏书面，不能算明确错误，应替换为“下雨”之类。B 的 level_3 中“毕业”在“他去过北京，现在已经毕业了”中语法和语义都讲得通，应替换。A 的 level_7 修正句“天黑了，你先回去吧”删去“家”后语义变了，应改为“你先回家吧”。B 的 level_7 错句“妈妈已经回了去”不是明确错误，应替换。A 的 synonym_antonym 中“前进”、B 中“出发”存在与 88479 相同的反义争议。A 与 B 的 level_6 错句模板重复。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与义项 88479 的释义相同（都是“返回原来的地方”），属于同一义项的重复条目。

definition: 昆虫，翅膀大而色彩鲜艳，常在花间飞舞。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant duplicate of sense 88481: same referent (butterfly, insect, colourful wings, feeds on flowers), so the two senses would seed identical exercises. The 蝴蝶结 embedding above would also need fixing if this sense is reinstated. This is a dedupe decision; a human can overturn it.
reviewer_issues: variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 目标词“蝴蝶”嵌在复合词“蝴蝶结”中，非整词出现；“墙角的蝴蝶结了一张大网”语义也不通，错误不是“蝴蝶”的义项误用。

definition: 影片是在电影院或电视上看的有人有声音的故事。
reviewer_notes: 作为重复义项予以弃用，只保留 88492（定义更完整，涵盖范围更广）。若要保留其中的句子，应合并到 88492。其余检查仅供参考：level_7 A 的“一个影片”改为“一部”是可接受的造错；level_6 B 的三个错误句都能说明原因（电视剧、音乐剧、节目）。level_1 声明 no_minimal_pairs，但“英片”（yīng piàn）是声调上的最小对立对，只有这一个，凑不齐三个干扰项，弃用仍可成立。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义“在电影院或电视上看的有人有声音的故事”表述别扭，且与 88492 的“也指电影作品”完全重合，不是可分开的独立义项。; core.sense_fingerprint: “在电影院或电视上观看的有演员和声音的故事”与 88492 的“电影作品”实为同一义，违反单一义项的区分要求。; core.sentences (all): 全部 10 句都是把影片当作可观看的作品来用（如“讲了一个爱情故事”“演员演得很好”），88492 的义项完全可以涵盖。

definition: 年间是一段年份里的那几年。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of sense 88496, not because the core is broken. Both senses carry the same gloss type and the same mix of uses. Retire this sense upstream and merge its sentences (0-9) into 88496's pool. Sentence 8 carries a furigana field the other sentences lack. Option blocks were checked: L3 distractors are clearly wrong, L6 and L7 errors are single-cause. The issues above are listed in case the sense is kept instead.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88496 义项重复：释义、指纹与用例类型相同（朝代年号与时段两类用法）。学习者无法区分两义项，各练习的唯一正确答案不稳定。; core.definition: 释义“年间是一段年份里的那几年”未覆盖朝代年号用法，而 10 句中有 7 句是朝代年号用法（乾隆、万历、光绪等）。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0].explanation: 建议替换词“当天”放入“昨天年间”会得到“昨天当天”，冗余不通。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0].explanation: 建议替换词“这段时间”放入“这个月年间”会得到“这个月这段时间”，冗余。

definition: 步行；走路。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of sense 88505 (same meaning, walk on foot), which is kept. The issues above are recorded for the record; they would need fixing if this sense is reinstated. This is a dedupe decision that a human can overturn.
reviewer_issues: variants.A.level_3.options[0]: “搬运很不方便”合乎语法且语义可接受（“他的腿受伤了，搬运很不方便”），与正确答案并存；解释“搬运需要宾语”不成立。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: “投掷很不方便”同样可接受，解释“投掷单用不完整”不成立。; variants.A.level_7: “他行走很慢”在书面语中常可接受（类似“他行动很迅速”），错误不够确定，解释“不能说‘行走很慢’”过于绝对。; variants.B.level_7.error_description: “不能重叠”说法不准确：双音节动词可以ABAB重叠。真正的错误是句末多出一个“走”。

definition: 许多年以来。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 88509, so no patches are offered. Two other problems would remain if it were kept. B level_3 distractors 上个月 / 这几天 / 当天 each still read as plausible with 一直 in 「多年来，大家一直很喜欢这位老师」. A level_6 wrong sentence 2 (“她多年来才打完电话”) and B level_6 wrong sentence 2 (“我多年来刚搬进新房”) are borderline, for the same reason as the 88509 items. Level_7 items were otherwise clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88509 为同一义项：“许多年以来”与“好多年以来，一直到现在”、指纹“时间词：许多年以来”与“时间词：好多年以来一直到现在”含义相同。同一词拆成两个义项，属于虚假的义项切分，两者的例句都无法区分锁定义项。

definition: 爱将是将军特别喜欢、特别相信的手下。
reviewer_notes: This is a duplicate of 88512.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This is the same sense as 88512 (爱将 = a trusted subordinate general), so it is a duplicate. Its level_1 also uses distractors that are not tone confusions: 败将 adds an initial, and 挨讲 is not a real word. Sentence 3 '他从小就是主帅身边的爱将' is unnatural.

definition: 用举手、投票等方式表示对议案的决定。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate. Other items are borderline: A's level_6 wrong sentence 大家进行表决，选出了新的班长 is contestable, since 表决 for electing a person is non-standard but not clearly wrong. A's level_7 会议已经表决通过这项计划 is weakly wrong, since 已经 without 了 is marginal rather than clearly ungrammatical. Neither matters if the sense is dropped.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 88521 (both define voting by show of hands or ballot to decide a motion). No sentence-level fix separates them.

definition: 手术是医生用刀把人身体里有病的地方治好。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of sense 88528. Both describe the same meaning (a surgical procedure by a doctor on a patient), and the sentences are interchangeable. A learner cannot tell the two senses apart. The 88527 definition is also narrower ('用刀'), which excludes non-knife procedures. The sentence content otherwise passes the checks (L3, L6, L7 and the valid 量词 errors), so its sentences can be used if they are merged into 88528. Please merge or drop one of the pair; I recommend keeping 88528.

definition: 在比赛中夺得冠军。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝该义项，因为它与 88533 重复，核心内容不能作为独立义项使用。若要求两者都保留，本义项需要与 88533 相同的修正，并修正 A 的级别7。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88533 为同一义项：同一 lemma、同一词性，释义都是“在比赛中得到／夺得冠军”。这是重复义项。; variants.A.level_7: 与 88533 犯同样的错误：“他去年夺冠了两次”的错误依据（次数须插在“夺”“冠”之间）不成立，“夺冠三次”是常见说法。; core.morphological_forms[1]: “夺冠过”为非标准形式，应为“夺过冠”。

definition: 有限公司是一种公司的名字,有很多人一起做生意。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 88548: both describe 有限公司 as the same company form, and the register difference (中性 vs 正式) does not create a separate sense. Keep 88548 only. Level_7 B's sentence 李阿姨开了一只有限公司 is identical to 88548's and disappears with this sense. The other blocks were checked and are not otherwise defective, but they are not patched because the sense is retired.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “是一种公司的名字”把法律形式误作名称，“有很多人”与合法的一人有限责任公司不符。该义项与 88548 指同一公司形式，不是独立义项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “我一个人出钱开的这家有限公司”可以合法存在（一人有限责任公司）。用〈个人独资企业〉替换的解释不成立。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “我每天在一家有限公司上课”可以是培训类有限公司，不是明确错误的句子。

definition: 学生学完规定的课程,达到要求而结束学习。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for content. Its blocks are otherwise sound: level_3 distractors do not fit, level_6 and level_7 wrong sentences are wrong only for the stated reason, and the antonym options are correct. Plan matches the document. If the pipeline ever keeps both copies, no other defects were found.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as 88555 (finish the required school course and leave). Two senses for one meaning would generate duplicate exercises.

definition: 副词，表示比较两方面利弊后所作的选择。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for content errors. The sentence set and blocks are otherwise comparable to 88557, but two senses for one meaning would produce redundant items with the same answers.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 88557. Both describe the same single adverbial sense of 宁可 (weighing two options, choosing one, usually paired with 也不). Their sentences and blocks overlap in teaching content.

definition: 头的前部,从额到下巴的部分。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for content. If the pipeline keeps it anyway, these defects also apply: (1) variants.B.level_1.options[3] 量 (liàng) fails the tone-pair and minimal-pair rule. (2) variants.A.level_3 anchor 他的脸很圆 also accepts 头 (他的头很圆，像一个大苹果). 头 is not a listed distractor, so this is a note, not a patch. (3) variants.B.level_3 anchor 弟弟的脸上沾着巧克力 also accepts 手 and 嘴. Neither is a listed distractor, so this is a note only. (4) variants.A.level_6 wrong sentence 他的脸很长，该去理发了 is wrong because of 理发, not 脸, so it is weak. Plan matches the document.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as 88571 (the face: the front of the head). Two senses for one meaning would generate duplicate exercises.

definition: 细小的管子。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 88585; the content itself is not the problem. Other checks: all core sentences are natural, and the level_6 wrong sentences are wrong for size reasons tied to the word. Two borderline items, not patched because the sense is rejected: the level_3 A distractor 旗杆 (a miniature flagpole could sit on a desk), and the level_7 A error 两只小管, which has the same weak 只 problem as 88585. The plan's active levels 2, 4 and 9 have no blocks.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 细小的管子 has the same meaning as 88585's 又细又小的管子. Both carry the same lemma, POS and pronunciation. The one meaning is split into two senses, so learners would repeat the same content.

definition: 在按键或屏幕上持续按压一段时间。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for content errors, so its blocks were not patched. If the pipeline keeps this sense instead of 88609, the same review applies, including the 短按 antonym question for synonym_antonym_match.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 88609. Both describe the same press-and-hold sense of 长按. Mentioning physical keys (按键) does not make a separate sense.

definition: 那时是说过去的某一个时候，或者将来的某一个时候。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of sense 88634, which covers past and future and includes these past uses. Retire it upstream and merge its sentences into 88634's pool. The issues above are listed in case the sense is kept instead.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义写“过去或将来”，而 sense_fingerprint 写“过去某个时候”，10 句全部是过去用法。释义与指纹不一致。; core.definition: 与 88634 义项重复：释义同为过去或将来，88634 的句子已包含全部过去用法。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “那里我们家住在乡下。”本身合乎语法（「那里」作话题，即“那里，我们家住在乡下”），不是错误句。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 干扰项“那天”在“小时候家里没电视，那天我爱听故事”中勉强可解，属临界干扰项，违反“干扰项不能也合理”的要求。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 说明“了不能紧跟时间词”并不成立，“现在了”“到那时了”是合法用法，该句的错误依据不成立。

definition: 外观好看。
reviewer_notes: Not patched because the sense is redundant. If it were kept, the same level_1 unjustified decline would apply (重看 and 终刊 are tone minimal pairs). Level_3 B option 难看 is weakly defensible in 我想买一把 as a joke, and 好听 could describe a whistling kettle, so both would need review. Other blocks looked clean.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 88635: both define 中看 as 'appearance/looks good'. Teaching both repeats the same lesson.

definition: 副词，一年到头；多年。
reviewer_notes: 核心重复，因此整体拒绝。若保留该 sense，其句子和块本身基本有效：A/B 干扰项、level_6 错误句、两处 level_7 错误均经检查有效。计划中 active_levels 含 2，但没有 level_2 块。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88637 为同一义项：词性、定义（一年到头／多年）和 sense_fingerprint 均相同。同一义项被拆成两个 sense，学习者会遇到两次相同的义项。

definition: 在斗争或竞赛中战胜对方;也指事情达到了目的。
reviewer_notes: Reject. The entry bundles two senses in one definition and one pos. Five of ten sentences use the adverbial sense and one uses the noun, so a patch would require rewriting the definition, the pos, several sentences, and most variant blocks. Recommended: keep the verb 'win' use in 88643, create a separate adverbial entry for 胜利 (顺利地/成功地) with 胜利完成, 胜利闭幕, 胜利开幕 sentences, and regenerate both plans. The blocks here (A level_6 index 3, A and B level_7 correct sets including adverbial sentence 2 and 9) cannot be trusted until the split is done.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Bundles two senses in one definition: 在斗争或竞赛中战胜对方 and 也指事情达到了目的. The entry does not pin a single sense, which violates sense pinning.; core.pos: pos 动词 is wrong for sentences 2, 4, 5, 8 and 9, where 胜利 is an adverb modifying a verb (胜利闭幕, 胜利完成, 胜利开幕).; core.sentences[0,1,6,7]: The verb 'win' sentences (经过多年努力他们终于胜利了 and similar) duplicate sense 88643 almost exactly, so the inventory has the same sense twice.; core.sentences[3]: 取得了胜利 uses 胜利 as a noun, not the verb in pos. The sentence also has a stray furigana key that no other sentence has, and a full-width comma unlike the rest.; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: The semantic-discrimination correct sentence (index 3) depends on the noun use 取得了胜利, which does not match the verb pos.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: Explanation says 胜利 cannot modify an action directly, but the entry's own correct sentence 9 (胜利完成了任务) does exactly that. The explanation is false.

definition: 表示不存在任何事物,或表示不要紧、不在乎。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable because two senses are merged into one. Variant B also leans on the idiom 没有什么大不了的.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition and fingerprint combine two distinct senses: 'nothing exists' (sentences 8, 9: 没有什么比健康更重要, 世界上没有什么能让他放弃) and 'it doesn't matter' (sentences 0–5, 7). The sense is not pinned to one meaning.; core.sentences[6]: 没有什么大不了的 is a fixed idiom, so the target word is not used as a free whole word.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences: The wrong sentences test the existence sense (没有什么书), which is not the 不要紧 sense the anchor sentence teaches. The mixed core causes this.; variants.B.level_6: The anchor (index 9) uses the existence sense while the level_3 and level_7 items use the 不要紧 sense.

definition: 疑问代词,询问原因,相当于「为什么」。
reviewer_notes: The sense itself is not separate from 88657, so the core is unusable as an independent sense. Its own blocks are mostly sound, but they add nothing that 88657 does not already cover.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 88657: same lemma 为何, same pronoun POS, same meaning (问原因，相当于为什么). The fingerprints describe the same sense. Several distractors and sentences repeat 88657's exact content, including 他是为何人, 书架上为何几本书, and the 为何什么 level_7 error.

definition: 胜过；比……强。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 88669. Sentences read naturally and the level_6, level_7 and synonym_antonym blocks are clean. One weak distractor, not patched because the sense is rejected: level_3 A option 挖掘 (挖掘那条难走的路 can be read as digging a road). Level_3 B options 怀疑, 放弃 and 责备 are acceptable.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 胜过；比……强 has the same meaning as 88669's 比别的更好、更厉害. The sense is split into two duplicates, so learners would repeat the same content.

definition: 凭借权力管理和支配一个国家或地区。
reviewer_notes: Not patched because the sense is redundant. If it were kept instead, these defects would need fixing: (1) level_1 is declined as no_minimal_pairs, but tone and initial minimal pairs exist; (2) variants.A.level_6 wrong sentence 他统治了三天的会议 is defensibly hyperbolic (统治整个会场 is idiomatic); (3) variants.A.level_7 error (missing 年 after 五十) is a generic numeral error that does not involve 统治; (4) variants.B.level_3 游泳 and 发明 are defensible completions of 统治得很好 in a skill sense; (5) variants.B.level_6 这个老人统治着三个孩子 is a humorous, acceptable usage.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 88673: both define 统治 as ruling a country or people through power. Teaching both repeats the same lesson.

definition: 动词，比不上；表示前者不及后者。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as redundant, not patched. Level_6 B wrong[2] reuses sentence 7 (弟弟的个子不如哥哥) as its first clause, which would confuse learners if the sense were kept. If the team wants a second 不如 sense, it should be the 与其…不如… use, which this document does not teach. Declined blocks are untouched.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 88683: same 动词, same 'A不如B / 比不上' meaning, identical level_1 options, and the same comparative sentence pattern. Two senses with no real distinction teach the same thing twice.; core.definition: Definition opens with the POS label '动词，', which repeats the pos field.

definition: 性学是研究人的身体和成长的一种学问。
reviewer_notes: The core gloss is unusable, so every downstream block inherits a false sense. Reject and merge into 88694.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 性学 means sexology, the study of human sexual behaviour and psychology. The definition 「研究人的身体和成长的一种学问」 is a softened, inaccurate gloss that describes physiology or puberty education. It is not a real separate sense, and it duplicates sense 88694 in a distorted form.; core.sentences: Because of the wrong definition, the sentences drift. Sentences 4 (「家长可以和他聊聊性学」) and 2 (「医生给初中生讲性学」) really mean 性教育 (sex education), not the academic discipline. Sentence 0 restates the wrong definition.

definition: 一家是住在一起的一群人,或是一个店。
reviewer_notes: 无工具，未能运行 fat_seed_runner，已对照所给 plan 检查：块集合与句子索引、correct_sentence_indices 一致。plan 的 active_levels [1,2,3,4,6,7,9] 中 2、4、9 无对应块，拆分后需重新运行 planner。其余块（L1 干扰项为声调混淆、L6 错误句各有明确理由、L7 每句仅一处错误）基本干净。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把两个义项并列（住在一起的一家人 或 一个店），sense_fingerprint 也是并列。句 0–3、7–8 为家庭义，句 4–6、9 为店义。同一 sense 行内无法锁定单一义项，违反“一义项”核心要求。; sense 88695 vs sense 88696: 两行的定义与句子高度重复（同为家庭＋店），是同一组义项的重复收录。; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: “家眷”能语法和语义上填入“我们___都住在北京”（“我们家眷都住在北京”成立），仅因偏书面而被排除，属于可辩护的正确答案。

definition: 一个家庭;也用于指一个商店、企业等。
reviewer_notes: 无工具，未能运行 fat_seed_runner，已对照所给 plan 检查：块与句子索引一致。plan 的 active_levels 中 2、4、9 无对应块，拆分后需重新运行 planner。其余 L1 干扰项、L6 错误句、L7 单处错误、正确句索引均已检查，基本成立。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义以“也用于指”把店/企业义并入家庭义，两义并存。句 0、1、2、5、9 为家庭义，句 3、4、6、7、8 为店/企业义，同一 sense 行无法锁定单一义项。; sense 88696 vs sense 88695: 与 88695 的定义和句子重复，属同一义项的重复收录。; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: “家眷”能语法和语义上填入“王老师___住在学校旁边”（“王老师家眷住在学校旁边”成立），仅因偏书面而被排除，属于可辩护的正确答案。; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: “一座饭馆”边缘可接受（“座”可修饰大型饭店），不是明确错误的量词搭配。

definition: 多才是会的东西很多，什么都会一点。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 88734 with an unnatural core. The cloze distractors (单纯, 木讷, 呆板) are also defensibly correct.
reviewer_issues: core: This duplicates 88734 with a simplified definition ('什么都会一点'). Bare predicative '很多才' is unnatural (natives say 多才多艺) and can mis-parse as 很多+才. Most sentences (0, 4, 9) and both level_6 blocks rely on it. The register '书面' clashes with the colloquial sentences.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 单纯 and 木讷 both fit the blank acceptably ('他很单纯，唱歌…都会一点'). Both are defensible answers.

definition: 询问发生了什么事或出了什么情况。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项重复，故判 reject，不作补丁。除上述 B.level_7 问题外，其余四个块（A/B 的 level_3、level_6、level_7 与 L1）检查未发现新的缺陷。若用户选择保留本条而非 88735，应同时修正 B.level_7。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88735 为同一义项：“询问发生了什么事”与“询问出了什么情况”几乎等同，sense_fingerprint 也几乎相同，两者的例句类型和变体结构也相同。同一义项拆成两个 sense 会让学习者看到重复的练习。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “王老师今天没来，大家怎么了吗？”同样依赖“吗”作为错因，母语者多会接受，不是可靠的错误句。

definition: 射是把箭或者子弹用力送出去。
reviewer_notes: 作为重复义项拒绝，而非因句子本身有缺陷。若决定保留本义项而非 88744，还需处理：B 侧 level_6 错句“他把鞋子射进了河里。”与 88744 完全相同。另，A 侧 level_6 错句“士兵把手榴弹射到了敌人阵地”较边缘（射通常不用于手榴弹），仅在此记录。其余 level_1、level_3、level_7 的正误检查均通过。无 shell，未运行 plan；plan 的 active_levels 含 2 和 4，但无对应块。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88744 实为同一义项：两者都是“用弓或枪把箭、子弹发出去”，指纹几乎相同，句型也重叠（如“拉弓……射出去”）。拆成两个学习单元会让同一含义被教两次，且本义项的释义（“用力送出去”）比 88744 的释义（“用弓弩、枪炮等把箭、子弹等发出去”）更空泛。

definition: 利用时机谋取私利；也指意见相合。
reviewer_notes: Reject for the core structure, not for the option blocks. Those were not patched because the sense they test is not a single sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition bundles two senses: 利用时机谋取私利 and 意见相合. Sentences 4-9 use only the second. Sense pinning fails, and the two variants teach different senses under one sense_id.; core.sentences[0:4]: The first meaning (利用时机谋私利) duplicates sense 88747, so the same meaning is stored twice.

definition: 主从是最重要的和跟着它的次要的。
reviewer_notes: 仅因与 88754 重复而拒绝。若决定保留本条而删除 88754，需先修：A 变体 level_3 的干扰项「颜色」可说“不分颜色”（肤色之义），不能算错误选项；B 变体 level_3 的干扰项「花草」（画里有花草）完全可接受，「桌子」也有一定可能，需替换。B 变体句子“两种颜色在画里有主从”的搭配也偏生硬。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88754（主要的与次要的）释义实质相同，同一义项被重复教授

definition: 按钮是用手指一按，机器就会动的小东西。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a redundant duplicate of sense 88756. Retain 88756 only. If the operator overrides this, also check: (a) variants.A.level_6 wrong sentence 这件衬衫的按钮掉了一颗 is borderline, because 按钮 for shirt buttons is used colloquially. A human should decide whether to keep it or replace it. (b) variants.A.level_1 is declined as no_minimal_pairs, but 暗流 (àn liú) differs from àn niǔ by one initial and a tone, so the decline may be premature. (c) active_levels lists 2, 4 and 9 but the plan has no blocks for them. Run the planner after reconciling.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 88756. Both define a button pressed by hand to operate a machine or device, and both use the same contexts (elevator, doorbell, machine). Two senses for one meaning would train the learner on a split that does not exist.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 电线 is defensibly correct in 门铃的___坏了，客人按了很久也没声音。A broken doorbell wire also explains why there is no sound.

definition: 新版是新做出来的一种，和以前的不一样。
reviewer_notes: Most core sentences use 新版 where 新款 is required, so the core is unusable. The L1 distractor 金版 is dubious as a real word, and 新办 is not a lexicalized word.
reviewer_issues: core: The sense '产品新款式' for physical goods is not idiomatic. Natives say 新款, not 新版. Examples are 新版的衣服, 新版的鞋子, 新版的书包, 这个杯子有新版 and 这款车的新版. 新版 for products is natural mainly for software, apps and editions. The level_6 explanations also define 新版 as 出版物的新修订版本, which conflates this sense with 88784.

definition: 彼此感情融洽;关系亲密。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项冗余，不作修补。88792 A level_7 的“我们俩从小就地要好”、B level_7 的“我把隔壁的阿姨要好”与88791的错句同类，且“我把……要好”几乎与88791 A level_7 相同。如果团队决定保留两个 sense，需要先合并定义，再重新审核。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与88791为同一义项（“感情融洽、关系亲密”与“感情很好、常在一起”），sense_fingerprint 几乎相同。两个 sense 会教授同一个意义两次，并共享同一道反义题和相似的错句（如“我把隔壁的……要好”）。

definition: 指示代词,指称说话人身边的某个人,含尊敬。
reviewer_notes: 拒收理由是与 88797 重复。以上问题仅供参考，因为核心本身有问题，所以未给出 patch。若审核者改为保留 88798 而拒收 88797，则 88797 的修改应改为针对 88798 的同类问题。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88797 为同一义项（礼貌地指称身边的人）。重复教授同一义项会使练习失去区分度。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 「这位很没礼貌，一进门就大声说话」是正常的反讽用法，句子可以接受，不是错句。; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 「这个是我们的王老师」语法通顺，仅语域略显不礼貌，属于可辩护的干扰项。

definition: 用在“对……”之后，表示从某一角度看。
reviewer_notes: 仅因与 88799 重复而拒绝。若改为保留本条，需先修 A 变体 level_7：错句“对我们来讲的，这个决定很重要”与 88799 存在同样问题（“来讲的话”是常见句式，说明有误），应改为“来讲对我们，这个决定很重要。”类的语序错误。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88799（从某人/某角度看）释义相同，同一义项被重复教授

definition: 给蓄电池等补充电能；比喻补充知识。
reviewer_notes: 比喻义（给自己充电、学习补充知识）是独立于 88811 的合理义项，其中第0至4句质量良好。请将本义项重新生成为仅含比喻义：重写定义与 fingerprint，替换第5至9句，重建两个变体，并在修改后为 88812 重跑 plan（句子与练习均已变化）。另外，A 变体 level_7 的解释“‘了’与‘想’不能搭配”过度概括（“我想家了”即合法），重建时勿照搬。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义包含字面义“给蓄电池等补充电能”，与 88811（给电池或手机补上电）重复。该条实际合并了两个义项。; core.sentences[5]-core.sentences[9]: 五句（蓄电池、电动车、电池、汽车、玩具车）都是字面用法，与比喻义不符，句子集合混合了两个义项。; variants.B.level_3 / level_6 / level_7: B 变体的练习（第6句、第9句，level_7 的 [6,7,9] 及“电动滑板车”错句）全部测试字面义，而 A 变体测试比喻义。两个变体测的不是同一义项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “这辆自行车该充电了”中的自行车可能是电动车，错因依赖未写明的假设。

definition: 大月是有三十一天的月份。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 88826. The level_3, level_6, level_7, and synonym_antonym A/B items were checked and are sound, but they are not patched because the sense is retired. Do not restore this sense by widening its definition, because that would make it identical to 88826.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 有三十一天的月份 does not specify the calendar. It duplicates sense 88826, which is the Gregorian 31-day month, and the sentences here describe the same meaning. The unqualified claim is also wrong for 农历大月, which has 30 days.

definition: 分数是考试得到的成绩，也是几分之几的数。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable because it is a polysemy conflation. Downstream items inherit the problem. For example, the B level_6 sentence '分子是三，分数是五' relies on the math sense, while the anchor sentences rely on the score sense. The antonym block's no_relation decline is fine.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two distinct senses: a test score and a fraction (几分之几的数). Sense pinning is impossible. The sentences split across both: indices 2, 5 and 7 use the fraction sense, and the others use the score sense. Index 6 uses a match score.

definition: 考试或比赛所得的成绩；表示几分之几的数。
reviewer_notes: This sense also duplicates 88831. Both should be replaced by two cleanly pinned senses: 分数(成绩) and 分数(数学).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same conflation as 88831: the definition covers both score and fraction. Sentences 1, 2 and 7 use the fraction sense, and the rest use the score sense.; variants.B.level_7: The error '分数了线' is an implausible insertion into the compound 分数线. It tests 分数线, not 分数, and is not a realistic learner error.

definition: 发出是把声音、光、东西从里面送到外面。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core has no single sense: the definition covers both 'emit sound/light/smell' and 'send out mail/goods', and the sentence set is split across the two. Sentence 0 also uses 发+出去 rather than the word 发出. Once the core is re-pinned to one sense, regenerate all variant blocks. The other issues listed above, covering A.level_1, A.level_7 and B.level_6, should be fixed during regeneration.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition and sense_fingerprint merge two separate senses of 发出. Sense ① is to emit a sound, light or smell (发出声音/光/香味). Sense ③ is to send out letters or goods (发出信件/包裹). The sentences are split between them: 0, 1, 5 and 7 are 'send/dispatch'; 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 9 are 'emit'. No single sense is pinned, so every downstream block teaches a mixed target.; core.sentences[0]: In 信已经发出去了, the structure is 发 + directional complement 出去. 发出 is not a whole word here, so the sentence fails the whole-word rule. It is also the anchor for A.level_3 and A.level_7.; core.sentences[9]: 房间里发出笑声 is marginal. 传出笑声 is the natural phrasing.; variants.A.level_1.options: None of the distractors is a clean tone minimal pair. 付出 fù changes the vowel. 翻出 fān adds a final. 发愁 chóu changes both the final and the tone.; variants.A.level_7: The error, a doubled 了, does not involve the target word. The anchor 发出去 is also not a whole-word use of 发出.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 他把怒气发出在球场上 has an additional structural error: 把…V在 requires a bare verb, so 发泄在 would be needed. The sentence therefore contains more than the labelled error.

definition: 产生并向外传出(声音、光等);发送。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项与 88853 重复，故判 reject，不作补丁。88853 已覆盖“从里面送到外面”这一核心义，包括发声、发光与送出物品。若要教授“发出邀请、通知”这一用法，需要新的定义和新的例句，而非修改本条。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把“产生并向外传出（声音、光等）”与“发送”并列为一个义项，同一个 sense 里混入了两个义项，违背单义项要求。; core.sentences: 与 88853（“把声音、光、东西从里面送到外面”）高度重叠：两者都同时包含“发出声音、光”和“发出物品”。例句中第 2、5、8 句（寄邮件、发通知、发邀请）属于送出或发布，与其余发声、发光的例句混在一起，学习者会得到两个重复的义项。

definition: 憎恨；极不喜欢。
reviewer_notes: 以重复项为由拒绝，未打补丁。若策展人改为保留本义项而非 88863，请按 88863 的方式改写 B 变体 level_7 的解释，并修正 furigana 字段。A 变体与 L3、L6 块经核查无误。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88863 的定义实质相同（极不喜欢）。“厌恶”并无另一义项，两条是同一义项被切成两条的重复。; variants.B.level_7.error_description: 与 88863 同一错误：称“很厌恶”为错，但本组正确句第7句“我真的很厌恶那些只会抱怨的人”即为正确用法。; core.sentences[8].furigana: 仅此一句带 furigana 字段，标点为半角逗号，且 yànwù 与 pronunciation 字段的 yàn wù 不一致。; core.semantic_class: 同 88863：心理动词标为 action 可能不符。

definition: 从悬崖或河床陡坡处倾泻而下的水流。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only as a duplicate. The sentences themselves are clean: L3 distractors fail, L6 wrong sentences are wrong for the stated reasons, L7 correct sets hold. If the owner wants to keep it, the L7 B error (missing 的 in 很高瀑布) is a generic grammar slip rather than a fault in the target's usage, and should be replaced with a classifier error on 瀑布.
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: Same sense as 88865: 瀑布 as falling water from height. The definitions (悬崖或陡坡倾泻的水流 vs 高山流下的大水) and fingerprints overlap almost completely, so one meaning is split into two senses. A learner would see two identical waterfall senses.

definition: 生产队是很多人一起种地、干活的小团体。
reviewer_notes: 作为独立义项不可用，因此不对其逐块打补丁。若保留，仍需修正：B level_7 的 error_description 把“名词修饰名词必须加的”概括得过宽（如“学校老师”即成立）；只有第 3 句带有 furigana 字段，结构不一致；morphological_forms 把“生產隊”列为“繁体”，它不是形态变化。level_1 以 no_minimal_pairs 放弃是可接受的。plan 的 active_levels 包含 2、4、9，但没有对应区块。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 88890 实为同一义项：两者都指农村集体的基层生产组织，定义只差“旧时”一词，例句也无法区分。义项指纹无法消歧，学习者无法判断哪个义项成立。

definition: 旧时称在富贵人家供使唤的仆人。
reviewer_notes: 否决原因是与 88893 重复，而非核心内容不可用。上列问题仅供记录；若改为保留本 sense，则需逐项修补，但按 reject 的规定本次不提供补丁。
reviewer_issues: core.sentences[3].text: “在旧时的大户人家,下人要听主人的话。”使用了半角逗号。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 干扰项「员工」在“老爷家里有很多____”中语法与语义均可成立，仅凭语域（现代企业用语）区别，属于可合理作答的正确选项。; variants.B.level_3.options[0]: B 变体 level_3 的四条解释是从 88893 的同类练习复制而来，写的是“照顾少爷的生活”“能照顾人的人”等，但本空句子是“下人们在院子里打扫。”，解释与句子不符，违反“每条解释须属实”的要求。涉及 options[0] 至 options[3] 四项。; core: 与 88893 为同一义项：定义「旧时称在富贵人家供使唤的仆人」与「很久以前在富人家里做活的人」实质相同，指纹也几乎一致。同一词义被拆成两个 sense，会让学习者看到两个并无区别的义项。

definition: 一种银白色的、坚硬的金属，可以制造各种器具。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for content errors. If it were kept, these would still need fixing: B L3 sentence 工人从石头里炼出了铁 is loose (iron is smelted from ore, not stone); A L1 is identical to 88899's A L1; B L6 distractor 我用铁炒菜 repeats a distractor in 88899 B L6. B L1 is a final decline and was left alone.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same material-iron meaning as sense 88899; the two differ only in color wording (银白色 vs 灰黑色). Two senses for one referent cannot be taught as distinct senses.

definition: 从高处到低处去;也表示动作继续进行。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as written, so no patches. Once the sense boundary is fixed, re-check the level_6 wrong sentence 雨终于下去了 for ambiguity (it can be read as the rain ending). Blocks already declined are not reported.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition bundles two senses: 从高处到低处去 (identical to sense 88909) and 动作继续进行. Sentences 0, 1, 4, 6 and 9 use the directional sense and duplicate 88909's sense. Sentences 2, 3, 5, 7 and 8 use the continuative sense. A single sense record cannot satisfy the one-sense rule.

definition: 各别是每个都不一样，或者是很特别。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate. If it were kept, the level_6 wrong sentences would be weak: 班上各别同学都有自己的想法, 这份计划的各别方面都考虑到了 and 这家超市里有各别水果 use attributive 各别 meaning 每个/各个/各种, which is natural Chinese, so they are not clearly wrong. No sentence exercises the 很特别 half of the definition.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 88920 (各个不同；与众不同). Same two meanings and a near-identical sense_fingerprint, so the learner would be taught one sense twice.

definition: 知识产权是人想出来的东西，别人不能随便拿走用。
reviewer_notes: This sense duplicates 88922 and has a misleading definition, so the core is unusable.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition is inaccurate. Intellectual property is a right over a work, not the work or idea itself. This sense is a simplified duplicate of 88922, the legal-rights sense. The sentences are childish and do not match the declared register 正式. Some sentences also teach false content. Sentence 1 says an idea alone is IP. Sentence 5 says copying homework disrespects IP. Sentence 2 '这是知识产权' is semantically garbled.

definition: 走同一条路；一起走。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 88925, so no patches are applied. The 散步 defect is recorded only so it is not carried over if this sense is ever restored. Declined blocks were not reviewed.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicates sense 88925. Both definitions say the same thing (跟别人走同一条路 vs 走同一条路；一起走), the fingerprints are near-identical, and the sentence sets test the same meaning. Two senses would teach one meaning twice.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: Distractor 散步 is defensible in the anchor 我们同路回家吧，路上有伴儿。 because 我们散步回家吧，路上有伴儿。 is natural. The explanation's claim that 散步回家 is awkward is false, so this is the polysemy-style failure the checklist warns about.

definition: 哪怕是就算这样，也不怕。
reviewer_notes: This is a duplicate, mis-glossed sense of 哪怕. Its exercise blocks largely copy 88934 (the same 幸亏/只要/只有/连/甚至/无论 wrong sentences), which would be repeated content across senses.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 'not caring, not afraid' is not a real sense of 哪怕. The real meaning, 'even if', is already taught as sense 88934. Here the fear meaning leaks from the 怕 character, and many sentences echo 不怕/敢 to support it. This sense duplicates 88934 under a wrong gloss.

definition: 散布在一定范围内的各处。
reviewer_notes: 否决原因是与 88937 重复：定义「散布在一定范围内的各处」与「东西分散在很多地方」为同一词义，指纹也一致。除重复外，我未发现其选项块或句子存在缺陷。

definition: 对年长男子的尊称；也指伯父。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so no patches. Had it been kept, B level_6 wrong sentence 0 is muddled: the fix 同学 does not repair the 大爷 error as its explanation claims. Not reported further.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicates sense 88967: same two-part definition (尊称年长男子；伯父), identical level_1 options in both variants, and overlapping kinship content (sentence 5 restates 爸爸的哥哥). Two records teach the same meaning twice.

definition: 红包是过年时大人给小孩的红色小袋子，里面有钱。
reviewer_notes: Rejected at sense level, not for item quality. Plan blocks match the sentence indices, each level_3 has four options with one correct, level_6 corrections are unambiguous, A and B are distinct, and the level_1 decline is allowed by the plan. If the inventory keeps 88987 anyway, fix the 张 and 只 items first. Keep 88988 as the surviving sense of this pair.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Sense duplicates 88988. Both describe the same money-filled red packet used as a gift or reward. 88987 only adds the New Year occasion, and the fingerprints overlap. The items are interchangeable: variants.A.level_3 sentence 0 and variants.B.level_6 sentence 9 are equally valid for 88988, so the two senses cannot be discriminated.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “我收到了一张红包。” The error is weak. 张 is for flat items, but some speakers may accept it for a small paper envelope.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “弟弟把一只红包放进了口袋。” 只 is used for bags and containers (一只包 is common), so a native speaker may accept 一只红包. The error is not clean.; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: 试卷 is a weak distractor. 大人都会给小孩试卷 is not clearly wrong as a New Year gift.; core.sentences[9].furigana: Only one sentence carries furigana; the others have none. The pinyin itself is correct.

definition: 供人大小便的场所。
reviewer_notes: No patches, because the core itself is the problem. If the team keeps this document instead of 88995, it needs the same 间/个 fix: its level_6 correct sentence 超市里有一个公共厕所 uses 个, which contradicts the explanations that say 这里应该用〈间〉. The level_1 decline is accepted as final and not reviewed.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. The definition (供人大小便的场所) and sense_fingerprint (大小便的场所) restate 88995 (上大小便的地方). All ten sentences use the same meaning. Splitting it into two senses creates two near-identical exercise sets that will both be taught as distinct senses.

definition: 允许用户共同编辑和创作内容的网站或系统。
reviewer_notes: The option blocks are otherwise clean: the L1 distractors are tone-only, the L3 distractors are clearly wrong, the L6 wrong sentences are wrong for 维基, and the L7 error 更新地 is a real error. The rejection is for the duplicate sense only.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense (允许用户共同编辑内容的网站或系统) is the same meaning as sense 89005 (很多人都可以在上面写东西的网站). Two sense_ids for one meaning teach it twice.

definition: 书记是一个组织里管事的人。
reviewer_notes: The core cannot be used: its definition, fingerprint and most of its sentences reflect a non-existent sense of 书记.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The sense is invented or drifted. 书记 does not mean a generic person in charge of a group or club. Sentences such as “俱乐部的书记”, “社团的书记很会管事” and “书记今天请大家一起打扫教室” are unidiomatic. The real senses are the Party/League branch secretary (already covered by 89022) and the archaic sense of a clerk handling documents. This core teaches neither of them correctly.

definition: 人民大众;老百姓。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝（核心重复，无补丁）。若流程确实需要两个义项，请人工确认后再由作者修改；如需保留，还需修正 B/A 的 level_7 中“一只民众”“一大只民众”的量词问题之外的其他项目。
reviewer_issues: core: 义项与 89025 完全重复（都是“普通百姓／人民大众”）。“相对于政府而言”只是语境说明，不构成独立义项，会导致练习重复。

definition: 男子是长大了的男人。
reviewer_notes: The sense is not wrong on its own, and its blocks are internally sound. It is rejected only as a duplicate of 89034. If the lexicon deliberately keeps 长大了 and 成年 as separate senses, reverse this to accept and review the blocks on their merits. Planner not run (no tools).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss 长大了的男人 duplicates sense 89034 (成年男性). Both teach the same meaning with the same contrast (男子 vs 男孩/男童), the same register, and near-identical sentence frames. Keeping both produces duplicate exercises for one meaning.

definition: 月事是女人长大以后，身体每个月会有的一件事。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as a separate sense, so this is a reject with no patches. I checked the variant contents for the record and found no further defects: the level_3 options are single-correct, the level_6 wrong sentences are wrong for the stated reason, and the level_7 items are fine. The 一个月事 measure-word error is acceptable. Those fixes would be wasted on a duplicate sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates sense 89036. Both are 女性每月一次的生理现象 with a 委婉 register, and this definition (一件事) is vaguer. Two senses for one meaning teach the same thing twice and make distractors ambiguous across senses.

definition: 看后觉得中意,喜欢。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 89037, not for its individual blocks. Apart from the shared 看上去 problem, the level_1, level_3, level_6 B and level_7 blocks look sound, and would need no change if the sense were kept.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 89037 (看后中意、喜欢). The fingerprints 看了以后很喜欢，想要得到 and 看了以后觉得中意、喜欢 do not separate the senses, so the course would teach one sense twice.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: Same defect as 89037: 他站在窗前，远处的山看上去很高 is acceptable Chinese, and 看上去 is a different word, so it is not a wrong use of the target.

definition: 有名声的;为众人所知的。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 89045. If the owner keeps 89046 instead of 89045, these variant fixes also apply: A.synonym_antonym_match option 普通 and B.synonym_antonym_match option 平庸 and 寻常 are risky antonym distractors (same reasoning as 89045). Sentences and the other blocks are otherwise clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition, core.sense_fingerprint: This sense duplicates 89045 (有名声的；为众人所知的 vs 很多人都知道，很有名). It splits one meaning across two cards.

definition: 治是给病人用药，让病变好。
reviewer_notes: reject 的依据是义项重复，而非单个块有错。被判为重复后，本文档的各个块不再单独修补。L1 与 L3 的干扰项在听感和语义上都站得住。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89054 实为同一义项（治＝医治疾病，“用药让病好”是其下位说法）。两个 sense_id 教的是同一个意思，学习者会在两处见到同一类练习，且两份文档的干扰项与句子高度重叠。

definition: 做事严肃、不马虎的态度。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the sense duplicates 89055 and offers no separable contrast. Nothing patched. Keeping any sense from this set would require a new sense (当真 / 不是开玩笑) with its own definition and sentences.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89055 的“做事很用心,不马虎”实质相同，只差“用心”与“严肃”，且同样以“马虎”为反义词。学习者在两个义项下会遇到同一套答案，无法教学区分。; core.sentences[3], core.sentences[4], core.sentences[7], core.sentences[8]: 这些句子中的“认真”都是专心、用心做事的意思，属于 89055 的义项，不符合“严肃、不马虎的态度”。; core.sentences[9]: “这件事不是开玩笑，请你认真一点”表达的是“当真、不是玩笑”之义，定义中并未写出该义。

definition: 熟悉是对一个人或一个地方知道得很清楚。
reviewer_notes: reject 的依据是义项重复。若流水线决定保留两个义项，则还需修复上面两条。其余块：L3 A/B 的干扰项在语义或搭配上都不通；L6 A 的错句确实错误；L7 B 的“过过”重复体标是清楚的错误。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89066 实为同一义项（熟悉＝知道得很清楚）。两者的差别只是宾语类型（人/地方 与 事物/业务），不构成词典意义上的不同义项，属于重复义项。; variants.A.level_7.error_description: 说明“熟悉”不能用“把”字句引出对象并不成立：“把这份资料熟悉一下”是合法的。真正的错误是“把……很熟悉”这种“把”字句里用“很”加状态动词。; core.sentences[9].text: “我熟悉她的声音，一听就知道是她”的宾语是声音，偏离定义“对一个人或一个地方知道得很清楚”，更接近“辨认”。它又被用作 B 的 L6 正确句，学习者可能把该句的义项理解错。

definition: 第一级;最好的等级。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as written. In addition, B level_6 wrong_sentences[1] (一等的第一) tests redundancy rather than confusion with a contrasting word.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: "拿了一等 / 拿到一等" is unnatural; native speakers say 一等奖. Most sentences (0, 1, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9) rely on this pattern. Sentences 2 and 7 (fruit and tea grading) belong to the quality-grade sense 89075, so the sense pin is blurred.; core.pos: The sentences use 一等 nominally (as the object of 拿), but pos is 形容词. It should be 区别词 or 名词 depending on how the sense is redefined.

definition: 从子是爸爸的兄弟的儿子。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core gloss is wrong, so no patch can repair it. The level_3 and level_6 options are also built around cousin-versus-nephew contrasts that would teach the error. 89094 holds the correct meaning.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 从子 is glossed as 爸爸的兄弟的儿子 (paternal cousin, 同辈的堂兄弟). The standard meaning is 兄弟之子 (nephew). The paternal cousin is 从兄/从弟. Every sentence, option and explanation in this sense rests on the wrong gloss.

definition: 听任是别人想怎么做，你不拦他。
reviewer_notes: 块内容本身基本干净：L3 两组各只有一个正确项，干扰项在义项或搭配上都不成立；L6 三个错句都因义项而错；L7 的错句只含一个错误（量词“只”、体标“了”）。synonym_antonym_match 以 no_relation 放弃，但“阻拦”“干涉”是此义项的明显反义，放弃理由不成立，若保留此义项需补上。定义“别人想怎么做，你不拦他”口语化，与书面语域不符；例句也偏口语叙述。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但 blocks 中没有对应块，须重跑 plan 核对。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89098 为同一义项：两者都是“任凭、不加干涉”，例句句义相同，只是宾语不同（人 vs 事情）。同一义项拆成两条，会让学习者重复学习。

definition: 到了那个时候。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 89103; nothing patched. Its sentences are future-oriented and otherwise fit. If the team prefers this definition (cleaner wording) and keeps it instead of 89103, the 89103 level_7 A fix must be applied to whichever sense survives.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89103 的“说到了那个时候”同义，fingerprint 也同为“将来某时”。两个义项学习者无法区分，属于重复义项。

definition: 花呢是有花纹的毛布，可以做冬天的衣服。
reviewer_notes: 若只看本文档，块内容基本干净：L3 的干扰项“小说”因量词“块”不当而不成立；L6 三个错句都因义项或语境而错；L7 的错句只含一个错误。L1 放弃（no_minimal_pairs）是正确的，因为“花泥”（huā ní）是完全同音同调的真词，不能作干扰项。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9 但无对应块，须重跑 plan 核对。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89106 为同一义项（有花纹的毛织物，做外衣或冬衣的布料）。“冬天”的限定不构成独立义项，定义、指纹与例句句义都与 89106 相同。

definition: 打水是用桶从井里或水龙头那里取水。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant duplicate of 89132, not for content defects in the sentences. The level_3 and level_7 items are sound. The plan lists active_levels 2, 4 and 9 with no matching blocks; re-run the plan command to confirm none are required.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as 89132 (drawing water with a bucket from a well or water source). The only addition is the tap, so the learner would be shown two identical senses.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 用扁担打水 still describes fetching water from a source, so 打水 is not wrong here. The semantic-discrimination item would have two defensibly correct sentences.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 快递员每天骑车给各家打水 describes fetching water for households, which is literally 打水. It is defensibly acceptable.

definition: 天天;每一天。
reviewer_notes: 因重复而拒绝，内容另作了检查。若决定保留本义项而非 89135，需要的修改包括：B 组 L3 的“一起”（options[3]）在无线索的句子“老人日日坐在门口看风景”中可辩护（“老人一起坐在门口看风景”读起来自然）。修法是给第 6 句加线索（“，已经坚持多年”），并把“一起”换为“偶尔”。其余模块检查如下：A 组 L3 的“刚刚”“正在”“终于”都与“从不迟到”相矛盾，正确；A 组 L6、B 组 L6、两个 L7 项目干净。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 89135 重复：释义“天天;每一天”与“每一天,天天”相同，词性、语义类、语域和指纹也一致。同一义项设两个义项会让学习者做两次相同的练习。

definition: 术语是某一行的人常用的特别的词。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on duplication with sense 89140, which is the cleaner sibling (correct 術語 form, sense-specific sentences). Sentences such as 医生说了很多我听不懂的术语 fit both senses, so neither sense can be pinned. Within this sense I found no distractor that is defensibly correct, and each level_7 sentence has one error, but these checks are moot if the sense is rejected. Plan lists active_levels 2, 4 and 9 with no matching blocks; confirm whether that is intentional.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89140 义项重复：两者都指某一行业或学科的专门用语。本义项的例句（医生说、做饭、踢球、厨师）同样满足 89140 的释义，无法把练习锁定到本义项。; core.morphological_forms[1]: 「專業術語」标为繁体，但它是「专业术语」的繁体，不是「术语」的繁体。「术语」的繁体是「術語」（见 89140）。

definition: 理由是你做一件事的原因。
reviewer_notes: 作为重复义项予以拒绝，因此未提出补丁。拒绝前已核查其余内容：A的level_3、level_6、level_7及B的level_3、level_6、level_7在单独看来均可用，但这不足以挽救重复的义项。另外，句2与句5带有furigana字段，其余句子没有，前后不一致，且拼音标注中“。”前有多余空格。若团队决定两个义项都保留，则需要重新划分义项并重审全部块。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 本义项与89158重复：二者都是“做某事的原因／根据”，词典对“理由”只立一个义项。两者的句子可以互换（如“他迟到的理由是路上堵车”同时符合两个义项），导致重复且相互混淆的干扰。

definition: 连词，假如，如果。
reviewer_notes: The sentences are natural and in sense, but the core is redundant, so this is a reject rather than a rewrite. If the owner decides to keep this row instead of 89159, the following must be fixed first. A L6 wrong 0 「你想喝茶设或咖啡都可以」 has a defensible hypothetical reading. A L6 wrong 1 「设或他很有钱，他还是很节俭」 is a hypothetical concession and is acceptable. A L6 wrong 2 「他迟到了，设或被老师批评了」 also has a hypothetical reading. B L6 wrong 1 「我们早点出发，设或赶上火车」 can mean 「以防赶上火车」, so it is not clearly wrong. B L6 wrong 2 「这道题设或专家都解不出来」 is borderline. Each needs a completed-time marker such as 昨天 or 已经 so that 设或 is clearly w
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89159 重复：同为连词，同表假设（假如/要是），同一类例句和干扰项。同一义项被拆成两行，学习者会学到两次同一个意思。

definition: 结婚是一男一女成为一家人,住在一起过日子。
reviewer_notes: Sentences, L3/L6/L7 blocks and the antonym block were checked and are clean in isolation: each distractor fails in context, each L7 incorrect sentence has one error, and the correct-index lists are accurate. The problem is the duplicate sense, not the exercises. Plan lists active_levels 2, 4 and 9 with no matching blocks; confirm this is intended.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 89162. Both define 结婚 as a man and woman becoming a married couple, and the only addition here (住在一起过日子) is a consequence, not a separate sense. The two senses share the same antonym (离婚) and the same distractor types, so a learner is tested twice on one meaning.

definition: 诅咒是用很坏的话盼别人倒霉。
reviewer_notes: If the sense inventory keeps this sense anyway, also fix B level_6 wrong_sentences[1] (她小声诅咒那个帮她修车的人), which has the same spite-not-error problem as 89166 A/B. Other blocks were checked and are otherwise clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 89166. 用很坏的话盼别人倒霉 and 用恶毒的话咒骂，希望别人遭殃 describe the same meaning, so the L3, L6, L7 and antonym exercises are interchangeable with 89166's (same 祝福 antonym, same distractor types).

definition: 著是把想法写下来,写成书。
reviewer_notes: This is a duplicate of 89170. The level 6 wrong sentences also duplicate 89170's verbatim (著了一首新歌, 墙上著了一幅壁画). The furigana fields are spurious for zh.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This is the same sense as 89170 (写作；撰写), so the two are duplicate senses. In addition, several sentences are unnatural in modern Chinese, where native speakers would say 写: 你能著一本书吗, 她一直希望能著一本自己的小说, 他想把自己的经验著成一本书.

definition: 警官是警察里管事的人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on duplication alone. Sense 89176 is kept because its sentences (升为, 级别, 当上了) pin the rank sense. The level_1 decline (no_minimal_pairs) would be acceptable: 警官 is a same-tone homophone of 景观 (jǐngguān), which cannot be used as a listening distractor. Within this sense I found no distractor that is defensibly correct, but these checks are moot if the sense is rejected.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89176 义项重复：「警察里管事的人」与「警察中具有一定级别的官员」指同一类人。本义项的例句（警官问了我几个问题、一位警官带着人去了现场）不能把练习锁定到本义项而非 89176。

definition: 东西是整个国家的，不是哪一个人的。
reviewer_notes: Core is unusable as a separate sense; no patches. If it were kept, B level_3 distractor 公立 is borderline for a shop and should be replaced (e.g. 合伙, which contradicts 不是私人的). The plan lists active levels 2 and 4 with no matching blocks. I could not run the plan script (no tools).
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. 89195 ('东西是整个国家的，不是哪一个人的') and 89196 ('属于国家所有的') express the same meaning (state-owned). 国有 has one sense here, so both senses would generate duplicate items that a learner could see as conflicting.

definition: 月信是女孩长大后，每个月身体会有的一种变化。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant duplicate of 89206, not for content defects. The sentences are otherwise sound. The plan lists active_levels 2, 4 and 9 with no matching blocks; re-run the plan command to confirm none are required.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same referent as 89206 (menstruation, 月经). Two senses with the same meaning and near-identical sentences would teach nothing new and could confuse the learner.

definition: 口服药物或保健品等。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core duplicates 89213, not because of sentence quality; the individual sentences are mostly fine. Level blocks for 89214 contain no other defects that I could confirm. Plan/document mismatch as in 89213 (levels 2 and 4 unmatched). I could not run fat_seed_runner (no tools).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “口服药物或保健品等”与89213的“把药吃进肚子里”是同一动作义项，仅宾语范围扩大到保健品。两个义项无法区分，练习会重复，学习者也无法判断哪个义项正确。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “她已经服用过三个月的维生素”并非明确错句：“已经……过……个月”在口语中可接受，错误归因存在争议。

definition: 大量地吃；常用于“大吃一惊”，表示非常吃惊。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is unusable as taught. It mixes two senses and duplicates 89233. The variant defects above are listed for the owner, but no patches are issued on a rejected core. Level_3 distractors in both variants are sound. Level_1 declined in both variants (allowed). The morphological form 大吃一惊 is labelled 固定搭配 but no sentence uses it.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition joins two senses: 大量地吃 and the idiom 大吃一惊 (to be shocked). No sentence uses the idiom, and the 大量地吃 meaning is the same as sense 89233.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: The sentence 我只大吃了一小口饭 is wrong because of 大 vs 一小口. reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core duplicates 89235. The content itself is worth keeping: most sentences (0, 1, 3, 5, 6, 9) use the 关乎生死的大事/危急关头 sense that 89235 does not define. The level_1 options are identical to 89249 in both variants.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 这次考试，老师已经把成绩录在了黑板上 is acceptable: 录成绩 / 录入 (enter grades) is standard. definition: 比赛项目是比赛里要比的一种玩法。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 89256. There is no distinct sense. The exercise blocks are otherwise mostly sound.

reviewer_notes: Core is unusable as a separate sense; no patches. If it were kept, A level_3 distractor 只好 is borderline (a resigned reading after the exam is possible). The rest of the content is otherwise clean. I could not run the plan script (no tools).
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. 89258 ('表示从某一时间或某一事情发生之后') and 89257 ('从那个时候开始，一直到后来') both express the single dictionary sense 'from then on'. Keeping both would produce duplicate items.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0].explanation: The explanation is false. 从此 is not barred from future-directed statements, so '不能用于将来' overstates the rule. definition: 年下是快要过年或刚过完年的时候。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for sentence quality. Its level_3/level_6/level_7 items are mostly sound, but they teach the same meaning as 89260. definition: 活动人士是常常站出来为一件事奔走、帮忙的人。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable. Most sentences teach a meaning the word does not have.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Sense drift. 活动人士 means 'activist': someone who advocates on social or political issues. It does not mean a warm-hearted neighbor who helps out. Several sentences misuse the word: '帮老人搬了家', '爱帮忙的活动人士', '每个周末都去帮忙', '经常帮邻居办事'. In those sentences the natural word is 热心人 or 志愿者. The sense also duplicates 89264.

Teaching both gives the learner two indistinguishable senses.; core.morphological_forms[0..1]: “一个配件” and “一套配件” are measure-word phrases, not word forms, and are labelled as morphological forms.

definition: 沦为是变成了很不好的样子。
reviewer_notes: Blocks checked on their own are mostly sound. L3 distractors fail on meaning or collocation (举办, 聘请, 哭泣; 饲养, 歌唱, 装饰). L6 wrong sentences are wrong for this sense. reviewer_notes: Moot if 89288 is kept, but these defects would need fixing if this sense were kept instead: (a) A L3 distractor 操场 is a weak distractor, because 学校的操场每个月开一次会 reads as an acceptable venue-as-subject sentence (school assemblies are held on playgrounds). (b) B L6 wrong sentence 这个理事会由七名委员组成 is borderline, since the explanation's rule that 理事会 members are 理事 is not strictly true. (c) morphological_forms lists 个 as 量词. A classifier is not an inflected form, so the field is misfiled. (d) A L6 wrong sentence 这家公司的理事会 rests on the 公司→董事会 convention. It is defensible but not strictly wrong. Note that 8
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Sense duplicates 89288. 小组 versus 机构 is not a real sense difference: both describe the governing body of an organisation, and the sentences overlap in meaning. 89288's definition is the standard gloss.

definition: 与一般的不同;不寻常。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 89293. If this sense were kept instead, its level_6 A wrong sentences [1] and [2] would need replacing for the reason above. Its level_3, level_7 and antonym blocks look sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of 89293 (跟平常的不一样 vs 与一般的不同；不寻常). Same antonym 普通/一般, overlapping sentences, and the same sense.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 她特殊地去帮你，真是好人 reads as 与众不同地 (the target sense as a manner adverb), so it is not clearly wrong.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 他特殊地记住了你的名字 reads as special attention, consistent with the target sense, so it is not clearly wrong.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences: The three B wrong sentences (风景/歌/服务 + 特殊地) largely duplicate those in 89293 B.

definition: 量子是非常非常小的东西，小到眼睛看不到。
reviewer_notes: Core is unusable, so there are no patches. Patching would mean rewriting every sentence and every block, and the sense itself is not a real lexical sense. The option-level work is also moot: the level_7 measure-word errors (只, 朵) and the level_6 wrong sentences would have to be redone for any replacement sense. Recommend dropping 89299 and keeping 89300, which is accurate.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 量子 as 非常非常小的东西 (any very small thing invisible to the eye) is not an attested sense of the word. In Chinese, 量子 is the physics term, and its only real sense is the one in sense 89300. This sense is a loose misreading of that term.; variants.A.level_3 / variants.B.level_3 / sentences[5], sentences[9]: Several sentences state false claims as fact: 桌子、水和空气里都有量子 and 我们的身体也是由很多很多量子组成的. Learners would be taught misinformation about physics.; sense_fingerprint: The sense duplicates the referent of 89300 with a different, incorrect size-based gloss, giving the lemma two conflicting definitions.

definition: 写作中选用文字的情况；也指所用的字。

reviewer_issues: core.definition: 本义项「写作中选用文字的情况；也指所用的字」与 89303 的「写文章时用了哪些字」是同一义项，两者的指纹、句子和练习会完全重复。

definition: 治疗疾病的方法。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for content. If the upstream owner keeps 89312 instead of 89311, fix the level_3 A distractor 心情: 这种心情对他的病很有用 is defensibly acceptable, so replace it with 噪音. The rest of this document was checked and is otherwise clean.

definition: 开金是用来说金子里有多少真金的一个叫法。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so no patches. definition: 讲清楚，说明白。

definition: 难走是路不好，走起来很累。

definition: 设在社区、面向社会大众开设课程的学校，学员可按兴趣修习。

definition: 点字是用凸起的小点摸着读的字，盲人用手指就能读。

definition: 大声说某个人做错了事，那样是不对的。

The family and classroom sentences sound unnatural to native speakers: “妈妈谴责弟弟说谎的行为”, “老师谴责了打人的学生”, and “全班同学一起谴责乱扔垃圾的人”. The sense also conflicts with the declared register 书面语 and duplicates 89382.

definition: 自家是说我们自己，或者自己的家。
reviewer_notes: 若保留需修复：A level_3 的「您」在「这是您种的菜，你带点回去吧」中并非明确错误；A level_6 的「他自家就走了」可读作「他自己就走了」，不是错句。furigana 字段只出现在部分句子上，前后不一致。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89386 重叠：89386「自己，也指自己家里或自己一方」已涵盖本义「我们自己或自己的家」。

definition: 处女是还没有结过婚的年轻女子。
reviewer_notes: Stray pinyin 'furigana' fields are present on Chinese sentences.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: In modern Chinese, 处女 is read almost exclusively as 'virgin', which is sense 89410. The archaic sense 'unmarried young woman' cannot be pinned down in these sentences: 国王爱上了一位善良的处女, 画家画了一位…处女, 这首歌是写给一位处女的 and others all read as 'virgin' to native speakers. The level_6 items also depend on the archaic reading; for example, 他的处女是个温柔的人 is a jarring sexual reading. The sense is not teachable without colliding with 89410.

definition: 行动电话是可以带着走的电话。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项重复，不可用，故无补丁。若日后保留此义项，还需处理以下问题：B 组 L6 错误句「他坐在行动电话前，打开文件写报告」有争议，智能手机也能打开文件；声明语域「书面」与多数口语化例句（如「妈妈用行动电话给我打电话」「我的行动电话没有电了」）不符。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但 blocks 与文档中都没有对应块，请由 runner 确认。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89426 为同一义项：两者都指可随身携带的手机。89425 只多了「台湾用语」标注，这是地域标签而非义项区分，会造成同一义重复教学。

reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 89432. The 89432 definition is more specific (组织、筹划、监督), and its level_6 wrong sentences are clearer, especially B's 服务员/歌手/医生 set. Level 9 is listed as active in the plan, but neither the plan nor the document has a synonym_antonym_match block or a no_relation decline. reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. The definition (管一部电影或一首歌从开始做到做好的人) names the same role as sense 89432 (负责组织、筹划并监督影视、音乐等作品制作的人), and the sentences are interchangeable. Two senses for one meaning would teach the same thing twice.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “制作人每天都要在片场指挥拍摄”：制作人有时也到片场监督，句子并非明显错误。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “制作人每天都要在电脑前写剧本”：部分制作人会参与剧本开发，句子在本义项内可能被接受。

definition: 自满，自以为比别人强；也指感到光荣自豪。
reviewer_notes: 核心问题是 sense 本身混合了两个义项，其中“自满”一半与 89437 完全重复。仅修补单个选项无法解决，因此判为 reject，建议重新生成。“自豪”义的句子（4、5、7、8）可作为新 sense 的素材。若拆分后仍保留此 sense，其 synonym_antonym_match 中的反义词“谦虚”只对“自满”义成立，对“自豪”义不成立，需要重新核对。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把两个义项合并在一个 sense_id 下：“自满，自以为比别人强”与“感到光荣自豪”。两者对应的反义关系与练习设计不同，单一义项的锁定原则无法成立。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹同时包含“因成绩而自满”与“因人、事感到光荣自豪”，无法为消歧提供单一依据。; sentences[1,2,3,6,9]: 取得好成绩后不要骄傲、骄傲使人落后、他一成功就骄傲起来了、虽然很有名但一点也不骄傲、你别太骄傲等句子教授的是“自满”义，与 89437 的核心义项重复，并使用相同反义词“谦虚”，造成题库重复。

definition: 故事里很坏很可怕、有特别力量的怪物。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable because the target never appears as a whole word. The sense also overlaps heavily with 89446.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: None of the ten sentences uses 魔 as a free noun. Every one embeds it in the verb-object compounds 除魔 or 降魔, and sentence [2] uses the fixed idiom 降妖除魔. This fails the whole-word rule. The L3 cloze options (除垢/除尘/除霉, 除蚊/除蝇/除雾) only test which compound is formed with 除, and several of them, such as 除尘 and 除雾, are real and partly defensible.; variants.A.level_1.options[2]: 磨 is also read mó (second tone, 'to grind'), so it can be a full homophone of the target. reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 89453. The variant issues are recorded for reference only and were not patched, because the sense should be removed rather than repaired. The 指示代词 label is defensible under common Chinese grammar classifications, so it is not flagged.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicates sense 89453. Both gloss 某 as indefinite reference to an unnamed or uncertain person or thing, with the same pos, semantic_class, morphological_forms, and near-identical sense_fingerprint. Two senses would teach one meaning twice.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “某天晚上，我都听到奇怪的声音。”is only weakly wrong. 都 attaches to 我 and the sentence is not clearly ungrammatical, so the stated reason (应用〈每〉) does not isolate a clear error.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “这位顾客是某人，他叫张伟。”is acceptable, since the speaker may withhold the name and then reveal it. The explanation (应该用〈那位〉) also does not fit: “这位顾客是那位”is not a correction of this sentence.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “我妈妈的生日是某月某日，你别忘了。”is defensible, since 某月某日 is a common way to withhold a date. The stated reason (具体日期) is not a clear error.

definition: 作手是做事很熟练、很有本事的人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is unusable as written. The headword the sense teaches (能手) is not the lemma (作手), and this cannot be fixed by patching fields. Re-key to 能手 before any further review. Variant-level issues are listed for the author. Sense 89469 and 89470 overlap heavily (generic skilled person vs specialist in a craft), and several sentences fit either sense; merge them or sharpen the fingerprints.
reviewer_issues: lemma: Headword mismatch. lemma, definition, pronunciation, ipa, and morphological_forms (老作手) all describe 作手, but target_word, furigana, and every sentence use 能手. A cook can also be a writer or a doctor, so the explanations rest on stereotype rather than a clash, and the blank is not uniquely determined.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “她做了三十年饭，成老能手。” is borderline. 成 + noun without 了 is used in written Chinese (成名, 成家), so the error is not clear.; core.sentences[7].text: “这活儿很难，只有能手才能做好。” uses colloquial 活儿 while register is 书面.

reviewer_issues: lemma: Headword mismatch. lemma, definition, pronunciation, ipa, and morphological_forms (老作手) describe 作手, but target_word, furigana, and all sentences use 能手. definition: 老婆是丈夫叫自己妻子的话。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the core is not a distinct sense. 89477 duplicates 89478 (both gloss to 妻子), and its own definition does not match most of its sentences. Level content was reviewed but cannot be salvaged by local patches. Core sentences were not edited. The input has no source field, so mined status could not be confirmed; no core sentence was touched. Plan read-through: the plan's sentence indices match the document.

The sense is not pinned to what its definition says.; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index / sentence 3: The semantic-discrimination anchor '我老婆喜欢听音乐' is a referent use, so the exercise teaches the same contrast as 89478 and not the address sense this document claims to teach.; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: '先生' as a blank in '老婆,明天我们去公园吧' is weakly defensible (a wife may playfully address her husband as 先生). Secondary to the core problem.

definition: 那种是说远处的那一样东西。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，故判 reject，不提供补丁。句子本身多数自然，可作为89502的素材，但须在89502下重新核对。level_6的干扰句同样依赖「远处」规则，同样存疑。plan 的 active_levels 含 2，但 plan 与文档均无 level_2 块，需确认是否为预期情况。

definition: 不为外人所知的内情。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of sense 89511. Both glosses describe the same meaning (不为外人所知的内情 = 藏在里面、别人不知道的事), so the two senses cannot be taught as distinct and their answers overlap. Rejected as a redundant core, not for content defects. Keep 89511.

definition: 页是书里的一张纸,数书的纸时用。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as the duplicate of 89516, which has the more precise gloss. Not patched. If this sense were kept instead, the level_1 explanation for 饿 (只差声母 y) would need fixing, because y is a zero-initial spelling and not a 声母.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 页是书里的一张纸 conflates 页 with 张. One 张 (leaf) is two 页, front and back. The gloss of sense 89516 (一张纸的一面) is the accurate one.; core.sense_fingerprint: Duplicate of sense 89516: same meaning (sheet/side of a book used as the counter 页), near-identical fingerprint (书册中纸张的量词 vs 书册、本子中一张纸或一面的量词), and overlapping sentence frames. Two senses cannot both be taught.

definition: 把各部分合计起来，求总和。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a core defect (duplicate sense), so no patches are given. If the curator keeps this as a separate domain sense, the level_7 and error-description issues above need patches. Level_3 A and B: the distractors are clearly wrong for stated reasons and none is defensibly correct in the anchor sentence. Level_6 A and B: the correct indices (3 and 9) point to sense-consistent sentences, and the wrong sentences fail for stated reasons. The B level_7 corrected sentence is correct. Both A and B are distinct. Level_1 and synonym_antonym_match are declined with permitted reasons. Furigana on se
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates sense 89523. Both define 加总 as adding parts together to get a total, and the only difference is the domain in the fingerprint (money and sales versus numbers in general). A learner would be taught the same meaning twice, and the sense does not denote a distinct meaning.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 我把各项费用加总下来了 is not clearly wrong. 算下来 and 加总下来 can mean the total was reached in the end, so a native speaker may accept it. The error description ("下来不能用于此义") is therefore not reliably true.; variants.B.level_7.error_description: The corrected sentence replaces 起来 with 一下, but the description says the error is that 起来 sits in the wrong position. The description does not match the actual change between the incorrect and corrected sentences.

definition: 中用是东西好用,有用处。
reviewer_notes: 这是虚设的重复义项。若强行保留，学习者会被教成错误读音。
reviewer_issues: core.pronunciation: “中用”只有 zhōngyòng 一个读音，词典释义为“有用、能起作用”，多用于否定。不存在读 zhòngyòng 的独立义项，IPA 同样有误。这个义项与 89530 重复，读音还是错的。

definition: 历史悠久、保留着古代遗迹的城市。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of sense 89531 (历史悠久、保留古代遗迹的城市 is the same sense as 很久以前就有的城市). Rejected as a redundant core, not for content defects. Keep 89531. Its A level_1 also contains the doubtful headword 古层, which is fixed in the 89531 patch.

definition: 完;用完。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for local errors. Even so, the L6 wrong sentences would fail on their own. They test 尽力, 尽心 and 尽量 with inanimate subjects (石头, 花, 桥, 椅子, 灯, 河). The error is animacy in a compound, not the taught 结果补语 sense, so the 'wrong for a reason unrelated to the word' rule applies. The L3 distractors and L1 minimal pairs were otherwise acceptable.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss 完;用完 duplicates sense 89541. All ten sentences use V不尽 to mean V不完, which 89541 already covers (用完, 一点不剩, 穷尽). Example: 用不尽 in sentence 5 is the same sense as 89541's 用不尽.

definition: 在道路上通过；也指普遍流行、通用。
reviewer_notes: This sense fails the one-sense rule. A level_6 item contrasting 普通话在全国都通行 with road-sense wrong sentences is incoherent. The doc also contains furigana fields, which do not belong in zh. A level_3 explanation glosses 通行 as 通用, which contradicts the road reading used elsewhere.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses: passing along a road, and being in general use. The sentences are split between them. Sentences 0–2, 8 and 9 are the road sense, which already exists as sense 89545. Sentences 3–7 are the 'in general use' sense.

definition: 邮政是帮大家送信和包裹的工作。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is a duplicate of 89558, so no patches are offered. The level_1 declines are plausible: the only real tone-minimal pair is 有证 (yǒu zhèng), which is not enough for a 4-option listening item. The plan lists active levels 2 and 4 with no blocks. I have no tool to re-run the plan, so the runner should re-plan 89558 and confirm.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Sense 89557 ('工作') and sense 89558 ('事业') describe the same referent, the postal service as an institution. Sentences such as 我妈妈是邮政的工作人员 and 这家邮政公司 fit either sense, so the sense split does not hold.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 我们学校门口有一条邮政 is wrong only because of the classifier 条 (should be 家). The target 邮政 is not the faulty element, so it does not test meaning.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: The error 一只 modifies 工作, not the target 邮政. The level_7 error does not involve the target word.

definition: 学位的最高一级;也指学问渊博的人。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the core is two senses. The fixes are structural (split and regenerate), not local patches. Once split, 89576 should keep the degree-reading sentences that are correct: 他去年考上了博士，还在读书; 读博士要花很多时间; 她三十岁那年拿到了博士; 他硕士毕业后，又去读博士; 博士比硕士高一级; 他想读完博士以后，回家乡的大学教书; 他毕业后马上去外国读博士了; 要当博士，得先完成很多研究. Borderline for the rebuild: A level_3 distractor 驾照 with 考上 is weakly collocational and should be reviewed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: The record bundles two senses: the degree (最高一级学位) and 学问渊博的人. The second is the person sense that 89575 already covers. The document therefore cannot pin one sense.; core.sentences[5] and core.sentences[6]: 她是学校里最年轻的博士 and 大家都叫他“博士”，因为他什么都懂 use the person reading. Sentence 6 is the B level_3 cloze and is in the B level_7 correct set.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0] and [2]: 博士做了一桌好菜 and 博士开车送我们去机场 are defensibly acceptable under the person reading. The 'wrong' sentences are therefore not reliably wrong.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence / corrected_sentence: 他去年遇到了一只博士 and its correction 他去年遇到了一位博士 use the person reading, while the three correct sentences (0, 1, 2) use the degree reading. The corrected sentence is not in the same sense as the correct set.; core.morphological_forms[0]: 位 (量词) is a person measure. It does not apply to the degree sense, and the A level_7 correction relies on it for the person reading.

definition: 男子的恋爱对象；也指女性朋友。
reviewer_notes: Mixed-sense core. Downstream blocks inherit the ambiguity: for example, the A.level_6 wrong-sentence logic relies on the romantic sense only. The stray 'furigana' fields on zh sentences should also be dropped on regeneration.

Sentences 1, 4 and 6 (a woman's 几位女友) use the female-friend sense, while the rest are romantic. B.level_3 even explains 女友 as 女性朋友. The romantic sense also duplicates sense 89587.

definition: 副词,就在原来的地方,不换地方。
reviewer_notes: 因重复义项而拒收，未生成补丁。若流水线改为保留本义项而非 89595，则应按上述 issues 修复。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89595 义项相同（“就在原来的地方，不换地方”与“就在那个地方，不到别处去”），同一义项教授两次。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: “随地拿起水桶灭火”可理解为“在任何地方”，句子勉强成立，属于可辩护的正确干扰项。; core.sentences[5]: 只有此句带有 furigana 字段，与其余句子结构不一致。

definition: 让人很难过、会哭起来的故事或事情。

The sentences are split across both: 0, 1, 2, 6 and 9 use the regime sense, while 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8 use the decision sense. The decision sense duplicates sense 89639.

definition: 戴在脸上用以遮盖或装扮的物品。

Block content was otherwise checked and is clean: A and B level_3 distractors are clearly wrong and no distractor fits the blank; A level_6 and B level_6 wrong sentences are wrong for word-related reasons (minor: A level_6 option 3 uses 面罩 as the correct word for a face covering, which may blur the 面具 vs 面罩 boundary); A level_7 (条 classifier error) is clean with correct indices [0,1,2]. Level_1 decline is accepted. Like 89641, the plan lists active_levels 2, 4 and 9 with no matching
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 89641 ('戴在脸上…把脸遮住的东西' vs '戴在脸上用以遮盖或装扮的物品'). Two sense rows for one meaning would have the learner taught the same thing twice, and the sense inventory is redundant.; variants.B.level_7: Same defect as 89641 A level_7: 「他戴起面具，走进了房间」 is not clearly wrong, and the explanation's rule (不说“戴起”) is false.

definition: 昨天晚上。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 89651, not for content defects. Its sense_fingerprint (“这段时间”) adds no separate meaning. Its sentences could be merged into 89651 if the bank needs more variety. I did not review the blocks further.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89651 为同一义项（“昨天晚上”与“昨天的晚上”），不是独立义项，属于重复。

reviewer_notes: Reject as duplicate of 89658. No sentence source fields are present, so none are treated as mined.

definition: 现在正在读的这一篇文章。
reviewer_notes: Rejected for the duplicate-sense defect, not for item-level defects. The level 3 and level 7 items for A and B are sound and match the plan indices, so they can be reused if 89660 is kept and this sense is deleted. Only the level 6 wrong sentences would need replacing. The level 1 and synonym_antonym declines are acceptable.

Both mean the article the word appears in, so the two senses cannot be taught as distinct meanings and their exercises collide.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “我写的本文得了作文比赛第一名” is a correct use under 89660 (the author's own composition), so it is not a valid wrong sentence.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “我的本文写得很清楚” is acceptable under 89660's author self-reference sense, so it is not a clean wrong sentence.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “我每天晚上都写本文” is acceptable under 89660 (writing the text being written).

definition: 一年十二个月中的前六个月。
reviewer_notes: Not patched, because the core is a duplicate. If the duplicate decision is overruled, these need fixing: (1) the synonym_antonym decline is wrong, since 下半年 is the antonym and the fingerprint itself names it, so use the same block as in 89661; (2) variants.B.level_7 “上半年前的产量” is defensible and needs the same replacement as 89661; (3) the level_3, level_6 and level_7 items in variant A are otherwise clean.

definition: 不平等地看待或对待。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core duplicates sense 89667. No patches are returned. The sentences are of acceptable quality, so they can be reused in 89667. Borderline if kept: B level_3 欢迎 is weakly contradicted, since 大家都批评它 does not name the reason.

Both describe the same meaning (treating someone unequally or discriminating against them) with the same register and the same three morphological forms. The fingerprint split (看不起 vs 不平等地对待) is not a real sense distinction.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 他们曾经歧视了农村来的孩子 is grammatical: 曾经 plus 了 is standard for a completed past event. It contains no valid error.; variants.B.level_1: Declined as no_minimal_pairs, but tone-only minimal pairs exist for the headword.; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: 吃女员工 is ambiguous: 吃人 can mean 'exploit', so the distractor is not clearly wrong.

definition: 具有保护作用的性质；多作定语使用。

definition: 上新是商店里放上新来的东西卖。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 89698. If this sense must be kept anyway, it has these other defects. (1) Sentence 7 carries a stray 'furigana' field containing pinyin; remove it. (2) A L6 '阿姨在上新房间' can be parsed as 上 + 新房间 ('go up to the new room'), which is ambiguous. (3) A L6 '顾客在柜台上新' can be parsed as 在柜台上 + 新, which is garbled rather than a clean misuse of the target.
reviewer_issues: core: This sense duplicates sense 89698: same lemma, same pronunciation, same meaning (a shop putting newly arrived goods on sale). 89698 has the cleaner dictionary-style definition. Shipping both would create two ladders for one sense.; core.definition: The definition 上新是商店里放上新来的东西卖 is not dictionary phrasing: it repeats the headword and is clumsy.

definition: 反问句,表示说话人认为对方应当同意。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 89703, not for local errors. The local items would hold up: L3 distractors fail, L6 wrong sentences fail on presupposition, and L7 has one error. Keeping 89703 over 89704 is arbitrary, so swap the survivor if the inventory prefers the structural gloss.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss 反问句,表示说话人认为对方应当同意 describes the same sense as 89703 (意思是对啊). Both are the 'X，不是吗？' tag expecting agreement. The sentence sets and the L6 and L7 designs are near-identical.

definition: 大能是本领特别大的人。
reviewer_notes: Would also have needed fixes if kept. A level_6 wrong sentence 2 (他是班里的大能，每次都能把全班的作业抄完。) and B level_6 wrong sentences 1-3 (大家都叫他大能，他连一道题都不会做。 / 他总是被人欺负 / 他跑得比谁都慢) are ironic nickname uses that a native speaker may accept as sarcasm, so they fail the wrong-sentence test. A level_6 wrong sentence 3 (他是一位大能，每天只会睡觉。) is borderline for the same reason.
