definition: 先出发；也指先进行。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for sentence quality. Its sentences are otherwise valid for the 先做 meaning, so their content belongs under 89709.
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: Same sense as 89709. 先出发 is a subcase of 比别人先走, and 也指先进行 is the same as 先做. Every sentence here also fits 89709's sense.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 他的脸色先行发白 can be read as 'turned pale first', a precede-in-time use, so it is borderline acceptable as a wrong sentence.

definition: 半天是一天的一半，也指很长的一段时间。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用：89725 与 89726 覆盖的是同一组两个义项，且两份文档都混入了另一义项的句子。89725 以“很长时间”为主（如等了半天、找了半天），89726 以“一天的一半”为主（如只上半天班）。建议拆分为两个单一义项：一个是“一天的一半”，一个是“很长时间”，各自重写句子，并重新生成 plan。由于拆分会改变句子索引和题块，这里不做补丁修改。为参考起见，现有题块中的“他找了一只半天”（量词“只”误用）和“我问着这个问题半天”（体标错误）两处错误设计基本成立，但在重新拆分后需要重做。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义同时包含“一天的一半”和“很长的一段时间”两个义项，sense_fingerprint 也是如此，不符合“一个句子对应一个义项”的要求。; core.sentences[8]: “我今天休息半天”是“一天的一半”义，与其余“等了半天”“问了半天”类句子不属同一义项。; core.sentences[9]: “他们只用半天，就把房子打扫好了”同样是“一天的一半”义，与本义项的主体句子不一致。

definition: 一天的一半；也指较长的时间。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，原因与 89725 相同：两个文档是同一对义项的镜像拆分，每份都混入了对方的句子。89726 以“一天的一半”为主，89725 以“很长时间”为主。请一并拆分重写，并重新生成 plan。由于拆分会改变句子索引和题块，这里不做补丁修改。B 的 level_7 解释为“我问着……半天”（体标错误）等设计也需要在重写后重做。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义“一天的一半；也指较长的时间”把两个义项并列，sense_fingerprint 也是如此，不是单一义项。; core.sentences[6]: “他等了半天，朋友还没来”是“很长时间”义，与本义项“一天的一半”的主体句子不一致。; core.sentences[7]: “我找了半天，也没找到手机”是“很长时间”义，不属于“一天的一半”义。; core.sentences[8]: “她说了半天，我还是没听懂”是“很长时间”义。; core.sentences[9]: “你怎么半天不说话？”是“很长时间”义。

definition: 案件是发生了坏事,需要弄清楚的事情。
reviewer_notes: Because the gloss is so broad, several 'wrong' distractors are defensible under it: B level_6 wrong 2 (这场洪水是一起严重的案件，很多人失去了家园。) describes a bad event that could need clarifying, and A level_6 wrong 2 (夜空中出现了一起罕见的案件。) is similar. Several level_6 explanations (A wrong 1, B wrong 1) quote the 涉及诉讼 definition, which contradicts this sense's own core.definition. The sentences also fit 89736 equally well. Keep 89736.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 89736. The gloss 发生了坏事、需要弄清楚的事情 is a broad version of 涉及诉讼或违法犯罪的事件, and the two cannot be told apart in practice.

definition: 能够移动或活动的。
reviewer_notes: Verdict is reject because the sense is a duplicate, not because its sentences or options are broken. Each item is individually valid for 能动: the level_3 blanks, the level_6 contrasts, the level_7 corrections and the antonym block all check out. Keeping both senses would give learners two near-identical items for one meaning. Also, the plan lists active_levels 2, 4 and 9 with no planned blocks, the same as 89745. Re-run the plan there too, if this sense is retained.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 89745. Both describe the same meaning (能够移动 / 能动). Both use antonym 固定, both use the same level_6 template (很可动 contrasted with adjectives such as 灵敏 / 稳定 / 活跃 or 灵活 / 活泼 / 灵巧), and both use the same level_7 'not movable, but can do X' contradiction pattern.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: '这个相机的屏幕是可动的的' has a doubled 的. This is a generic typo that teaches nothing specific to 可动.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: '这个灯座的支臂是不可动的，可以调节角度' repeats the same error template as 89745 A level_7 ('是不可动的，可以…' contradiction). Two senses teach the same item.

definition: 地位较高的领导层；也指高的楼层。
reviewer_notes: sense_fingerprint 同样合并了两个义项。morphological_forms（高层建筑、高层住宅）只属于楼层义。B 变体 level_6 的错句使用领导层的“人”义（“一把/一架/一头 高层”），测试的是量词，并且混入了另一个义项。计划缺少 synonym_antonym_match 块，但“低层”是楼层义的明确反义词。个别句子和块本身基本可用，但在义项拆分之前，任何补丁都是无效的。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义把两个义项合并为一个：“地位较高的领导层”与“高的楼层”。句 0–3 使用领导层义，句 4–9 使用楼层义。A 变体的块全部取领导层义（句 0、3），B 变体的块全部取楼层义（句 6、7、9），单个文档无法锁定一个义项。

definition: 戏剧、电影等作品中的主要角色。
reviewer_notes: The individual sentences are clean, but the record duplicates 89763 and should not ship as a separate sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as sense 89763 (the protagonist of a work). The split is only by medium (story vs film/drama), so two senses teach the same thing and their exercises overlap.

definition: 秘密地拿走他人的财物。
reviewer_notes: The sentences are individually fine. If this record were kept, variants.B.level_7 would also need a patch: “他不偷过我的钱” is only a marginal error, since 从来不 with 过 is occasionally acceptable in speech.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 89777 (covertly taking others' property). Two records for one sense; their exercises overlap heavily, and the level_1 option sets are identical to 89777's.

definition: 一个地方四周围的地方。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 89810, not for sentence quality. The blocks are otherwise sound: level_3 distractors (围墙/课桌/教室; 课堂/舞台/书架) are not defensibly correct, and the level_6 and level_7 errors are valid. Do not carry these blocks into 89810 without re-running the plan.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 89810 (周围；附近). Both definitions describe 'the area around a place', and all 10 sentences here use that same sense. Two senses that cannot be told apart would produce two exercises with overlapping correct answers.

definition: 国家或地区边界以内的地方。
reviewer_notes: The individual sentences are clean and the variants are internally consistent, but the core is redundant with 89823. Also, core.sentences[6] is the only sentence with a furigana field, which is inconsistent with the rest of the document.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 境内 is defined here as the area within a country or region boundary, which is the same single sense as 89823 ('国家或地方的里面'). The sense_fingerprint is nearly identical as well. Both drills would teach and test the same meaning twice.

definition: 指夜里很晚的时候，多用于口语。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 89833. If it were kept, A level_3 option 夜间 would be defensibly correct (「夜间你怎么还不睡？」 is grammatical), and its register-only explanation is weak. Its level_3 and level_7 blocks also carry the same 很大晚上 and 都大晚上 errors as 89833.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89833 为同一义项（口语中指深夜），两个义项会用不同句子反复测同一词义。

definition: 女权是女人和男人一样，应该有的权利。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 89840. Its level_6 and level_7 blocks also use 一份女权 as the error, with the same classifier problem found in 89840.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89840 为同一义项（女性应享有的与男子平等的权利）。89840 的定义更精确，本义项更笼统。

definition: 所做的事;作为。
reviewer_notes: This sense is not teachable as a standalone noun. Consider merging it into 89841.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences[1]: 「有所为」is 有所＋为, a fixed pattern (as in 有所作为). Here 所为 is not the noun.; core.sentences[5]: Same embedding: 「有所为」.; core.sentences[0]: 「大的所为」is unnatural; a native speaker says 作为.; core: The meaning 'achievement' (作为) is not current for 所为 as a standalone noun. Most sentences are just copies of sense 89841, and several blocks teach 「一件所为」.

definition: 神话中的女性神灵；也指极受喜爱的美丽女性。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is unusable as written: the definition covers two senses, and the exercises depend on which one is meant. Patches cannot fix that, so the sense must be split and regenerated. The deity sentences duplicate sense 89845, so the split should merge them rather than create a second copy. The other issues are listed for the regeneration. Level_3 distractors and level_6 wrong sentences are otherwise sound, and A and B are not copies of each other. I could not run the runner here to regenerate the plan.
reviewer_issues: core.definition and core.sense_fingerprint: One sense bundles two meanings: 神话中的女性神灵 (literal deity) and 比喻受人喜爱的美丽女性 (figurative idol). The exercises then mix them. A level_3 uses deity sentence 0, B level_3 uses figurative sentence 6, A level_6 has a figurative correct sentence with deity-based wrong sentences, and B level_6 has a deity correct sentence. A single-sense document cannot be patched into a consistent exercise.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「粉丝们都把她叫着女神。」 The error is the verb 叫着 versus 叫作, not the target word, which level_7 requires. 叫着 also has a valid calling-out reading in some contexts, so the sentence is not clearly wrong.; variants.A.level_1.options[3]: 女士 (nǚ shì) is not a sound-alike of 女神. The final and tone both differ, so it is not a minimal pair or a tone contrast.

definition: 工程图是画着怎么盖房子、做机器的图。
reviewer_notes: 句子本身大体干净。若改为保留本义项而删除 89880，还需修复：variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]“我们看工程图找路”（建筑平面图可用于室内找路，错误不稳，可改为其他明显误用）；variants.B.level_7 的“这本工程图”（装订成册的图纸册可用“本”，错误不稳，可改为“这只工程图”）。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但无对应 blocks。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89880「表示工程建筑或机械构造、尺寸的图样」指同一事物（工程图纸），两个义项无法在选择题中分开，锁定义项失效。

definition: 从事某种活动所应具备的条件、身份。
reviewer_notes: Half of the core sentences drift into sense 89883, so the downstream blocks cannot be salvaged.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: The sense is 身份/资历 (identity or standing). Sentences 3, 4, 6, 7 and 9 instead use the qualification/condition sense of sense 89883: 拿到医生的资格, 没有资格这样要求, 没有当裁判的资格, 取得教师资格, 取消当经理的资格. These include the anchors for A.level_6, B.level_3, B.level_6 and the B.level_7 indices, so the core is not pinned to one sense and duplicates 89883.; core.sentences[8].furigana: This is a stray non-zh field holding pinyin.

definition: 身体恢复健康。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 89891, not for the blocks themselves. The level_3, level_6 and level_7 content is otherwise sound apart from the issue above.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Sense duplicates 89891. 「身体恢复健康」 and 「生病或受伤以后，身体慢慢好起来」 describe the same meaning, and every sentence in this document is valid under 89891's definition. The learner would be taught one sense twice and the sense pin no longer separates anything.; variants.A.level_7.corrected_sentence: The corrected sentence 「姥姥的病已经康复了。」 makes 病 (a disease) the subject of 康复. This sense's own level_6 explanations say 康复 applies only to a person's or animal's body, so the corrected sentence breaks the rule the document teaches.

definition: 副词,不容易;不易于。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate sense of 89895. If the pipeline keeps 89896 instead of 89895, it needs the same kind of definition fix, the 偏偏 distractor must be replaced, and the blocks must be checked again. Its sentences are otherwise in the 不容易 sense and the level_6/level_7 wrong sentences are clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition is a raw gloss with the part of speech embedded and ASCII punctuation (副词,不容易;不易于。). It is not a clean definition.; core (sense inventory): This sense duplicates 89895. Both gloss 难以 as 不容易 plus a verb. The fingerprints (不容易、不易于（难以理解） vs 很不容易做到（难以完成）) differ only in their example verbs, not in meaning, so the split is not a real sense distinction.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 偏偏 is arguably defensible in 这两个词的意思很近，学生偏偏分清了 (read as 'unexpectedly, students did distinguish them'), so it may be a second correct answer for the blank.

definition: 第一次。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate only; the core is not unusable on its own terms. If the reviewer keeps this sense instead, fix these first: (1) variants.B.level_1 declines 'no_minimal_pairs', but A's 首字 is a valid minimal pair, so the block must be added; (2) variants.B.level_3 explanation for 从来 says it 「单独用于肯定句不通」, which is false because 从来 does take affirmative predicates. The real reason it fails is that it marks a long-standing habit, which clashes with a first occurrence. The rest of the sentences and level_6/level_7 items were clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 「第一次」 with fingerprint 首次:第一次 describes the same adverb meaning as 89901 (「第一回做某件事」). The inventory double-counts one sense.

definition: 一年中的某个月；月份。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant duplicate of 89913. Block-level fixes would not help because the learner would see the same meaning twice.

definition: 经营业务；商店等开门做生意。
reviewer_notes: Rejected: the core is not a single pinned sense, and its sentences overlap sense 89921. The variant A blocks are otherwise sound: 睡觉/下班/旅游 are not defensible for 公司, 歇业 is the right antonym, and the level_7 error (营业很到晚) is valid. Re-author the 经营业务 sense from scratch, then re-run the plan.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss '经营业务；商店等开门做生意' merges two senses. The one-sense pinning rule fails, and the fingerprint '经营业务，开门做生意' repeats the merge.; core.sentences: Most sentences use the shop-hours sense that sense 89921 already owns: [4] 小店营业到半夜, [7] 旅馆全年营业, [8] 照常营业, [9] 这条街上的店晚上都不营业. The sense is therefore not distinguishable from 89921.; variants.B.level_3.options[1..3]: In '他在小区里开了一家店，已经开始___了。' the subject is 他, so 退休 (retired), 散步 (walking) and 锻炼 (exercising) are grammatical and defensibly fit. 锻炼 is essentially correct. The explanations, which say '店不会散步/退休/需要锻炼', assume the wrong subject and are false.

definition: 普通人，一般的大家。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant duplicate of 89938. Other defects noted for the record: furigana is present on only 2 of 10 sentences, and B level_7 uses the 一些…们 rule (see 89938 notes).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This duplicates 89938 (普通人，一般的大家 vs 平民；普通民众). Every sentence has the same meaning, so the sense is split arbitrarily.

definition: 盛放食物的扁浅器皿。
reviewer_notes: 句子本身大多合格，但核心是重复义项，故拒绝。若需保留其句子，还需处理：A level_1 同样含弱干扰项胖（pàng）；B level_7 使用“把一张盘擦干净了”，修正句“把一个盘”存在与 89943 相同的“把”字问题；morphological_forms 中的“圆盘”指圆形盘状物（如光盘），不是餐盘，应删除。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 sense 89943 指同一义项（盛放食物的扁平盘子），sense_fingerprint 实质相同。同一义项拆成两个，会让学习者重复练习同一内容。

definition: 明天。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of sense 89949, which is retained. The sentences are otherwise mostly sound, and the A level_6 and antonym block (昨日) are fine. The A level_7 defect would need repair if the owner keeps this as a separate sense.
reviewer_issues: sense.core.definition: “明天。”与 sense 89949（“明日就是明天，是今天过去后的那一天”）是同一个义项。两个 sense 教授同一义项，会对同一词给出相互冲突的练习。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “我们约好明日下午三点见面了。”不能确定为错误：句末“了”可表示安排已定的新情况（“我们约好明天见面了”是自然的说法）。若作为独立 sense 保留，此错误需要修复。

definition: 本月之后的那个月。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate only. If this sense is kept instead, these defects from 89951 apply here too: both L1 blocks decline 'no_minimal_pairs' although 夏夜 is a minimal pair; both synonym_antonym_match blocks decline 'no_relation' although 上月 is the antonym; A's level_3 distractor 下一月 is defensibly correct in its anchor; and B's level_3 distractor 下月份 is a near-synonym, not a clean wrong answer. The level_6 and level_7 items were otherwise clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 「本月之后的那个月」 with fingerprint 下月:本月之后的那个月 describes the same meaning as 89951 (「这个月的后一个月」).

definition: 改换名称或名字。
reviewer_notes: The blocks are individually clean (level_3, level_6 and level_7 checked for both variants). Rejected only as a duplicate: keeping two identical senses teaches the same thing twice. If the inventory deliberately keeps both, overturn this verdict and re-review the blocks with a distinct definition.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 89959 同义重复：两者都是“改换名称”。89959 的释义更宽，且覆盖本义项全部例句。

definition: 改正错误，重新做人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for sentence content. Sentence-level quality is otherwise reasonable: target words are exact and the register fits. Declined blocks were not reviewed, as required.
reviewer_issues: core: This sense duplicates 89965. Both define 自新 as reforming after wrongdoing (改正错误，重新做人 vs 做错事以后决心变好). Their sentences and exercises are interchangeable, so the sense cannot be told apart from 89965 and fails the one-sense standard.; variants.B.level_7: The error “他已经真正自新。”（missing 了）contradicts sentences this document keeps as correct: core sentence 6 “他用实际行动证明自己已经自新。” and the A level_6 anchor sentence 3 “这个孩子偷过东西，现在已经自新。” both use 已经＋自新 without 了.

definition: 地球表面巨大的岩石块；也指某个整体中相对独立的部分。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the core merges two senses and its crust sense duplicates 89969, so no single patch fixes it. Sentences 2 to 9 are good examples of the component sense and can be reused in a new abstract sense. Regenerate the blocks and rerun plan for the new sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把“地壳巨大岩石块”和“整体中相对独立的部分”两个义项合并，违反一义项锁定。地壳义与 89969 完全重复。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹同样混合了两个义项。; core.semantic_class: 标为 concrete，但“业务板块”“体育板块”等部分义是抽象的。; core.sentences[0]: “地球上的大板块每年都在慢慢移动”是地壳义，违反一义项。; core.sentences[1]: “日本在几个板块的交界处，地震多”是地壳义，违反一义项。; variants.A.level_3: 锚句 sentences[0] 是地壳义，选项解释也依赖地壳常识，与所锁定的部分义不一致。

definition: 现在;目前。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 89973: same sense, same gloss. Keep 89973. If the author chooses 89974 instead, the three issues above must be fixed first. The other blocks are acceptable as far as checked.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “现在;目前” is the same sense as 89973 (“如今是现在这个时候”). Splitting it into two senses produces duplicate exercises.; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: In 如今的我已经学会了做饭。, 当年 (and 往昔 and 当初) fits grammatically: 当年的我已经学会了做饭. The anchor has no context that excludes past time, so the distractors are not clearly wrong.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0].explanation: The explanation cites 〈以前〉, but the sentence 她如今曾经是老师 uses 曾经.

definition: 由皇帝统治的、疆域很大的国家。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 89979. Keep 89979. If this sense were kept instead, all four issues above would need fixing: remove the stray synonym block, replace 火箭, and replace the figurative A level_6 sentence.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “由皇帝统治、疆域广大的国家” is the same sense as 89979 (“由皇帝管着的、很大的国家”), so the two senses duplicate each other.; variants.B.synonym_antonym_match: The stated antonym of 帝国 is 以前, but 以前 is the antonym of 如今, not of 帝国. The block also has one option where exactly four are required. The plan does not call for this block.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 古代火箭 is a historical term, so 关于古代火箭的电影 is plausible. The cloze is not exactly one correct answer.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 他家是一个很小的帝国，只有三间房 is figurative. Chinese speakers accept this kind of playful use, so it is not reliably wrong.

definition: 形容心理或行为极不正常；另指动物发育过程中形态的变化。
reviewer_notes: 判为 reject：该 sense_id 在一个条目下定义了两个词性不同的义项，无法靠 block 级补丁变成单义项。建议拆分为“心理义形容词”与“生物义（形态变化）”两个 sense，再重新运行 planner。未运行 planner（本次无工具）。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 同一 sense_id 承载两个词性不同的义项：心理或行为极不正常（形容词），以及动物发育中的形态变化（名词或动词，如“经过变态”“变态分为”）。句子也混用两者：3、4、7、9 为生物义，其余为心理义。pos 与 sense_fingerprint 只描述了前者。; variants.A.level_7: 错误句“蝌蚪变态进了青蛙”属于生物义，而标为正确的三句（0、1、2）全是心理义，同一练习混合了两个义项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “这只变态很可怕”：“只”用于指人在口语中带贬义但确有使用，解释称“只”不能用于人，并不属实。此句不是明确的错误句。; variants.B.level_7.error_description: ““要”表示将来，与“了”不能同用”过于绝对：“要下雨了”“快要……了”都成立。真正的问题是“经过了”表示已完成，与表示将来的“要”相矛盾。

definition: 传说中死后不腐烂、能行动的尸体；也比喻不再起作用的事物。
reviewer_notes: There are further defects: A level_6 uses a classifier distractor (台), and B level_1 declines without justification. Regenerate after the sense split.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition combines two distinct senses: the literal legendary corpse and the figurative defunct thing. The sentences mix both (3, 6 and 8 are figurative; the rest are literal), so the core does not pin one sense. The A level_6 anchor (index 3) is figurative while its distractors test the literal sense. The literal part also duplicates 89995.

definition: 某一部分在整体中所占的比例。
reviewer_notes: The rejection is for duplication only. The content passes the checks: the sense is held in every sentence, each distractor is defensibly wrong, the level_7 errors are single and correctly tagged, and the indices are valid. The core is redundant rather than unusable. If the pipeline merges senses, 89999's blocks cover this material.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. 90000 defines 比重 as a part's share of a whole (某一部分在整体中所占的比例), the same meaning as 89999 (一部分在整体里占的多少). Both are abstract nouns with the same register and the same usage pattern, so two sense IDs teach one meaning.

definition: 照相机前面的圆玻璃；也指拍下来的一小段画面。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core bundles two senses: lens and shot. 90017 and 90018 both bundle the same pair, so the lemma needs regeneration as two separate senses (镜片/光学部件 and 一段画面), and the plan must be re-run afterwards. Sentence split under the two-sense reading: lens = 0,1,3,4,5,6,7; shot = 2,8,9. Patching sentences alone cannot fix this, because the definitions themselves are wrong.
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: 一个义项内合并了两个不同义项：镜头作“光学镜片”与作“拍下的一段画面”。两者在词典上是独立义项，合并后一个义项下的例句无法保持单一义项。; core.sentences[2], core.sentences[8], core.sentences[9]: 这些例句使用“画面／镜头段落”义（最后一个镜头很感人；导演说这个镜头要重拍；镜头里的海边夕阳），与镜片义不一致。; variants.A.level_7.correct_sentence_indices: 索引 2（最后一个镜头很感人）是画面义，在镜片义的 level_7 中被当作“正确”句，属于义项漂移。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “这副眼镜的镜头很厚”中“眼镜的镜头”在部分地区口语中可以接受，错误性不够干净。; core.sentences[5]: “这个镜头太小，拍不到远处的山”不自然；所指的是焦距过短，应说“太短”。; variants.A.level_1 / variants.B.level_1: 以 no_minimal_pairs 放弃 L1，但 镜 jìng 与 jǐng（如 井头 jǐng tóu）构成声调最小对立，放弃理由不充分。; morphological_forms[0]: “个”标为量词，不是形态派生形式，属于分类错误。

definition: 照相机、摄影机上的光学部件；也指拍摄的画面。
reviewer_notes: Rejected for the same reason as 90017: the sense bundles lens and shot, and this sense largely duplicates 90017. Sentence split under the two-sense reading: lens = 0,1,3,5,9; shot = 2,4,6,7,8. Regenerate the lemma as two separate senses and re-run the plan. The A level_3 block (摄影机的镜头很大) is the cleanest lens item in this document, and its distractors 键盘/方向盘/车轮 are clearly wrong, so it is a useful reference for the regenerated lens sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: 与 90017 相同的捆绑：光学部件与拍摄画面被合为一个义项。该义项与 90017 几乎重复。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “这张照片的镜头很清楚，人物都能看见”在本义项自身定义的“拍摄的画面”义下可被辩护为可接受，因此不是干净的错误句。; variants.A.level_7.correct_sentence_indices: 索引 2（这部电影里有一个很长的镜头）是画面义，在镜片义的 level_7 中被当作“正确”句。; variants.B.level_3.sentence_index 6 / variants.B.level_7.correct_sentence_indices: B 块混用了画面义（这个镜头只有三秒）与镜片义（这个镜头能拍很远）的例句，在同一块中义项不统一。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “近视的人要去配镜头”在眼镜店口语中并非明确错误，标准说法是“配镜片”；错误性依赖于非标准用法。; variants.A.level_1 / variants.B.level_1: 以 no_minimal_pairs 放弃 L1，但 镜 jìng 与 jǐng（如 井头 jǐng tóu）构成声调最小对立，放弃理由不充分。; morphological_forms[0]: “个”标为量词，不是形态派生形式。

definition: 社会主义是一种国家的办法,让大家一起把东西共有。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense; it adds no teaching content beyond 90024. The A-side blocks (level_3, level_6, level_7, synonym_antonym_match) and the B-side level_6 and synonym blocks are otherwise clean. Reviewer has no tools, so the plan for levels 2, 4 and 9 (listed in active_levels with no blocks) could not be checked. Run fat_seed_runner plan if this sense is ever restored.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicates sense 90024 (以生产资料公有制为基础的社会制度及其理论). The definition 「一种国家的办法,让大家一起把东西共有」 is a folk paraphrase of the same concept, and the sentences use the same ideological sense. Keeping both teaches one sense twice.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「一股社会主义」is not clearly wrong. 股 combines with 思潮, 势力 and 风气, so the 'wrong' classifier may be accepted.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 「你知道什么是北京吗？」is grammatical, so 北京 is a borderline distractor. The 什么是X frame accepts most concrete nouns, which weakens the item.

definition: 门所在的出入处。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the sense is effectively a duplicate of 90025 (“门前的地方” vs “门所在的出入处”). No patch can separate them without changing the definition and the whole example set. Recommend merging into 90025. The rest of the document (A.level_3, A.level_6, A.level_7, B.level_7) is mostly sound, but it is not worth patching while the sense itself is invalid.
reviewer_issues: variants.B.level_3.options[2]: “房间柜台放着一双拖鞋”不是干净的错误选项。“柜台”在房间里并非不可想象，这个干扰项可以辩护。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 在“门所在的出入处”这一义项下，门口本身就是门洞，说它“很厚”是可以辩护的（门框、门槛），不能算确定的错误句。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “门口生锈了”可以指门框或门槛生锈，因此不是确定的错误句。; core.sentences: 义项重叠：多数句子在 90025 的“门前”义下同样成立，例如“我们在商店门口见面吧”“出租车停在酒店门口”“他在医院门口买了一束花”“我家门口有一个小花园”。这些句子无法体现“出入处”义与“门前”义的区别。

definition: 从地下涌出的、温度较高的泉水。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用的原因是义项重复，而非句子质量。若以后要保留，另有缺陷：A level_3 的“水库”在冬季可以冒出水汽，干扰项不干净，应替换为“冰块”。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 90031 指同一事物、同一义项（从地下涌出的热水，可泡澡），属重复义项，无法形成可区分的教学梯度。

definition: 两边里的一边。
reviewer_notes: Rejected at the core level, so no block patches were made.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: Spatial '一方' meaning '一边' is literary and rare. Sentences such as '请你站到路的一方', '他把车停在路的一方' and '船的一方有人在钓鱼' are unnatural; native speakers would say 一边/一侧. Sentence 8 '我们的队站在场地的一方' drifts into the party sense (90036). The core is not a usable teaching set for T3.

definition: 天空正中；当空。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90045 rather than patched. Its A and B level_1 options are identical to 90045's, which confirms the duplication. Sentence 4 has an extra furigana field that no other sentence has; the reading zhōng tiān is correct, but confirm the schema allows it. Other borderline items, such as A.level_3 窗台 and A.level_7 “升了中天”, were not patched because this sense is being removed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 90045 重复：“天空正中；当空”与“天空正中间”是同一义项，指纹也几乎相同（“日月星辰悬在天空正中，当空高挂”与“天空最中间的位置，常指月亮或太阳所在处”）。两个义项无法在教学中区分。

definition: 连词,书面用语,表示总括上文,相当于「总之」。
reviewer_notes: 作为独立义项不成立，因此不打补丁。单句与 A 组各块本身基本可用，但 B 组 L7 的漏逗号错误与 90047 同样是纯标点问题，若决定保留本条，需做相同修补。A 组 L7 的“了”错误模板与 90047 相同。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 90047 义项重复：两者都是书面连词、总括上文、相当于总之，同一义项被拆成两条。

definition: 男高是男人唱歌时声音最高的那一种。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用的原因是义项重复。若以后要保留：B level_3 的“鼓手”与“学唱歌”语境略不协调；A level_3 的“乐手”在合唱团语境中可能被视为伴奏者，干扰项不够干净。其余句子与错句检查基本通过。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 90056 同为“男声中最高的声部或歌手”，属重复义项。90056 的定义（男高音的简称）更精确。

definition: 留学生是去别的国家读书的学生。
reviewer_notes: 拒收的理由仅为义项重复。除此之外，A/B 两个变体的 level_3、level_6、level_7 选项与解释经核查基本成立，level_1 的 no_minimal_pairs 声明按规则不作处理。计划的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但计划中没有对应的块，需人工核对。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 sense 90062 的释义实质相同（“去别的国家读书的学生”与“到外国学习的学生”），两个义项没有可教的区分，学习者会遇到重复或互相矛盾的练习。

definition: 照旧；仍然如故。
reviewer_notes: Rejected at the core, so no patches are proposed. The duplication is the defect, not any single block.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicates sense 90063. 照旧；仍然如故 and 和以前一样，没有变 describe the same meaning. Sentences fit both definitions (e.g. 过了十年，他依旧记得那件事 is the same pattern as 过了二十年，那棵树依旧站在门口). Sense pinning fails because the learner cannot tell the senses apart.

definition: 异议是不同意，想说出不一样的意见。
reviewer_notes: Every sentence here also fits 90066's definition (不同的意见，不赞成的看法), so this sense adds nothing for learners. Keep 90066. If the inventory deliberately keeps both, the definition here must be rewritten as a noun gloss that clearly differs from 90066, and the blocks re-reviewed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 90066 同义重复。另外 pos 标为名词，但释义“异议是不同意，想说出不一样的意见”描述的是动词性动作，与名词词性及义项指纹不一致。

definition: 不知道。
reviewer_notes: 作为独立义项不成立，因此不打补丁。A 组 L1 的六个选项与解释与 90073 A 组逐字相同，可见两条为同一义项。A 组 L6 的错误句也与 90073 高度相似。A 组 synonym_antonym_match 以“no_relation”放弃，同样不成立，因为“知道”与之互为反义。B 组 L1 的放弃理由同样不成立。
reviewer_issues: core.sense_fingerprint: 与 90073 义项重复：两者都是“不知道／不明白，没有弄清楚”，学习者会学到同一词义两次。

definition: 从里面到外面去。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on duplication, not on the content of its blocks. Had it been kept, it would need the same B level_1 patch as 90085, and its B level_6 wrong sentence 'the tears 出去' would need its explanation checked. Plan lists active_levels 2, 4 and 9 with no blocks; this also needs reconciling if the sense survives.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 90085 almost word for word: same meaning (from inside to outside), same sense_fingerprint, and the same kinds of exercises. Two entries for one meaning will produce near-identical items for learners.

definition: 古代作战时用来遮挡刀箭的护身武器。
reviewer_notes: The rejection is for duplication. The content in this document is otherwise clean: level_1 distractors are valid tone pairs, the level_3 and level_6 distractors are wrong, and the level_7 errors are single and correctly tagged. morphological_forms holds the same 面 classifier entry as 90101 and has the same problem. Because this sense is rejected, no patch is offered here.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 90101. Both define 盾 as the shield used in battle to block blades and arrows. The only added qualifier is 古代, and 90101 already covers ancient use within a broader definition. Its sentences draw on the same meaning.

definition: 用手承接;迎接;连上。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as a single sense. In level_6 A, '接了巨大的压力' is aimed at 承受, but 接 is close to 接受/承接 there, so it is borderline. Fix that sentence on regeneration.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two distinct senses: 迎接人 (meeting a person) and 连接 (joining two ends). The sentences mix both, which breaks sense pinning. Several level_6 explanations also describe a third sense (承接递来的东西).

definition: 三面环水、一面与大陆相连的陆地。
reviewer_notes: The core is redundant, so the variant blocks were not patched.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 三面环水、一面与大陆相连的陆地 restates 90109's 三面是海，一面连着大地的陆地. The sense_fingerprint describes the same concept, so the ladder would teach one meaning twice.

definition: 表示这样就可以，不必再做别的。
reviewer_notes: Core is redundant. If the duplicate is kept by decision, these would need fixing: variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0] (进门即可看见) is standard X即可Y usage (进门即可看到大海), so it is not clearly wrong; core.sentences[6] (十分钟即可结束) drifts from the 'enough, nothing more' sense; variant A level_1 options are identical to 90115.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of 90115. 表示这样就可以，不必再做别的 is the same sense as 这样做就行了; the sense_fingerprint differs only in wording.

definition: 东方和北方之间的方向。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90123. If 90124 is kept instead of 90123, apply the four wrong-sentence and furigana fixes listed above.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 90123. Both gloss 东北 as the direction between east and north, with near-identical fingerprints and the same morphological forms (东北方). Teaching two senses here double-counts one sense.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: "我在超市的东北边等你，你却说超市在我的西南边" is consistent. If I am northeast of the supermarket, the supermarket is southwest of me. The sentence is not wrong, so it is an unusable distractor.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: "他们往东北走了一个小时，回头却看见东北在身后" is consistent once you turn around. After turning back, the northeast is behind you.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: "这条路通向东北，我们沿着它一直往西南走，最后却到了东北的湖边" depends on an unstated starting point, so the contradiction is not guaranteed.; sentences[5].furigana: A stray furigana field appears on sentence 5 only and is not part of the other sentences.

definition: 由来是一件事是从哪里来的。
reviewer_notes: 与 90136 释义与练习内容重复，应只保留 90136。上述问题仅在保留本 sense 时需要处理。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义“由来是一件事是从哪里来的”语句不通，且与 90136（事物的起因或来历）为同一义项。两个 sense 会产出几乎相同的练习。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “他来这里的由来很明确”中由来可取“起因”义，句子不能判为明确的错句。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “考试失败的由来是粗心”中由来取“起因”义，本义项下成立，“原因”只是近义替换，不是错句。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 句末“了”表示情况变化，“我想知道月饼的由来了”语法上可接受。错误说明“了不附在名词后”也不准确。

definition: 相合;与条件、要求等一致。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as redundant, not for content. The level_1, level_3, level_6, level_7 and synonym_antonym_match blocks are otherwise sound. If the inventory keeps both senses, the definitions must be differentiated first.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 90141 (fingerprints 与要求相合 and 与条件要求一致). Two lessons would teach one meaning with overlapping sentences, e.g. 这个人符合我们的条件 versus 这个房子符合我们的要求.

definition: 人的自然寿命。
reviewer_notes: Reject on sense duplication. 90146's only distinguishing feature, 'not shortened by illness or accident', is already conveyed by 90145's sentences (不少人没能活到天年就去世了). Decide which of 90145 or 90146 survives. If 90146 is kept instead, the issues above apply. Its sentence 1 (天年是一个人自然的寿命) is a definition restatement rather than usage, so it is a weak exercise sentence.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “人的自然寿命” is the same sense as 90145 (“人活到很老，一生应该活的岁数”). The two senses cannot be taught apart, and the sentences overlap in meaning (没能活到天年, 享尽天年).; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: Identical to 90145 B level_7 (same sentence and explanation). This is a copy, not a separate exercise.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “天年如梭” can be read as a poetic description of a lifetime passing quickly, so it is not clearly wrong.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “这只狗的天年很短” is not clearly wrong. The explanation itself says the word is “多用于人”, so the error depends on context.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “就能活天年” without 到 is contestable. 活 with a bare noun object (活百岁) is grammatical, so the claim that the sentence is ungrammatical needs checking.; variants.B.level_1: Declined as no_minimal_pairs. The same unsupported decline appears in 90145 B level_1 (near-minimal pairs 千年 and 天然 exist).

definition: 节日;节令。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as redundant with sense 90147, which covers the same 节日 meaning. The other issues are listed for the author in case the sense is reinstated. The level_3 distractors and the correct-sentence checks otherwise hold.
reviewer_issues: core.morphological_forms[0]: 個 labelled 量词 is the measure word 个, not a morphological form of 节.; variants.A.level_7.error_description: Same overbroad rule about 〈只〉 (only for animals). 只 also counts single items of a pair.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: '我们认识的节是三月十号，每年都要一起吃饭' is borderline: a shared yearly meal can read as a festival, so the 'wrong' label is weak.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: '明天的节很激烈' may be acceptable: 节 can mean a period or quarter of a sports match (第一节), so the explanation 〈比赛〉 does not clearly show a wrong sense.; core.definition: Duplicates sense 90147 for the 节日 meaning. 节令 (solar term) is in the definition, but no sentence exercises it.

definition: 一个国家里女的国王。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90152. The level_1 and level_6 issues above would still need patching if the pipeline keeps 90151 instead. Level_7 A and B checks passed: the 件 and 只 classifier errors each involve the target. Declined level_1 blocks were not reviewed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 90152. Both define 女王 as a female monarch (一个国家里女的国王 vs 女性君主), and the sentences describe the same referent. A learner cannot separate them, and the level_3 and level_6 distractors would overlap.; variants.A.level_1.options[1-3]: 女方 (fāng), 女装 (zhuāng) and 女双 (shuāng) do not sound like 女王 (wáng). They are not tone confusables or minimal pairs, so the listening judge would reject them.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “她嫁给国王以后才成为女王” reads as a queen-consort usage, which English-influenced speakers may accept. It is not clearly wrong.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “国王的母亲是女王” can pass as a queen-mother usage, so it is not clearly wrong.

definition: 观众是坐着看表演或比赛的人。
reviewer_notes: 与 90160（观看表演、比赛等的人）为同一义项，且本 sense 的释义含错误限定。应退役本 sense，保留 90160。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “坐着看表演或比赛的人”错误地限定了坐姿。观众也可以站着，句 1（站起来鼓掌）与句 9（都站了起来）与该释义冲突。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹“坐着看表演或比赛的人”带有同样的坐姿限定。

definition: 肉体是人的身体，是你摸得到的这个身子。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable, so every downstream block built on these sentences is unusable too.
reviewer_issues: core: 肉体 is a literary/philosophical word that is normally set against 精神/灵魂. The core does not capture this. Most sentences use it as a plain substitute for 身体, which is unnatural: 肉体很结实, 肉体累极了, 让肉体更健康, 肉体一下子就冷了. The register is mislabeled 中性. The form 一具肉体 mainly evokes a corpse, so the level_7 量词 items in both A and B teach a misleading pattern.

definition: 至若是写文章时，用来转到另一件事的词。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate sense of 90180. Separately, 至若 is a literary connective, but the sentences are simple colloquial T3 content. This register mismatch is tolerable but weak.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This is the same sense as 90180 (至若 = 至于, introducing another matter). The '转折过渡' wording describes the same function, and the sentences are interchangeable with 90180's. Teaching it as a separate sense duplicates content and invites cross-sense confusion. The level_6 wrong sentence “我没有时间，至若没去。” appears verbatim in both senses.

definition: 开支，使用钱财。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90189. The definition 开支，使用钱财 and all ten sentences describe the same act of spending money as 90189's 把钱拿去买东西用掉. No sentence uses 花用 in a different sense, so a learner would meet two senses that teach the same thing. Merge into 90189 rather than keep both. The blocks themselves are sound: plan indices match, the L3 and antonym distractors are not defensibly correct, and each L6 and L7 wrong sentence fails for its stated reason. If the maintainers keep this sense in place of 90189, no patches are needed.

definition: 表示过去某个时候发生过某事。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant core, not for sentence quality. The sentences and blocks I checked were sound. If the inventory intends two distinct senses, rewrite core.definition and core.sense_fingerprint to a distinct sense and revalidate instead of rejecting. The same pronunciation note as 90215 applies.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 90215. Same lemma and POS, same meaning (a past occasion when something happened), near-identical fingerprint and example pattern. Keeping both would yield duplicate exercises.

definition: 没有事情；没有关系，没有问题。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core conflates two senses and must be split, which cannot be done as a patch. Once split, the individual blocks need re-review: the B level_3 stem and the A level_3 explanation are the known problems. The declined synonym block is not reported.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition and sense_fingerprint bundle two senses: “没有事情要做”（空闲）and “没关系、不要紧”. Sentences split between them (0,1,2,6,7,8,9 are free-time; 3,4,5 are no-matter). The sense is therefore not pinned to one meaning, and “没有问题” duplicates sense 90235.; variants.B.level_3.options: Cloze “___的时候，他喜欢去公园走走” is under-constrained. “工作的时候”（break-time walks）and “开会的时候” are both grammatical and interpretable, so 工作 is defensibly correct.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: The explanation for 有事 labels the failure 搭配, but the real failure is a contradiction with the invitation 我们去逛街吧.

definition: 舞台是在大房子里，给人唱歌、跳舞、演戏的高高的地方。大家坐在下面看。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90248; no patches needed. The sentence-level checks are otherwise clean and the plan matches the sentences. The declined level_1 block is not reported.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 90248. Both describe the same meaning: a raised platform inside a hall or theatre where performers perform, and 90247 has the same fingerprint (大房子里供人唱歌、跳舞、演戏的高处). This is one sense split into two IDs.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “学校里有一把舞台” is a measure-word error, not a meaning error. The level_6 exercise tests semantic discrimination.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “学生们在舞台上跑步” is plausible in a drama or performance context, so it is not clearly wrong.

definition: 万人是很多很多的人，多到有一万个。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable because almost every sentence embeds 万人 inside 上万人. All downstream blocks (L3, L7, correct_sentence_indices) are built on these sentences and must be regenerated. Also check whether this sense duplicates 90254.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences[0,1,2,4,5,6,7,8,9]: Nine of the ten sentences use '上万人'. That phrase parses as 上万 (numeral, 'tens of thousands') + 人, so '万人' is only a character fragment that spans a word boundary, not the whole word in its sense. This fails the 整词/整义 rule. Only sentence 3 ('万人大会') uses 万人 as an attributive unit.; core.definition: The wording '多到有一万个' is childish and inaccurate. The word means 'ten thousand people' or, loosely, 'a very large crowd'. It also duplicates sense 90254.; variants.*.level_7: The inserted error '一只' attaches to 上万, not to the target word. The error also depends on cores that fail.

definition: 一万个人；泛指人数极多。
reviewer_notes: This sense duplicates 90253 (same lemma, same meaning), so the two should be merged. The core fails the whole-word criterion in most sentences.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences[0,1,2,4,5,6,8]: These seven sentences use '上万人' (上万 + 人), so the target is not a whole word in them. Only sentences 3, 7 and 9 (万人合唱团, 万人长跑, 万人大合唱) are valid.; variants.A.level_3 / variants.B.level_3: The anchor sentences are 0 and 6, and both are 上万人 fragments. The cloze therefore tests 上万+X, not the target word.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: '很多万人' is wrong because of the numeral structure and because of plausibility, not because of a misuse of the word's sense.

definition: 表示次数居第二。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so the other defects do not need patches. For the record: variant A level_3 distractors 鸡蛋, 地铁 and 假期 are non-temporal and therefore trivially wrong, and variant B level_7's 把 explanation is loose.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates 90267. 表示次数居第二 and 做过一遍后再做的这一回 describe the same usage. Every sentence here fits 90267's definition (for example 这是学校第二次开运动会 is the second occurrence of the event). Two senses a learner cannot separate fail sense pinning.

definition: 煮熟的谷类食物，特指米饭；也泛指每天定时吃的食物。
reviewer_notes: If this sense is kept after a split, also fix: B level_6 wrong sentences are all measure-word errors (一只/一张/一根), the same defect as 90285. A level_3 and level_7 are otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 90285 (cooked rice plus regular meal). The two senses cover the same sentence types, so a learner cannot pin one sense against the other.

definition: 把东西一条一条交叉着做成篮子或网；或者把计划写出来。
reviewer_notes: Core is unusable as written, so no patches. Once split, re-check the blocks. The A level_3 explanation for 缔造 labels a collocation problem as 语域 (minor). The plan lists active_levels 2, 4 and 9 but the document and plan contain no blocks for them. Confirm with the runner plan, which I could not run.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses: weaving a basket or net (sentences 0-4) and drafting a plan or budget (sentences 5-9). A sense document must be locked to one sense.; core.sentences: 90289 and 90290 have the same two-sense scope with near-identical definitions, so the lemma has two overlapping records.

definition: 把条状物交叉组织成器物；也指拟订计划、预算等。
reviewer_notes: Core is unusable as written, so no patches. The block-level content is otherwise in-sense, but it will need rebuilding after the split. The plan lists active_levels 2, 4 and 9 with no corresponding blocks; confirm with the runner plan, which I could not run.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges weaving (把条状物交叉组织成器物) with planning (拟订计划、预算). Sentences 0-4 are weaving and 5-9 are planning, so the record is not locked to one sense.; core.sentences: Same two-sense scope as 90289, so the two records overlap.

definition: 高年是年纪很大的时候。
reviewer_notes: reject 仅因核心重复，且定义不合格。保留的义项为 90292。未生成补丁。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 90292 为同一义项：两者都释为「年纪大的时期」，指纹仅措辞不同。定义「高年是年纪很大的时候。」是以词条自身开头的复述句，也不合格。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「这一个高年」并非确实错误：「个」是通用量词，「一个时期」「一个阶段」很常见，该「错误句」会被判为可接受。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 解释「不能与「和」连用」在语法上不成立。抽象名词可与「和」并列，真正原因是语义不符（高年不指具体的人）。

definition: 由低处向高处、向说话人所在处移动；也用作动词后的趋向补语。
reviewer_notes: Core is unusable as written (two senses in one record), so no patches. The speaker-directed content duplicates 90297; keep only one of the two. The complement-use record needs its own cloze contexts. The plan lists active_levels 2, 4 and 9 with no corresponding blocks; confirm with the runner plan, which I could not run.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two uses: motion toward the speaker (由低处向高处、向说话人所在处移动) and the grammatical directional complement (动词后的趋向补语). The sense is not locked to one meaning.; core.sentences[4]: “渔夫把一条大鱼拉上来。” has no speaker reference; it is a complement use, not the speaker sense.; core.sentences[5]: “他从地下室搬上来一箱水。” has no speaker reference; complement use.; core.sentences[8]: “这口井很深，水怎么提上来？” has no speaker reference; complement use.; core.sentences[0]: “他一口气跑上来，满头是汗。” gives no speaker location, so 上去 is defensible (see below).; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: 上去 is defensible: “他一口气跑上去，满头是汗。” is natural. The explanation's appeal to the speaker's direction is not supported by the sentence.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 过去 is borderline: “小猫从树下跳过去，坐在我身边。” can be read as the cat jumping over to the speaker's side.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “我先上来拿伞。” has no location cue and may be acceptable in some contexts.

definition: 主人是家里欢迎客人的人。小狗的主人是养它的人。
reviewer_notes: reject 因为核心义项未拆分，补丁无法修正。B 侧的 level_3、level_6、level_7（只/位错误）大体干净，但整体仍需重做。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，却没有对应 block，且 morphological_forms 中有 女主人/男主人，需核对 plan。未生成补丁。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义由两句分别描述两个义项：「家里欢迎客人的人」与「养它的人」。sense_fingerprint「家里招待客人的人；养小动物的人」也合并了二者，违反一义一条。; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: 锚句 variants.A.level_3 用的是「接待客人」义（主人给客人倒茶），而 level_6 的正确句 sentence 3「小猫看见主人回家」用的是「所有者」义。同一义项内出现义项漂移。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 「主人偷走了他的手表」在「接待客人的一方」义下可以成立（作客时主人行窃），并非确实错误。; variants.A.level_1: 以「no_minimal_pairs」放弃，但「住人」(zhù rén) 是真实词，与「主人」仅声调不同，构成可用的最小对立。放弃理由不成立。; core: 与 90304 义项重叠：两者都合并了「接待客人」与「所有者」两个义项，属于重复。

definition: 接待客人的一方；也指财物、动物等的所有者。
reviewer_notes: reject 因为核心义项未拆分。B 侧的 level_3 和 level_7（只/位错误）大体干净，但整体仍需重做。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，却没有对应 block，需核对 plan。未生成补丁。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义「接待客人的一方；也指财物、动物等的所有者」在一个词条内合并了两个义项，违反一义一条。; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: level_6 的正确句 sentence 3「主人把客人送到了门口」用的是「接待客人」义，而 level_3 锚句「房子的主人把钥匙交给了我们」用的是「所有者」义。同一义项内出现义项漂移。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 「主人在场边指导队员」在「所有者」义下可以成立（球队的主人在场边），并非确实错误。; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 解释「搭配：『找到』与『价格』搭配不当」不准确，「找到它的价格」在语法上成立，真正的问题是语境不合。; variants.A.level_1 / variants.B.level_1: 两处都以「no_minimal_pairs」放弃，但「住人」(zhù rén) 是真实词，构成可用的最小对立。; core: 与 90303 义项重叠（两者都合并了「接待客人」与「所有者」）。

definition: 见面时互相问候的常用语。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense. Its level_6 and level_7 sentences are otherwise grammatical. Regenerate only if 90309 is removed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 90309 为同一义项（叹词，见面问候），属重复义项。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: “喂，请问这里有人吗？”本身地道，“喂”可作正确答案，属可辩护的正确干扰项；解释以语域为由也站不住。; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: “学中文，第一个要学的词就是……”未限定时间，“晚上好”同为问候语，不能算明显错误。

definition: 像黄金一样的颜色。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90313. If 90314 is kept instead, the B-level_3 explanations must be rewritten as described above. Its sentences, A-level blocks and B-level_6/7 blocks are otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 90313, the same colour sense of 金色 with overlapping fingerprints. Keeping both teaches one sense twice.; variants.B.level_3.options[0].explanation: Explanations are copied from another document. They refer to "这本书的封面是金色的", but the cloze sentence for this block is sentence 6, "他买了一条金色的鱼。"; variants.B.level_3.options[1..3].explanation: The distractor explanations (夜晚, 雨, 歌声) all refer to 封面 and "是……的", not to the fish sentence. "夜晚的鱼" is also weakly defensible without the time-versus-colour point.

definition: 购买和出售；生意。
reviewer_notes: Not patched because the sense should not exist separately. For the record, if the curator keeps it: A level_3 options 照片 (做照片 is a real job phrase, e.g. a photographer working in the city) and 房子 (做房子 can mean building houses) are both defensibly correct, which breaks the rule against defensibly correct distractors. B level_3 option 工作 ('这种工作会亏钱') is arguable. The other blocks looked sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates 90327. The gloss '购买和出售；生意' matches 90327's '买卖…也指做生意'. Sentences overlap: '这笔买卖赚了不少钱' is a single transaction, which 90327 also covers, and '这家小店的买卖一直很稳' is a business use that 90327's definition also covers. The two senses cannot be taught separately.

definition: 表示明白了原因，对某事不再感到奇怪。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because it duplicates 90341, so the core is redundant. Its exercise blocks are otherwise sound. If the inventory keeps 90342 instead of 90341, the sentence-order issues above must be fixed and the level_6 A/B and level_7 blocks re-checked.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 90341 (明白原因后不再奇怪 is the same as 知道原因后不再奇怪).; core.sentences[2]: 难怪 comes before its reason (难怪他不爱吃辣，他是上海人). Grammatical but weak, and it is in the level_7 correct set [0,1,2].; core.sentences[9]: Result-before-reason structure (难怪我找不到手机，它在包里). Weak as a teaching model and used as the B level_6 correct sentence.; core.sentences[4]: Result-before-reason structure (难怪房间这么热，空调坏了). Grammatical but weak as a model.

definition: 死者留下的财产；也指前人留下的文化成果。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝：核心本身的义项边界有问题。定义包含两个义项，其中财产义与90345重复，句子集也不是单一义项。在决定收窄或并入之前，修补块毫无意义。上述各条问题在最终保留的版本中都需要修复。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把两个义项合在一起：「死者留下的财产」与90345的义项重复，「前人留下的文化成果」则是另一义项。句子集中，第1、4、7、9句是财产义，其余为文化义，因此不符合「每句只用一个义项」的要求。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「这是一本宝贵的遗产。」在文化义下成立（一部珍贵典籍即可视为前人留下的遗产），所谓错误句并不错。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「继承过叔叔的一本遗产」若遗产是一部书，则成立。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 「他完成了父亲的遗产」在文化义下可读作完成父亲未竟的作品，因此并非错误句。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 「他一生都遵守祖父的遗产」属边界句，在文化义下接近可接受。

definition: 难以担当或难以承受。
reviewer_notes: The core is not sense-pinned and overlaps sense 90347. It needs to be regenerated with the 担当 sense only.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition mixes two senses: 难以担当 and 难以承受. Seven of the ten sentences (indices 2, 3, 5–9) use the 承受 sense, which duplicates sense 90347. Only indices 0, 1 and 4 use the 担当 sense. The level_3 and level_6 anchors (indices 3, 6, 9) are all in the 承受 sense, while the A level_6 wrong sentences contrast against the 担当 sense.

definition: 用来买东西的钱。
reviewer_notes: Rejected at core. The sense duplicates 90358, and the anchor sentences are unnatural for 金钱 because they need 钱. All downstream blocks inherit the defect.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense ('用来买东西的钱') is not distinct from sense 90358 ('钱财；货币'). The lexicon has no separate concrete 'spending money' sense of 金钱. Spending cash is just 钱, and 金钱 covers both uses as one 书面 word, so the split is artificial.; core.sentences: Most sentences are unidiomatic. They put the 书面 word 金钱 into everyday 钱 frames: 这点金钱够我们吃饭了, 学生的金钱不多, 他身上只剩下一点金钱, 花很多金钱买书, 买东西要用金钱，不能白拿. Native speakers would say 钱 in all of these. This is a register mismatch and a naturalness failure across the core, which would score 2–3 under the P1 judge.; core.sentences[4].furigana: The furigana field appears on Chinese sentences (sentences 4 and 5). This is a spurious Japanese-only field.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: In 也要用金钱做首饰, 金钱 can be read as coins (金钱 = 铜钱) used decoratively. The sentence is not cleanly wrong.

definition: 撤销是把原来说好的事不要了，取消掉。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable. The level_6 anchor (聚会) and the downstream blocks inherit the defect.
reviewer_issues: core: This sense is really 取消, not 撤销. 撤销 is formal and administrative. 撤销了明天的面试, 撤销了周五的聚会, 撤销了下午的聚餐, 撤销了去旅行的计划 and 撤销了对他的邀请 are unnatural collocations; natives say 取消. The register 中性 is wrong. The Chinese sentences also carry stray furigana fields.

definition: 没出问题或没受伤害；也指没有事情要做。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because its core mixes two senses and duplicates 90369. Only sentences 3, 4 and 7 use the 无事可做 sense. Sentences 0, 1, 2, 5 and 9 use the 没出事 sense. The blocks A level_3, B level_3, B level_6, B level_7 and B synonym_antonym are all built on the 没出事 sense, so the 无事可做 sense has almost no block coverage. definition: 再四是一遍又一遍，说了很多次。

reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90539 (same meaning, same sentence fit). If the operator keeps this ID instead, apply the fixes above. The planner could not be run (no tools); active_levels 2, 4 and 9 have no blocks.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates 90539. 埋葬死者的地方 and 埋葬去世的人的地方 are the same sense, and the sense_fingerprint cannot separate them. Every sentence here also fits 90539.; variants.A.level_1.options[3]: 墓道 (mù dào) differs from 墓地 in both vowel and tone, so it is not a tone-only or minimal-pair distractor.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 爷爷的墓地上刻着他的名字 is a borderline natural reading (a plot marked with a name), so it may be acceptable.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 工人挖好了墓地 is the same borderline usage as in 90539.; variants.A.level_7.error_description: Says 应说“座”, but correct sentence 0 uses 一片 and correct sentence 2 uses 这块. 片 and 块 are acceptable, so the description contradicts the correct set.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 这座墓地是用石头一块块砌成的 with correction 墓室. The explanation says a cemetery cannot be stone-built, but stone-walled cemeteries exist, so the sentence may be acceptable.; variants.B.level_7.error_description: Says 应说“片”, but correct sentence 9 uses 这块墓地. 块 is acceptable.

definition: 明知不应该或会产生某种后果而有意去做。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90541, not for block content; no patches are offered because the core is rejected. The issues above apply only if the owner decides to keep this sense instead, in which case 90541 must be rejected. The 6-sentence block content is otherwise clean (level_6 and level_7 checked).

definition: 庆祝是遇到高兴的事，大家一起笑，一起吃好吃的。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate core. If both senses are intended, rewrite the definition and fingerprint to a distinct sense and revalidate. If the sense is kept, the level_7 A explanation says 「过去完成时」, but Chinese has no tense, so it should describe 完成 or 经历 aspect.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 90544. Both describe 庆祝 as holding a joyful celebration, so one sense is split into two. The definition also opens with the headword ('庆祝是…') and reads colloquially, which is weak for a learner dictionary entry.

definition: 外心是不再一心一意，想着别处的心。
reviewer_notes: The core sense is not genuine. Every exercise built on it teaches a misuse of 外心.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 外心 is attested as 二心 (disloyalty, which is sense 90546) or as the geometry term 'circumcenter'. A 'distracted, mind elsewhere' sense (分心/走神) is not standard. As a result most sentences are unnatural to native speakers: 外心却一直在想周末的旅行, 他的外心已经飞到了别的地方, 开车的时候不能有外心. These should use 心思, 心, or 分心.; core.sentences[2].furigana: A furigana field (pinyin) is present on a zh sentence. It is a stray field.

definition: 军队中的普通成员；也指为正义事业奋斗的人。
reviewer_notes: 拒收。核心存在义项混合，不能只靠补丁修复，应拆分后重新生成。变体的其他检查：A 与 B 的 level_6 错误句全部是量词错误，没有测试练习名称所暗示的义项区分；level_3 的干扰项在语义上基本站得住。拆分后这些练习需要重新设计。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “军队中的普通成员；也指为正义事业奋斗的人”把字面的军人义与比喻义合在一个 sense 中，违反单义项要求。句 0、3、4、6、8 是军人义，句 1、2、5、7、9 是比喻义；军人义与 90547 重复。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹同样并列了两个义项，无法为学习者锁定具体义项。; variants.A.level_1.options[3]: “战书”（shū）与“战士”（shì）的韵母和声调都不同，不是纯声调或单音位的最小对立对，不适合作为听音辨字的干扰项。

definition: 会面，多指正式的见面。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the core is redundant with 90557, not because of the individual blocks. Retire it or merge it into 90557. The remaining issues are listed only so that a retained sense is not copied from this one. The plan's active_levels also include 2 and 4 with no blocks, as in the other documents.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 90557. 会面，多指正式的见面 and 和重要的客人见面谈话 describe the same formal meeting, and every example here works for 90557. The sense split is not pedagogically real, so sense pinning cannot hold.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences: The three wrong sentences are the same as 90557 A level_6 (路上我会见了老同学, 周末我去医院会见生病的奶奶, 他去美国会见了一个月), only reordered. A and B level_1 options and B level_6 wrong sentences are also copied from 90557.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “两国代表昨天会见过一次。” has the same contestable 过-with-a-specific-time error as 90557 B level_7. If this sense is kept, the error is not clearly wrong.; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: “吵” is arguably meaning-compatible with 他们在大使馆正式___，没有记者 (a private quarrel without reporters). It is a risk for the 'no distractor fits' rule, not a clear failure.

definition: 说话人自己所在的国家。
reviewer_notes: reject 的理由：（1）与 90567 释义相同、用法相同，是重复义项；（2）其自身释义“所在”与其句子和解释互相矛盾。应保留 90567，删除本义项。若义项清单确实需要“说话人当前所在的国家”这一区分，应另行设计，句子须符合该释义。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义“说话人自己所在的国家”与句子用法矛盾。句 0“他在外国工作，但很想念本国的家人”和句 6“留学生回到本国后”中，说话人并不在本国，本国指的是母国。句子实际用的是 90567 的义项。; variants.B.level_3.options[1].explanation: 解释称“本国指留学生自己的国家”，这是 90567 的义项，与本核心的“所在”释义相悖。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0].explanation: 解释以“身在法国时要说当地的风俗”为前提，即本国不指说话人所在之地，这与核心释义“说话人自己所在的国家”直接冲突。level_6 的全部 wrong_sentences 解释都有同样问题。

definition: 展示服装等或供艺术创作时描摹的人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90573, which is the surviving sense. The other defects are recorded so they are not lost if the duplicate question is decided the other way.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of 90573. Both define 模特 as the person who displays clothes or is painted or sketched. The pos, semantic_class and fingerprint are effectively identical, so the two senses would produce duplicate items and shared distractors.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: The only error (missing 得 in 做很好) does not involve the target 模特.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 医生 is only contextually odd with 走秀 in sentence 0, not clearly wrong. definition: 将令是将军下的命令。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的理由是义项重复，而非句子质量。若改为保留 90577，则还需修正：(1) variants.B.level_7 的错误句“从来不会改了”，错误在动词后的“了”，不涉及目标词“将令”，且该句勉强可接受，属于边界情况；(2) variants.A.level_7 的“一个将令”，“个”是最通用的量词，“一个命令”是自然说法，母语者可能接受，错误不够明确，建议改用“首”或“把”；(3) variants.B.level_3 的干扰项“旗帜”（将军下的旗帜）属于边界情况；(4) level_1 以 no_minimal_pairs 拒绝：“将领”（jiànglǐng）与目标词只差声调，是真实词语，故拒绝理由仅在凑不齐三个真实干扰项时成立，需用 L1 评审重新核查。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 90578 重复：两者都是“将帅/将军发出的命令”，同一义项被拆成两个学习义项，练习内容会相互污染。

definition: 小小说是特别短的小故事。
reviewer_notes: 若改为保留 90589，还需修正：(1) variants.B.level_7 的错误句“她写了完一篇小小说”，错误在补语“完”的位置，不涉及目标词“小小说”，不符合 level_7 的目标词要求；(2) variants.A.level_3 的干扰项“歌曲”只是弱可辩护（歌词可以按字数计）。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 90590 重复：“特别短的小故事”与“篇幅极短的小说，即微型小说”描述的是同一文体，应合并为一个义项。

definition: 巡逻是边走边看，保护大家平安。

reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates 90602. Both describe patrolling by moving along a route and watching. The guard subject and 保护大家平安 do not make a separate sense, and every sentence here fits 90602's definition.

definition: 计算；谋划；也指计策。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core spans at least three senses (计算/计入, 计较, 计策 as a noun), which a patch cannot repair. Recommended split: 计 (动词, 计算/计入), 计 (动词, 计较), 计 (名词, 计策). Each needs its own document and plan. Overlaps heavily with sense 90605 on the 计算 sense. synonym_antonym_match blocks are declined (no_relation) and left unchanged. reviewer_issues: core.pos and core.definition: The sense mixes 计算/谋划 (verb) with 计策 (noun). definition: 副词，表示出乎意料。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90609. Its sentences and blocks are otherwise mostly sound (level_1 A/B, level_3 A/B, level_6 A/B). Level_7 A 竟竟 is a valid repeated-adverb error. reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 90609: both gloss 竟 as 出乎意料 and the sentence sets test the same surprise use. A learner would see the same sense twice.; core.definition: The gloss 副词，表示出乎意料。 repeats the part-of-speech label as a gloss, so it is not a usable definition.; variants.B.level_7: The error explanation is wrong. 竟就 is the standard order for these adverbs, so 叠用/不能并用 is false. definition: 途径是走到一个地方的路，也是做成一件事的办法。
reviewer_notes: Reject is for the core: the sense is not separable from 90618. Plan active_levels [1,2,3,4,6,7,9] lists 2, 4 and 9, but neither plan.blocks nor the document has blocks for them; the document matches plan.blocks exactly. reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition fuses two senses: the literal road (走到一个地方的路) and the figurative method (做成一件事的办法). Sense 90618 is the figurative method sense, so the two senses overlap and this sense cannot be taught as one sense.; core.sentences: Seven of ten sentences (indices 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9) use the figurative method sense, duplicating 90618's sentence set. Only indices 0, 1 and 7 are literal route uses.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “他的途径很大” is not clearly wrong for the literal sense (a road can be wide), and its explanation (correct word 〈声音〉) has nothing to do with the sentence.

definition: 指不确定的数量；多少；一些。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90627, which is the surviving sense. The content defects above would need patches if this sense were kept.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of 90627. Both gloss 若干 as an indefinite quantity meaning some, with the same pos and class.; variants.B.level_7.error_description: The rule that 若干 must be followed by a measure word is false. The sense's own sentences use bare nouns (过了若干年, 文章里有若干错字), and 90627 uses 若干人 and 若干问题.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 他写了若干信 is at most marginal, not clearly ungrammatical, given that bare nouns are acceptable after 若干.; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: The unpunctuated declarative 请准备多少张白纸 reads as a question. The distractor is borderline rather than clearly wrong.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1], variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: Both wrong sentences are near-copies of the correct sentence 3 (公园里有若干个孩子在玩), which weakens discrimination.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1], variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 现在是若干点 and 我只有若干个妈妈 appear verbatim in the 90627 B level_6 block.

Its explanation (只是有帮助) is weak, so replace it with a clearly wrong sentence. (2) A level_6 wrong sentence 「这本小说对学习英语很必需。」 is weakly wrong (a novel could be required reading), so consider replacing it too. (3) B level_6 wrong sentence 「这篇文章写得很必需。」 is ungrammatical rather than semantically wrong. Acceptable, but weaker than the other wrong sentences. The level_3 an
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates sense 90629 (定义 「一定要有，不可缺少」 vs 「必需是说一定要有，少了不行」; same pos 动词, same semantic_class property, same meaning and sense fingerprint). Two documents for one sense would produce redundant exercises.

definition: 钱的数量。
reviewer_notes: 句子与各块单独看都站得住（如 B 组 level_3“金额少了一百多元”的干扰项都明显不搭），唯一的缺陷是义项重复，不应两个都保留。另外，A 组 level_6 的“这台电脑的金额很贵”同样语病较弱，若该义项被保留，需一并处理。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 sense 90631 属于同一义项（“钱的数量，可多可少”与“钱的数目，有多少钱”无实质区别），属于重复义项，会让学习者同一个词得到两个几乎相同的义项。

definition: 交通上重要的道路；也指重要的道理。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，建议拒收。道路句与 90639 重复；「道理」义的句子需要另建义项。拆分后「道理」义很可能是抽象类（abstract），plan 会改变，需在拆分后运行 PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python scripts/fat_seed_runner.py plan RUN --source reviewed --senses <sid> 并据此增删块。A 的 L3 干扰项「故事」的解释较弱（「交通的故事」在语法上勉强可接受），但因整份文档拒收，未单独修补。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 一个义项合并了两个义：「交通上重要的道路；也指重要的道理」。句 0–7 为道路义，与 90639 完全重复；句 8–9 为「道理」义。这违反了「每句只用一个义项」的核心要求。; variants.B.level_6.correct_sentence_index: B 的 L6 正确句（idx 9「做人的要道」）为「道理」义，而 A 的 L6 正确句（idx 3）为道路义。同一义项内两个变体的锁定义不一致。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「这个要道通往城东，车很多」：「个」用于地点名词在口语中常见（如「这个路口」），母语者可能接受，错误不清晰。

definition: 请求回答问题时的客套话。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the sense is not distinct from 90643, not because its sentences are bad. Option blocks were otherwise sound: the wrong sentences are wrong for the stated reasons and the distractors are clearly wrong. Plan check: active_levels 2, 4 and 9 have no blocks. I had no tools, so I could not re-run the runner.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Sense duplicates 90643. 「请求回答问题时的客套话」 describes the same polite opener used before asking, and all ten sentences satisfy 90643's definition 「想问别人一件事时，先说的有礼貌的话」. The venue list in the fingerprint (服务、会议、采访) is a context, not a different meaning, so the sense split is not real.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「请问问，还有其他问题吗？」 is not a clear error. 问问 can take an object (请问问大家…), so the 'wrong' label is doubtful.

definition: 不但是说，不只是这样，还有别的。
reviewer_notes: 作为重复 sense 拒收，故不附补丁。若词典保留本 sense，请应用上述 issue 中的修正。其余检查：plan 的 blocks 与文档一致（A 的 level_3 为 index 0，level_6 为 index 3，level_7 为 [0,1,2]；B 的 level_3 为 index 6，level_6 为 index 9，level_7 为 [6,7,9]）。level_6 的错句与 level_7 的错误均成立。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 90654 实为同一义项：两者都表示递进（不但…还/而且），同一义项被拆成两个 sense_id，学习者无法区分。; variants.A.level_1.options[4]: “不难”(bù nán) 与 bú dàn 只有“不”字相同，声母、韵母、声调均不同，听感不会混淆，不是有效干扰项。; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: “可是”可作强调副词（如“小王可是会英语”），填入 sentence 6 后语义可以成立，构成第二个正确答案。

definition: 什么样是问一个东西是怎样的。
reviewer_notes: Also borderline: A level_6 wrong[1] “这次考试的分数是什么样的？” and B level_6 wrong[0] “她的体重是什么样的？” are weak errors. A level_7 incorrect “这间屋子现在什么样的了？” is a debatable 的 error. Plan active_levels lists 2 with no block; the document matches plan.blocks.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 90658: same meaning (asking what something is like), same sentence pattern, and a less precise definition (“什么样是问一个东西是怎样的”). Two senses for one meaning will produce duplicate exercises.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “她今天的生日是什么样的？” is defensibly acceptable (it asks what the birthday was like), so it is not a clean wrong sentence.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “这次出差的费用是什么样的？” reads as a meaningful question (what kind of expenses), so the error is weak.

definition: 副词，用于否定句，表示不会重复或继续。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90659, not for bad content. The level_6 and level_7 sentences are sound and can be reused in the merged sense. The plan lists active_levels 2 and has no level_2 block. I had no tools, so I could not re-run the runner.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Sense duplicates 90659. Both gloss 再也 as 'not again from now on'. The example 他搬到国外，再也没见过老朋友 has the same pattern as 90659's 她再也没有给我打过电话. 'Event ended and cannot recur' versus 'resolved not to recur' is not a real dictionary-level sense split. The definition also begins with the metalabel 副词，, which should not appear in a learner gloss.; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: 「那条河干了，总是没有鱼了。」 reads naturally as 'there were always no fish', which is close to 再也. The distractor 总是 is defensible in the anchor sentence.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 「他走了，忽然没有回来。」 is grammatical and can be read as 'suddenly did not come back', so 忽然 is a weak distractor.

definition: 副词性短语，表示无论如何程度加深，结果也不变。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90663. Merge any useful sentences into 90663 instead. No patches were written, so the defects above are only recorded.
