reviewer_notes: 在本义项自身的变体内容中，我逐块核查，未发现其他缺陷。驳回的理由仅是重复。句子“他向公安咨询了贷款的事。”同时出现在 93879 的 B level_6 中。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义“负责维护社会治安的机关或其工作人员”与 93879 的“抓坏人、保护大家平安的人，也指他们的机关”含义相同。两个义项教的是同一个意思，sense_fingerprint 也无法将二者区分。

definition: 小学之后的第一阶段中学，一般为三年。
reviewer_notes: 核心问题是与 93883 的义项重复，因此判为 reject。其余内容（例句、A level_3、A/B level_6、A/B level_7、B level_3）基本无误，但不需要修改，因为整个 sense 不保留。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 93883 义项相同（“小学之后的第一阶段中学，一般为三年”与“小学以后上的学校，要上三年”），同一义项被拆成两个 sense，学习者会遇到答案相同却分属两个义项的练习。; variants.A.level_1.options[2]: （若保留时需修）击中（jī zhòng）与初中（chū zhōng）首音节的声母和韵母都不同，不是最小对立对，听感上不构成混淆。

definition: 四面围住。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate core. The sentences and option blocks are otherwise well formed, so this is a sense-inventory decision, not a content failure. If the team wants a separate person-or-object sense, it needs a different definition and different sentences, and should be reviewed as a new sense. No patches are offered because the core itself is the problem.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The sense 四面围住 / 从四周把人或物围起来 is the same meaning as 93891 (从各个方向把一个地方围住). Every sentence here is the same sense as 93891's sentences. The two senses cannot be taught separately, and the duplication makes the distractor sets collide across lessons.; variants.B.level_7.error_description: Same overbroad claim as 93891: says 着 and 了 cannot co-occur after 包围.; core.morphological_forms[0]: 包圍 is a script variant (繁体), not a morphological form.

definition: 社会上各个方面、各个行业的人士。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 93897. Patches are withheld per the reject rule. If the inventory keeps this sense instead, the three compound sentences and the variant B level_3 anchor must be fixed first.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Redundant with 93897: same sense (社会上各个行业的人) with near-identical fingerprint.; core.sentences[1].text: Uses 各界 inside the listed compound 各界人士.; core.sentences[4].text: Uses 各界 inside the listed compound 社会各界.; core.sentences[6].text: Uses 各界 inside 各界人士. The variant B level_3 cloze anchor would blank only the first half of the compound.

definition: 用手指拨动或敲击，使发出声音；也指使物体跳起。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项混杂了两个义项：用手指拨弹/敲击发声，以及物体借弹力跳起（反弹）。例句也混用两者：0、2、3、5、7、8 句是不及物的反弹义，1、4、9 句是手指弹击义。第 6 句（弹琴弦）还与 93915 的乐器义重复。B 组 level_3 正是用这个乐器句做锚句，level_6 的错误句也在两个义项之间来回。应拆分为“手指弹击”和“反弹”两个独立义项后重新生成。另外，zh 文档中的 furigana 字段填的是拼音，不应出现，需清理。

definition: 使物体着火或受热。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的原因仅为重复，不因内容有误。作为参考，其题块在检查中未发现明显错误：level_1 干扰项为真实字且声调或韵母有别；level_3 和 level_7 的干扰项在句中不成立；level_6 的正确句编号 3 与 9 正确。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 sense 93931 完全重叠（使物体着火或受热），同一义项被拆成两条。

definition: 眼睛。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的原因仅为重复且释义无区分度，不因题块内容有误。作为参考，其题块在检查中未发现明显错误：level_1 的干扰项为真实字且声调或韵母有别；level_3 的干扰项在句中不成立；level_6 的错误句为量词错误，正确句编号 3 与 9 正确；level_7 的正确句 [0,1,2] 与 [6,7,9] 正确。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义“眼睛。”是循环定义，sense_fingerprint“眼睛”也只是重复词目，无法区分义项。与 sense 93939 的含义相同，属于重复条目。

definition: 可以看出；显得（多用于否定句，如“不见得”）。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable, so all downstream blocks (level_3, level_6, level_7) inherit the ungrammatical affirmative pattern. The level_7 'corrected' sentences are themselves unidiomatic.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: In modern Chinese, 见得 is used only in negative or interrogative forms (不见得, 未见得, 怎么见得). Every one of the 10 sentences uses bare affirmative 见得 (e.g. 从他的脸色见得他很累), which a native speaker would reject in favor of 可见 or 看得出. The sense_fingerprint itself models this unidiomatic usage. Every sentence also carries a bogus furigana field with the wrong reading jiàndé.

definition: 进而是做完了一件事，接着再往下做。
reviewer_notes: 作为独立 sense 不可用，因为它与 93962 重复。这里不做修补，建议只保留 93962。
reviewer_issues: core: 本 sense 与 93962 实为同一义项：两者都描述“先……，进而……”的递进接续用法，定义措辞仅有细微差别；“进而”在词典中只有一个义项（在前一步基础上进一步）。保留两个 sense 会重复教学同一用法。

definition: 太；超过了适当的限度。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, so no patches. If the team keeps this sense instead of 93963, also check B level_6 wrong_sentences[2] (我过于谢谢你了), which is arguably acceptable, and the A level_3 distractor 极其, which fits as 93963's does.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 93963. Both describe 过于 as an adverb meaning excess ('太' / '比应该的多太多'), and the fingerprints overlap. The learner would get two identical senses.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 颇 fits “这个办法___冒险，我们不能用” grammatically and in meaning. Its register objection is weak, so it is defensibly correct.

definition: 许多人聚集在一起开会或活动。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate. If it were kept, it would also need: (1) a synonym_antonym_match block in A and B instead of the decline, since 解散 is the antonym; (2) a B level_1 block, because minimal pairs exist (机会 and similar).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 93971. Both glosses say many people gather to do something together, and the fingerprints differ only in wording. Two senses with one meaning would give learners redundant items.

definition: 青春是人年轻的那些年，身体有劲，心里有梦想。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only as a duplicate. Its blocks are otherwise sound: the L3 distractors don't fit the blank, the L6 wrong sentences are wrong for the stated reasons, and each L7 has exactly one error.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 93974 (人的青年时期；年轻的时光). Two senses for one meaning would teach the same word twice. The definition also builds in 身体有劲、心里有梦想, which is a connotation rather than the sense itself.

definition: 欠别人的钱或东西，需要偿还的义务。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so no patches. For the record, the block-level defects would not change the verdict. B level_3's 银行 distractor fits 减少银行 plausibly as a policy goal, and B synonym_antonym_match's 财富 is risky for the same reason as 资产 in 93987.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 93987 (owed money or goods that must be repaid). The fingerprint and sentence set overlap heavily, so the learner would be taught one sense twice.

definition: 凡是；所有的。表示在一定范围内无例外。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 93991. Its core cannot be repaired by patch. If the team keeps this sense instead of 93991, apply the wrong_sentences[0] fix above.
reviewer_issues: core: 与 93991 实为同一义项（凡＝所有、无例外的副词）。定义、指纹和例句模式几乎相同，两个义项的 L1、L3 和 L6 练习形式也重复，学习者无法区分这两个义项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “凡不会写的字，才请先问老师”同样是“凡…才…”限定句式，母语者可以读通，所写理由“意思不通”不成立。

definition: 出身是一个人小时候的家庭，或者他以前做过什么。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is not a single sense, so patching would mean replacing most sentences and rebuilding every block. The block content is internally consistent. Distractors are valid and the level_6 and level_7 errors are single and clear, so the blocks can be reused when the occupational sense is regenerated.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses: family background (工人家庭, 农村出身) and previous occupation (教师出身, 军人出身). Most sentences use the occupational reading, so single-sense pinning fails. The family-background sentences also duplicate sense 93994.

definition: 多党是有很多个党，不止一个。
reviewer_notes: 作为重复义项，本条目应被拒绝。应保留 94010，不要两者都保留。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 94010 为同一义项：sense_fingerprint 都是“有多个政党”，定义也几乎相同。同一词目下的重复义项会让学习者重复学习同一用法。; core.sentences[6]: “听说那个国家以前是多党，后来变成了一党”以谓语形式使用“多党”，与 94010 中“非谓形容词须带“的””的规则相矛盾。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “两国进行了多党会谈”不是明显错误，“多党会谈”本身是常见说法（指多个政党参与的会谈）。; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: “无党国家”是可以成立的说法，解释“无党不能直接修饰国家”不成立。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 句 6 中“以前是无党，后来变成了一党”是连贯的前后变化叙述，“无党”可以作为合理答案。

definition: 表明家族的字，写在名字前面。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only as a duplicate. Otherwise the content is clean: L1 distractors are tone or final confusables, L3 cloze options each fail the blank, L6 wrong sentences fail for the annotated reason, and L7 errors are valid. Borderline but kept: B level_7 '她姓很少见' fails because of the missing 的, but it can be read with 姓 as a verb, so a judge may rate it 4.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 94021: 姓 as the family surname written before the given name. Two senses for one meaning duplicates the exercises and repeats the same content to the learner.

definition: 多山的地区。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only as a duplicate. If the pipeline keeps 94024 instead of 94023, these defects need fixing: (a) B level_1 is declined with no_minimal_pairs, but the same target has minimal pairs in A (删去, 商区, 三区). (b) A level_1 correct-option explanation contains meta-language ('是这里要辨认的词'). (c) synonym_antonym_match blocks in A and B are declined but are not in the plan, so they should be removed. Otherwise the sentences and the L3, L6 and L7 blocks are valid. Borderline: B level_7 '这一带是一座山区' relies on 座 being wrong for 山区, which a judge may rate 4 rather than 5.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 94023: 山区 as a mountainous area. Two senses for one meaning duplicates the exercises.

definition: 在短时间内容易赚到的钱。
reviewer_notes: 因与 94031 重复而拒收。上列其它问题仅在保留本义项时才需要处理。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94031 为同一义项（“短时间内容易赚到的钱”），属重复义项。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “银行的快钱每个月都会入账”的解释有误：利息可以按月入账。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “一个快钱”的量词边缘可接受，不是明确错误。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “花了一笔快钱”可以接受（“快钱快花”），不是明确错误。

definition: 检察院是国家里管查案和告诉法院的地方。
reviewer_notes: 句子本身基本干净，但整个义项与 94048 重复，应整体拒绝。若保留，需先合并义项，再修复 B 组的量词与干扰项问题。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94048 指同一机构、同一职能（查案并移交或提起公诉），属于重复义项，不是独立义项。; core.definition: “告诉法院”是误译，应为“移交法院”，义项描述不准确。; variants.B.level_7: 错误在“了”的位置，不涉及目标词“检察院”，不符合 level_7 要求。; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: “衙门”可以替换目标词且语义可通（旧式官府可以调查公司事务），仅凭语域排除，属于可辩护的正确答案。

definition: 登是一步一步向高处走上去。
reviewer_notes: 因与 94060 重复而拒收。其余句子与各块未发现明确缺陷。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94060 为同一义项（“由低处走到高处；攀登”），属重复义项。

definition: 补是把破了或少了的地方弄好，让它变完整。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so no patches. If upstream keeps 94075 instead, fix these first: sentences[5] (口红补妆) is touch-up makeup, which drifts from the repair/completion sense; its furigana reads 掉色 as diào sè, though the standard reading is diàoshǎi (please verify). sentences[3] (补一点水) is topping up, which is borderline and overlaps 94076. The synonym_antonym decline (no_relation) is questionable, since 弄破/弄坏 can serve as the antonym in the repair sense. The active_levels list includes 2, 4 and 9, but the plan blocks do not, so the plan needs regenerating after any change.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 'Restore a broken or missing part to make it whole' covers the same ground as 94076 ('repair broken things or add missing parts'). Sentences 2 and 6 are 'add a missing part', which is exactly 94076's definition. Two senses teach the same meaning twice.

definition: 过道是房子里或车里，供人走过去的窄路。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 94086, so no patches. If upstream keeps 94085 instead: level_1 is declined as no_minimal_pairs, which is questionable because 国道 (guó dào) is a real tone-only pair. It is the only usable distractor, though, so the decline stands unless two more real distractors are found. level_3 has a unique fit in both variants. level_6 and level_7 errors are clean (the 量词 error 只 for 条 is valid). The active_levels list includes 2, 4 and 9 with no matching blocks, so regenerate the plan.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 「房子里或车里供人走的窄路」is fully contained in 94086's 「房屋、车厢或剧场内供人行走的狭窄通路」. Both teach 过道 as an indoor or vehicle aisle.

definition: 开设是把店、班或课办起来。
reviewer_notes: Apart from the duplication, the sentences and blocks are mostly sound. A minor weakness is that 修理 in variants.A.level_3 can read as 'renovate a shop', but the sense is being rejected, so no patch is needed. The rejection is for the duplicate sense only.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94090. Both define 开设 as the same 'set up' meaning and both use 店铺 and 课程 as examples. 94090's definition is broader (店铺、课程、账户等), and every usage here falls within it.

definition: 副词，表示过去曾有过一次或一段时间。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for content errors. For the record, if it were retained: variants.A.level_3 option 老是 is defensible in 去年冬天，我老是想回老家工作 (reads naturally as repeated wanting), so it fails the one-correct rule; replace it, for example with 永远, which conflicts with the bounded time. Variant B level_3 option 总是 is borderline in 因为下雨，路总是不能走 (habitual reading), so replace it. Variant A level_1 一代 and 一对 and variant B level_1 一道 are rhyme-only, not minimal pairs. Level_6 and level_7 in both variants are otherwise clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Sense 94094 duplicates sense 94093: same POS (副词), same semantic class, and the same meaning (past occurrence, no longer the case). The word would be taught twice with overlapping sentence types and near-identical distractor sets. This sense has no separate teachable meaning.

definition: 在中国，指各级国家行政机关，负责管理本地区的公共事务。
reviewer_notes: 核心重复，不是块级问题。若流程必须保留两个义项，需先由人工定义真正的区别再重写。块级检查（L3 干扰项、L6 解释、L7 唯一错误）若单独看均通过。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 94101 指称相同（各级国家行政机关，负责本地区公共事务），释义与 sense_fingerprint 实质重复。两个义项的例句可以互换，学习者会把同一个义项学两遍。

definition: 出站是从火车站或车站里走出来。
reviewer_notes: Individual blocks are clean: 进站 is a valid antonym, and each level_7 has one error that involves 出站. The rejection is for the duplicate sense only.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94108. Its definition 离开车站，或列车驶出车站 already covers a person leaving a station, and all ten sentences here are person exits.

definition: 同一年；也指同一年出生或同一年考中的人。
reviewer_notes: The core sense is archaic and is misapplied to modern sentences. All sentences are generated, not mined.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The noun sense 'a person born or passing the exam in the same year' is archaic (科举同年). Modern '我和他同年' is a predicative 'born in the same year', not a person noun. Sentences such as '小李是我的同年' and '是同年' sound unnatural in modern Chinese, where speakers say 同龄人 or 同岁. The core does not match the 中性 register or the learner tiers.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: '我和他同乡。' is fully correct, and 同月 is also plausible.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: This sentence uses the temporal sense (94121), not this sense. The same problem appears in B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2].

definition: 请别人代为办理或负责某事。
reviewer_notes: 与 94133 为同一义项（“请人替自己办事”），两者的 fingerprint 与例句均可互换，无法在教学上区分，应合并或退役，保留 94133。本文件的其它问题仅供参考，不做修补。
reviewer_issues: variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “我想委托老师解答一个问题”在正式语境中可以成立（如委托专家解答），不是明确错误。; variants.B.level_6.correct_sentence_index: 正确句“妈妈委托老师多关心我”里，“关心”不是典型的可委托事务，作为正确范例偏弱。; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: “逮捕”的解释把问题归因于“我没有权力”，实际问题是“逮捕律师”本身荒谬，解释不够准确。

definition: 方言，指富家子弟、老板的年轻儿子。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate. If it were kept, A level_6 wrong sentence 1 (老板的一只小开) has the same classifier defect fixed in 94137, and that would need patching too.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94137. Both gloss 小开 as a young son of a rich family. The 方言 label and the 老板 mention do not give a learner a distinct sense, so the items would repeat the same meaning.

definition: 房子；房间。
reviewer_notes: 与 94139 为同一义项（房子或房间），定义与 fingerprint 基本重复，应退役，保留 94139。上面列出的问题仅供参考，不做修补。
reviewer_issues: variants.A.level_3.options[2]: “他把行李搬进海里了”语法通顺，可以指把行李搬进海里；解释“人不能把行李搬进去”不属实，干扰项并不荒谬。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “妹妹在屋画画”是口语中省略“里”的说法，不是明确错误；解释中的“通常”也说明错误并不确定。

definition: 意志是心里想把一件事做成的力量。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on the core, so no patches. Block-level checks were spot-run and are not the reason for rejection: L1 tonal distractors are valid, L3 has one correct option, L6 and L7 wrong sentences are wrong for their stated reasons, and the synonym_antonym decline is permitted. Nothing here should ship as a separate sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates sense 94150 (为达到目的而自觉努力、克服困难的心理力量). 「心里想把一件事做成的力量」 describes the same meaning, and its sentences, sense_fingerprint and L6/L7 distractor patterns overlap heavily. The two senses cannot be taught as distinct, and a learner cannot tell them apart.

definition: 供旅客住宿的营业性场所，规模一般较小。
reviewer_notes: reject 的原因是重复义项，而非句子质量。与 94163 的句子高度重复（如“他在海边开了一家旅馆”与“他每天坐旅馆上班”等）。如果运营方选择合并，应把 94164 的 B 组 level_3 与 level_7 中仍有价值的句子迁入 94163 并重新审核。若保留，除上述修改外，还需重新生成 plan。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94163 实为同一义项（供旅客住宿的营业场所）。“规模一般较小”不构成可教的区分：两个义项的 sense_fingerprint、句子、干扰项都无法把它们区分开，学习者无法从语境判断锁定的是哪一个义项，违反义项锁定。; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: A组 level_3 的锚句“这家小旅馆只有十个房间”没有过夜语境。饭馆可以设包间，因此“饭馆”并非明确错误，解释“不设客房”不成立。; core.sentences[0]: 同上：锚句未限定用途，银行、饭馆、书店都可以拥有房间，句子无法锁定住宿义。

definition: 兰花；多年生草本植物，花香而美。
reviewer_notes: 作为重复义项拒绝，无需补丁。若策展人仍保留，则 B 层6 错误句 0（“他每天喝兰”，〈茶〉）存在与 94199 相同的“兰不能喝”虚假解释，需同样修正；其余块未发现问题。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94199 指同一参照物（兰花／兰这种植物），所有例句也都指同一植物，义项无法区分，属重复义项。

definition: 角是两条线碰在一起的地方，也是牛头上长出来的硬东西。
reviewer_notes: Reject: the core covers two senses and the sentences mix them, so a single-sense exercise cannot be built by patching. 94204 defines the same two senses, so 94203 and 94204 duplicate each other. Re-split into one corner-sense and one horn-sense document, then review again. Level_1 options (小, 巧, 减, 叫) are otherwise valid tone and initial confusions. No plan run is needed for a rejected document.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss fuses two senses, corner ('两条线碰在一起的地方') and animal horn ('牛头上长出来的硬东西'), joined by 也是. The sense is not pinned.; core.sense_fingerprint: The fingerprint lists both senses (物体的角；牛羊头上的角), so disambiguation is impossible.; core.sentences[2], core.sentences[4], core.sentences[5], core.sentences[8]: Horn-sense sentences (牛头上有两个角 / 鹿的角又长又硬 / 那只羊的角弯弯的 / 小孩摸了摸牛的角) are mixed with corner-sense sentences in one document.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 隅 is a literary near-synonym of 角 in the corner sense, so it is not a clean distractor.

definition: 物体两边相交的地方；某些动物头上长的硬而尖的东西。
reviewer_notes: Reject for the same core reason as 94203. The two documents duplicate each other, so both should be replaced by one corner-sense and one horn-sense document. Level_6 A wrong sentence 他在超市买了一角牛奶 is a valid homograph distractor (currency 角) and can be kept in a re-split. No plan run is needed for a rejected document.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss joins two senses, 物体两边相交的地方 and 某些动物头上长的硬而尖的东西, with ；. The sense is not pinned.; core.sense_fingerprint: The fingerprint lists both senses (物体两边相交处；动物头上的硬角).; core.sentences[2], core.sentences[6], core.sentences[8]: Horn-sense sentences (那头牛的角很大 / 山羊的角长得很长 / 这只鹿的角还没有长大) are mixed with corner-sense sentences.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 隅 is a literary near-synonym of 角 in the corner sense, so it is not a clean distractor.

definition: 证书是一张纸，上面写着你做到了某件事。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for quality. The 证书 senses overlap heavily. Keep 94208, which covers qualifications, achievements and identity and includes the issuing body. If you keep 94207 instead, apply the fixes above and reconcile the 营业证书 sentence with 94208. The level_1 block is well formed (variant A distractors 整数, 正数, 证实 are real tone-confusion words).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94208. Both gloss 证书 as an official paper certifying an achievement or qualification, and 94207's sentences fit 94208's gloss. 94208 is the broader, dictionary-accurate sense. The two senses also contradict each other: variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2] calls 营业证书 wrong here, but it fits 94208's definition (a qualification issued by a 机关).; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 我想给朋友看我的雨伞 is grammatical and plausible (showing a new umbrella), so the distractor 雨伞 is defensibly correct in the anchor sentence.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 出国前要先办好证书 is defensible: language or study certificates are routinely needed before going abroad, so the 'wrong' sentence can be read as correct.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 忘了带证书，没法进去 can be read as acceptable where a certificate is required to enter an event or training.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 他带着证书去银行存钱 is wrong, but the explanation is thin. 存单 is a deposit receipt, and a learner could reasonably read 证书 as referring to one.

definition: 开幕是一场大活动或表演开始了。
reviewer_notes: 各变体题目本身大体可用（A/B 的 level_3、level_6、level_7、synonym_antonym_match 均成立），但因义项重复，整体不保留。若人工决定保留 94213 而删除 94214，则需修复 B level_3 的“开园”干扰项（同 94214 的问题）。计划的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但 blocks 中没有对应题型，请确认是否为预期。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 94214 为同一义项的重复。“大型活动或表演开始”与“会议、展览、演出等活动正式开始”所指相同，例句类型也高度重叠（演出、运动会、展览、电影节、音乐会等）。两个义项会让学习者在两处学到同一个词义。; core.definition: “开幕是一场大活动或表演开始了。”以词条自身开头，并夹带“了”，不是合格的释义。

definition: 暗中策划的、危害别人的坏计划。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 94215, not for an option-level defect. Option checks, in case the sense is kept: all L3 distractors (笑声/阳光/雨; 微笑/身材/旋律) fail on sense or collocation. L6 correct index 3 and the wrong sentences are sound. The L7 incorrect sentence (stray 了 after 阴谋) has one error and the corrected sentence is grammatical. B level_6 wrong sentence index 1 (「他们阴谋要照顾生病的老人」) uses 阴谋 as a verb, the same concern as 94215. The synonym_antonym_match decline carries the same 阳谋 caveat as 94215.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94215. Same POS (名词), semantic class (abstract), register (中性) and meaning (暗中/偷偷策划的、危害/要害别人的坏计划). The two senses cannot be told apart by sense_fingerprint or by sentences, so a learner would get the same answers under either.; core.sense_fingerprint: The fingerprint says 「会危害别人或集体」 but the definition says only 「危害别人」. The two descriptions disagree.

definition: 首相是一个国家里管事最大的官。
reviewer_notes: A 与 B 的 level_3、level_6、level_7 在首相的语义框架内本身基本成立（如 A level_6 的“美国首相”“广东首相”“教育部首相”错误均有依据）。level_1 的 declined 合理，因为“手相”与“首相”同音同调，没有可用的最小对立对。sentence 8 是唯一带 furigana 的句子，其余句子没有，属不一致。计划中的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但无对应 blocks。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “一个国家里职位最高的政府官员”会把总统制国家的元首兼政府首脑也算作首相，与本义项自身的例句矛盾。例句“首相和总统有什么不一样？”预设二者不同；变体 A level_6 的干扰句“美国首相明天会见记者”又说美国不叫首相。; core: 与 94224（内阁制国家内阁的最高首长）指称同一类人，属于重复义项。; variants.B.synonym_antonym_match: 该块整体从“开幕”复制而来（正确项“闭幕”，干扰项研究、取消、等待），与“首相”无关。计划中也未要求此题型。

definition: 因出乎意料而感到奇怪、吃惊。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 94225, not for quality. If you want to keep both, give them distinct glosses; otherwise keep 94225 and carry over the sentence-level fixes listed above. The level_3 options and the level_7 corrections in both variants are otherwise correct. The B level_6 wrong sentence 我每次考前都认真复习… is also used in 94225's B level_6 list, so the same weak sentence appears in both documents.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94225. 因出乎意料而感到奇怪、吃惊 and 遇到想不到的事，吃了一惊 are the same sense, and the two sense_fingerprints overlap almost completely. Two senses with one meaning make the distractor checks unreliable, since a distractor that is correct for one can be treated as wrong for the other.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 我惊讶地决定明天去超市买菜 is marked wrong because a self-made decision cannot be a 惊讶 event. That reason is inaccurate, since 惊讶 can describe self-directed surprise (我惊讶地发现自己…). The sentence is wrong only because a planned decision is not unexpected.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 我每次考前都认真复习，考完后我惊讶地看着自己的高分 is borderline. A high score after preparing can still surprise someone, so the sentence is not clearly wrong.

definition: 三次是做了三回。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for sentence quality. Plan blocks match the document. If the inventory deliberately keeps both senses, this document still needs these fixes. variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0] ('他三次毕业于北大') is defensible, since one can earn a bachelor's, master's and doctorate from the same university. variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0] ('这座桥三次建成') is defensible, since a bridge can be rebuilt several times. The variants.A.level_7 error is the aspect marker 着 rather than 三次 itself, so it is only weakly tied to the target and should be redone.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as 94230 (three occurrences or three repetitions of an action). The two sense_fingerprints ('某事发生或做了三回的次数' vs '同一动作重复进行三遍') describe one sense, so one headword is split into two indistinguishable exercise sets. The definition '三次是做了三回' is also circular.

definition: 副词，表示不超出某个范围，只是。
reviewer_notes: 判为reject，原因是义项重复而非内容有误：94233已覆盖相同的意义，且定义更清晰。若决定保留本义项，则需同时修正以下问题：B的level_3干扰项“一共”（与94233相同的问题）、B的level_7中的“只不外是”（语义重复），以及为避免两个义项混淆而需修改定义。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与94233（同为“不超出范围，只是”的副词用法）属于重复义项。定义开头的“副词，”也是多余的词性标注。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹与94233几乎相同，同样以词性标注开头，无法区分两个义项。

definition: 比某个标准、数量或位置低。
reviewer_notes: Core is unusable as a separate sense, so no block-level patches are offered. For the record, several wrong sentences are copied from 94235 (他低于我三岁, 这件衣服低于那件好看, 我们决定低于价格, 他低于头看书), and the B level_7 corrected sentence repeats the pattern used in 94235. If the merge is rejected, these copies need varying and the definition must be narrowed to a benchmark-only sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94235. The definition 比某个标准、数量或位置低 covers 94235's 比某个数目少 and 比某个地方矮, and the sentences (成绩低于要求, 工资低于平均水平, 排名低于第十名) use the same benchmark meaning. Two senses with no separable meaning will produce identical answers in every block.

definition: 由许多乐器演奏者组成的演出团体。
reviewer_notes: 判定为 reject，原因是义项重复（见上条），不是因为其他块有缺陷，因此没有给出补丁。如果日后重建本义项，需同时修正两处注音（读音应为 yuè，不是 lè）。另外，level_7 B 的错因“乐团本身是集体名词，不能再加们”同样过宽，应改为“这个”与“们”的单复数矛盾（与 94281 B 的修改相同）。level_1 A/B 都已声明 no_minimal_pairs，两个变体一致。level_3、level_6、level_7 的其它内容检查无误。
reviewer_issues: core.sentences[1].furigana: 注音错误：“乐团”的“乐”读作 lè，正确读音应为 yuè，与 core.pronunciation（yuè tuán）不符。; core.sentences[8].furigana: 注音错误：同上，“乐团”的“乐”误读作 lè。; core: 义项与 94281 几乎重复：定义“由许多乐器演奏者组成的演出团体”与 94281 的“很多人一起用乐器演奏音乐的队伍”指同一事物。两者的区别只在于是否对外演出，学习者无法据语境区分，义项锁定会失效。

definition: 研究并撰写历史的学者。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for its own content. Other defects, for the record: level_3 B distractors 小偷 and 乞丐 are weakly defensible in 这位历史家得过很大的奖 (a beggar can win a lottery prize), so that block would need replacing if the sense were kept.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 94283 ('研究和写过去发生的事的人'). Two senses teach one meaning, so this sense is redundant and not usable as a separate lesson.

definition: 港口是船开来停靠，装东西、下人的地方。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for sentence quality. If the inventory keeps this sense, variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0..2] must be replaced. Each of the three uses 港口 in a computer or device 'interface' sense (电脑后面的港口, 打印机的港口, 插U盘). That sense is not standard for 港口, and the explanations present it as a real meaning of the word, which teaches a false sense. Plan blocks match the document.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 94290 (boats docking, loading and unloading at a port). The fingerprints '船停靠、上下人和东西的地方' and '海边江边供船舶停靠和装卸货物的设施' describe one meaning, so this is a duplicate split.

definition: 熟是吃的东西做好了，可以吃；也说很了解，不陌生。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable because it pins two senses at once. Smaller defects should be fixed on regeneration. A level_6 wrong[1] ('已经很熟了，说话很稳重') tests 成熟, a lexical confusion rather than a misuse of this sense. A level_7 uses doubled 了, which is a trivial error.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two distinct senses: 'cooked/ready to eat' and 'familiar/well acquainted'. The sentences split across both. Sentences 0, 1, 3, 5 and 8 are 'cooked'; 2, 4, 6, 7 and 9 are 'familiar'. This breaks the one-sense rule, and every block inherits the problem. For example, A level_3 tests 'cooked' while A synonym_antonym_match pairs 生 only with the cooked reading, and B tests 'familiar'.; core: This document is essentially a duplicate of sense 94292, which has the same merged definition.

definition: 食物煮到可吃的程度；对人或事物很了解。
reviewer_notes: This is a duplicate of 94291 with the same merged definition. Reject both and re-split by sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same merged-sense defect as 94291: the definition covers both 'food cooked' and 'familiar with'. Sentences 0, 1, 2, 6 and 8 are 'cooked'; 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 are 'familiar'. The pinned sense is not unique.; core.sentences[2].furigana: A stray 'furigana' field holds pinyin. Furigana does not apply to zh. Sentence 7 has the same problem.; variants.A.level_7: The error description ('熟作补语时要用得连接') is misleading. The resultative 煮熟 is fine without 得, so only the 很 phrase requires 得.

definition: 亲笔写上自己的名字。
reviewer_notes: The core is redundant, so no patch can fix it. If the inventory wants a separate autograph sense, that needs a new definition and a new sentence set. Sentence 5 (这件事要本人亲自签名) is formal signing, not autograph, and would conflict with such a split.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94307. Both gloss 签名 as writing one's own name by hand, the fingerprint does not separate them, and every sentence fits 94307's sense. Two identical senses split review and teach nothing.

definition: 最高；高到极点。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only because the sense duplicates 94315. The remaining content reads clean (level_3 options, level_6 and level_7 errors), but none of it is worth keeping as a separate sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The meaning (最高、高到极点) is the same as sense 94315. 至高 has only this one sense, so the two rows would produce duplicate exercises.

definition: 副词，表示偶然、有时。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is a duplicate of 94331, not a separate learning target. Independently of the rejection, variants.A.level_3 (sentence 0) has two defensible answers: 忽然 and 猛地 both fit 大海很平静，___有海鸟飞过 (大海很平静，忽然有海鸟飞过 is natural), so the cloze is not valid as written. The sentences themselves are otherwise natural. No mined sentences. Declined blocks were not touched.
reviewer_issues: core: This sense duplicates sense 94331: same lemma, same part of speech (副词), same semantic class, same register, same meaning (偶尔/有时), and the same sentence construction. Two senses with no contrast make the answers and distractors ambiguous across senses.

definition: 中期是一段时间里，中间的那一段。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate sense with a weak, unnatural sentence core.
reviewer_issues: core: This sense duplicates sense 94342: both define 中期 as the middle stage of a period. The level_1 blocks are identical across the two senses.; core.sentences: Many sentences are unnatural: 故事的中期, 这本书的中期, 学期开始、中期和结束, 工作做到中期，大家一起吃饭, 我在学习中期有点累. Native speakers would say 中间 or 中段 here.

definition: 化工是用化学办法把东西变成新东西的工作。
reviewer_notes: This is a duplicate or spurious sense of 化工. Sense 94350 already covers it.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates sense 94350 (化工 = the chemical industry). 化工 does not separately mean an individual's job. Its sentences use 做化工, which still refers to the industry, and sentence 0 is a circular definition. 「他每天都做化工」 is also unnatural.

definition: 叹词，打招呼或呼唤时用；也指给人或动物吃东西。
reviewer_notes: Reject: the core is mixed-sense and has the wrong pos, so it cannot be patched in place. Regenerate it as a pure 动词 sense (给人或动物吃东西) and keep the 叹词 usages in 94355. Reusable as a guide: the feed-sense material is consistent. B level_3 (sentence 6), B level_6 (correct index 9) and B level_7 ([6,7,9]) are all feed-sense; A level_1 options are valid for a wèi target; morphological_forms 喂养 and 喂食 fit this sense. The B level_6 and level_7 errors also check out.
reviewer_issues: core.pos: pos 标为叹词，但释义与多数句子所用的是动词义（给人或动物吃东西）。; core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: 释义和指纹把叹词义与动词义合并在一个文档中，违反一义项一文档。; core.sentences[0..3]: 句0–3（喂，小王…／喂，你好…／喂，别跑…／喂，我听见了…）用的是叹词义，不是本文档的义项。; variants.A.level_3 (sentence 0): 填空句用的是叹词义，并非本义项。; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index (3): “正确”句“喂，我听见了，你说吧。”是叹词用法，不是动词义，正确答案的义项不对。; variants.A.level_7.correct_sentence_indices ([0,1,2]): 列为正确的句0–2均为叹词义，不属于本义项。

definition: 国内外是自己的国家里面和别的国家那里。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 94360. The definition is also awkward: "是自己的国家里面和别的国家那里". Doc B also has a synonym_antonym_match block that is not in the plan. Other defects I noticed but did not patch, since the document is rejected: variants.A.level_6 correct sentence "这种茶国内外的人都爱喝。" needs a comma after 茶.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Sense 94359 has the same meaning as sense 94360 (国内外 = 本国内部和其他国家, domestic and foreign). Two senses for one meaning would teach a duplicate.

definition: 报名是把自己的名字告诉别人，想参加一件事。
reviewer_notes: Core is redundant with 94364, so it is rejected. For the record, the other content is mostly sound: the level_3 distractors are ungrammatical or contradictory, and the level_7 errors involve 报名. Weak point if retained: variants.A.level_6 wrong sentence 我出差回来就去财务处报名 can still be read as registration at a finance desk, so it is not cleanly wrong.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94364. Both glosses (把名字告诉组织者想参加 / 自愿登记姓名参加活动) and fingerprints describe the same meaning, so one sense is split into two identical teaching units.

definition: 夏是一年里最热的那个季节。
reviewer_notes: 拒收：本义项与 94368 重复（都指夏季）。应保留 94368，删除本义项。其余问题在本义项删除后已不适用。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94368 指同一事物（夏季）。“最热的那个季节”不是独立义项，两个义项重复切分了同一词义。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “在夏去海边玩”口语中偏生硬，未必不可接受，错误不够干净。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “场”可计量经历（一场梦、一场病），“度过了一场夏”未必是错误句。

definition: 夏季，一年四季中的第二季。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as seeded because bare 夏 is not a free noun at a neutral register. The antonym 冬 is fine. A re-seed with 夏 restricted to bound or list contexts, or a switch to 夏天, is needed.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: In modern Mandarin, 夏 meaning 'summer' is almost only a bound morpheme. Outside the fixed list 春夏秋冬 and literary set phrases, native usage is 夏天 or 夏季. Many sentences use bare 夏 as a free noun with a 中性 register, and this is unnatural: 去年的夏 (s4), 夏来了 (s3), 夏过去以后 (s2), 夏有三个月 (s5), 接着就是夏 (s8), and 夏的风带着咸味 (s9). This would teach learners a non-idiomatic usage.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: The block rejects 我们在夏去海边玩 because bare 夏 is not used as a time expression. The core sentences use bare 夏 in exactly that way, so the document contradicts itself.; variants.A.level_7.corrected_sentence: The corrected sentence 我去年过了一个很热的夏 is still unnatural; it should be 夏天. Variant B's level_7 has the same problem.; variants.A.level_1.options[1]: 见 (jiàn) differs from xià in both the initial and the final, so it is not a minimal pair. The explanation says only the initial differs, which is false.

definition: 姐姐和妹妹的合称。
reviewer_notes: 以重复为由拒收，而非内容有误。若库中决定保留本义项而不保留 94373，则需修复：(1) A.level_7 的错句“她们俩合起来是姐妹，常常一起逛街。”并不明显有误，“合起来是”加“姐妹”仍可勉强接受，应替换为更明确的错句，例如“她们俩合起来叫兄弟，常常一起逛街。”，并相应修改说明与改正句；(2) A.level_6 第三个错句的说明加入了“同一家里”，超出本义项的释义，应改为只依据“姐姐和妹妹的合称”来说明。其余填空、重排与 furigana 基本无误。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94373 义项重复：“姐姐和妹妹的合称”与“同一个家里的姐姐和妹妹”指的是同一个意思，只是表述不同。同一词同一义项拆成两个，会产生重复的练习，并使义项区分失去意义。

definition: 许多孩子。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as redundant, not for sentence quality. The individual sentences and blocks are otherwise well formed, but the core duplicates sense 94375. Keep only one of the two. The lemma 孩子们 itself is probably better handled as the plural of 孩子.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense: “许多孩子。” with fingerprint “许多孩子（复数）” is the same meaning as sense 94375 (“很多个小孩子。”, fingerprint “多个孩子（复数）”). Two identical senses would give conflicting exercises for the same word.

definition: 工作单位是你每天去上班的地方。
reviewer_notes: 整体拒收，理由是义项本身与 94380 重复，且自身解释与锁定义项矛盾。若上游决定保留地点义，则需逐条重写 L6/L7 解释，并另行核对例句。我没有工具运行 fat_seed_runner.py plan，因此未核对 blocks 与计划是否一致。active_levels 列出了 2、4、9，但文档中没有对应 block，请由 runner 确认。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94380 实为同一义项。两者都指个人任职的单位，94379 只是把同一机构说成「每天去上班的地方」。例句如「我的工作单位离家很近」「他的工作单位在市中心」同样可以读作机构义，无法单独区分两个义项。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0..2].explanation; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0..2].explanation: 解释把词义说成「所在的机构」「指机构」，与本义项自身的定义（每天上班的地方）不符。同一文档的 level_3 解释却按地点理解，前后不一致。; variants.A.level_7.error_description; variants.B.level_7.error_description: 以「不用来数机构」「不能用于机构」立论，同样把义项说成机构义。

definition: 常务是每天都要办的事。
reviewer_notes: 以重复为由拒收。若库中决定保留本义项而不保留 94382，则需修复：(1) A.level_1 的选项“商务”与“常务”在声母（sh/ch）和声调上都不同，不属于仅差一个音位或仅声调不同的混淆词，按规则应删除，删除后仍有四个选项，符合要求；(2) B.level_6 第一个错句“这个常务由王姐负责，进度比计划快。”并不明显有误，因为日常事务也可能“进度比计划快”，应替换为明确的错句。另外，“场务”与“厂务”读音完全相同，但两者都是错误选项，可以接受。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94382 义项重复：“每天都要办的事”与“经常性的、日常的事务”指同一个意思；94382 的释义更完整，并包含“常务工作”的用法。同一义项拆成两个会产生重复的练习。

definition: 经常性的、日常的事务；常务工作。
reviewer_notes: Most of the sentences do not use 常务 in an attested way, so the core cannot be salvaged by patching. The written-register (书面) label combined with T3 sentences is also inconsistent.
reviewer_issues: core: 常务 is essentially an attributive or non-predicate word, as in 常务工作, 常务副校长 and 常务委员. Used on its own as a countable noun meaning 'daily affairs' it is unidiomatic. Sentences 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8 and 9 sound wrong to native speakers, for example 这个月常务多, 处理了一上午常务 and 不懂常务. The POS 名词 and the definition do not match real usage. The level_6 and level_7 blocks are built on this false premise, for example 这项常务. The level_1 explanation for 乘务 is also inaccurate.

definition: 有力量，强而有劲。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a whole because the core needs re-authoring, not patching. Other defects, for the record: A level_6 wrong sentence 这个条件对我们很有力 (有利) is borderline, since 有力 does not normally mean 有利. B level_6 correct sentence 经理有力地支持了我们的计划 uses an adverbial sense (effectively) that the definition does not cover. Once the sense is rebuilt, the L1 distractors, L7 blocks and antonym block (无力) can be reused after checking.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: '有力量，强而有劲' overlaps the physical-strength sense of 94395 ('身体或动作有很大力气'). The sense is not distinct from 94395, and it has no clean boundary.; core.sentences[1,3,6,8]: Four of ten sentences use 94395's physical sense: 手臂非常有力, 握手握得很有力, 跑起来又快又有力, 腿还很有力. The sentence set is mixed.; variants.B.level_3: The cloze (sentence 6, 那只狗跑起来又快又有力) tests the physical sense, not the locked sense.; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: The correct sentence (index 3, 他握手握得很有力) is in the physical sense, so the discrimination item tests the wrong sense.

definition: 已经死去的人。
reviewer_notes: No patches, since the core is unusable as a separate sense. The blocks were otherwise checked and are sound (L3 distractors clearly wrong, L6 and L7 errors valid), but they add nothing that 94403 does not already cover. The same level 1 and active_levels observations as 94403 apply.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 已经死去的人 and 已经不在了的人 are the same meaning, same POS, same register and same sentence type as sense 94403. Two senses here would teach one meaning twice and split the exercise pool.

definition: 搀杂在一起；蒙骗；随便度日。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable because it is a multi-sense definition with sentences that drift across senses. Smaller defects should be rechecked after regeneration: in A.level_1, 恨 hèn vs hùn is acceptable but 讯 xùn is a weak listening pair. Pairs such as 魂/婚 are better.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition bundles three distinct senses: 搀杂在一起, 蒙骗, and 随便度日. The fingerprint adds a fourth, 在外谋生. The sense is not pinned, so no exercise can test one meaning.; core.sentences: The sentences mix senses. 0, 1, 3, 5, 6 and 9 mean 蒙混/混入. 2 and 4 mean 随便度日. 7 means 搀杂. 8 means 谋生. This fails the one-sense rule.; variants.B.level_7: The sentence 混得很好 uses the 谋生/混社会 sense. The correct_sentence_indices [6, 7, 9] also span different senses (蒙混 and 搀杂).; core.sentences[6].furigana: This is a stray furigana/pinyin field on one zh sentence only, and the schema is inconsistent.

definition: 用病原微生物制成的生物制品，接种后使人产生免疫力。
reviewer_notes: No patches, since the core is a duplicate. The blocks are otherwise reasonable (scientific-context L3 A, 新冠疫苗 L3 B, valid L6 and L7 errors), but the L7 'a 个疫苗' error is weaker than the others because 个 is a generic classifier used colloquially; if this sense were ever kept, that item should be re-checked.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 用病原微生物制成的生物制品，接种后使人产生免疫力 is the same meaning as 94409's 打进身体、预防生病的药, only at a more technical grain. Two senses for one meaning split the exercise pool and teach one meaning twice.

definition: 神奇是特别特别，让人觉得很奇妙。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的依据是义项重复，不是句子质量问题。B 的 level_6 中“他的心跳很神奇”也可一并复查。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但没有对应的 block，改动后需重跑 plan。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94412 指同一义项（奇妙、令人赞叹），属于重复切分。定义“特别特别”也不是规范释义。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “他说话的样子很神奇”可读作“令人赞叹”，错误不成立，可能出现第二个正确答案。

definition: 经过一年或许多年。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as an unusable core. The sense duplicates 94415, and its pos and attributive usage conflict. Recommend merging its sentences into 94415 (the adverbial ones are already there) or reclassifying the sense if the attributive reading is kept. The variant blocks were not patched because the core would still be invalid. The level_6 wrong sentences (一会儿/整天/当天 etc.) are otherwise sound, and the level_3 distractors (冰箱/奶茶/名片) are weak but do not create a defensible-correct conflict.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Near-duplicate of sense 94415 (经过一年或许多年 vs 过了很多年). Same pos, register and semantic class. The only difference is usage pattern (经年之后, 经年的思念), not sense, so a learner cannot distinguish the two and the distractor logic cannot separate them.; core.pos: pos is 副词, but sentences 1 and 6 use 经年 as an attributive modifier (经年的思念, 经年的雨水). Variant level_7 corrections also rely on this (A 经年的努力, B 经年的风雨). The core POS does not describe its own sentences.; variants.B.level_7.error_description: The explanation says 经年的风雨 is correct because 经年 modifies a noun, which contradicts the 副词 pos. The corrected sentence therefore rests on a grammar claim that the sense's own POS does not support, and the item is not a clean single-error exercise.

definition: 联赛是很多队伍一场一场比赛的大比赛。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的依据是义项与 94424 重复。两个义项的例句与选项本身没有明显错误。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94424 指同一义项（按队伍比赛的体育联赛）。“很多队伍一场一场比赛的大比赛”也不排除杯赛，区分度不如 94424。; core.primary_collocate: variants.B.level_3 的说明称“参加联赛”是常见搭配，但 primary_collocate 为 null，二者不一致。

definition: 靠近，面对；将要。
reviewer_notes: 建议：时间义（将要、快要）只保留在 94425 中；94426 应重新生成为只表示靠近或面对河、街、海的空间义，例如 临河、临街、临湖、临窗 等，并同步重建 level_6、level_7 与 synonym 模块。其余的空间义句子（0–7）本身没有问题，可以在重建时复用。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义和指纹都把“将要”（时间义）并入“靠近、面对”（空间义）之中，但这是 94425 的义项。文档 core 中的句子 8（临下雨前，天气特别闷）和句子 9（临睡前，她喜欢听音乐）都属于时间义，违反“每句都用定义所描述的义项”的要求。B 变体的 level_6 正确句（index 9）、level_7 正确句（index 9）和 synonym 句（index 9）都依赖这一句子，A 的 level_6 错句中也有 临下雨之后、临三岁 这类时间用法。

definition: 把自己与别人或别的事物相比。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable: the sense is mostly non-idiomatic, and the rest duplicates 94427.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: The sense 'compare oneself with someone, as in 和…比较' is not an idiomatic use of 自比. In standard usage, 自比 means 以…自比, likening oneself to a figure, which is sense 94427. Several sentences are unnatural under the claimed sense: [1] 她总爱自比姐姐，觉得自己不够好; [2] 弟弟常自比班上成绩最好的同学，有点难过; [3] 你不要总自比别人; [4] 小李自比…最年轻的经理; [6] 我不想自比邻居. A native speaker would say 拿自己跟…比. Sentences [0], [5] and [9] (自比张学友/诸葛亮/李白) are actually sense 94427. The L3-B anchor ([6]) and the L6-A anchor ([3]) are both unnatural.

definition: 连词性短语，表示前后两件事在同一时间发生。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of sense 94429: same lemma, 连词, same meaning, and near-identical definition and fingerprint. Teaching both would repeat the same items. Its own items looked sound. The definition calls the word a 连词性短语 while pos is 连词. Retire one of the pair; 94429 is the one kept.

definition: 魅力是让人特别喜欢、想看想听的吸引力。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 94452. The pair must keep only one sense for this meaning.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 94452 (魅力 = attraction), split into two senses. This gloss narrows the sense to 想看想听, which does not cover 魅力 in general.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0..2]: Three wrong sentences can be read in a charm/attraction sense: 魔杖有魅力, 工作的魅力让他睡不着觉 (a fascinating job), 磁铁的魅力吸铁钉. None is clearly wrong.

definition: 分内是应该自己做的事。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable: the sentences force a non-idiomatic bare-noun use. The level_6 and level_7 exercises are built on the same faulty usage. Sense 94466 covers the real usage.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: The core treats 分内 as a free-standing noun object (做好分内, 做完分内, 这是分内, 他的分内). Standard usage is attributive: 分内的事 or 分内事. Bare 分内 as a noun is unidiomatic, so almost every sentence would get a 2–3 for whole-word/sense. The noun sense also duplicates the property sense 94466 (分内的…).

definition: 机关、学校、团体等统一规定式样的服装。
reviewer_notes: 核心内容不可用，因为它与 94467 重复，故驳回。其他块仅作记录，不作为修改依据。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94467 的义项重复：二者定义、指纹和例句的核心含义相同（统一规定式样的服装）。; variants.B.level_1: 同样以 no_minimal_pairs 放弃，但同一词头的最小对立对（致富、字符）存在，理由不成立。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “这次去爬山，他特意穿了一身制服。”：与 94467 中的问题相同，可解读为统一购置的登山服，属于边界句。

definition: 名字叫作。
reviewer_notes: Reject. The sense is redundant with 94473, and its own sentences contradict its own sense_fingerprint (four person-referring sentences against a places/things fingerprint). Its level_3 and level_7 blocks are otherwise sound, so the content is salvageable by merging. Level_1 is declined, which is final. The active_levels mismatch also applies. Not verified by running the plan command.
reviewer_issues: sense as a whole: 与 94473 为同一义项（名字叫作），属重复义项，不应作为独立义项教授。; sentences 2, 5, 7, 8 (sense fingerprint contradiction): fingerprint 声明用于地方、事物、书名，但句子 2（客人马丁）、5（同学林林）、7（哥哥的朋友高山）、8（电影里的小男孩小东）均指人，与自身 fingerprint 矛盾。; core.definition: 释义“名字叫作。”过于简略，缺少主语和用法说明，与 fingerprint 不一致。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2] and variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “他名叫医生”与“这种花名叫红色”均可被读作合理的（戏谑）名字，错误性存疑。

definition: 告知是把一件事说给别人听，让他知道。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 94480. The level_3 explanation error is recorded for the record and not patched, because the sense is rejected.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 94480 (告知 = inform). 把一件事说给别人听 also describes 告诉, so it fails to separate 告知 from its near-synonym.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: The 复印 explanation says 不能把检查结果复印给病人, but 复印给病人 is grammatical (copy the results for the patient). The real fault is that 复印 cannot take 病人 as its object.

definition: 通过邮局等传送；托付。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable because of the sense conflation. The level_6 and level_3 anchors also test different senses.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition and fingerprint combine two distinct senses: mailing (传送) and entrusting (托付). The sentences mix both: 0, 1, 5, 6, 7 and 8 are mailing; 2, 3, 4 and 9 are entrusting. The mailing sense also duplicates 94491.; core.sentences[4]: '寄希望于' is a formal fixed expression. It is above the learner tier and does not fit the 中性 register.; core.sentences[4].furigana: Stray 'furigana' fields appear on sentences 4 and 6 of a Chinese document.

definition: 封建是很久以前，国王把地分给别人管的那种制度。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项不可用，因为它与 94494 重复，故驳回。其余内容（例如 level_7 的量词错误“只”改“种”）解释正确，但不影响驳回结论。synonym_antonym_match 的放弃理由（no_relation）在计划中允许，但若保留该义项，应考虑郡县对立。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94494 的义项重复：“国王把地分给别人管的那种制度”与“古代君主把土地分给贵族管理的社会制度”含义相同，指纹也几乎一致。; core.sentences[2]: “老师给我们讲了封建的历史。”及“这部电影讲的是封建年代的事。”中，“封建”作定语修饰名词，接近形容词用法，与标注的名词义项不一致。

definition: 建立时间是一个地方或一个东西开始有的时间。
reviewer_notes: The core cannot be used as written. A.level_7, which relies on dropping 的, is also weak, because '这座寺庙建立时间…' is marginally acceptable as a topic construction.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: Collocation drift. 建立 does not combine naturally with physical structures (桥, 庙, 塔, 公园, 老房子). Native usage is 建成时间, 修建时间 or 建造时间. Most of the sentences therefore teach an unidiomatic pairing.; core.definition: This sense largely duplicates 94500 (both cover 商店, 饭馆 and 小镇 founding). The split is not a real lexical sense distinction.

definition: 才能和天赋。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的依据是义项重复，而不是句子质量；这些句子本身基本干净。若流程要保留两个义项，两者的定义必须体现真正的区别，而这些句子并未显示这种区别。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94507 义项重复。两者都是“天生的才能/天赋”（“天生就会做某些事的本事” 与 “才能和天赋”），本义项的每个句子也都同样符合 94507 的定义。同一释义出现两个义项，会给学习者两个相同的义项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2].explanation: “种……不用于植物”的说法不真确：“种”可用于植物（如“一种花”）。真正的错因是“株”专用于植物。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “这个孩子才分让大家很佩服。”省略“的”，属于类似“孩子脾气”的名词修饰，口语中可接受，因此错误不成立。

definition: 政治运动是很多人为了国家的某种想法一起做的大行动。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant sense. No patches are offered, since no sentence edit would make it a distinct sense. Its sentences are individually fine for the shared meaning. If the reject is overruled, these defects must be fixed: (a) B level_3 distractor 生日 is defensible in 书里写了一场很大的___ (a big birthday party is 一场很大的生日). Its explanation that 生日 does not take 一场很大的 is false. Replace the distractor, for example with 钥匙. (b) A level_6 wrong sentence 妈妈做了一场政治运动 is weak. 做一场 for a mass movement is not clearly wrong, so swap it for a sentence with a clear category error. (c) B level_6 wrong sentence 桌上
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. 94515 (“许多人为了国家的某种想法一起参加的大行动”) and 94516 (“为实现某种政治目标而发动的大规模群众活动”) describe the same meaning. A learner cannot tell which sense a given sentence uses, so the lock-in (义项匹配) test cannot pass for either.

definition: 介于东和南之间的方向。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for content. Other checked items are clean: all ten sentences use 东南 in the direction sense, the level_3 and level_7 blocks match the plan, and the level_6 wrong sentences are wrong for word-related reasons. If the pipeline keeps this sense instead of 94523, it needs the antonym-block fix.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 94523. Its definition 介于东和南之间的方向 and sense_fingerprint 东和南之间的方向 describe the same direction sense as 94523 (东边和南边中间的方向). Both would teach the same meaning with overlapping exercises.; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match and variants.B.synonym_antonym_match: Both declined as no_relation, but 西北 is the opposite direction of 东南. The sentence 9 in B also has no antonym exercise despite the relation existing.

definition: 档案；等级、类别；变速的位置。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝理由：核心的词形与读音对该义项不成立，无法通过补丁修正，需以「挡 dǎng」为词形重新撰写。这一判断较有把握，但建议编辑人员核实标准书写形式。句子本身（A 与 B 两组的正确句、错误句与修正句）在变速义项下均通顺，计划与文档索引一致。
reviewer_issues: core.pronunciation, variants.A.level_1.options[0] (档 dàng) and options[2] (挡 dǎng): 变速挡位的标准读音是 guà dǎng（挂挡、换挡），标准书写为「挡」。本文档将该义项标为「档 dàng」，所以 L1 的正确答案与该义项的标准读音不符；而「挡」作为干扰项的解释「意思是阻挡」对该义项也是错误的。; core.definition: 定义「档案；等级、类别；变速的位置」列出三个义项，违反单义项要求。

definition: （台湾用法）课程成绩太差，必须重修；也指当物品而不赎回。
reviewer_notes: Recommended split: a pawn sense (当铺, 不赎回) using sentences 2, 3, 5, 6, with its own blocks. Drop the course portion as a duplicate of 94527 unless a regional sense is wanted. Two sentence-level checks, for reference after the split: the course-failing sentence 4 (他缺课太多，老师把他死当了) uses 死当 with a person as object, which is the same pattern 94527 handles, and the level_6 wrong-sentence corrections are reasonable. Declined blocks were left alone.
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: One sense ID carries two distinct senses: (a) course failing, which must be retaken, and (b) pawning an item and not redeeming it. The checklist requires every sentence to use one sense, and this record does not satisfy that.; core.sentences: Sentences mix the two senses. Course sense: 0, 1, 4, 7, 8, 9. Pawn sense: 2, 3, 5, 6. The blocks inherit this mix (A level_3 and B level_6 use course usage, A synonym_antonym_match uses 赎回, which only fits the pawn sense).; core.definition (台湾用法 course portion): The course-failing meaning duplicates sense 94527 (same meaning, only a 台湾用法 label differs). This duplicates a sense in the inventory.

definition: 国王的儿子。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for content. Other checked items: A level_6 (女孩 and 怀孕 errors are wrong for word-related reasons), A level_7 (单 量词 error with 一只 is clean), B level_3 (cloze with 过生日 distractors 河流, 钥匙, 城堡 is clean), B level_6 correct index 9, B level_7 (复数 error with 两个). If the pipeline keeps this sense instead of 94539, the issues above need fixing.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 94539. Its definition 国王的儿子 and sense_fingerprint 国王的儿子 match 94539's 王子是国王的儿子, so the same sense would be taught twice.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: The explanation for 石头 is false. 石头 is countable and can be ownable (三个石头), so the stated reason is wrong. The real reason it fails is semantic: a king's child cannot be a stone.; variants.A.level_1.options[3]: 王室 differs from 王子 in two places (initial and tone of the second syllable), so it fails the L1 keep rule.; variants.B.level_1: Declined as no_minimal_pairs, but minimal pairs exist (房子, 网子).; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1] and wrong_sentences[2]: 这个王子家里很穷 and 王子每天都要在田里干活 are only wrong through unstated context. A poor or working prince is possible in fiction.

definition: 生活教育是教小朋友怎么好好过日子。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 94542: same lemma and meaning. 教小朋友怎么好好过日子 is a narrower gloss of 培养日常生活能力和习惯的教育. If the caller keeps this sense instead, these items need patches. Variant A level_6 wrong sentence 这个孩子的生活教育很健康，不挑食 is defensibly acceptable, and 生活教育的压力很大 is weak. Variant B level_6 wrong sentences 这个孩子的生活教育很好，每天都睡九个小时 (coherent: good life education, so sleeps nine hours), 这次生活教育让员工学会了新技能, and 他养成了早睡的生活教育 (养成 fits this sense's habit meaning) are not clearly wrong.

definition: 疼是身体某个地方不舒服，让人想哭。
reviewer_notes: 判为 reject，并非因为练习本身有明显失效，而是因为本义项与 94550 重复，且 94549 独有的“让人想哭”并非可靠的区分特征。请合并到 94550，不要单独修补。以上问题仅作记录，未返回补丁。L1 干扰项（糖/停/同/能；堂/亭/童）均为同声调或仅声母/韵母不同的最小对立对，核查无误。计划 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但两个变体均无对应块，请确认是否有意如此。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “让人想哭”是症状或后果，不是释义。本义项的多数例句（如“我的腿疼，走不了路”“你哪儿疼？”）并不涉及哭。; core (sense overlap with 94550): 94549 与 94550 描述的是同一义项（身体受伤或不舒服时的疼痛），仅释义措辞不同，不构成可区分的独立义项。; variants.A.level_7: “疼地叫出声来”：形容词加“地”可修饰动词（如“痛苦地叫”），该句并非确定的错误句；解释称“疼地”不能修饰动词“叫”，与事实不符。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “泡了个热水澡，我觉得又暖和又疼”：热水澡后肌肉仍酸痛的情境下，母语者可能接受该句，不能确定是错误句。

definition: 众人是很多人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 94560, not for item defects alone. Keep 94560. If a human decides to keep 94559 instead, the minimum changes are: replace A level_3 option 诸君, replace B level_3 option 众生, remove A level_6 wrong sentence 请众人保持安静, and replace the A level_7 incorrect sentence with a clearer error.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “众人是很多人” is circular and nearly identical to 94560 (“大家；许多人”). The added “在场” in the fingerprint is not a separate dictionary meaning, so the two senses cannot be taught apart.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “请众人保持安静，不要大声说话。” is a correct use under 94560 (大家), so it is not a clean wrong sentence.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: “诸君” fits the blank grammatically and in meaning, and 书面语 is the declared register, so it is defensibly correct. The explanation relies on register alone.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: “众生” (all living beings) fits “大雨来了，众生急忙躲进了小店” grammatically and in meaning, and 书面语 matches the declared register. Defensibly correct.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “众人们” is a redundancy (赘余) error, not a grammatical one, and it is widely used. It is weak as the single clear error.

definition: 砸是用重的东西用力打下去，把东西打坏。
reviewer_notes: This is a core-level duplication, so no patch is offered. Sentence, distractor and explanation checks found no further defect beyond the overlap. B level_6 "他一脚砸坏了门" has the same weakness as 94562's foot sentence, so fix it if this sense survives.
reviewer_issues: core: The definition (用重的东西用力打下去，把东西打坏) describes the same action as sense 94562 (用重物撞击使破碎): a heavy object strikes and damages. The sentences are interchangeable across the two senses, e.g. 把门砸坏了 / 砸坏了门锁 / 砸坏了邻居的车 could all be 94562 sentences. The sense cannot be pinned, so exercises built on it cannot be defended.

definition: 旧时对皇帝的称呼；欢呼时用来表示祝愿的口号。
reviewer_notes: Reject: the definition merges two senses, and sentences 1, 3, 6 and 9 use the cheer sense that belongs to 94571. Regenerate the sense from fingerprint 旧时称呼皇帝的说法, with a definition limited to the title use and sentences free of 高喊/大喊/欢呼 contexts. Then regenerate the blocks, since B level_3 (sentence 6), B level_6 (correct 9) and B level_7 (6, 7, 9) depend on drifted sentences. The plan was not regenerated (no tools). active_levels includes 4 and 9, but morphological_forms is empty and neither level has a block.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义同时含两个义项：「旧时对皇帝的称呼」和「欢呼时用来表示祝愿的口号」。后者即 94571 的义项，违反义项锁定，与 sense_fingerprint「旧时称呼皇帝的说法」不一致。; core.sentences[1]: 「大臣们跪在地上，高喊“皇帝万岁”。」中的万岁是欢呼口号义，属于 94571 的义项，不是称呼义。; core.sentences[9]: 「皇帝走过来，所有人都大声喊：“万岁！”」是欢呼义。它是 B level_6 的正确句，会让该题与 94571 混淆。; core.sentences[6]: 「皇帝一出来，大家就跪下高喊万岁。」是欢呼义。B level_3 的 cloze 与 B level_7 的正确句都依赖该句，其中 B level_3 的干扰项（圣旨、礼物、奏章）和解释也都建立在「高喊」语境上。; core.sentences[3]: 「古时候，百姓见了皇帝，要喊万岁。」语义模糊，「喊万岁」更接近欢呼。A level_6 的正确句依赖该句。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「旧时候，人们称呼皇帝是万岁。」中「称呼X是Y」结构语法上可接受，母语者未必判为错误，标注的「为/是」错误不成立。; variants.A.level_3.options[3].explanation: 解释称「太监」口语色彩强，说法不准确。「太监」是旧时宦官的通行称呼，并非口语。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 「宫女见到皇帝，轻声说：“万岁。”」中的低声问候在宫廷语境下未必不可接受，错误理由不够稳固。

definition: 较比是跟别的东西比一比，看看更好还是更差。

Sentences such as 「把两家的价钱较比一下」 and 「老师让我们较比这两篇文章」 sound unnatural; native speakers would say 比较/比一比. Every exercise built on this core would teach a non-standard usage.

reviewer_notes: Reject, not patch. The first clause 喧哗吵嚷 is 94887’s sense, so this is a sense-inventory problem. Fixing it means re-cutting the sense and regenerating sentences 3 and 6, plus every block that references them: A level_6 correct sentence 3, A synonym_antonym sentence 3, B level_3 sentence 6, and B level_7 index 6. Secondary, to check when regenerating: A level_7 “这件事闹大家都不高兴。”is borderline natural (like 吵我没法睡觉). The blocks that remain (闹肚子, 闹矛盾, 闹笑话, 闹出麻烦) are otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义把“喧哗吵嚷”（即 94887 的义项）与“发生不好的事”捆在一起。两个义项重叠，不是单一义项。; core.sentences[3]: “小妹妹闹脾气，不肯吃饭。”属于吵闹、撒泼义，漂移到 94887 的义项。; core.sentences[6]: “孩子在商店里闹着要买玩具。”是吵闹义，漂移到 94887；它还是 B level_3 的 cloze 句。

definition: 不局限于，范围超出所说的。

The definition covers both readings, so the sense mixes two parts of speech.; core.morphological_forms: 主演了 and 主演过 apply only to the verb reading and are wrong for the noun sentences.; core.definition: The verb reading (在戏剧或电影里担任主要角色) duplicates sense 94895, which covers the same meaning for films.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “他在剧中主演了一个卖菜的人。” is defensibly acceptable: a lead role can be a vegetable seller. definition: 在社会上有名声、为许多人所知的人。
reviewer_notes: 判为 reject，因其为 94913 的重复义项，故不做修补。若词典保留的是本条而非 94913，则需先修正上述第二条 issue，并检查其余区块。其余 A 级选项与 B 级 6、7 的错误句基本通过。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94913 义项重复：“在社会上有名声、为许多人所知的人”与“很多人都认识的人”所指相同，用法也相同。; core.sentences[6]: “记者正在采访一位体育名人。”中，目标词嵌在复合词“体育名人”内。B 级 3 的挖空因此变为“一位体育____”，干扰项会组成如“体育体育馆”这样的怪异结构。

definition: 哪一个是问在几个里面是哪个。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant duplicate, not for a defect in the variants. Otherwise checked: A.L1 distractors are tonal or initial minimal pairs; A.L3 distractors fail on meaning; A.L6 and A.L7 each have one clear error; B.L3 「它」 is weak but not defensibly correct. Plan lists level 2 as active, but neither variant has a level_2 block. Confirm with the plan command whether that block is required.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. It teaches the same sense as 94916 (interrogative pronoun: choose one from several). Its definition 「哪一个是问在几个里面是哪个」 is circular, while 94916's definition is clearer.

definition: 城乡是城市和乡下。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate. For the record, the variant defects are these. B.L7 「城乡中间的路越来越宽」 is defensibly acceptable (「城乡中间地带」 is standard), so the spot-incorrect item is ambiguous. A.L6 wrong sentences 「住在城乡」 and 「在城乡买一套小房子」 are odd but close to acceptable, which weakens that set. Plan lists levels 2, 4 and 9 as active with no blocks, although morphological_forms is populated and level 4 would apply.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense of 94918 (城乡 = 城市和农村的合称). Its definition 「城乡是城市和乡下」 is the weaker gloss: 「乡下」 is colloquial against a 书面 register, and it does not state the collective meaning.

definition: 对批评或打击自己的人进行反击，使其受害。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for a per-block defect. I checked the level blocks: the distractors do not fit their blanks, and the level_6 and level_7 errors are clean. If the team would rather keep 94920 and drop 94919, swap the two verdicts and re-check.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94919. The definition (retaliate against a person who criticised or attacked you) is a narrower case of 94919's retaliation for mistreatment. Every 94920 sentence also holds under 94919, so the items cannot separate the two.

definition: 用工具或手把土壤等向里掘取。
reviewer_notes: Reject is recommended as a duplicate. The option explanations are otherwise sound, including the 挖过到 vs 挖到过 correction, but these are moot. Also, synonym_antonym_match was declined as no_relation, but 填 is a standard antonym of 挖 in this sense. The plan lists active_levels 2, 4 and 9 with no blocks, so confirm with the runner.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 用工具或手把土壤等向里掘取 describes the same act as sibling 94935 (用手或工具把土往外拿出来). Several sentences are the same dig-soil sense: 雪里挖洞, 花盆里挖土, 用手挖泥巴. The sense cannot be taught separately from 94935, and the two would share answers and distractors.

definition: 谈到，说起；也指用手拿起。
reviewer_notes: Reject: the core is unusable. Only 2 of 10 sentences use the lift sense. Regenerate 拿起 as its own sense with its own sentences, then rerun the plan. Block-level defects are not itemized because every block depends on the core being rebuilt.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Merges two senses, 谈到/说起 and 也指用手拿起. A document must teach one sense.; core.sense_fingerprint: The same two-sense merge appears in the fingerprint, so sentences cannot be judged against one sense.; core.sentences[7]: 她慢慢提起了那只旧箱子 uses the 用手拿起 sense, not 说到.; core.sentences[8]: 他提起水桶，走进了厨房 uses the 用手拿起 sense, not 说到.; core: The 说到 meaning duplicates sense 94937 (definition 说到一件事), so two entries teach the same sense.

definition: 刚入学的学生；也指新出生的。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，故不给出补丁。若要修补，需替换 definition 与 fingerprint，删去 4 条新出生义项的句子，并替换 A 的 level_6 正确句（索引 3 为新出生义项），然后重新生成 plan。学校义项的 L1、L3、L6、L7 内容本身站得住，若 94945 保留该义项，这些内容可直接沿用。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 一个 sense_id 含两个义项：「刚入学的学生」（句 0、1、2、6、8、9）与「新出生的」（句 3、4、5、7）。违反单义项原则，学习者无法针对单一义项练习。; core.sense_fingerprint: 学校义项与 94945 完全重复，同一义项出现在两个 sense_id 中。; core.morphological_forms[1]: 「新生儿」是另一个复合词，不是「新生」的词形变化。

definition: 有钱是有很多钱。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so no patches. If the owner reinstates it instead of 94950, the defects below must be fixed. (1) A level_3: 富饶 is a near-synonym of 有钱 and 我朋友很富饶 can be read as wealthy, so it is defensibly correct; replace with 冷淡. (2) B level_1: 有限 differs in initial and tone and is not a minimal pair; replace with 有权. (3) B level_3: the 胖 explanation says 句子不通, but 她很胖，但是从来不乱花钱 is grammatical; the reason is a semantic mismatch. The A level_3 聪明 distractor is grammatical but does not mean wealthy, so it can stay.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 94950. Both mean 手里的钱很多 / 富裕, and the 口语 vs 中性 register split is not a sense difference. Variants A and B are near-verbatim copies of 94950's: identical level_1 options, identical level_6 wrong sentences, identical level_7 wrong sentence, and identical synonym block. A learner would meet the same exercises twice.

definition: 检察是认真查看有没有人犯法。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable. All dependent blocks inherit this misuse.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: 检察 is a judicial/procuratorial term, used mainly in 检察院 / 检察官 / 检察机关. The sentences instead use it as an everyday verb, for example '认真检察了每一笔钱' and '检察这些房子'. Native speakers would write 检查 in these sentences, so they teach a common typo. They are also colloquial, which mismatches the declared register 书面. Level_6 then calls 检查 wrong, which inverts real usage.

definition: 检查并审查是否有违法行为。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: This core has the same defect as 94959. 检察 is used where natural Chinese uses 检查, as in '检察这批货', '检察每家工厂' and '账目每年都要检察'. Level_6 distractors (检查, 检测) are the words natives would actually use in these frames. The sense also duplicates 94959.

definition: 王朝是一家人当了很多年国王的时代。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 94974. No patches are needed because the core is not kept. The other issues are listed so they are not lost if the duplicate is resolved the other way. No tools were run here; the plan was not regenerated.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 94974. Both mean a dynasty ruled by one family across generations, with near-identical fingerprints (一家人世代当国王的时代 / 同一家族世代统治的朝代). Two senses for one meaning would teach the same content twice.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 闹钟 fits 关于___的电影 grammatically and plausibly (a film about an alarm clock). The explanation says 'historical subject', but the sentence never says the film is historical.; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: 皮鞋 has the same defect: a film about shoes is plausible.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “统治着三百年” is a natural written phrasing (统治着中国三百年). The 着 error is not clearly wrong, so a learner could defensibly accept it.

definition: 把信件、信息或货物送出去。
reviewer_notes: Not patched because the core is rejected as a duplicate. If it were retained instead of 94977, fix these: (1) variants.B.level_3 distractor 奉献 is rejected only on register, and 奉献样品给客户 is not clearly wrong; replace it with a semantically clear distractor such as 丢弃. (2) variants.B.level_7 incorrect sentence 这份合同已经发送到律师了 is borderline, because 发送到 plus a person is commonly heard; replace it with an unambiguous error. Everything else in this document checks out.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicates sense 94977. Both define 发送 as sending letters, messages or goods out to others. Two senses for one meaning will make the ladder teach the same item twice and produce confusable distractors.

definition: 逐渐衰老。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的理由：本义项与已通过的 94981 同义，且 A 版的 L6 干扰项与其自身指纹冲突，核心义项不可用。无论是否并入，都不应作为独立义项存在。若决定保留，需要的修改见上述 issues。其余检查结果：B 版的 L1 与 L3 干扰项基本成立，B 版 L6 的错误句成立，L7 的错误句成立。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 本义项“逐渐衰老”与 sense 94981（“人慢慢变老”）在词义上重复，教学上会把同一义项教两次。“事物”的延伸只是 94981 的比喻用法，不构成独立义项。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences: 三个“错误”句（设备老去、技术老去、影响力老去）符合本义项指纹“人或事物随时间逐渐衰老”，因此并非错误。其说明“指人或生物”与本义项自身的指纹矛盾。; core.sentences[4].furigana: 注音字段应只标注目标词读音，此处却是整句拼音，格式错误。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: “衰败”可用于身体或人的衰弱（如“身体日渐衰败”），“人们都会衰败”并非清楚错误，可能被判为正确答案。

definition: 体育比赛每年举行的整个时期。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of sense 94987, with the same meaning and fingerprint. No patches are given because the core is not a distinct sense. If the owner decides to keep this sense instead of 94987, the issues above would need patching. Each sentence individually is grammatical and uses 赛季 in the sports sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94987. “体育比赛每年举行的整个时期” and “一年里比赛的那一段时间” describe the same sense, and the fingerprints are equivalent. Learners cannot be taught these as two separate senses.; variants.A.level_3.options[0]: “学期”is not clearly wrong, since a school league could plausibly run 38 rounds within a semester.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: “球场”is borderline: a stadium can host matches, so 球场有三十八轮比赛 is not clearly false.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “这个景区的赛季很长”uses 赛季 in the tourist-peak sense, which is colloquially attested, so it is not a clean wrong sentence.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: “年里的每场比赛” reads as a strained but possibly acceptable “during the year” phrase, so “年” is not clearly wrong.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: The explanation says 季赛 is not a word, but 季赛 is a real term in Chinese sports and esports. The error is therefore not clean.

definition: 军官是军队里管很多士兵的人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 94992. No patches are needed because the core is not kept. The other issues are listed for the record. The sentences themselves are fine. No tools were run here; the plan was not regenerated.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 94992. Both describe the same referent (military officer). The gloss 军队里管很多士兵的人 is vaguer and partly inaccurate, since a 排长 commands few soldiers. Its fingerprint does not separate it from 94992.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 在路口指挥交通 is a task military officers can actually do, so the sentence is not clearly wrong.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 做早饭 and 给病人换药 are job-based, so a military cook or medic who is an officer makes them defensible.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 哥君儿 is an unnatural fit for 当一名___, and the explanation rests on register alone.

definition: 陆军是在地上走路打仗的军人。
reviewer_notes: Core sense is a drifted, nonstandard reading of 陆军 that duplicates 95000. Most sentences treat the branch noun as a countable individual, which native speakers find off. Recommend removing this sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense defines 陆军 as an individual soldier ('在地上走路打仗的军人'). Standard usage of 陆军 is the army branch, which is sense 95000. The individual-soldier reading is marginal and colloquial at best. Sentences built on it, such as '那个陆军背着很重的包', '几个陆军在雪地里', '这位陆军' and '一名陆军', sound unnatural to native speakers. The definition is also childish and circular, and sentence 0 just restates it.; variants.A.level_7: The level_7 blocks depend on the faulty sense. For example, B's corrected sentence '一名陆军' teaches a doubtful count usage.

definition: 随即是一件事做完，马上做下一件。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for a sentence-level defect. Its sentence-level problems are moot once the sense is removed. The surviving sense for 随即 is 95002.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 95002 (紧接着，立刻). Both teach 随即 as 'immediately after the previous event', with the same sentence frame. The extra requirement that the prior event be 做完 is not part of the word's meaning. The A level_6 wrong sentence 我正在看书，随即有人敲门 is only wrong under this narrower gloss; under 95002 it is acceptable. The two senses cannot be taught as distinct.

definition: 下作是做的事让人看不起。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for sentence quality. Do not patch; 95012 carries this meaning. Discard its plan with it.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95012. 「做的事让人看不起」 and 95012's 「言行卑鄙、低级，令人瞧不起」 describe one dictionary sense (卑鄙、下流). Sentences such as 「这么下作的话」 and 「这种下作的行为」 fit 95012's definition equally well, so the split does not reflect a real sense boundary.

definition: 没有变化，保持原样。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，因为与 95015 重复，不应单独发布。锚句本身基本干净，若人工选择保留本条而删除 95015，可用上述 B 级 7 的修正方向修补。A 级 1 和 synonym_antonym 的选项与 95015 完全相同，合并时只需保留一套。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95015 为同一义项（“没有变化，保持原样”与“还和以前一样”同义）。两义项的锚句、干扰项与反义选项几乎一一对应，学习者无法区分，这是核心层面的重复。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “笑容多年来一直不变着”的错误并不明确。解释“状态词后不能加着”过度概括。

definition: 圆形或区域正中的一点；也指最重要的地方。
reviewer_notes: 判为 reject，因为核心义项定义并列了字面义与比喻义，且与 95017 的字面义重复。两个义项编号不能同时保留同一个含义，而补丁无法在不改变义项含义的前提下解决这一问题。建议保留 95017。变体层面的问题已列出以供记录，若重新生成此义项可参考修改。level_1 的 declined 原样保留。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把两个义项并列（“圆形或区域正中的一点；也指最重要的地方”）。一个义项编号应只对应一个义项，且其字面义与 95017 几乎重复。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹同样并列了两个义项，与 95017 重复。; core.sentences[4].text: “这次争论的中心点是孩子的教育问题”用的是“最重要的地方”这一比喻义，与其余字面义句子不一致。; core.sentences[8].text: “这个问题的中心点在哪里？”同样是比喻义。; variants.B.level_3.options[0].explanation: “操场的运动”不成词”的说法不准确。真正的问题是“运动”不是地点，不能作“等你”的地点。; variants.B.level_7.error_description: 解释说“到”不能用于此，但“放到……上”是正常说法，说法不准确。

definition: 全省是一个省里所有的地方。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95032. Its level_6 and level_7 content is otherwise clean, but it should not ship as a separate sense. The plan lists active_levels 2, 4 and 9 with no matching blocks, so plan generation should be checked.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicates sense 95032. Definition 「全省是一个省里所有的地方」 and fingerprint 「一个省里所有的地方」 describe the same meaning as 「整个省的范围」, with the same usage pattern. Two senses would teach one meaning twice.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 「全省的首都在哪里？」 is wrong because of 首都, not 全省. The explanation's own fix is 〈省会〉, so the target word is not the error. This fails the requirement that the wrong sentence be wrong for a reason related to the word.; variants.A.level_1.options[2]: 「全城」 differs from 全省 in both initial (ch/sh) and tone. It is not a single-feature minimal pair, so the L1 judge will likely reject it. 「全身」 (ēn/eng plus tone) has the same weakness.

definition: 食物的味道；也指个人饮食或爱好的偏好。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is not a single sense and overlaps 95037; the variants were not patched. The same 口腹 distractor problem appears in A level_3 and should be fixed in any regenerated version. The same 量词 error (只 for 口味) appears in A level_6 and A level_7, so the regenerated version should avoid repeating it.
