reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95285 重复：两者都定义为每周一期的定期刊物（“每周出版一期的刊物” 对 “每个星期出一本的书报”），例句用法和题型结构也相同。同一义项写成两条，会让学习者重复学习。

definition: 擅长体育运动或从事体育运动的人。
reviewer_notes: 作为 95287 的重复义项而拒绝，不是因为其内部的块有问题。它的 sense_fingerprint“从事体育运动的人”比 95287 更宽，并且例句与 95287 重叠（如“参加过很多国际比赛”与“去过很多国家参加比赛”）。若人工决定保留 95288 而删除 95287，那么 95287 的补丁不能直接迁移，需要重新审核。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95287 义项重叠：两者都是“做体育运动、参加比赛的人”，学习者无法区分，两个义项同时保留会造成混淆。

definition: 请懂行的人看一看，说说这个东西是真是假、好不好。
reviewer_notes: 由于整个义项应当删除，块级检查没有继续展开。顺带观察：A level_7 的“匹花瓶”、B level_7 的“把专家鉴定为真货”两处错误本身是清楚的。如果团队需要另一个义项，应当用不同的对比来界定，例如“对……作出评定结论”（如鉴定为二级），而不是同一个意思的重复。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95294 的义项重复。两者都是“判定事物的真伪、优劣”，“请懂行的人看”只是施事的细节，不是不同的意思。学习者无法被锁定到其中一个义项，两个义项的例句和干扰项也大量重叠。

definition: 技艺或本领高超的人。
reviewer_notes: 作为冗余义项拒绝。其余部分本身成立：level_3 的 A、B 各只有一个正确答案；level_6 的错误句都因词义而错；level_7 的错误都是单一错误（过/了、只/位）。plan 题块与文档一致。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95299 重复：“技艺或本领高超的人”与“在某件事上特别厉害的人”描述的是同一人物义，用法都是“X高手”。同一义项写成两条。

definition: 当事人不服判决，请求上级法院重新审理。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of sense 95305 (both are 'appeal to a higher court after disagreeing with a judgment'). Keep 95305 and drop this one. The issues above are recorded for the record and do not need patching if the sense is dropped. The L1 no_minimal_pairs decline has the same 上述 problem as 95305.
reviewer_issues: variants.B.level_7.error_description: The explanation is false. 可以 plus a verb can take 着 (e.g. 可以坐着), so the stated rule is wrong. The real reason is that 上诉 is a one-time action.; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: 汇报 is grammatical in 他对判决不服，向上级法院汇报 and can be read as reporting dissatisfaction, so it is a defensible alternative.

definition: 在这句话后面一个一个写出来的。
reviewer_notes: Reject is for duplication, not for the content. Every correct sentence in A and B is clean, and no distractor is defensibly correct. Plan blocks match the document. The two 下列 senses are interchangeable, so a human may prefer to keep 95307 and drop 95308. Whichever is kept, the 下列的 error claim (level_7 A and B, level_6 wrong sentences) is contestable: 下列的 appears in written Chinese, so the 'cannot take 的' rule is a prescriptive generalisation. Check this before the item ships.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Gloss adds '一个一个' (one by one), which is not part of 下列's meaning. It also nearly duplicates sense 95308 ('列在下面的'), so the same meaning is taught twice.; core.pos: pos is 形容词, but this document's own level_7 explanations call 下列 a 区别词. The core field and the explanations contradict each other.

definition: 人住的地方。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of sense 95318 (人住的地方 vs 居住的地方, same meaning). Keep 95318. The variants are otherwise sound: the L6 and L7 classifier errors are valid and the L3 distractors are clearly wrong.
reviewer_issues: variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 他住地离公司不远 is an arguable error. Pronoun-plus-noun without 的 is not always ungrammatical, so the error is weak.

definition: 描述数据属性与来源的数据，即元数据。
reviewer_notes: 仅因重复而拒绝，本义项的例句与变体内容本身基本合格。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95321 义项相同（描述数据属性与来源的资料即元数据，与说明资料的资料为同一义），同一义项被切成两个 sense_id，学习者会在两处看到同义内容，变体干扰项也无法区分。

definition: 一年里最冷的时候，会下雪。
reviewer_notes: Reject is for duplication and the weaker definition. Other content is largely sound. Items to check if a human reinstates this sense: (1) B level_7 incorrect sentence '我最期待下一个冬天了。' is contestable. 了 with 期待 can be acceptable, so the rule 'cannot use 了' is an overgeneralisation and the item may fall to a rating of 2. A word-order error such as 我最期待冬天下一个 would be clearer. (2) A level_6 wrong sentence '冬天腊月' is borderline, since the claim that it is 不通顺 is weaker than for 寒冬腊月. (3) A level_1 options duplicate 95330 A level_1 exactly.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95330 (both mean the coldest season of the year). The definition also says 会下雪, which is not a defining feature of 冬天, and 一年里最冷的时候 is a less accurate gloss of a season than 一年四季中最冷的季节.

definition: 离开本国到外国去。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as redundant with 95331, not for content errors. Its other blocks (level 6, level 7, antonym) were otherwise clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 95331 ('离开自己的国家，到别的国家去' vs '离开本国到外国去'). Two senses for one meaning means the sentences and blocks teach the same thing twice.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 出访 ('出国访问') is a near-synonym of 出国 and implies an official visit. Its only clash with 旅游 is register, so a learner could defensibly pick it in 「我打算明年夏天出访旅游」.

definition: 住在庙里，信佛的男人。
reviewer_notes: 各块本身检查通过（干扰项、解释、level_6 与 level_7 的错句均成立）。仅因与 95346 重复而拒绝。若清单改为保留 95345，则应拒绝 95346。active_levels 含 2、4、9，但 plan 与文档均无对应块，本次未核实是否应有。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95346 指同一义项（和尚＝男性佛教僧人），属重复义项，会产出重复练习。

definition: 一个国家里最高的一位领导人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected: duplicate sense plus an inaccurate defining gloss. Other blocks were checked and their distractors do not fit, but the core cannot be kept as written. Retain 95356.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of 95356, which covers the same head-of-state sense of 国家主席.; core.definition: The gloss '一个国家里最高的一位领导人' is inaccurate for 国家主席 in the Chinese context. The office is head of state, and top leadership sits with 中共中央总书记.; core.sentences[0].text: '国家主席是一个国家最高的领导人。' repeats the inaccurate claim, and it is the level 3 cloze sentence.

definition: 女孩长大后，去和一个男人结婚，住到他家里。
reviewer_notes: 拒收：与 95370 重复。建议保留 95370，并把本文档中可用的句子并入其中。其余项目（L1、L3、L6 B、L7 A）单独看基本合格，但在合并时需要修正 L7 B 的错因解释。
reviewer_issues: core.definition, core.sense_fingerprint: 与 95370 是同一个义项（女子出嫁、结为夫妻）。“住到他家里”不足以让学习者区分两个义项。两版的句子、反义词（娶）和错句都可以互换，属于重复的义项。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “他把桃枝嫁到了李树上”用的是“嫁”的嫁接义（嫁接义在词典中存在），并非错句，只是另一义项。; variants.B.level_7.error_description: 解释有误：“嫁”可以用于“把”字句（如“把女儿嫁到邻县”）。此句真正的错误是“把”后缺少宾语，而不是“嫁”不能用“把”字句。

definition: 东西挨得很近，中间没有空隙。
reviewer_notes: 除重复外，各块检查通过（稀、疏为反义，听音干扰项声调或声母可辨）。若清单改为保留 95373，则 A level_6 中“这锅粥很密”一句需修正，理由与 95374 的芝麻糊句相同。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95374 同义（挨得近、空隙小），属重复义项；95374 的定义更完整，另含“稠密”。

definition: 新的一年的开始，常指春节前后。
reviewer_notes: 句子层面未发现缺陷：level_3 的干扰项“夏天、中秋、国庆”与“暑假、考试、农历”均明显不通；level_6 的错误句都因与该词相关的原因出错；level_7 每句只有一处错误。计划的句子索引与 plan JSON 一致。如果义项清单的负责人决定保留两个义项，这份文档可以在那时重新审阅。未能运行 fat_seed_runner plan（本次无工具）。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 本义项与 95391 重复。两者都指“新年”（春节前后的节日/时段），句子也可以互换，例如“新年前”的句子同时出现在两个义项中。学习者无法就这两个义项做出有意义的区分练习。

definition: 一个地方给人的感觉，比如热闹或安静。
reviewer_notes: Blocks checked and sound: level_3 distractors (人口/价格/包裹; 货架/价格/行李) do not fit the blank, level_6 and level_7 errors are single and correct, explanations are true. Rejection is for the duplicate only. If the team would rather keep this document, retire 95404 instead. Declined blocks not reviewed.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. Its definition and fingerprint (a place's feel or atmosphere) match 95404 almost exactly, and its examples are the same kind of sentence. Two identical-sense ladders teach nothing new and make distractors ambiguous across senses.

definition: 很多人为了一件事一起做的事。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable. Every exercise depends on unnatural sentences built on a misdefined sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 社会行动 is a sociological or political term ('social action'). Native speakers would call the community activities in these sentences 公益活动 or 社会活动. Sentences like '小区里有一次社会行动，大家一起捡垃圾' and '种树是一个很好的社会行动' are unnatural, and the definition misdescribes the word.

definition: 软软甜甜的点心，过生日时常吃。
reviewer_notes: 作为重复义项退役。若所有者决定同时保留两个“蛋糕”义项，则两者必须合并或重新界定，不能并存。其余问题仅供记录。
reviewer_issues: core.sense_fingerprint: 与 95432 为同一词义（松软烤制甜点）。“过生日时吃”是用法语境，不是独立义项。“这个蛋糕软软的”“这块蛋糕又软又甜”等句子两个义项都能套用，学习者会重复学同一义。; variants.A.level_7: 错误是补语“得”缺失（“切很整齐”），不涉及目标词“蛋糕”的用法，偏离 level_7 对目标词的要求。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “硬邦邦”的陈旧蛋糕并非绝对不合法，判错理由不够干净，母语者可能接受。

definition: 死亡，多用于意外事故。
reviewer_notes: 作为 95445 的重复义项退役。若所有者决定需要单独的“意外死亡”义项，则必须给出区别于 95445 的释义，并重新检查其句子。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “多用于意外事故”是语境倾向，不构成独立义项。与 95445 同为“人死亡”，句子（如“不幸身亡”“当场身亡”）两义都能套用。

definition: 对令人尊敬的人去世的敬称。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant core, not an unusable one: the sense duplicates 95449, and the duplicated distractors show the same spurious split. The individual blocks are mostly sound (for example, 出版 and 发表 fail as intransitive predicates), but nothing here adds a learnable distinction. If the product wants both lemmas, the senses need different definitions first, which would be a new sense design task rather than a patch.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “对令人尊敬的人去世的敬称”与 95449 的“对很受人尊敬的人去世的说法”实质相同，不构成独立义项。; variants.A.level_1 / variants.B.level_1 / synonym_antonym_match options: A level_1 与 95449 B level_1 的选项完全相同，B level_1 与 95449 A level_1 相同；两个 synonym_antonym_match 的选项也与 95449 完全相同。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “这棵老树前年逝世，树叶都落光了。”与 95449 B level_6 的第一个错句完全相同。

definition: 第一个，或者每个月的第一天。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable because it pins two senses. B.level_6 and B.level_7 use the ordinal or date sense inconsistently with their anchor sentences. Regenerate everything after splitting the senses.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition and fingerprint combine two senses: 'first in a sequence' (ordinal) and 'first day of the month' (date). The sentences mix them: 0-3 and 6-8 are dates, while 4, 5 and 9 are ordinals. Every downstream exercise therefore teaches two senses at once.; variants.A.level_1.options[2]: 一到 (dào) and 一笑 (xiào) differ from 号 (hào) in the initial consonant, not the tone. They are weak listening distractors.

definition: 序列中的第一个；每月的第一天。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝原因是义项重复，而非块内容的质量问题。其 A 与 B 的其它块与计划一致，未发现其它缺陷。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95467 为同一义项（“序列中的第一个；每月的第一天”与“第一个，或者每个月的第一天”含义相同）。两个义项会让学习者在同一义项上做重复练习。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “这部动画的一号很精彩”可按“序列中的第一个”义理解，不是可靠的错误句。与 95467 的缺陷相同。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “这部剧的一号很感人”同样可按“序列中的第一个”义理解，不是可靠的错误句。与 95467 的缺陷相同。

definition: 管一本书或一份报纸怎样出来的那个人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only because the sense is redundant with 95476; the core is not otherwise broken. Its sentences are fine for 95476, so they can be reused there if the merge is chosen. Its variant blocks were not patched because the sense is rejected.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95476. Both define the chief editor of a book, newspaper or magazine. Their fingerprints and example sentences overlap almost entirely (for example, 这家报纸的主编换人了 and 作者给主编写了一封信 fit either). A learner cannot pin one sense to a sentence.

definition: 力气；力量。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on the core, so no patches are proposed. Block-level observations for reference only: A level_3 (腿上的劲) and B level_3 (使出了很大的劲) distractors are not defensibly correct. A level_6 and B level_6 wrong sentences are wrong for stated reasons. Keep 95489 as the body-strength sense. Declined synonym_antonym_match (no_relation) is final and not reported.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense cannot be separated from sense 95489 (身体里的力气). All 10 sentences use 劲 as physical strength (e.g. 他年轻时劲大，一个人能扛两袋米 matches 95489's 这个孩子劲很大). The definition 力气；力量 and fingerprint 力气、力量，可指用在某处的力 do not distinguish it. Two senses a learner cannot tell apart lead to distractors that are defensibly correct in both.

definition: 高级军官；率领军队的人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant core, not for a content error. The option blocks are sound on their own: A level_3 distractors are not defensible in sentence 0, A level_6 has 3 wrong plus 1 correct, A level_7 error is the classifier 只 with 人, B level_7 error is the redundant 们 after 这三位, and the plan's indices match the document. If the editor would rather keep 95528 and drop 95527, swap the two rejections.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as 95527 (带兵打仗的军官). The fingerprint 地位较高、指挥军队 adds no distinction a learner could test, and the sentences use the word the same way 95527 does.

definition: 对三至六岁儿童进行学前教育的机构。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝原因是义项重复。其定义（限定三至六岁）比 95537 更精确，如编辑希望保留它，则应删除 95537，而非两者都保留。若改为保留本义项，变体 B 的 L3 干扰项“军营”（选项 3，锚句“孩子上幼儿园前要先体检”）属临界：孩子进入军营前体检虽可想象，但“上军营”并非规范搭配，应替换为明显不符的场所。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95537 指同一机构（“对三至六岁儿童进行学前教育的机构”与“小朋友上学前玩耍、学习的地方”所指相同）。两个义项会让学习者在同一义项上做重复练习。

definition: 创建某事物的人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant core, not for a content error. The option blocks are sound on their own: A level_6 wrong sentences (作者, 导演, 量词 座) are wrong for the stated reasons, B level_6 has 3 wrong plus 1 correct, B level_7 error is 只 with 人, and the plan's indices match the document. If the editor would rather keep 95540 and drop 95539, swap the two rejections.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates 95539 (把一个东西做起来的人, fingerprint 把店、学校、网站等做起来的人). Its own sentences include school, company and organization founders, which 95539 already covers.

definition: 有权利可以用某样东西的人。
reviewer_notes: 因重复义项而拒收，故未打补丁。若策展人决定保留本义项，还需处理以下问题：第 3、8 句的 furigana 只标了目标词读音，第 7 句没有 furigana，前后不一致；第 8 句“这幅画的权利人今天没来”语义别扭；声明语域为书面语，但多句偏口语。B 的 level_3 中“原告”的解释以语域为由，真正的原因是语义不通，可以接受。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95574 为同一义项（均指“享有权利的人”），仅措辞不同。两个义项之间没有学习者可辨认的对照，例句可以互换，例如“想用这首歌，要先问权利人”同样适合 95574。

definition: 别人觉得他可能做了坏事，但还没有弄清楚。
reviewer_notes: This duplicates sense 95580. Several sentences also carry a stray 'furigana' field, which is not appropriate for zh, and it is applied inconsistently. Variant B declined L1 with no_minimal_pairs even though A found valid pairs (射线, 涉险, 设限).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This is the same lexical sense as 95580 (被怀疑与违法事件有关), only reworded vaguely as '坏事'. The sentences push 涉嫌 onto school misconduct and gossip (抄袭作业, 偷看答案, 大家不理她), which is off-register for a 正式 word. The document's own L6 explanations (涉嫌只用于违法或犯罪行为) contradict this definition.

definition: 说好的一段时间有多长。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a standalone sense, so no patches. Its weaker distractors (参加, 报名) are moot.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95584. Both define 为期 as a period fixed in advance as the time limit. The fingerprints differ only in emphasis (持续 vs. 到期), and the sentence types (contracts, courses, training) are the same. Learners cannot tell the two senses apart, so their items would be near-identical.

definition: 做事很坏，不讲道理。
reviewer_notes: The core sense is not a natural modern usage. Every exercise built on these sentences would teach unidiomatic Chinese.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: 无道 is a 书面 word used of rulers and regimes (昏君无道, 无道之君). Applying it to ordinary people in colloquial frames ('那个老板很无道', '他很无道，抢了别人的东西', '你不能这么无道') is unnatural. Native speakers would say 霸道 or 不讲理. Most sentences also clash with the declared 书面 register.; variants.B.level_7: '这个老板无道' is labelled as an error for missing 很. A bare adjective predicate is fine for 无道 ('君王无道'), so the 'error' is acceptable usage.

definition: 直接归国家管的大城市。
reviewer_notes: 因重复义项而拒收，故未打补丁。若策展人决定保留，A 的 level_6 第 2 个错误句“我去过一条直辖市”考察的是量词而非义项，与 95596 中的问题相同，需要同样修正。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95596 为同一义项（直辖市，直接由国家或中央管辖的城市），定义和 sense_fingerprint 仅措辞不同。95596 的定义更精确（指明中央政府、举例北京），两者之间没有可供学习者区分的对照。

definition: 事先筹划和准备。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on the core. Its option blocks show no defect that a patch would fix, but the sense has no separate meaning to teach. Also, core sentence index 6 carries an extra 'furigana' key that is not in the schema.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95597 (same headword, same meaning: 事先筹划/准备 vs 事先把要用的东西准备好). Every sentence here also fits 95597's gloss, so the sense cannot be pinned or taught as distinct.

definition: 年老的男子。
reviewer_notes: Not patched, because the core is redundant. For reference, its A level_6 wrong sentence 我家老头今天又加班到很晚 has the same 'husband' problem as 95605 B level_6. Its other blocks were otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95605: 年老的男子 and 年纪很大的男人 are the same meaning with near-identical fingerprints. The same meaning would be taught twice.

definition: 报社为报道重大消息而临时加印的报纸。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95611, not for content. Its own material is clean: the level_3 and level_6 distractors and the level_7 量词 and 的 errors are all defensible. Keep one 号外 sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 义项“报社为报道重大消息而临时加印的报纸”与95611的“有大事发生时，临时多出的一张报纸”几乎相同，sense_fingerprint也重合，同一句可同时归入两个义项。

definition: 拿钱去换自己想要的东西。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for a sentence defect. Findings if the sense were kept: (1) variants.A.level_3.options[3] (挖掘) explanation says 挖掘 cannot take 钱 as its object, but 钱 is the instrument in the blank sentence, so the explanation is misdirected; the real reason is that 挖掘 does not take 东西 here. (2) The level_1 decline is acceptable: 卖东西 is a tone pair, but there are too few candidates for a 4-option block. Level_3, level_6, level_7 and the antonym blocks in both variants were checked and hold.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95626. Both define 买东西 as buying goods, and the sentence pools are interchangeable: '我带了五百块钱去买东西' fits either sense. The two senses teach one meaning twice.

definition: 路途之中。
reviewer_notes: The sentences and blocks are internally sound (the distractors are clearly wrong and the level_6 and level_7 items are valid), so the only reason to reject is the duplicate sense. The core is not usable as a distinct sense, so nothing is patched. The curator should merge or drop it.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 95627. 路途之中 and 在路上，还没有到目的地 describe the same situation, and the two fingerprints overlap completely. The same meaning would be taught twice under two ids.

definition: 比另一事物的数量或程度更高。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95635. Its definition (比另一事物的数量或程度更高) is a narrower restatement of the same sense, with fingerprints overlapping on 价格 and 水平; the general 95635 is kept. The two issues above would also need fixing if a human chooses to keep 95636 instead. Level_3, level_1, level_7 (A and B) and the antonym match are otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “三高于二”在数学语境中可以接受，而解释“高于不用于数字的大小比较”不真实，因为“这个数高于那个数”是正常说法。该句不是可靠的错误句。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “这台机器的质量高于了那场比赛”是范畴错误，解释给出的修正词“胜过”同样说不通（“这台机器的质量胜过那场比赛”仍是胡话），修正方案不成立。

definition: 收了很多钱，用来帮助别人的一个组织。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95670. The synonym_antonym decline (no_relation) is acceptable: 基金会 has no antonym, and its hypernyms are not synonyms. Other blocks were checked; the only defect beyond the duplication is the copied level_7 noted above.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95670. Both define 基金会 as a donation-funded charitable organisation. Sense 95669's definition ('收了很多钱') is also a weaker gloss.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: Variant B level_7 is a verbatim copy of variant A level_7 ('我基金会里工作。' / '我在基金会里工作。'). The checklist requires B to be rewritten when it copies A.

definition: 正常收入以外额外得到的钱。
reviewer_notes: The blocks are otherwise well built, but if the sense were kept, two defects would need fixing. (1) Variant A level_3 option 房租 has the same overstated explanation as 95673 (“不能说‘挣房租’”). (2) Variant B level_6 wrong sentence 还了外快 has the same false explanation as 95673 (“不能用来偿还贷款”). Variant B level_6 wrong sentences are also identical to 95673 B level_6.
reviewer_issues: core: This sense duplicates 95673. The glosses (“正常收入以外额外得到的钱” vs “除了平常的工资以外，另外挣到的钱”) and all ten sentences describe the same sense. No exercise can separate the two, and distractors in one block would be defensibly correct for the other.

definition: 非常非常多的信息，要用电脑才能看完。
reviewer_notes: Each sentence and option block is clean on its own terms, so the content could be reused under 95676 if the curator wants it. The problem is that the sense itself is redundant. The 台 and 们 error templates also nearly repeat 95676.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same referent as sense 95676 (规模巨大、需用计算机处理分析的数据集合). Standard dictionaries give 大数据 one sense, and this lay paraphrase describes that same sense. Teaching it as a separate sense would present one meaning twice, and the learner could not tell the two apart.

definition: 年纪较小的女性；女孩。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项与 95677 重复，不能作为独立的教学义项，因此判退。其余练习（level_3 的正确答案“女孩子”、level_6 与 level_7 的序号）与 plan 一致，干扰项也基本成立，但这些都改变不了义项重复的问题。level_6 的错误句同样只测量词。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “年纪较小的女性；女孩”与 95677 的“年纪小的女生”实为同一义项，被拆成两个重复的感义。句 7“没有女孩子”取“女儿”义，其余句子则是泛指女孩，义项边界混杂，无法形成清楚的单一义项。; core.sentences[4]: “我想要一个女孩子，叫她小美”生硬，“想要一个女孩子”的说法不自然。

definition: 经过比较后选择某一方面，表示情愿。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant core, so no patches were written. Reviewing it anyway surfaced further problems that would need fixing if it were kept as a distinct sense. Its A level_6 wrong sentence 「我宁愿跑步，也要跑步」 has the same 〈干脆〉 explanation problem as 95683. Its B level_6 wrong sentences are identical to 95683 B, including the 「天下雨」 sentence, which is defensibly acceptable. The sentence 「我宁愿现在难一点，以后就轻松了」 is unnatural. Keep 95683 as the single 宁愿 sense unless a real second sense can be defined.
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: This sense duplicates 95683. Both have the same POS and register and the same meaning (prefer one option, with the cost accepted). The difference between 也要 and 也不 is a construction difference, not a sense difference. Learners would meet two items with the same answer, and the fingerprint does not separate them.

definition: 几乎；险些。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，因为它只是 95691 的重复。无需逐块修补。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95691 完全重复：二者都表示“险些发生但未发生”，sense_fingerprint 只是换了措辞，level_1 选项也完全相同。两个义项无法在教学中区分，学习者会得到相互矛盾或冗余的练习。

definition: 说起；谈到。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95703, so not patched. The level_1 defects in 95703's variant B would also apply here.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 95703 ('说话的时候，说到某件事或某个人' vs '说起；谈到'). Two senses for one meaning would teach the same thing twice and split the sentence pool.

definition: 把掉在地上的东西拿起来。
reviewer_notes: If the curator keeps 95705 instead of 95706, its level_3 A options 买 and 扔 must be replaced. 书掉在地上，我去买 can mean buy a replacement book, and 书掉在地上，我去扔 can mean throw it away, so both fit the blank defensibly. Its level_1 A and B sets, level_6 and level_7 blocks are otherwise clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 95706 (拾起；拿起地上的东西). The two senses differ only in wording, so the learner would be taught one meaning twice.

definition: 一个国家或种类没有了，不再有了。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95720 (keep that one). The sentence-level content is otherwise sound, but the level_1 blocks are unusable for 灭亡.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Near-identical to 95720 ('国家、种族等不再存在；消失'). Both cover a nation or species ceasing to exist.; core.sentences[1]: '很多古老的民族已经灭亡' uses 民族 (ethnic group), which this definition's 国家或种类 does not cover. It drifts toward 95720.; variants.A.level_1.options and variants.B.level_1.options: The distractors (体积, 梯级, 题记, 体己 and 提起, 提价, 提纪, 提气) are copied from the 提及 senses. Their explanations admit they share no initial or final with miè wáng, so none is a listening confuser.

definition: 火灾是东西着了大火。大火会烧坏房子，也会让人受伤。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项与 95724 重复，不能单独成立，故 reject，不给补丁。若因故必须保留此条，则 variants.A.level_6 的错误句“消防员冲进火灾，把老人背了出来”只依赖“冲进火灾”的转喻用法，属于临界，需要替换。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95724 为同一义项（均指火失控而烧毁财物、伤害人的灾害事故），sense_fingerprint 也只是措辞不同。同一义项拆成两条会重复教学，并使消歧失去意义。

definition: 无间是两个人很好很好，好得像中间没有空隙。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core usage of the target word is unnatural.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: 无间 is essentially bound to fixed forms such as 亲密无间, 合作无间 and 配合无间. Standalone '感情无间' and '情谊依然无间' are unidiomatic, so most of the core sentences are unnatural. The declared 书面 register also clashes with the colloquial T3 sentences.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences: In '很无间', the sentence is wrong first because 无间 cannot take 很. The labeled reason (wrong object type) is not the real defect.; variants.A.level_1.options[1]: 无限 (and 无线 in B) differ from 无间 in initial plus tone, which is weak sound confusability. 无限 may also be heard as a near-homophone.

definition: 某事物所独有的，别的事物不具备的。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项与 95731 重复，故 reject，不给补丁。若此条因故保留，则 variants.A.level_6 的三个错误句（写作风格、装修、设计）都只是“很特有”一种错误，学习者只会学到一个窄规则，应换成不同类型的错误。其余 blocks 核对无误。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “某事物所独有的，别的事物不具备的”与 95731 的“只有这一个才有，别的都没有”同义；fingerprint 仅在例子领域上不同（风味 / 文化 vs 动植物）。同一义项重复教学。

definition: 省份是一个国家里分出来的大块地方。每个省份都有自己的名字。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95736, which should be kept. Also weak in this sense: B level_6's three wrong sentences (每一条 / 每一块 / 每一片省份) fail only on the measure word, so the item tests classifiers, not the sense. A level_6 wrong sentence 3 (我家在一只靠海的省份) is the same kind of measure-word error. The A level_3 distractor 鸡蛋 is weak but not clearly wrong.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates 95736 (both mean the province-level administrative region). The sense_fingerprints are nearly identical. Two ladders would test the same meaning with the same kinds of sentences and distractors.; variants.A.level_1.options[3].explanation: 生分 is pronounced shēng fèn, not fēn. The only difference from 省份 is the tone of the first syllable, so the stated reason is false.

definition: 围着中心转动；缠住；不走直路而走弯路。
reviewer_notes: The core is not single-sense, so every downstream block inherits the ambiguity.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition bundles three senses (围着转, 缠住, 走弯路), so the core cannot pin one sense. The sentences mix 缠绕 (sentences 0, 1, 3, 4) with detour/circling uses, and the circling and detour uses duplicate sense 95747. A stray furigana field also appears on sentence 8.

definition: 兄弟姐妹中排行第一的人；也指团体里的头领。
reviewer_notes: Rebuild this sense as the 头领 sense only. With the current definition, several blocks are ambiguous. For example, B level_3 and A level_6 both draw on the two senses.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two distinct senses: the eldest sibling and the leader of a group. The sentences mix both senses, for example 0/1/4/6/8 are sibling and 2/3/5/7/9 are leader. The sibling sense also duplicates sense 95749.

definition: 指机器设备在没有人直接操作的情况下，按要求自动工作。
reviewer_notes: The sentences are individually fine. The defect is structural: this sense cannot be distinguished from 95755 for the learner or for the judges. Its exercise content would be redundant with 95755.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95755. Both say the machine works automatically without direct human operation, and the sense_fingerprints are the same. 自动化 has no second sense to teach, so the sentences cannot be pinned to this sense, and the sense-pinned semantic exercises would be ambiguous.

definition: 穿在腰部以下、遮盖双腿的衣服。
reviewer_notes: Not patched because the sense is redundant, not because its content is wrong. If the pipeline keeps it anyway, it needs the same level_1 fix as 95761 (its A level_1 options are the old 95761 B set, and its B level_1 options are the old 95761 A set, both with the same weak items).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as sense 95761 (trousers worn on the legs). It is a duplicate sense, not a distinct one. Its level_1 option sets are also the 95761 sets with A and B swapped.

definition: 本周的前一周。
reviewer_notes: 驳回的原因是重复义项，而不是内容失败。本条的各个块，除上面列出的问题外，其它的判断都是合理的。请只保留 95787；若两者都保留，就会在学习者面前把同一个词义教授两次。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95787 是同一个义项：“本周的前一周”与“这个星期的前一个星期”含义相同，sense_fingerprint 也几乎一样。这里是重复，而不是内容错误。; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: “往昔”可以填入空缺（“往昔我去了北京”），语义通顺，属于可辩护的正确答案。; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: “昔日”可以填入空缺（“昔日妈妈给我打过电话”），语义通顺，属于可辩护的正确答案。; variants.A.level_7.error_description: 说明写作“后面不能加‘的’”，但正确句 1（“上周的天气一直很好”）中的“上周的”恰恰是名词修饰，两者容易让学习者混淆。

definition: 指网站、软件、系统等开始运行或对外使用；也指登录网络。
reviewer_notes: Reject for sense pinning and duplication, not for block quality. I checked every A and B block: each has exactly one correct option, distractors are not defensibly correct, and explanations are true. A.level_1 上香 has the same weak-confusable issue as 95789. Sentences 0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 and 9 are launch-sense and usable if the launch meaning is kept in 95789 only. Plan indices match the document. Core sentences untouched.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition and fingerprint bundle two senses: 开始运行或对外使用 (launch) and 登录网络 (log in). The launch part duplicates sense 95789, so the entry is not pinned to one sense.; core.sentences[4]: Sentences 4 (他每天晚上八点准时上线和朋友聊天), 5 (你上线的时候，请给我发一条消息) and 8 (他的账号昨天晚上没有上线过) use the log-in sense, while sentences 0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 and 9 use the launch sense. The sentence set therefore violates one-sense pinning.

definition: 经过处理后可再次利用、但不能饮用的水，介于上水和下水之间。
reviewer_notes: 因为是重复义项，不做补丁，直接拒收。其 A/B 的 level_3、level_6、level_7 句子与 95793 高度相似，撤销后无需保留。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 sense 95793 为同一义项：二者都指经处理后可再用、不能喝、可冲厕所的再生水。“介于上水和下水之间”只是系统位置说明，没有任何句子或干扰项体现这一区别，因此不构成独立义项。两个义项会让学习者重复学习同一个词义。

definition: 使用或办事方便，不费事。
reviewer_notes: Not patched because the sense is redundant. If the pipeline keeps it anyway, B level_7 has the same problem as 95801: “手续比便利多了” has a recoverable comparand, so the claim that it is ungrammatical is weak and it needs the same kind of replacement. Its A level_1 options duplicate the 95801 A set. The synonym_antonym_match options are sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as sense 95801 (convenient / easy to do). It is a duplicate sense.

definition: 话说得中听，听起来让人舒服。
reviewer_notes: 因为是重复义项，不做补丁，直接拒收。它的句子并没有引入 95819 所没有的用法。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 sense 95819 为同一义项：二者都指话说得中听、让人听了舒服。sense_fingerprint 也几乎相同，属于重复义项。; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match and variants.B.synonym_antonym_match: 同样误以 no_relation 放弃，但受听的反义词“难听”明确存在。

definition: 单位元是数学里的一个特别的数。它和别的数一起算，别的数不会变。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as a standalone sense because it duplicates 95822. Apart from that, the option blocks are mostly sound: each level_3 block has exactly one correct option; the level_6 wrong sentences fail for the stated reasons (逆元, 幂等元, 〈单位〉); the level_7 errors are single and the corrected sentences are right. The level_1 and synonym_antonym_match declines (no_minimal_pairs, no_relation) are acceptable. Minor register drift: sentence 5 (你知道加法的单位元是几吗？) is conversational against a declared 书面 register. The plan command was not run (no tools), so I checked against the plan JSON as supplied.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95822. Both describe the same concept (the identity element) and the sentences overlap in content (零是加法里的单位元 vs 加法的单位元是零). Two senses for one meaning would teach the learner two entries for one word.; core.definition: The definition 数学里的一个特别的数 says the identity element is a number. That is false in general: identity elements of matrix groups, function spaces and similar structures are not numbers. sense_fingerprint repeats the error (数学里和别的数一起算时…的特别的数).

definition: 植物学上指叶子在茎的每个节上相对着长出两片。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95843, so no patches were written. If it were kept, two further problems would need fixing. (1) core.sentences[3] '薄荷的叶序是对生，不是互生。' puts the answer 互生 in the stem of the antonym exercise, which gives it away. (2) A level_7 uses the same bare-predicate '是对生' error as 95843 A level_7, which is marginal.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 95843: both describe leaves arranged in opposite pairs on each node of the stem. Teaching both creates duplicate exercises with the same correct answer.

definition: 对男孩子或年轻男子的称呼，口语里常带亲昵或轻视的意味。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for block defects. Its blocks are otherwise close to clean, so the rejection rests only on the duplication. Keep 95845, whose definition is more precise. If the owner wants a separate 年轻男子 sense, that needs a new sentence set and an inventory decision, which is outside this review. If it were kept, B level_1 would carry the same 小崽 near-synonym problem noted for 95845.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95845. Both teach 小子 as a term for a boy, with the same affectionate or dismissive tone. The added 年轻男子 reading is not carried by a separate sentence set; the usage in its sentences matches 95845.

definition: 平方公里是量一块地有多大的单位。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，因为它与 95850 重复。无需逐块修补。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95850 重复：二者都是“平方公里”这一面积单位，区分不成立。本义项的释义“量一块地有多大的单位”限定为土地，但其例句包括国家、山、草原等，且释义本身循环（“平方公里是…的单位”）。

definition: 好的境遇或机会。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for block defects. Had it been kept, A level_6 wrong sentence 他在国外找到了一条更好的机遇 nearly copies correct sentence index 3, 他在国外找到了更好的机遇. Only the classifier differs, so the item tests 量词 rather than the sense. The A and B level_7 blocks are otherwise fine.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95867 (恰好碰上的好机会). Most sentences teach the same general opportunity meaning, such as 终于等到了机遇 and 有人把困难看成机遇. The 境遇 or environment reading in the fingerprint is carried by only a few sentences.

definition: 洪水是河里的水突然变得特别多，漫到岸上来。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for sentence quality. Its sentences and variant blocks were otherwise clean (I found no homograph drift, no defensibly correct distractors, and no multi-error level_7 items), so they can be reused if the inventory is deduplicated the other way. Do not rewrite both senses.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. The definition (河里的水突然变得特别多，漫到岸上来) describes the same meaning as sense 95872 (河水暴涨泛滥形成的大水). Teaching both as separate senses presents one meaning twice.

definition: 没有关联；不相干。
reviewer_notes: 判 reject 的理由是与 95875 重复，而不是核心不可用。若决定两者都保留，须同时修正 B.level_1.options[2] 与 B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]。其余 block 检查通过：A 层 level_3、level_6、level_7 与 synonym_antonym_match 的正确选项唯一，错句均确有错误。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 95875 为同一义项（与某事没有关系，即“与…无干”），释义仅措辞不同，同一义项被拆成两个 sense_id，学习者会在同一层级重复学到同一义项。; variants.B.level_1.options[2]: 与 95875 相同：语感（yǔ gǎn）与 wú gān 韵母与两个声调均不同，不是合格的听感混淆项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 与 95875 相同：解释断言“无干不能与紧要连用”，但“无干紧要”可视为“无关紧要”的变体，错句不确定。

definition: 真实的人，区别于图画、模型、玩偶等。
reviewer_notes: 判 reject 的理由是与 95885 重复，而不是核心不可用。若决定两者都保留，须修正 B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]。其余检查通过：A 层 level_3 的正确选项唯一（比真人还高），level_6 与 level_7 的错句均确有错误（量词误用、与“只”相关的动物量词误用）。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 95885 为同一义项（真实的人，相对于图画、假物或模型），释义与例句模式高度重叠，同一义项被拆成两个 sense_id。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “真人”在口语中可指真诚直率的人，“他是个真人，说话从不绕弯子”未必确定错误；解释“不表示为人诚实”过于绝对。

definition: 习俗是很多人长久以来都这样做的事。
reviewer_notes: reject 的原因是核心义项与 95906 重复，无法单独成为一个义项，因此不提供补丁。另有两点供参考：(1) variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence「当地人一直遵守这个习俗的。」的错误在于句末「的」缺少「是」的强调语境，判断有争议，若保留需确认。(2) plan 中 active_levels 包含 2、4、9，但 blocks 中没有对应块。本次审阅无法运行 fat_seed_runner，未验证 plan 是否需要重新生成。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95906 指同一义项（长期形成的社会习俗），同一词义以两个义项出现，学习者会看到重复内容。; core.morphological_forms[1]: 個 是「个」的繁体，不是「习俗」的繁体形式。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 「学校的习俗」可指学校长期形成的做法，母语者可能接受，此干扰句不合格。

definition: 联合会是由好几个团体合起来的大团体。
reviewer_notes: Reject the core as a duplicate of 95908. The group-versus-individual split does not hold, since several of its sentences (3, 8, 9) and the 95908 sentences use the same membership reading. Keep 95908 as the only sense for 联合会. The A and B L3 and L6 blocks here are otherwise well formed, but they cannot be taught as a separate sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The sense is a duplicate of 95908 ('由若干团体或个人联合组成的组织'). The only split is group versus individual membership, which is not a lexical distinction. A learner cannot be taught two senses here.; core.sense_fingerprint: The fingerprint is not distinct from 95908 and cannot be used to disambiguate.; core.sentences[3]: 学生联合会帮同学解决问题 serves individual students, which is the 95908 reading and not the group reading claimed in the definition.; core.sentences[8]: 妈妈参加了妇女联合会的活动 is individual membership, which contradicts the stated group sense.; core.sentences[9]: 我想加入这个联合会 is individual joining, which is the 95908 reading.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: The incorrect sentence, corrected sentence and error description are verbatim identical to variants.A.level_7. A and B are copies.

definition: 记者站是新闻记者在外地工作的地方。
reviewer_notes: The blocks are otherwise sound. L3 distractors are clearly wrong, L6 and L7 each have a single clean error, and the L1 decline for no minimal pair is plausible. No sentence is marked mined. Rejected only because the sense is redundant.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Sense duplicates 95920. Both describe the same referent, a bureau that reporters staff in another city. Sentences such as “报社在上海有一个记者站” fit 95920's definition equally well, so the two senses do not discriminate.

definition: 访谈是一个人去问另一个人问题，听他讲。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95922. The sense is redundant, not unusable as a gloss. The document has no source fields, so no mined-sentence constraint applies. active_levels includes 2, 4 and 9 but the document has no blocks for them. Plan re-run needed only if this sense survives.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Near-duplicate of sense 95922. '去问别人问题并听对方讲' and '面对面交谈以了解情况听取意见' describe the same meaning, and no sentence here shows a distinct sense.; core.morphological_forms[2]: '访谈录' is a derived noun, not an inflected form of the verb 访谈.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: '上个月访谈着几位退休教师' is a durative past reading and can be grammatical. The stated reason (着 conflicts with a completed past time) is misleading, so the sentence does not reliably fail for the annotated reason.; core.sentences[7]: '我们先访谈，再写报告' uses 访谈 with no object and reads weakly.

definition: 转载是把别人写的文章拿来，放到另一个地方登出来。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95926. The sense is redundant, not unusable as a gloss. No source fields are present, so no mined-sentence constraint applies. active_levels includes 2, 4 and 9 but the document has no blocks for them.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 95926. '把别人写的文章拿来，放到另一个地方登出来' and '把已经发表过的文章从一处刊载到另一处' are the same sense. The 95926 gloss is more precise.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: '作者在论文里转载了一段话' is borderline: 转载 of a passage is used in online contexts, so the sentence may be acceptable.; core.sentences[3]: Only this sentence carries an extra 'furigana' key; no other sentence in the document has it.

definition: 通向某地。
reviewer_notes: Blocks individually look fine, but the core is redundant. The judge should not accept two senses that describe the same meaning. The A level_1 options are copied verbatim from 95929, which is consistent with the duplicate.
reviewer_issues: sense 95930 as a whole: Duplicate sense. '通向某地' with fingerprint '道路、桥梁等通向某个地方' is the same sense as 95929 ('路可以走到某个地方'). The usage in the sentences is also identical, so the learner would see one sense taught twice.

definition: 开间是房子里一间屋子左右有多宽。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for sentence quality. The blocks checked out: level_3 distractors (颜色, 重量, 价格 / 声音, 年龄, 味道) are not defensibly correct, level_6 wrong sentences are clearly wrong, and each level_7 item has exactly one error. Its sentences can be reused if the inventory is deduplicated the other way.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 开间是房子里一间屋子左右有多宽 describes the same meaning as sense 95934 (建筑物中相邻两道横墙之间的距离，即房间的宽度). Both fingerprints are the left–right width of a room.

definition: 顶级是最好最好，排在最上面。
reviewer_notes: The A level_7 explanation ('双音节形容词不能重叠') is also a false general rule, since many two-syllable adjectives reduplicate (漂亮 to 漂漂亮亮). The B level_1 decline is weak because A found minimal pairs (定级, 等级, 丙级, 丁级) for the same word and pronunciation. Level_3 and level_6 blocks are otherwise clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Garbled definition: '顶级是最好最好，排在最上面。' has a doubled '最好最好' and is not a usable gloss.; sense 95937 as a whole: Duplicate sense. 95937 ('最好的，排在最上面的') and 95938 ('级别最高的，最上等的') describe the same adjectival sense of 顶级 with the same example types.; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match: Declined with no_relation, but 低级 is a direct antonym of 顶级 in its 'top grade' sense. The decline is not justified.

definition: 束头发或装饰头发的带子。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95943; no patches, since the core is unusable as a separate sense. The sentences are otherwise clean (level_3 distractors are clearly wrong, level_6 and level_7 errors are valid), so the content can be reused under 95943 if wanted. If the lexicon needs a decorative sense, it needs a different fingerprint and a new sentence set, not this document.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 束头发或装饰头发的带子 names the same referent as sense 95943 (绑头发或戴在头上的带子). There is no lexical split, and 95944 sentence 8 (她用发带把长头发束了起来) duplicates 95943 sentence 5 (她把头发用发带绑起来了). Keeping both creates two senses a learner cannot tell apart.; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match: This block is not in the plan for this sense (plan A lists only level_1, level_3, level_6 and level_7). It is extra.

definition: 汇报是把做的事情告诉别人。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as a distinct sense. Every sentence depends on playful register, and sentence 9 drifts into the formal sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Standard dictionaries list no '汇报 = tell family or friends what one did' sense. The sentences use a jocular, mock-formal extension of the reporting-to-superiors sense, which is sense 95966. Teaching it as a separate neutral sense misleads learners. Distractors for this sense would also collide with 95966.; core.sentences[9]: 老师让同学们汇报假期做过的事 is reporting to a teacher, a superior. That is sense 95966, not the casual sense.; core.sentences[2].furigana: Stray pinyin field labelled 'furigana' on a zh sentence.

definition: 在某方面特别擅长。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项重复，因此不提供补丁。各个块本身大体合格（拙于正确，level_7 的错误单一，锚句无误），但不应作为第二个义项上线。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95979 为同一义项：两者都表示“擅长做某事／在某方面擅长”，句型与语境完全重叠。同一意义会被学习两次，两道题的正确答案也相同。; core.ipa: 与 95979 相同：“ɕan” 应为 “ʂan”。

definition: 外贸是和别的国家买东西、卖东西。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not because its items are broken. If the 'trade as a job' usage is wanted, merge its sentences into 95990. If this document were kept, its A level_7 error ('一外贸公司') is about the classifier for 公司 rather than the target word, which would also need rework.
reviewer_issues: core: Same sense as 95990 (foreign trade: buying and selling goods between countries). The definition and fingerprint differ only in wording ('生意或工作' vs '对外贸易'). Two senses for one meaning, and the level_1 options are identical to 95990's.

definition: 夜晚是天黑了的时候。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝而非修补：问题在义项切分本身，替换句子无法让两个义项可区分。两义项应合并为 95992。未产出补丁。本环境无工具，未运行 fat_seed_runner。
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: 与 95992 实为同一义项的两种切分。“天黑了的时候”与“从天黑到天亮的时间”无法区分：如“小孩怕夜晚，因为什么也看不见”“夜晚的海边又黑又冷”“每到夜晚，小猫就爬到我的床上”等句只能按时段义理解，违反义项指定。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “夜晚十二点”的解释称夜晚“不与具体钟点连用”，不实：夜晚加钟点并非不合语法，该句不能确定为错误句。

definition: 大使馆是一个国家在别的国家办事的地方。
reviewer_notes: 与 95994 重复，应保留 95994。其余块中，A 组 level_3 的“医院／超市／花园”、level_6 的“只／张／看病”错句、level_7 的“只”和“们”错误均设计正确；但 B 组 level_3 的干扰项问题如上所述。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95994 为同一义项：都指一国派驻他国的外交机构（大使馆）。两个义项会产生重复练习。; core.definition: “在别的国家办事的地方”过宽，同样涵盖领事馆，无法把大使馆与领事馆区分开。; variants.B.level_3.options: 锚句“我们在大使馆见到了大使”里，“厨房”“操场”作为见面地点在语境上仍可成立，干扰项不够干净。

definition: 旧时对饭馆、旅店里伙计的称呼。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on duplication, not on the sentences. The only real difference from 95999 is that this sense mentions 旅店. The blocks are otherwise clean. If this sense is kept anyway, B level_6 wrong sentence 1 ('小二在柜台后面算账') has the same arguable-accounting problem as 95999 A level_6 and needs replacing.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95999. Both mean the same thing (a restaurant or inn attendant, glossed 'waiter'). Every block would have 小二 as its answer, so a learner cannot tell the two senses apart.

definition: 爱心是心里想帮助别人、对别人好的心意。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝为重复义项，96010 为保留者。各块在独立看来基本成立，但合并后即失效。本环境无工具，未运行 fat_seed_runner。
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: 与 96010 为同一义项：“想帮助别人、对别人好的心意”与“关爱、同情他人的心”几乎等同。同一词两个义项会让学习者看到重复词条，两套练习的答案也可互换。; core.morphological_forms[2]: “愛心”是繁体字形，不是形态变体或量词，以 form_label“繁体”生成形式练习没有语法意义。

definition: 用手握着东西顺着捋；也指把袖子等向上卷起。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝：核心并未锁定单一义项，且卷袖义的句子与 96019 完全重复。需要先重新划定义项（建议保留“用手握着东西顺着捋”，句 0、1、2、5、7 已基本符合，卷袖相关句子应替换），然后重写定义与指纹、修正句 7 的注音，并在完成改写后重新运行计划命令，因为各区块依赖句子内容。在重新划定之前，不对其逐块打补丁。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把两个义项并列（用手握着东西顺着捋；把袖子卷起），违反“锁定唯一义项”的要求。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹同样混合了两个义项，无法消歧。; core.sentences[3]: “他撸了一下袖子”属卷袖义，与其余句子的捋取义混用。; core.sentences[4]: “孩子撸起衣袖”属卷袖义，与捋取义混用。; core.sentences[6]: “厨师撸起袖子”属卷袖义，与捋取义混用。; core.sentences[8]: “我撸起袖子”属卷袖义，与捋取义混用。; core.sentences[9]: “大哥撸起袖子”属卷袖义，与捋取义混用。; core.sentences[7].furigana: 注音为“lǔ”，撸应为 lū（第一声）。

definition: 病例是一个人生了某种病的记录。
reviewer_notes: level_1 的“冰梨”不是真实词语。B.level_6 的“病例们”也不成立。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义“生病的记录”是“病历”（bìng lì，同音词）的意思，不是“病例”。全部例句（“看你的病例”“复印病例”“写病例”等）都把“病历”误写成“病例”，属同形/同音误用，核心不可用。

definition: 研究人员是专门学习、查找新知识的人。
reviewer_notes: The L3, L6 and L7 blocks are well formed, and the L1 decline is plausible. Rejected because the sense is a redundant near-duplicate with a mis-glossed definition, not because of any single block.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Gloss “专门学习、查找新知识的人” describes a learner, not a researcher. It duplicates 96062 (“从事科学研究工作的人”) in referent. Sentence #5 (“研究人员像学生一样”) shows the drift: it compares the referent to a student.

definition: 不许；制止。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense; the core is unusable as a separate sense. Its blocks were checked and would pass if the sense were kept: level_1, level_3, level_6, level_7 and synonym_antonym are all clean. Those blocks can move to 96067's pool if the senses are merged.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 96067. Both describe the same meaning (不许 / 禁止) and the fingerprints differ only in wording. All ten sentences use 禁 in the 不许 sense and none is specific to 制止, so the sense has no content of its own.

definition: 听讲、读书时记录下来的内容。
reviewer_notes: 作为重复义项直接拒绝，无需修补。保留 96069 作为唯一的听讲或看书记录义。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 96069 几乎无法区分（同样是听讲或看书时记下的内容），学习者无从判断句子属于哪一义项，属于重复义项。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 句中不含目标词“笔记”，不能作为语义辨别的错误句。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “他写了三页笔记”完全正确，解释却说应用〈页〉而非“只”，句子与解释矛盾。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “老师布置了笔记作业”可以成立，错误理由偏弱。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “他写了一篇笔记”完全正确，解释却说应用〈篇〉而非“支”，句子与解释矛盾。

definition: 碰到；遇见。
reviewer_notes: 作为重复义项直接拒绝。若日后重建为独立义项，还需修正以下问题：A 的 level_6 错误句“孩子终于遇上了钥匙。”用的是偶然找到义，并不错误；“孩子在家遇上课文。”过于牵强；B 的 level_3 干扰项“讨论”可以接人作宾语（讨论某人），不能只说“讨论的对象不能是人”；A 的 level_3 干扰项“挑选”偏弱，需要复核；A 的 level_7 错误句“他在公司遇上一个难题。”同样属于漏“了”的边界情况。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “碰到；遇见”与 96099 的“在路上或事情中正好碰到”是同一个义项。sense_fingerprint 也几乎相同，两条的 level_1 选项集完全一样，10 个句子都是同一用法。同一个义项被教授两次，练习会重复。

definition: 从过去到现在一直。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate only; the individual blocks were not otherwise judged. If the duplicate is ever kept instead of 96125, B level_6 wrong sentence 3 (小王一向戒烟了。) is borderline and should be replaced with a clearly time-conflicting sentence. Its A and B level_3 options and A level_6 are otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 96125: 从过去到现在一直如此, with the same pos, semantic_class, register and fingerprint. This is a duplicate sense, not a second one.

definition: 楼房的第一层；也指一个层面。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is unusable as one sense. Several blocks also mix senses: B level_6 wrong sentences test floor-sense errors against a figurative correct sentence, and A level_6 uses floor-sense distractors. The floor-sense sentences (商场的一层卖化妆品, 我在一层停车, 地铁站在一层, 医院的一层是挂号的地方, 一层的灯坏了) duplicate 96127. Figurative sentences (他的话里还有一层意思, 这件事还有一层原因, 这个故事还有一层深意, 他想到了更深的一层, 你想想这里面的一层关系) need a separate sense and plan. No sentence is marked mined.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition fuses two senses: 楼房的第一层 and 引申为一个层面 (a figurative layer). Its sentences mix both: floor sentences (0, 2, 4, 6, 8) and figurative sentences (1, 3, 5, 7, 9). This breaks the rule that every sentence uses one sense.

definition: 身体健康没有残缺；制度完备。
reviewer_notes: Also remove the stray furigana fields on sentences 5 and 8 when re-seeding. In level_6 A, 他走路很健全 and 这座山很健全 are acceptable wrong sentences, but the 高大 explanation (不形容体形) conflicts with a body sense. Regenerate these after the split.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses: 身体没有残缺 and 制度完备. Sentences 3, 4, 6, 7 and 8 use the institutional sense, which duplicates 96141. The B L3 anchor (index 6) is institutional while the A L3 anchor is physical. This violates the one-sense rule.

definition: 参见别处的相关内容。
reviewer_notes: Judged as a separate sense only, so reject. Sentences and blocks are otherwise sound, with valid L3 distractors (修理/跳/唱) and correct L6 and L7 indices. L7 A 「相关内容另见在附表」 is marginal; 「在」 is not clearly ungrammatical there. The same level_1 decline issue as 96163 applies if the sense is ever reinstated.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 96163 的义项完全重复：「参见别处的相关内容」与「告诉你去别的地方看相关的内容」指同一用法，两个义项会生成内容重复的练习。

definition: 国际媒体是在很多国家都能看到的新闻报道。
reviewer_notes: The core is not a real distinct sense of 国际媒体, so all blocks are unusable.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition is wrong: 国际媒体 means news outlets or organizations, not 'news reports'. Every sentence actually uses it as the outlet that produces 报道, which is the 96166 sense. This makes the sense an invalid duplicate. Sentences 1 and 5 (国际媒体报道上了头版 / 报道很多) are also awkward.

definition: 大国是土地很大、人很多、很有力量的国家。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as an unusable core, so no patches are applied. The sense cannot be taught separately from 96172 as currently defined. Any replacement needs a new definition, new sentences that avoid the power sense, and regenerated blocks. Do not reuse B level_3 as written.
reviewer_issues: core.definition and core.sense_fingerprint: 定义“土地很大、人很多、很有力量”同时包含地理义和实力义，与 96172 的“或”式定义几乎完全重叠。这不是一个可区分的独立义项。; core.sentences[6] and core.sentences[8]: 句 6“那个大国有很多钱，也有很多军人”和句 8“世界上的大国不多，这个国家就是其中一个”讲的是实力义，属于 96172 的义项，而不是本义项。B 的 level_3 解释却按“土地广大、人口众多”来讲，与句子不符。; variants.A.level_1 and variants.B.level_1: 以“no_minimal_pairs”豁免不成立：大国 dà guó 有同音异调的真实词大锅 dà guō、大过 dà guò、大果 dà guǒ。

definition: 以出卖肉体为生的女子。
reviewer_notes: 核心重复，不宜保留。若决定保留，需同时修正 core.ipa 的第三声标注（同 96175）。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “以出卖肉体为生的女子”与 sense 96175 “靠出卖身体来赚钱的女人”为同一义项，sense_fingerprint 也几乎相同。这是重复的 sense，练习会重复出题。

definition: 房间里面。
reviewer_notes: 核心重复，不宜保留。若决定保留，另有以下问题需处理：A L3 “演唱会很安静，只有他一个人”可理解为空场演出，干扰项不成立；B L3 “工地没有一点声音”在门关着的语境下也可成立；A L6 “室内结了一层厚冰”可指冷库，属可接受句。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “房间里面”与 sense 96177 “房子里面，与室外相对”为同一义项，sense_fingerprint 也基本相同，属重复 sense。

definition: 应分是应该做的事。
reviewer_notes: The core sense is unusable: native speakers say 本分, not 我的应分. It overlaps with 96202.
reviewer_issues: core.pos: 应分 is standardly an adjective (属分内应当做的). The noun use '我的应分' (meaning 本分) is not idiomatic Chinese, so every core sentence ('这是我的应分', '子女的应分', etc.) teaches a non-standard usage. This sense also duplicates 96202.; core.register: Declared 书面语, but the sentences are colloquial ('你不用谢我', '请别夸我').

definition: 按次序站成行列。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the sense is redundant with 96205, not because its sentences are poor. Its level_6 wrong sentences are near-copies of 96205's (for example 这些零件按大小排队摆好 vs 这些积木按颜色排队摆好, and 这篇稿子需要排队 vs 这篇文章需要排队). The sentence pools should be merged rather than kept as parallel sets.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 96205 (一个接着一个站成一排). Both describe the same line-up meaning, so it is not an independently teachable sense.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 站队 is defensibly correct in 买票要按顺序站队 (it can mean forming a line), and the explanation misstates the word.; variants.A.level_1: The declined no_minimal_pairs is wrong: 派对 (pài duì) is a tone-only minimal pair with 排队.; variants.B.level_1: Same as variants.A.level_1.; plan.active_levels / blocks: active_levels lists levels 2, 4 and 9 with no matching blocks; the level_4 form block is required by morphological_forms.

definition: 等级中最高的。
reviewer_notes: 核心为 96213 的重复，故拒绝，不作修补。若将来要从本条抢救句子，需先并入 96213 再重审。另记：sentences[7]“评委给她的作品评了最高等”与 B 变体 L7 的错误说明（“评”后须接“为”）矛盾，却被列为 B 的 L7 正确句。A 变体 L3 的干扰项“最大”“最干净”在房间分级的语境中也可能成立。以上问题在拒绝的前提下不再逐一修补。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 96213 为同一义项（“排在最上面的一等”与“在若干等级中处于最高的一级”无法区分），属于整义项重复，学习者无法据此分辨两个义项。

definition: 深沉的夜晚；半夜。
reviewer_notes: 核心为 96227 的重复，故拒绝，不作修补。若将来要从本条抢救句子，需先并入 96227 再重审。另记：A 变体 L1 同样含“山野”，不构成最小对立对，与 96227 中的问题相同。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “深沉的夜晚；半夜”与 96227 的“大家都睡了的夜里很晚”指同一时段，两个义项无法区分。本块句子如“这家店开到深夜两点”“深夜十二点，我还在看书”也与 96227 的“大家都睡了”定义不符，说明义项边界模糊。

definition: 当众表演歌唱。
reviewer_notes: reject 的理由是与 96231 重复，而不是核心句子不可用。其句子大体可用，可并入 96231。core.sentences[2] 独有 furigana 字段，与其他句不一致。core 中无 source 字段，没有 mined 句。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “当众表演歌唱”与 sense 96231 的“在大家面前唱歌”是同一义项。同一义项以两个 sense 教授会造成重复。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “他们在厨房里演唱民歌”可被视为可接受的口语说法，并非明确错误。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “老师在课堂上演唱公式”。唱公式作口诀在教学中常见，并非明确错误。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “演员在剧场演唱台词”。歌剧或音乐剧中演员唱出台词（唱词）是可接受的，因此该句不是清晰的错误。

definition: 父亲的称呼。
reviewer_notes: reject 的理由是与 96235 重复，而不是核心句子不可用。若要保留，需要修正 A.level_1 与 B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]。其余块（A.level_3、A.level_6、A.level_7；B.level_1、B.level_3、B.level_7）通过。core 中无 source 字段，没有 mined 句。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “父亲的称呼”与 sense 96235 的“对爸爸的叫法”是同一义项。同一义项以两个 sense 教授会造成重复。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “我的爹是我父亲的父亲，每天早上都去河边走路。”句子本身前后矛盾，读不通，不是清晰的单点错误。; variants.A.level_1.options[1]: “铁 tiě”与“写 xiě”（options[2]）同样是声母与声调双重差异，不是有效的听感干扰项。

definition: 具有一定形状和体积的实物。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for a bad core. Its block-level content is otherwise coherent, but the two senses cannot be taught separately, and the cross-sense conflict above shows it. Keep 96237. The B level_7 那条物体 is borderline in the same way as 96237.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 96237. Both glosses describe a real object one can see and touch (or one with shape and volume), and all ten sentences fit both. The fingerprint's added domain tag (科学、观察) is not a sense difference.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 形体 is close to the target gloss (形状和体积). Its stated reason (书面语域) conflicts with the sense's register 中性, so the explanation is wrong.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “水是一种物体” is wrong only under this gloss. Under 96237 (能看到、能摸到的东西) water is plainly a 物体, so the wrong sentence contradicts the sibling sense.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “这家商店卖很多日用物体” is not clearly wrong by sense. The real defect is collocation/register (物品 is the usual word), and the explanation does not say that clearly.

definition: 玩者是玩的人。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 96240 (both = a person who plays). 96240 is kept because its definition (参与玩耍或游戏的人) is more precise. If this sense were kept instead, these would still need fixing: A level_3 option 作品 has a false explanation (认真的作品 is idiomatic; the real problem is that 他是一个... requires a person noun). B level_3 option 电灯 is defensibly grammatical (路灯站在路边 is attested), so it is not a clean distractor. A level_1 option 玩主 is a near-synonym of 玩者.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 96240 (a person who plays). The definition 玩的人 is circular, so the two senses cannot be taught apart.

definition: 纪律是大家要一起遵守的规矩。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 96250. Both define 纪律 as the rules a group's members must keep, and the 'order' facet ('守规矩的秩序') is not a separate sense. The two documents draw on the same sentence pool, so they would produce overlapping exercises. Keep 96250 and drop this one. If this one is kept instead, it needs: (1) level_1 is declined as 'no_minimal_pairs', but 记录 jì lù, 纪录 jì lù and 几率 jī lǜ are valid minimal pairs; (2) A.level_6 wrong[0] and A.level_7 rest only on 个 vs 条, which is borderline because 个 is a generic classifier; (3) morphological_forms lists 条 as a 'form', but it is a classifier, not a morph

definition: 占极大比例的多数。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 96253, so the core is unusable as a separate sense. Its sentences and blocks are otherwise sound. Its wrong sentence 这瓶牛奶绝大多数我已经喝了 is borderline (mass noun), which is another reason not to keep the duplicate.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 占极大比例的多数 describes the same meaning as sense 96253 (差不多全部). The two senses cannot be taught apart, and the sentences fit both.

definition: 编剧是写电影或戏里故事的人。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 96256. If this sense were kept instead, these would still need fixing: B level_1 option 占据 is zhàn jù, not zhān, so the explanation is wrong; B level_1 option 间距 is jiàn jù, not jiān, so its tone claim is also wrong; B level_6 wrong sentence 编剧在出版前检查书稿，修改错字 is defensibly acceptable, since a writer may proofread their own manuscript.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 96256 (a person who writes screenplays). The two senses cannot be taught apart.

definition: 连接头和躯干的部分。
reviewer_notes: Reject. The core is a duplicate of 96257, so there is nothing to patch. Keep 96257 as the single neck sense. Its variants are also copies of 96257's, so do not salvage any part of this document without first deciding whether a separate sense exists at all.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 96257. Both define 脖子 as the part connecting head and trunk, and every sentence here is the same neck sense. The ‘anatomical’ vs ‘everyday’ split in sense_fingerprint does not produce a distinct usage, so this is not a separate sense.; variants.A.level_1: Copied verbatim from 96257 variant A level_1, so the two senses share the same distractors and explanations.; variants.A.level_6 and variants.B.level_6: Wrong sentences are copied verbatim from 96257 (她的脖子又大又亮, 他站到台上先清了清脖子, etc.), so the duplicate sense would reuse the same exercise items.

definition: 万位是一个数里从右往左数的第五个位置。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 96260. Both define 万位 as the fifth digit position from the right in a number. Keep 96260 and drop this one. If this one is kept instead, it needs: (1) level_1 A: 单位 dān wèi and 王位 wáng wèi differ from 万位 in more than one segment and fail the minimal-pair/tone-confusion rule; B: 完美 and 完备 fail the same way. (2) A.level_6 wrong[0] '老师在黑板上画了一条万位' and B.level_6 wrong[2] '他买了一只万位' are semantically wrong, but their explanations say 〈个〉 fixes them, which is misleading. (3) B.level_7 '数字9应该写在万位。' and A.level_7 '我先把7写在万位里。' are borderline. The sentences with the 上 fix are clearly better.

definition: 薄是东西不厚，很扁很细。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 96262, so the core is unusable as a separate sense. Other defects to carry over if merged: A level_6 wrong #3 这杯酒很薄，喝一口就醉了 is not wrong for this sense, because 薄酒 (weak wine) is a real usage. A level_3 sentence 0 uses the reduplicated 薄薄的, so the single-blank stem 一本___的小书 does not match the explanation 一本薄的小书. B level_6 wrong #1 这根绳子很薄 is only borderline.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates 96262 (厚度小的). The definition 很扁很细 also conflates 薄 with 细 (narrowness). The two senses cannot be taught apart.

definition: 赛事是比赛的事情。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝：与 sense 96266 为重复义项，无法通过局部补丁修复。96266 覆盖了该词的活动义，应保留后者。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 96266 同义（均为比赛相关的事情/活动）。其 10 个例句全部使用活动义（如「赛事结束后」「赛事太多，运动员很累」「这次赛事的规则」），未体现 sense_fingerprint 所称的「消息和安排」义，属于重复义项。; variants.B.level_3.options[2].explanation: 解释标签「体貌」不是合法的错误类别，应为「语义」。; core.sentences[9]: 仅此句带有 furigana 字段，其余句子没有，数据不一致。

definition: 整体中的某一部分的位置。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a sense-splitting duplicate, not for a content defect; the block-level content I checked was clean. If the inventory deliberately keeps both senses, the sentences would have to be rewritten to separate them, which requires a new core rather than patches.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense of 96275. Both mean a region or part of a whole, and 96276's sentences (e.g. 这台机器的每个部位都有名字, 医生问我疼痛的部位在哪里) are equally correct under 96275's gloss.

definition: 用来装钱和卡片的小包。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for block-level content. If the sense is kept anyway, B level_7 has the same 把-word-order problem as 96277 (他把拿走了钱包), so it would need the same measure-word replacement.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense of 96277 (钱包 as a small pouch for money). 卡片 is typical contents, not a separate sense, and every sentence here is equally correct under 96277's gloss.

definition: 由多种人际关系交织形成的网络。
reviewer_notes: 因整个义项为重复而拒绝，以下问题未打补丁。若日后重新启用：B 的 level_3 干扰项“天气”并不完全不成立（天气也可以说“复杂”），解释“自然现象，不能说太复杂”站不住，应换成明确不成立的名词。其余句子与改错句基本干净。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 96279 义项重复：二者均为“人际关系连成的网”，sense_fingerprint 仅措辞不同，两组句子都落在同一义项上，学习者会在两个义项下学到同一个意思。

definition: 走上舞台或讲台；也指掌权、出任官职。
reviewer_notes: “掌权”义项本身真实存在，sentences 0、2、4、6、8 也确实是该义项。但内核把两个义项合并，且一半句子属于登台义项，与 96297 重复。内核无法通过局部修补解决，需要重新生成为只含掌权义项的词条，并据此重新运行 plan。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 同一词条合并了两个义项：“走上舞台或讲台”和“掌权、出任官职”。一个词条应只对应一个义项。; core.sentences[1]: “校长上台讲话”是登台义项，与 96297 重复。; core.sentences[3]: “歌手上台时，大家都鼓掌了”是登台义项，与 96297 重复。; core.sentences[5]: “她上台领奖”是登台义项，与 96297 重复。; core.sentences[7]: “演员们上台前都很紧张”是登台义项，与 96297 重复。; core.sentences[9]: “主持人上台，音乐也停了”是登台义项，与 96297 重复。; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: A 的正确句（index 3）是登台义项，而本词条应是掌权义项，因此正确答案对本词条不成立。; variants.B.level_6.correct_sentence_index: B 的正确句（index 9）同样是登台义项，对本词条不成立。

definition: 有些国家里，由很多人坐在一起商量国家大事的地方。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on the core. Cross-sense conflict: under this gloss, 国会 (the sibling 96324 A level_3 distractor) is defensibly correct, so the two senses cannot both ship. The block-level content is clean: the level_3 distractors 医院, 厨房, 菜市场, 学期, 咖啡 and 歌曲 are wrong, the level_6 wrong sentences are wrong for stated reasons, and the level_7 errors (只 and 过过) are clean. Sentences fit the gloss, so this is a core problem only.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss (有些国家里，由很多人坐在一起商量国家大事的地方) describes any legislature, including 众议院 and 国会. It is not 参议院's own meaning. It duplicates sense 96324, which gives the correct upper-house meaning.

definition: 一起行走；也指同一职业的人（名词）。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is not a single sense (verb + noun in one definition) and it duplicates sense 96329. The verb blocks are clean: level_1 A/B, level_3 A/B, the level_6 correct sentences, and level_7 A. A rewrite would still need the inventory decision first, so no patches are offered. If the noun sense is kept, it needs its own sentences, blocks and plan. The B level_6 distractor 两队同行争夺冠军 would then have to be removed or rewritten.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses: 一起行走 (verb) and 同一职业的人 (noun). The sense_fingerprint and every example sentence cover only the verb. A single sense document must describe one sense.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 两队同行争夺冠军 is acceptable under the noun gloss that this document's own definition gives (同一职业的人, rivals). It is not a wrong sentence.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: The level_7 pair (一只同行 → 一位同行) uses the noun sense, not the sense_fingerprint's 'walk together' sense. This breaks the one-sense rule.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 侦探同行嫌疑人 has the same flaw as in sense 96329: the explanation (side-by-side, not following) contradicts the sentence. The real defect is the direct person object.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 警察同行犯人回局里 has the same flaw as in sense 96329. Its explanation contradicts the sentence.; core: The verb content duplicates sense 96329 (same definition, same morphological forms, same block structure). Two senses teaching the same meaning will double-count exercises.

definition: 叹词，用于打招呼，或表示惊讶、感叹。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is not a single sense: it merges the greeting sense (already in 96335) with exclamation. The fixes listed above would be needed after the split. Re-author the core with exclamation-only sentences. Currently 0, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 9 are greeting uses, so they cannot stay. Also, the level_1 blocks are identical to sense 96335's, so they will need to be regenerated for the new sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition combines two senses: 打招呼 (greeting) and 表示惊讶、感叹 (exclamation). Seven of ten core sentences are greetings, which duplicates sense 96335. The one-sense rule is broken at the core.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 哼 has a sarcastic reading. 哼，你的新发型真好看！ is a defensible sarcastic compliment, so the distractor is also correct in the anchor sentence.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 我撞到了人，嗨，真不好意思。 uses 嗨 as an exclamation, which this sense's own definition allows. It is not clearly wrong.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 这本书多少钱？嗨，我想买。 uses 嗨 as a casual greeting opener, which is acceptable.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 他帮我搬了东西，我对他说了一声“嗨”。 reads as a casual hello or an exclamation, both of which this sense allows. The stated reason (谢谢) does not make it wrong.; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: 呸，你怎么在这儿？ has a contemptuous reading that fits the question, so the distractor may be defensibly correct.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: The level_7 error 说了一个“嗨” is grammatical with the general classifier 个, so it is a weak sole error (same pattern as sense 96335).

definition: 很多人可以一起用的。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项重复，故整体退回，不做补丁。A、B 两套的 level_3、level_6、level_7 与反义题干扰项大多清楚错误（如“全公司的人都能用”与“私人的”“损坏的”“独占的”矛盾）；问题在于义项重复，而非练习本身。level_1 声明无最小对立对，可接受。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 96340 为同一义项的重复拆分（“很多人可以一起用的”与“允许多个使用者同时或分别使用的”），学习者会把同一义学两次。; core.sentences[8]: “多用户的充电宝”及打印机、扫描仪、平板等非计算机用法并不地道；“多用户”的标准用法限于计算机系统、软件与账号，这些例句与该词核心义脱节。

definition: 婚姻关系中新娘一方的家庭。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of sense 96345. Keep the one sense that best matches the bride's-family meaning; 96345 is the better-attested candidate once its drifted sentences are fixed. If the team decides to keep 96346 as a separate sense, it needs a distinct, testable gloss (for example, the family as a unit, not its members) and new sentences: the current ones mix readings. The level_1 block is not commented on here, per the declined-block rule.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The core gloss ('婚姻关系中新娘一方的家庭') duplicates sense 96345 ('结婚的时候，女孩子自己的家人'). Both mean the bride's side of the family, and no fingerprint separates them. A learner cannot tell which sense a given sentence uses.; core.sentences[3]: '女家的亲人给新娘准备了礼物' uses 女家 as relatives (people), which is the 96345 reading and not the household reading in this gloss. It is also the level_6 correct sentence for variant A, so the answer key is built on the overlapping reading.; core.sentences[5]: '两家人见面时，女家来了五个人' uses 女家 as a group of people, again the 96345 reading, so the sentence does not show the household sense it claims to teach.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: The explanation for '女家们' says 女家 cannot take 们. That is only right for the household reading. Stated as a general rule it is too broad, since 们 can attach to some group nouns. The error is borderline.

definition: 好好地，认真仔细地；也作程度副词，表示很。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项需要重新定义，且两套练习分属不同义，修补不可行，需按拆分后的义项整体重做。若只打补丁，则须替换 A 套 level_3 的句子、两套 level_6 的全部错误句，并改写 level_7。方式义已由 96347 覆盖，本条不能作为其补充。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 一个义项内并列两个义：“好好地，认真仔细地”（方式）与“表示很”（程度）。一个义项只能承载一个义。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹以“或”并列两个义，无法对应单一义项的消歧。; core.sentences[0-4]: 第 0 至 4 句为方式义（休息、想想、听讲、读书、解释），与 96347 的“做事很用心”重复，学习者会学两次同一义。; variants.A: A 套练习（level_3 第 0 句、level_6、level_7）测的是方式义，B 套（level_3 第 6 句、level_6 第 9 句）测的是程度义，两套不属于同一义项。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “她好生忘了带钥匙，只好在门口等了一下午”描述的是一次性事件，而“丢三落四”指习惯性疏忽，错因与替换词不匹配。

definition: 量词，用于布帛、图画等。
reviewer_notes: 作为独立义项应当驳回。它的 blocks 本身基本可用：level_1、level_3、level_6、level_7 均已检查，没有发现确定的错误。plan 的 active_levels 包含 2，但 blocks 中没有 level_2。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 sense 96351 的义项完全重复：二者都是称量画、布等又宽又平之物的量词（“量词，用于布帛、图画等”与“数画、布这种又宽又平的东西时用的字”）。同一义项会被教授两次。

definition: 变为真实；愿望、预想等得以实现。
reviewer_notes: Sentences and blocks are otherwise clean: the level_3, level_6 and level_7 errors are valid for the target word, and the level_7 'correct' indices hold. Keep 96359 as the surviving sense. If the team decides the two senses really are distinct, this document needs a narrower definition and fingerprint, and its plan needs re-running. primary_collocate is null although 梦想成真 is a fixed collocation, which matters only if this sense is kept.
