definition: 影片在影院等场所公开放映。
reviewer_notes: Apart from the redundancy the core is sound: targets are whole words and no distractor is defensibly correct. Rejected for duplication, so no patches are proposed. Borderline sentence for the record: 这部老影片去年在电影节上映过 (a festival screening is not commercial 上映).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 98187. '影片在影院等场所公开放映' and '电影在电影院里放出来给大家看' describe the same meaning, with the same antonym (下映), the same kinds of examples and the same morphology. Two senses for one meaning cannot be taught as distinct senses.

definition: 到街上去，多指去买东西或逛街。
reviewer_notes: 若保留：variants.A.level_1 的“上级”与“上街”仅韵母和声调不同；variants.B.level_1 的“长街”声母和声调都不同，二者都应替换。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 98189 重复。“多指去买东西或逛街”描述的是常见用途，不是独立义项。98190 的全部句子都符合 98189 的释义“走出家门到街上去”，例如句 0、1、3、9，学习者无法分辨两个义项。

definition: 不停地；也用在动词后面表示留不住或承受不了。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the core mixes two senses, which is not fixable by patch. Once split, rerun the plan for each resulting sense (fat_seed_runner plan ... --source reviewed --senses <sid>) and read plans_reviewed/<sid>.json before adding or removing blocks. The B level_7 corrected sentence and the A level_7 error ('不住的笑') are otherwise clean, but A level_7 correct_sentence_indices must drop index 2 once that sentence is removed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Two senses in one record: 不停地 (adverb) and 动词后表示留不住 / 承受不了 (complement). Sentences 3, 4, 6, 8 are complement uses and 0, 1, 5, 7, 9 are adverb uses. This breaks the one-sense rule.; sentences[2]: 「听到这个笑话，大家忍不住笑了起来。」 uses 忍不住, a compound that embeds the word. This fails the whole-word rule.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 「他蓦然点头，表示同意。」 is grammatical and plausible as a sudden nod of agreement, so 蓦然 is defensibly correct.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 「他猛然点头，表示同意。」 is likewise defensibly acceptable.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 「这份报告我写不住了」 uses the complement sense, so it is not a clean error for this record's intended sense.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 「这个消息我听不住」 and 「这件衣服我穿不住」 are non-standard uses; 听不清 / 穿不下 are the normal forms.

definition: 被劫持作为要挟筹码的人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for the content of its exercises, which are internally consistent with the plan. Level 1 A options are identical to 98211's level 1 A. Level 6 B shares one wrong sentence (难民营里住着三百名人质。) with 98211's level 6 B. Resolve in favor of 98211 rather than patching this document.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. '被劫持作为要挟筹码的人' describes the same meaning as sense 98211 ('被坏人抓住、用来逼别人听话的人'). Both have the same pronunciation, the same ipa, and near-identical sense_fingerprints. The split adds no teaching distinction, and learners would see the same meaning twice.

definition: 按顺序排列的名次或位置。
reviewer_notes: Rejected at core level. It duplicates 98223 and its definition conflicts with its own level_6 distractors. Its declined blocks were not assessed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Near-duplicate of sense 98223 (排队或比赛时排在第几个). Both teach 位次 as ordinal rank, so the second sense adds nothing for the learner.; core.definition: The definition includes 位置. That makes variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0] (这张桌子的位次很好，靠窗。) defensibly correct under this sense, so the 位次 vs 位置 distractor is invalid. The core contradicts its own distractor logic.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 身高 fits the blank grammatically (我的身高比上次高了 is natural). The explanation's collocation reason is weak; the only real objection is the 这次考试 frame.; core.sentences[8]: A furigana field appears on this sentence only and is absent from every other sentence in the document.

definition: 地势较低的地方。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 98227. Level_1 options in A (泥地/离地/批地) match those in 98227 B, so sibling senses reuse the same distractors. Declined blocks were not assessed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Near-duplicate of sense 98227 (比旁边的地方矮一些的土地). Both mean a low-lying patch of ground, and the learner cannot separate them. Sentence 8 here (低地的土很软，适合种菜。) is near-identical to 98227 sentence 9.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 农田 can defensibly fill 这个城市大部分是___ (some cities are mostly farmland). The explanation 一座城市大部分不会是农田 is not reliably true.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: A classifier error (一只低地) used as a level_6 semantic distractor, with no single substitute word. Same defect as 98227.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: Classifier error again (一棵低地 in B's wrong sentences, here 一只低地 in A and 一棵低地 in B on the 98227 side). Not a sense mismatch.

definition: 再保证是又一次说，一定会做到。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of sense 98264 with weak, context-free sentences. 再保证 is the free phrase 再 + 保证, so it is doubtful as a lexical item at all.
reviewer_issues: core: This sense duplicates 98264, which has the same lemma and the same meaning ('again make a guarantee'). The definition 又一次说一定会做到 is only a paraphrase of 再次作出保证, so learners would get two identical senses.; core.sentences: Most sentences use 再保证 with no earlier promise in the context, so 再 'again' has nothing to refer back to. Several are unnatural: 我再保证过 (#6) and 司机再保证了，路上一定很安全 (#7). In #7 a driver cannot promise that the road will be safe, and 再保证了 with no object reads oddly.

definition: 伸手投出或动手做某事；也指拿出钱物。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as written. Its definition and fingerprint include the 动手/投 sense, which duplicates 98275 and makes sense-level discrimination impossible. Six of ten sentences (0, 1, 4, 6, 8, 9) use the money sense and could anchor a separate, narrowed sense. The 动手/投 sentences belong to 98275. Re-author this sense as the money sense only, with new blocks, then regenerate the plan with fat_seed_runner (I could not run it here).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition bundles two senses under one id: 伸手投出或动手做某事 (the 98275 sense) and 拿出钱物 (the money sense). The core is not a single sense.; core.sentences[2]: 他出手一投，球正好进了篮 uses the 投球 sense, which is 98275's sense, not the money sense in this definition.; core.sentences[3]: 看到坏人，警察立刻出手抓住了他 uses the 动手 sense, which overlaps 98275 directly. It is also the level_6 correct sentence for variant A and the synonym_antonym anchor.; core.sentences[5]: 比赛最后一秒，他出手投了个三分球 uses the 投篮 sense, not the money sense.; core.sentences[7]: 他出手太重，把朋友的手打疼了 uses the 动手 sense, not the money sense.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 他出手向朋友要钱 is defensibly acceptable, because 伸手要钱 is idiomatic. The sentence is not clearly wrong.

definition: 到位是到了该到的地方，或者做得刚刚好。
reviewer_notes: The core mixes two senses, so it cannot be fixed by patching. Sense 98288 has the same mixed definition, so the two entries likely duplicate each other. Split them into a locational sense and an evaluative sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition joins two separate senses with 或者: physically arriving at the proper place, and doing something just right. The sense is not pinned. Sentences 0, 1, 5 and 9 use the locational sense; sentences 2, 3, 4, 6, 7 and 8 use the evaluative sense. Every downstream exercise therefore teaches two senses at once.; core.sentences[0]: '客人都到位了' is unnatural. For guests a native speaker says 到齐.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: '这件衣服到位了' is ungrammatical on its own, so the sentence fails for a reason other than the stated contradiction. The suggested replacement 〈宽松〉 also does not fit the slot.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: The explanation offers 〈到达〉 as the right word, but '说自己已经到达了' contradicts '走错了路' just as much. The explanation is false.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: '这支队伍一向很到位' is unnatural Chinese. The sentence is wrong for a reason unrelated to the stated contradiction.

definition: 到达应到的位置；也指做得合适、完善。
reviewer_notes: This entry duplicates sense 98287 (same lemma, same two-sense definition). Merge the two entries and then split by sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition '到达应到的位置；也指做得合适、完善' covers two senses. The sentences alternate between them: 0, 1, 5, 7 and 9 are locational; 2, 3, 4, 6 and 8 are evaluative.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: This is almost a copy of the anchor sentence 3 with a clause appended. Wrong sentences [1] and [2] test the same contradiction.

definition: 用剪刀等使东西断开。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the sense duplicates 98291, so the core is unusable as a separate sense. No patches are proposed. Other checks, for reference if the sense is kept as distinct: the level_3 distractors (吃/写/喝 and 煮/洗/唱) do not fit their blanks. The level_6 and level_7 errors are single and clearly defined. Level_3 B's sentence 医生把我手上的线剪掉了 would also take 拆 naturally (拆线), but 拆 is not an option, so this is not a distractor failure. Blocks match the plan.
reviewer_issues: core.definition and core.sense_fingerprint: The sense (用剪刀等使东西断开 / 用剪刀等使东西断开) restates 98291 (用剪刀把东西弄开或弄断). Both teach cut with scissors, so this is a duplicate sense, not a separate one.; core.sentences[5].furigana: Only this sentence has a furigana field. The other nine sentences do not, so the document is inconsistent.; core.sentences[4].text: 小心，别剪到手。 is unnatural. 剪到手 is not a usual collocation for accidental cutting.

definition: 某一时间某一场合中的景象和情形。
reviewer_notes: 练习内容本身基本可用，但核心义项是重复的，因此整体拒绝。若日后有必要保留它，level_6 B 的错误句“他的情景很温和”与 98355 中被修正的句子存在同样的边界问题。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98355 重复：同一词、同一词性、释义实质相同（“某一时间某一场合中的景象和情形”与“某个时候你看到的样子和发生的事”），指纹也重叠。学习者无法区分两个义项。

definition: 指擅长某种技艺或劳动的人，也指武术。
reviewer_notes: Rejected: the core cannot be fixed by patching, because the definition, fingerprint and most sentences belong to two different senses, one of which is already covered by 98387. The level_3 and level_7 items here are otherwise well-formed, but they will need regeneration against the martial-arts-only sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把两个义项合并：「擅长某种技艺或劳动的人」（与 98387 完全重复）和「武术」。一个 sense 文档必须锁定一个义项。句子也混杂：sentences[3]、[4]、[5]、[8] 为人义，与 98387 重复；其余为武术义。level_6 A 的正确句 sentences[3] 也是人义，与 level_6 B 的武术义正确句不一致。

definition: 发布条件，邀请多方报价，从中选择承办者。
reviewer_notes: 因重复而拒绝。若要保留，还需处理以下问题：B 的 level_7 错误句“这家公司去年招标了三次标”包含两处错误（“了”位置不当，且“标”重复），违反单一错误的要求；其解释又与 98391 中被接受的“招标了”相矛盾。另外，sentences[8] 带有 furigana 字段，其余九句都没有，应当删除。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98391 重复：同一义项（发布通知或条件、征集报价、选择承办方）。同一个词义被拆成两个条目。

definition: 政务是政府要做的事情。
reviewer_notes: This is a duplicate of 98402. The content itself is mostly sound. The one weak point is sentence 1: 政务很忙 is slightly unnatural, and 政务繁忙 is the idiomatic form.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense is the same as sense 98402. '政府要做的事情' and '政府管理国家或地方的各项事务' describe one meaning of 政务, so the lemma is split into two indistinguishable senses. Learners would get two ladders for one meaning.

definition: 在竞争或战争中失败。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项重复，因此判为 reject；若确需保留为独立义项，应先拆分定义，再重审全部变体。其余内容可读：level_3 干扰项（赢、参加、吃；写、嫁、唱）在空位上都不成立；level_7 的错误句“败了给他们”确有错误，修正句成立；反义关系的正确答案“胜”成立。边界情况：A level_6 第 1 句“他的计划败了”与 B level_6 第 2 句“这次实验败了”属于计划或实验失败的用法，有文献依据，母语者可能接受，如保留义项则应考虑替换。计划的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但没有对应 blocks，本次未审。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98405「比赛或打仗时输了」几乎同义（同样指比赛或战争中的输）。两个义项在练习中无法区分，同一句通常同时符合两者。

definition: 星球是天上很大的圆圆的东西，比如地球和月亮。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 98414, which has the more precise gloss. No patches, because the sense itself should not be taught separately. If the team keeps both senses on purpose, the level_3 A distractor above must be replaced.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 98414 ('宇宙中的天体，如地球、火星') covers the same meaning. This sense differs only in its examples (月亮 vs 火星).; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 饼干 can pass as a child's figurative description of the moon, so it is not a clean distractor for 天上有一个圆圆的___.

definition: 时式是用来说事情是现在、过去还是以后的话的样子。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate. No patches, because the sense itself should not be taught separately. Its blocks were otherwise sound. If the team keeps this sense instead of 98418, only one of the two may survive.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 98418 ('语法中表示动作发生时间的形式，即时态') covers the same meaning (tense). This gloss is also clumsy: '用来说事情是现在、过去还是以后的话的样子'.

definition: 爸是爸爸，是你的男性家长。
reviewer_notes: 与 98462 同义，建议合并为一个义项并保留 98462。上述 B 变体问题在删除后即不再相关。计划中 active_levels 含 4，且 morphological_forms（爸爸、老爸）存在，但两个变体均无 level_4 块；9 也无对应块。无法在此运行 fat_seed_runner，需在保留的义项上核对计划。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98462 为同一义项（爸＝父亲），属重复条目。定义“爸是爸爸，是你的男性家长”以“爸爸”释“爸”，不如 98462 的“父亲。”清楚。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 干扰项“妈”不是清楚的错误选项：句中已有“我妈”，替换后变为“我妈在看电视，我妈在睡觉”，错误只能靠“同一人不能同时……”的逻辑推断得出，而非目标词本身的问题。

definition: 农历以狗为生肖的年份。
reviewer_notes: 与 98469 重复，建议保留 98469，删除本条。本条各变体的干扰项和错误句基本成立，但不应作为独立义项重复教授。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98469 为同一义项（十二生肖中属狗的年份），属重复条目。所有例句都围绕“农历狗年”这一框架，没有独立的教学内容。

definition: 生存和死亡。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 98473: the definition (生存和死亡) is the same sense, and the sentences show the same usage. Rejected as redundant, not patched. If this copy is kept instead of 98473, the same B level_7 defect applies: 他经历过一个生死 relies on a false classifier rule and must be fixed.

definition: 身体肉少，不胖；也指衣服或鞋子窄小。
reviewer_notes: Reject: the core mixes two senses and duplicates 98477. Salvageable: sentences 0 to 5 and most A-variant blocks (level_1, level_3, level_6, level_7, and the 肥 antonym item) are clean clothing-sense material. Regenerate as a clothing-only sense (narrow clothes or shoes), dropping body sentences 6 to 9 and the 胖 key. After regeneration, rerun PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python scripts/fat_seed_runner.py plan RUN --source reviewed --senses <sid>. I could not run it (no tools).
reviewer_issues: core.definition and core.sense_fingerprint: One sense_id covers two senses: body thinness (身体肉少，不胖) and clothing or shoe narrowness. The body half is the sense already held by 98477, so this is a duplicate that also merges two senses.; core.sentences[6-9]: Sentences 6 to 9 (她太瘦了…, 他工作太忙…, 这个孩子很瘦…, 那只狗瘦得走不动了) use the body sense, mixed with clothing sentences 0 to 5. The sense is not one sense.; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match vs variants.B.synonym_antonym_match: The same sense_id gives two answers. A keys 肥 (the clothing antonym) and B keys 胖 (the body antonym). The variants disagree on what the sense means.

definition: 直接隶属于某个机构管辖。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the sense duplicates 98483. If the team keeps this sense instead, it would need the A level_7 description fix and the B level_1 restoration. Other blocks are mostly sound. A level_3 distractor 派驻 is borderline (派驻于 is grammatical), but it does not mean the same thing.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 98483 (直接归某机构管辖 vs 直接归某地管). Its sentences overlap heavily, e.g. 该研究所直属于中国科学院 duplicates 98483 sentence 5. Two separately taught senses with the same meaning cannot be distinguished by a learner.; variants.A.level_7.error_description: Claims 直属 must be followed by the preposition 于 to introduce the superior. This is false: the same sense's own sentence 这个局直属市政府管辖 and 98483's 这所大学直属教育部 are grammatical without 于.; variants.B.level_1: Declined as no_minimal_pairs, but 植树/质数/指数 in variant A are valid tone-pair distractors.

definition: 人和动物休息时意识暂停的生理状态。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only because the core duplicates 98487. Its blocks are otherwise close to sound. If the pipeline keeps this sense instead, fix the A level_6 wrong sentence and the B level_3 options as noted above.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 98487. Both gloss 睡眠 as the state of rest in which consciousness lapses. The added “人和动物” framing does not make a separate sense, and the sense_fingerprint does not contrast with 98487.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “动物冬天都要睡眠很久。” is defensibly acceptable in formal or scientific register, where 睡眠 is used as a verb. The explanation that it is noun-only is contestable.

definition: 专门用来配种繁殖的公马。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 98493: the definition (专门用来配种繁殖的公马) is the same sense, with the same sentence pattern. Rejected as redundant, not patched.

definition: 经济力量是一个国家或一个人有多少钱、能做多少事。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 98506, with unidiomatic individual-scope usage across most sentences. sentences[3] also carries a stray 'furigana' field holding pinyin.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 98506: both mean 'economic strength', and 98506 covers the same ground correctly. The only thing distinct here is the 'one person's money and means' reading. That reading is unidiomatic for 经济力量, which is used for countries, regions and organisations. For a person, natives say 经济能力 or 经济实力.; core.sentences[1]: '他没有经济力量，买不起房子': using 经济力量 for an individual is unnatural. Sentences 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 9 (孩子, 我父母, 这家人, 我们…买新车, 他, 她) have the same problem.; variants.*.level_7: A uses a classifier error (一条/一股 经济力量), but 一股经济力量 is itself shaky. B's 的/得 error does not involve the target.

definition: 口腔里能辨味、帮助咀嚼和发音的器官。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only as a duplicate. Its blocks read as sound on their own terms. If it is kept instead, check the A level_6 wrong sentence about 舌头 and taste against the same standards applied to 98515.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 98515. “口腔里能辨味、帮助咀嚼和发音的器官” and “在嘴巴里面软软的，用来尝味道和说话的” both describe the tongue as an oral organ. The sense_fingerprints also overlap almost completely.

definition: 万全是想得很多，一点危险都没有。
reviewer_notes: The level_7 items in both variants (安排得很万全, 考虑得很万全) treat “很万全” as correct, so their corrected sentences are themselves unidiomatic. The level_6 correct-sentence index 9 (这样就万全了) is weak, so the variants cannot be salvaged without a new core. Level_1 A: 万千 and 版权 would be rejected as not confusable. 完全, 万元 and 王权 are usable. Not mined, so a full regeneration is permitted.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences: 万全 is a literary, essentially non-gradable attributive word. It occurs idiomatically in 万全之策, 万全的准备 and 万无一失. Sentences 1, 4, 5, 7, 8 and 9 use it as a gradable predicate (很万全, 最万全, 不够万全, 想得很万全, 就万全了), which is unidiomatic. This also clashes with the declared 书面 register through casual frames. Sentence 3 embeds it in the fixed compound 万全之策. Sentence 5 carries a stray “furigana” pinyin field.

definition: 详细的情况。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，不做补丁。若团队决定保留，A 块 level_1 的“香芹”解释同样存在把第二音节声调also写成不同的事实错误，需同样修正。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98529 完全重复：“详细的情况”与“一件事各个细节都说清楚的情况”同为名词、同一用法，所有例句都使用同一个义项，并非独立义项。

definition: 对造成的损失给予补偿；也指亏本。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝理由：核心义项不唯一，任何单处修改都无法使 10 句同属一义，需拆分后由生成器重做。拆分时，补偿义可与 98565 的“弄坏别人的东西”对照界定范围（如航班延误、路面坑洞属于更宽的损失补偿）；亏本义需要新的 sense_id 与新句子。拆分前，A level_3 的“赚”干扰项（作反义）和 B level_3 的“涨”干扰项的解释都依赖于亏本义，需一并重核。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义并列两个义项（对损失给予补偿 / 亏本），sense_fingerprint 同样合并。10 句中第 0、3、5、7、9 句为补偿义，第 1、2、4、6、8 句为亏本义，违反“一句一义”。补偿义也与 98565 重叠。; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match: 两个变体均声明 no_relation，但亏本义的反义词是“赚”，此义项下可构成合法反义题。声明与该义项不符（补偿义下的 no_relation 本身成立）。

definition: 起到是产生了某种作用。
reviewer_notes: 与 98570 重复。两者释义同为“产生某种作用”，练习会把同一义项教两次，sense_fingerprint 也无法区分。应保留定义格式更规范的 98570，删除本义项。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98570 为同一义项（产生某种作用）。定义写成“起到是…”，词目重复出现在释义中，格式也不规范。

definition: 车辆的编号或车牌号码。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 98577. The sentence sets are otherwise competent, but the core adds no new sense, so it should not ship as a separate lesson.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 98577. 车辆的编号或车牌号码 and 车子身上的号码 name the same referent, so the lesson is redundant.; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: 车钥匙 is defensible in 他用手机拍下了前面那辆车的___, because a key can be photographed.; variants.A.level_1.options[3]: 车考 differs from 车号 in both onset (k/h) and tone, so it is not a minimal pair and is a weak listening distractor.

definition: 第二年；明年。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 98581, and the two were not distinguished. If the human decides to keep this sense instead, also fix the level_1 declines in both variants, and in variant B level_6 the suggested replacement 〈眼下〉 does not fit “这次考试”; deleting 转年 (“这次考试我考得很好”) is the right fix. No sentence has a source field, so mined status cannot be checked.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “第二年；明年” describes the same sense as 98581 (“过了这一年以后的下一年”). Both senses are “the next year” and their sentence sets overlap in meaning, so this is a duplicate sense, not a separate one.; variants.A.level_1: Declined as no_minimal_pairs, but 转念 (zhuǎn niàn) is a tone-only minimal pair. Variant B has the same false decline.

definition: 将收到的信息再发送给他人。
reviewer_notes: This is a duplicate call, not a content defect. The blocks are otherwise sound: the level_3 options are clearly wrong; the level_6 wrong sentences are wrong for the stated reasons; the level_7 A double-aspect error (转发了过) is valid; the plan indices match. If the human keeps this sense instead of 98585, no block changes are needed. Note also that the wrong sentence 麻烦你转发一下小李，就说我晚点到。 appears in 98585 B level_6 as well.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 98585 already defines 转发 as passing received messages on to others (把收到的话或图片再发给别的人). This sense (将收到的信息再发送给他人) denotes the same meaning with different wording and a different sentence set, so the exercises would overlap.

definition: 前进的道路；入口通道。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable because the sense is unpinned and overlaps 98589. In level_6, all six wrong sentences share an identical 进程 explanation. This needs more variety on regeneration.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition conflates two senses: an abstract path or approach (前进的道路/途径) and a concrete entrance passage. As a result the sentences drift. Sentences 0, 1, 2, 6 and 9 are abstract. Sentences 3, 4, 7 and 8 are concrete. The concrete sense duplicates sense 98589. semantic_class 'concrete' is also wrong for the abstract usage.; core.sentences[7]: '进路有三个' uses the classifier 个, which contradicts the declared classifier 条. The sentence also reads like 入口.; core.sentences[2]: '公司的进路很清楚，每年都在进步' is unnatural.

definition: 院士是在科学上非常有名、非常有成就的人。
reviewer_notes: 核心问题在于义项重复，而不是单个选项。A.level_1 的干扰项原始、远视、院史确实构成声调最小对立，若日后保留该义项可沿用。B.level_3 的“歌手”干扰项（学校请来一位歌手做报告）在语义上有一定可能性，若该义项保留需要复查。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把院士写成一般“非常有名、非常有成就的科学家”，不是院士的含义，院士是科学院或工程院的学术称号。sense_fingerprint 与 98618 基本重合，10 个例句的用法也与 98618 相同，因此这是 98618 的重复义项，而不是独立的义项。

definition: 连词性短语，表示在上述情况之外还有别的。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so no patches. If it were kept, these would also need fixing: the A and B level_3 explanations for 只要, 因为 and 虽然 make the same false 配价 claim as 98619. B level_6 wrong sentences 我除此之外要感谢大家 (acceptable in a speech) and 他不是老师，除此之外是医生 are not clearly wrong. A level_6 wrong sentence 他很努力，除此之外成绩却不太好 is borderline.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 98619. Both are 连词 meaning 在前述之外还有别的 with near-identical definitions and fingerprints, so the same exercises would be taught twice.

definition: 首长是军队或国家里职位很高的大官。
reviewer_notes: 与 98622 重复，应保留 98622、删除本义项。B 变体的 level_1 已由生成端声明 declined，此处不作评审。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98622 为同一义项（党政军机关中职位较高的领导）。定义用口语“大官”，与中性语域不符；且本变体的 level_6 解释又写“首长指党政军机关中职位较高的领导”，与自身定义不一致。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: “大王”在故事语境中可合理作“首长今天要来我们学校”的主语，并非明显错误，只因口语语域被排除。

definition: 一种热带水果，果实弯而长，成熟时果皮黄色。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 98623. The blocks are mostly sound. The 蔬菜 distractor in A.level_3 is arguable for cooking bananas (plantains) but acceptable for the stated sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 98623. 一种热带水果 and 弯弯的黄色水果 name the same referent (banana).

definition: 结束一天的工作离开工作地点。
reviewer_notes: 因与 98635 重复而拒绝。内容本身大体可靠：A/B 的 level_6 错句均为真正误用，B level_3 的干扰项均不可辩护。若作者改为保留本文档、弃用 98635，则上述三处问题需修复。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “结束一天的工作离开工作地点”与 98635 的“一天的工作做完了，离开上班的地方”描述同一义项，sense_fingerprint 也几乎相同。同一教学义项被拆成两个 sense，属于重复。; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: “毕业”的解释称其后须用“于/从”引出学校，句子因此不成立。但“毕业”语法上并不要求“于/从”，判错理由不当。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “这个月我下了三个班”中“班”指班次，“三个班”是常见说法，句子未必有错，难以作为唯一错句。

definition: 大便和小便。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so no patches. If it were kept, variant B level_1 needs the same fix as 98651: it is declined as no_minimal_pairs even though minimal pairs exist. B level_7 incorrect 让二便很顺畅一些 is a contested error, since 很大一些 is attested in usage, so the explanation overstates the rule.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 98651. 二便 as 大便和小便 is the same meaning as 身体排出的尿和大便, so the same word-sense would be taught twice.

definition: 人相是一个人脸和身体长的样子。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，下游全部练习都会受影响。
reviewer_issues: core: 「人相」在现代汉语中罕用，多见于相术语境。母语者会说「长相 / 相貌 / 个子」，「人相很高大」「人相很好」「人相像爸爸」等句都不自然，注明的口语语域也不成立。L1 中「人形」的解释也有误：它与人相的韵母也不同（ing 与 iang），不只是声调不同。

definition: 某地之南的方向或地区。
reviewer_notes: 因与 98659 重复而拒绝。若作者两者都保留，上述问题需修复。A/B 的 level_6 错句判定干净。furigana 字段只出现在本文档第 5 句，应删除或统一添加。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “某地之南的方向或地区”与 98659 的“在某个地方的南边”属同一方位用法，sense_fingerprint 也高度重叠，属重复 sense。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: “我们公司在机场之上/之后/之下”都是合乎语法的处所短语，cloze 有多个可辩护的答案，无法只检验“以南”。解释称“之后”不表示方位，这一说法也不准确。; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: “之前”有空间用法，“黄河之前是一片很大的平原”有一定可辩护性。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “这条江以南土地很适合种水果”省略“的”在口语中可接受，不是干净的错句。

definition: 使馆是一个国家在别的国家里办事的地方。
reviewer_notes: 本义项的例句与 A/B 各块在其自身释义下均无误（level_3 干扰项、level_6 错误句、level_7 错误句）。问题只在义项本身，无法通过修补解决。请保留 98668。另外 core.ipa 中 shǐ 写作 ʂɻ̩˨˩（调值 21），单字三声的标准记音应为 ˨˩˦，98668 同样存在此问题。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98668 是同一义项的重复切分。两者都指一国派驻外国的机构，区别只在“本国人在国外办事”这一语境，词典上并不构成独立义项，两个义项的释义与例句指向同一事物。

definition: 把事情做到结束。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for sentence quality. The remaining sentences and blocks look correct in isolation (level_3 distractors fail, level_6 and level_7 errors are single and true, plan indices match). No patches proposed because the core is redundant.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as sense 98671 ('把事情做到最后，已经结束了' vs '把事情做到结束'). The sense_fingerprint is also effectively identical, so two senses would drill the same word-sense twice.

definition: 备案是把事情写下来交给管的地方，让他们记着。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 98676. Its level_3, level_6 and level_7 blocks are otherwise sound, but the second issue above would need fixing if it were ever kept. No patches proposed because the core is redundant.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as sense 98676 ('把事情交给主管部门登记留底' / '向主管机关报告并登记以备查考'). Two senses would teach the same filing sense twice. The definition is also weaker ('把事情写下来交给管的地方' is ungrammatical).; variants.B.level_7.error_description: The explanation says the error is a 把-construction that cannot be used at all ('不能用“把”字句'). That is overgeneralised: the sentence '请把合同交给主管部门备案' is grammatical, and the real problem is that 社区 is the recipient, not the thing being filed.

definition: 一家的所有成员。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the sense duplicates 98695, not because of its sentences. Its exercise content is otherwise well-formed. If you decide to merge instead of rejecting, note that level_7 B's correct sentence 7「这台电视是全家一起买的。」mirrors the corrected sentence frame「这套房子是全家一起攒钱买的。」and would need replacing.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 sense 98695 的定义（「一家里所有的人」）语义相同。“作主语”与“作宾语或定语”只是句法差异，不构成义项区分，两个义项会把同一个意思教两次。

definition: 反驳是别人说了话，你用理由说他说得不对。
reviewer_notes: 因重复而驳回，故不附补丁。若决定保留本义项，还需修两处实际缺陷：(1) variants.A.level_3 选项“瞪”可以成立（“他说我错了，我马上瞪他”很自然），需替换；(2) variants.B.level_3 选项“修理”在口语中可作“教训、收拾”解，“小王修理过我很多次”有合理读法，需替换。另外，“妈妈反驳了他的遭遇”同时出现在 98725 与 98726 的 level_6 错句中。
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: 与 98726 是同一义项。两者都释为“用理由否定对方的话或意见”，同一句在两个义项下都成立，例如“他说得很清楚，我不能反驳”和“我想反驳他的看法”。学习者无法据锁定义项作答，违反义项锁定。

definition: 与众不同的类别或人。
reviewer_notes: 判 reject 而非 rewrite，原因是义项重复，而非 block 本身损坏。若团队决定两个义项都保留，须先使两个定义区分开，并替换第 7 句。若保留，B 的 level_6 错误句“她买了两只另类”改为“两种另类”后仍读来别扭，也需修改。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98733 为同一义项（与众不同的人或类别）。两个义项意义相同，会让每道题出现两个正确答案。; core.sentences[7]: “另类音乐在年轻人中很受欢迎”：目标词嵌入已列为复合词的“另类音乐”（音乐类型名），词义滑向“另类音乐”这一类型，不再是“与众不同的人或类别”。; core.pos: pos 标为名词，但第 0、2、3、4、8 句中“另类”作定语或谓语形容词。

definition: 外科学是学怎么用刀和手术给人治病的学问。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so no patches are offered. If the pipeline keeps 98761 instead of 98762, apply remove /core/morphological_forms/0, then re-run the plan and reconcile plans_reviewed/98761.json. Apart from these, the sentences are clean: L3 distractors fail in context, L6 wrong sentences are wrong for the reason given, L7 corrections hold, and declining synonym_antonym_match with no_relation is defensible.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 98762. Both define 外科学 as the surgical discipline (学习用刀和手术给人治病的学问 vs 医学的一个分支，以手术为主要手段). The same meaning would be taught twice.; core.morphological_forms[0]: “门” is a measure word, not a morphological form of 外科学. A form-based block (level 4) could draw on it.

definition: 多平台是说在好几种手机、电脑上都能用。
reviewer_notes: 因重复而驳回。若决定保留本义项，还需注意：A level_7 的错句“这款应用是多平台。”可能被接受（产品文案中“是多平台”偶有出现），可能被判为低分，应替换为更明确的错误。A synonym_antonym_match 声明 no_relation 是可接受的，因为“单平台”是唯一可能的反义词，但词典依据较弱。其余块的内容与计划一致。
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: 与 98770 是同一义项：“在好几种手机、电脑上都能用”与“能在多种系统或设备上使用”含义相同，两个义项无法区分。

definition: 重大的灾难或祸事。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate only; the content is otherwise clean. Sentences, anchors, and explanations check out, and A and B are distinct. The L7 error '一个大难' in variant A has the same borderline classifier issue noted for 98773. The synonym_antonym_match decline has the same avoidable no_relation issue noted for 98773.
reviewer_issues: core: 与 98773 为同一义项（均指重大的灾祸），同一词拆成两个重复义项。

definition: 学派是在学问里，想法差不多的一群人。
reviewer_notes: 判 reject，因为与 98792 重复，保留定义更准确的 98792。B 的 level_3 帮派问题已记录在案，以防团队保留本义项。其余 block 未进一步核查。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98792 为同一义项（学问里想法差不多的一群人 与 学术上观点相近的人所形成的派别）。98792 的定义更准确，指“派别”，而非泛指“一群人”。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 干扰项“帮派”：“大学里有不同帮派的老师”语法通顺，且可理解为“派系”，属于可辩护的正确答案。

definition: 禾本科作物，籽粒磨成面粉，是主要粮食之一。
reviewer_notes: This is a duplicate call, not a content defect. Items to fix if this sense is kept instead: the level_3 B distractor 时间 is explained as impossible, but 'price of time' (时间价格) is an attested economics usage, so the explanation overreaches and the distractor is weak in context; the level_6 A wrong sentence 农民用小麦烧火做饭 is borderline, since grain is not normally burned; the wrong sentence 我每天早上喝一杯小麦。 is duplicated in 98799 B level_6. The level_1 decline is fine. The level_7 B error (missing 把) is acceptable. Plan indices match the document.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 98799 already defines 小麦 as the crop that is ground into flour (磨成粉可做面包和面条的农作物). This sense (禾本科作物，籽粒磨成面粉，是主要粮食之一) denotes the same referent with no distinct sense, so the exercises would overlap.

definition: 物体的末端又尖又锋利；也指声音高而刺耳。
reviewer_notes: The core mixes two senses, so the document cannot be safely patched node by node. The sound-sense content should be regenerated as a single-sense document. The physical sense is already in 98801.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses: 物体的末端又尖又锋利 and 声音高而刺耳. A single-sense document cannot teach both.; core.sense_fingerprint: The fingerprint is also two senses ('物体末端尖而锋利，或声音高而刺耳').; core.sentences[2], core.sentences[4], core.sentences[7]: Three of ten sentences use the physical sense (这把刀的刀尖很尖锐 / 铅笔头太尖锐 / 这个玻璃碎片很尖锐). They violate the one-sense rule and duplicate sense 98801.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1], variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: Explanations cite the physical meaning (末端锋利、会扎人、锋利的物体), which is misleading for a sound-sense item.; variants.A.level_7.correct_sentence_indices, variants.B.level_7.correct_sentence_indices: The correct sets include physical-sense sentences (index 2 in A, index 7 in B).; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match, variants.B.synonym_antonym_match: Both are declined with no_relation, but the sound sense has clear antonyms (低沉, 柔和, 温和), so the decline is not justified.

definition: 尤其是是说在很多里面，这一个更特别。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 98804, not for sentence quality. If the pipeline keeps 98803 instead, these fixes are required: (1) core.definition contains a typo, 尤其是是说; (2) core.sentences[9] 我喜欢听音乐，尤其是下雨天听 uses a time adverbial rather than a member of the same class, which conflicts with B level_6's wrong sentence 我喜欢听音乐，尤其是下雨天的书 (judged wrong for being out of class). Replace the correct sentence with a same-class example such as 尤其是古典音乐; (3) re-run the plan after the change.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98804 为同一义项：“众多之中更特别的一个”与“同类中特别突出的一个”用法相同，句子类型也相同，属于重复切分。另有笔误“尤其是是说”。

definition: 养成了习惯，难以改变。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core duplicates sense 98825. Keep one of the two senses. If curation chooses this one instead, apply the fixes listed above. The sentences themselves are clean and tier-consistent. The level_3 cloze for A and the level_7 corrections are correct. The level_1 options are identical to 98825's, so they must not be duplicated if one sense survives.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98825 义项重复：“养成了习惯，难以改变”与“一件事做多了，变成改不掉的习惯”实质相同；指纹和干扰项也重合（A level_1 选项逐字相同）。同一义项不应拆分为两个 sense。; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: “逆转”的说明归因于语域，但真正的失败原因是配价与搭配：逆转需要“局势”“命运”之类的宾语，无法接“玩手机”。说明不真实。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “她学习刻苦成性”：与 98825 的同类问题相同，说明中“不能用”过于绝对，褒义品质的用法并非一律不可接受，错误句不够干净。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2].explanation: 标注“近义误用”不准确：成熟与成性并非近义词。; core.sentences[3].furigana: 仅此一句带有 furigana 字段，其余句子及 98825 均无，结构不一致。

definition: 房价是买一间房子要花多少钱。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项与 98830 重复，无法通过补丁修复，建议作废，改用 98830。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 98830（房屋的价格）为同一义项的两种说法。“买一间房子要花多少钱”与“房屋的价格”所指相同，同一义项出现两次会让学习者重复学习，也会使干扰项判断失效。; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 解释称“鞋子不会涨价”，这不真实，鞋子的价格完全可以上涨。“这里的鞋子每年都在上涨”也可被理解为鞋价上涨，并非确定错误。

definition: 教育性是说能让人学到东西。
reviewer_notes: Reject. The core is a noun mislabeled as an adjective and duplicates 98860, so no patch can make it a valid separate sense. The option blocks (A/B level_3, B level_6, B level_7) are mostly sound, but they would need regeneration under a corrected core. Keep 98860 as the surviving sense. The level_1 decline (no_minimal_pairs) and the synonym_antonym decline (no_relation) are acceptable.
reviewer_issues: core.pos: 教育性 is a noun (作品或活动的教育作用这一性质). The core labels it 形容词, and the sense_fingerprint describes an adjectival use the lemma does not have. Every sentence uses it nominally (很有教育性, 教育性很强, 有教育性的玩具).; core.definition: Duplicate of sense 98860. 能让人学到东西 and 具有教育作用的性质 express the same meaning, and the example sentences overlap. This creates two senses for one meaning.; variants.A.level_7.error_description: Describes 教育性 as 性质名词, which contradicts core.pos 形容词. The document is internally inconsistent.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 这所学校的教育性很有名 is arguably acceptable, since a school's educational quality is a natural reading. It is not clearly wrong, so it may be a second correct answer.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 这个小孩很有教育性 is odd, but it can be read as 'educational / teaches others', so it is a weak distractor.

definition: 没有月光，夜晚很暗。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 98881. Its content is otherwise similar in quality. 屋里月黑，只有一盏灯 is a valid wrong sentence, but it overlaps with 98881's lamplight item.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition (没有月光，夜晚很暗) is the same sense as 98881 (晚上没有月亮，天很黑). The same lemma, POS and fingerprint now appear twice, so two near-identical exercise sets would be taught for one meaning.; core.sentences[2], core.sentences[7]: These sentences carry a stray `furigana` field holding pinyin. That field is a Japanese-only key and does not belong in a zh document.

definition: 正书是写得工整、方方正正的字。
reviewer_notes: 与 98894 为同一义项，核心重复，无法通过补丁修复，建议作废，改用 98894。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “写得工整、方方正正的字”即楷书的特征描述，与 98894（楷书的别称）为同一义项。两个义项的例句风格相同，错误句的干扰对象（行书、隶书、狂草、篆书）也相同，无法独立教授。; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: 干扰项“肥皂”不当：“用肥皂写名字”（如在镜子上写字）是成立的，与锚句“老师让我们用……写名字”同样可接受。; core.sentences[5]: 句子对象带有 furigana 字段，这是日文注音字段，中文练习中不应出现，pinyin 应只在 pronunciation 中。

definition: 后天获得的，非先天具有的。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 98959. If the sense is ever reinstated as a distinct medical sense, the defects above must be fixed. Borderline, not listed as issues: B L7 「这个孩子的耳聋是获得性，是后来才有的」 drops the 的, which is arguably acceptable in medical writing. Sentences and L6/L7 otherwise look sound.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. Its meaning (after birth, not innate) is the same as 98959's (not innate, acquired later). Only the example contexts (disease) differ.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 机械性 is a second defensible fit in 「这种病不是遗传，而是机械性的」 (mechanical cause, as in 机械性损伤). Its explanation is false.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 「这是先天的还是慢性的」 is a natural medical question, so 慢性 is a defensible answer. Its explanation is false.; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: 「这是先天的还是急性的」 is equally natural, so 急性 is a defensible answer.

definition: 现在式是说话时，说事情现在正在发生的样子。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core premise, that Chinese verbs take 现在式/过去式, is wrong for this course, and the sense duplicates 98964. Rewriting the core would mean replacing every sentence, option and explanation, so no patches are offered. Sense 98964 should stand as the 现在式 entry.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Presents 现在式 as a tense of verbs in Chinese. Standard Chinese grammar has no tense inflection; 在/正在 marks progressive aspect. The gloss misdescribes the language for a Chinese-learner course.; core.sentences[0], core.sentences[2], core.sentences[4], core.sentences[5], core.sentences[8], core.sentences[9]: These sentences apply 现在式/过去式 to Chinese verbs, for example sentence 4: 我今天学了现在式，明天学过去式. This spreads the misstatement into every exercise built on the sense.; variants.A.level_3.options[0].explanation: The explanation asserts 我在吃饭 属于现在式, a Chinese tense category that does not exist in standard grammar.; core.sense_fingerprint: Duplicates sense 98964 (语法中表示动作发生在现在的时态形式). 98964 defines the same grammar term and uses it correctly, with sentences about European and Japanese verbs.

definition: 省委是管一个省的大事的一个工作小组。
reviewer_notes: Reject. The sense duplicates 98976 and has an inaccurate gloss, so it should not ship as a separate sense. No patches are proposed for a rejected core. B level_1 is declined and was not reported.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把省委说成“管一个省大事的工作小组”，不是中国共产党省级委员会。该义项与 98976 是同一词义的重复义项。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “我每天在省委吃饭”与“在公司吃饭”一样自然，所谓错误句实际可接受。; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: 甲方可以是出资办学的机构，选项解释“甲方不办学校”不成立，干扰项存在部分正确性。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “这个省有一座省委”中的“座”可读作省委大楼，错误不够确定。

definition: 约法是一个地方大家说好要遵守的规矩。
reviewer_notes: The core sense is not a real standalone sense of 约法. Village or local rules are 乡规民约 or 规矩; 约法 survives in modern usage mainly in 约法三章 or the historical legal sense (see 98990). Sentences such as “村里有一条约法” and “他们定了约法：晚上十点前回家” are unidiomatic, so every exercise built on them would teach a non-native usage.

definition: 一点儿；常用于否定。
reviewer_notes: Rejected for redundancy, not for sentence quality. If the editor keeps this sense instead, also fix: A.level_3 “略” uses a register rationale that does not apply to a 书面 sentence, and B.level_3 “竟” is only weakly wrong, since “竟不怀疑” is grammatical and the register reason is unconvincing. Declined blocks not reported.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. “一点儿；常用于否定” means the same as 98991’s “一点点也没有”, and both are adverbs with the same 不/没 pattern. One lesson would teach the same thing twice.

definition: 整体的长度；也指部门的最高负责人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on the core. The length-only half adds nothing beyond 98993, and the minister half cannot share a sense with the length reading. The variant blocks are otherwise locally sound: A level_7 and B level_7 errors are single-error and the corrected sentences are right; the B level_1 decline has the same unjustified no_minimal_pairs problem as 98993. Sentences 6-9 carry furigana while 0-5 do not, which is inconsistent but moot.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: One sense document covers two senses: 整体的长度 (length) and 部门的最高负责人 (minister). Sentences 0-5 are the length sense, which duplicates 98993. Sentences 6-9 are the minister sense. sense_fingerprint has the same conflation.

definition: 腰是身体中间细细的地方，在肚子的后面。
reviewer_notes: Core is unusable as a separate sense. Its forms and sentences are otherwise fine, and A's level_1 distractors (要/摇/咬) are valid tone-only confusions, so they can be reused under 99002. A distinct sense for 山腰 (mid-slope) may be worth adding, but that is outside this review.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Describes the same body-part referent as sense 99002 (人体胯上、胸下的部位). The sentences in this sense also use 腰 as the body part, so the two senses are duplicates. The gloss 在肚子的后面 is also imprecise.; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 躯干 is defensibly acceptable in 请你弯下躯干，帮我捡一下笔. The explanation relies on register alone, which fails the no-defensible-distractor rule.

definition: 水上各种船只的统称。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so no patches. If the team decides to keep it anyway, level_3 variant A has a borderline distractor: 货物 is weak because 停着 fits containers and vehicles, so replace it with an unambiguous non-fit such as 雨伞.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 水上各种船只的统称 and 99005's 在水上行驶的大大小小各种船 describe the same meaning of 船舶, so the two senses cannot be pinned apart and would teach learners one sense twice.

definition: 到处；各个地方。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 99007. If the team prefers this sense's gloss, keep it and drop 99007, but do not keep both. Also, the 在各方面 sense used as the wrong sentences in both B level_6 blocks is not in any inventoried sense. Its B level_3 distractor 竟 (过年的时候，竟很热闹) is also a questionable distractor.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The sense 到处；各个地方 duplicates 99007 (每个地方都是这样). Two near-identical senses should not coexist.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2].explanation: The explanation says the sentence expresses 每个地方都是这样, which contradicts this document's own definition 到处；各个地方. This is a copy error.

definition: 行列是人一个一个站成的队。
reviewer_notes: The core sentences are unusable, so the whole document needs to be regenerated.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 行列 means ranks or rows, as in formations. It is typically abstract (加入……的行列). It does not mean an everyday queue. Phrases such as “买票的行列”, “排好行列”, “行列太长了” and “走出了行列去买水” are unnatural; a native speaker would say 队伍 or 队. The 书面 register also conflicts with the simple queue sentences.

definition: 行市是市场上东西现在卖多少钱。
reviewer_notes: 与 99016 重复，判为 reject；编辑保留其中一个即可。本条不做修补。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 99016 是同一义项的重复：“行市是市场上东西现在卖多少钱”与“市场上商品的价格”实为一个义项。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “涨了了”的错误是重复的“了”，错误并不落在目标词“行市”上，不符合 level_7 须涉及目标词的要求。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: “今天菜市场的天气怎么样？”语法通顺、可以理解，“天气”并非明显不合，解释称“不能这样说”过于绝对；“收成”（options[3]）同理偏弱。

definition: 车、船等在路上或水上行进。
reviewer_notes: Not patched, because the core is a duplicate. Other defects, if the sense were kept: variant A level_7 incorrect sentence 渡船已经行驶着两个小时 is arguably acceptable (durative 着 with a duration phrase), so it is a weak spot-the-error item. Variant B level_3 distractor 驾 is arguably defensible in 车只能慢慢驾着 (车 as topic), which conflicts with its explanation that the object is missing.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 99019: same meaning (车/船在路上或水上行进) and same fingerprint.

definition: 说动是用话让别人改变想法，听你的。
reviewer_notes: 与 99034 重复，判为 reject；本条不做修补。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 99034 是同一义项的重复：均为“用话使人改变想法”。; core.definition: “，听你的”加入了原词释义中没有的服从义，超出“说服”的含义。; variants.A.level_1.options[1]: “说通”（讲明道理使人明白）与“说动”在说服义上接近，是近义词，听到目标的人可能合理选它。; variants.A.level_1.options[3]: “生动”（shēng dòng）与“说动”的第一个字韵母和声调都不同，不是最小对立对，听感上难以混淆。; variants.B.level_1.options[2]: “山洞”（shān dòng）与“说动”的第一个字韵母和声调都不同，听感上不接近；且与“扇动”同音，两个干扰项互为同音。; variants.B.level_1.options[3]: “扇动”（shān dòng）听感不接近，且有“煽动、激起”之义，与“说动”在说服义上相近。; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: “你能拉走他吗？他最听你的话。”语法通顺、语义连贯，“拉走”可合理填入空缺。; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: “你能抱起他吗？他最听你的话。”同样可以连贯，“抱起”也能合理填入。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “他很会讲道理，最后说动过我。”中“过”表示曾经的经历，与“最后”并非绝对矛盾，错误不够干净，解释也较弱。

definition: 负责调查某事的工作人员。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so no patches. If it were kept, variant B level_7 would have the same misleading 们 rationale as 99037 ("医院请三名调查人员们"), and that explanation would need the same correction.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 负责调查某事的工作人员 and 99037's 去问人、找东西，把事情弄清楚的人 both mean an investigator, so this sense repeats 99037.

definition: 违反法律，偷运货物进出国境。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 99041. If the team keeps this document instead, the two must be merged first, including the sentences and the exercise blocks, because they cover the same sense. Otherwise the sentences here are grammatical and the explanations are accurate.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 違反法律，偷運貨物進出國境 duplicates 99041 (偷偷运进或运出，不让管事的人知道). It is the same sense with a different gloss.

definition: 自己去冒必死的危险。
reviewer_notes: Rejected for redundancy. If it were kept, A.level_7 has the same flaw as 99053: “那是去送死了”/“去送死了” is not a reliable error. Declined blocks not reported.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. “自己去冒必死的危险” is the same as 99053’s “自己去做很危险的事，会丢掉性命”. The extra “或让别人去冒这种危险” in the fingerprint is not exercised by any sentence.

definition: 这一天；指说话时所指的那一天。
reviewer_notes: If the team prefers this sense over 99057, reject 99057 instead. Sentences 4 (到了这天), 6 (约好这天) and 9 (这天，小明第一次…) use the day-in-question reading, which is wider than this sense's own 说话时 gloss, so any merged sense should be stated broadly. If the sense were kept, these would need fixing: the level_7 B error (地 after 晚上) is off-target in the same way as in 99057; the level_3 B distractor 一个小时 is borderline, since 约好一个小时在… is natural only with 后; and the level_1 decline matches 99057.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 这一天；指说话时所指的那一天 has the same meaning as 99057 (说话时所说的这一天), the same POS and semantic class, and a near-identical fingerprint. The two senses cannot be taught separately; the exercises would test the same answer twice.

definition: 天空云多、不见太阳的状态。
reviewer_notes: No patches, because the core is a duplicate. For the record, the same defects appear here as in 99077: A level_6 wrong sentence 「灯光很阴」is not clearly wrong, and B level_6 wrong sentence 「屋里的气氛很阴」can be read through the 阴沉 sense. The other blocks I checked are sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 99077. 「天空云多、不见太阳的状态」and the fingerprint 「天上云多，看不见太阳」duplicate 99077's 「天上有云，看不到太阳」. Two ladder entries would teach the same sense twice.; sentences[3].furigana: Furigana reads 一直 as yī zhí. Before a second-tone syllable 一 is yì, so it should be yì zhí.

definition: 两只眼睛。
reviewer_notes: Not patched, because the core is a duplicate. The level-level content otherwise passes: distractors are wrong in their anchors, the wrong sentences are wrong for the target, and the level_7 errors are clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 99093: 两只眼睛 versus 双眼是两只眼睛, with the same usage in every sentence.

definition: 中等教育之后在大学、学院等进行的教育。
reviewer_notes: No patches, because the core is a duplicate. I found no independent defects in the sentences or blocks: the level_3 distractors 中等教育/初等教育/大学 are false or misfit, the level_6 wrong sentences are each contradicted, and the level_7 errors are single measure-word or suffix errors. If the curator prefers 99106's definition wording, merge it into 99105 rather than keeping both.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 「中等教育之后在大学、学院等进行的教育」and the fingerprint 「中等教育之后由大学、学院实施的教育阶段」cover the same 高等教育 sense as 99105. Splitting it across two ids gives two ladder entries for one sense.

definition: 新鲜盛开的花朵。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的理由是重复：本 sense 与 99109 是同一个义项，内容不足以单独成立。若最终保留 99110 而非 99109，需要应用上面的 level_1 替换和 B level_7 的修正。另外两个需注意的点（不构成本次拒绝的依据）：A level_7 的修正集包含「他在老师桌上放了一瓶鲜花」，「一瓶花」在语义上可以接受，但学习者可能对其提出异议；A level_3 的干扰项「树枝」可以接「一束」，只因不是生日礼物才被排除，属于较弱的干扰项。plan 的 active_levels 同样列出了 2、4、9，但文档中没有这些块。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 「新鲜盛开的花朵」与 99109 的「刚开的、好看又香的花」是同一个义项，两个 sense_id 之间没有可区分的义项边界，学习者会得到两套几乎相同的练习。; variants.A.level_1.options[3]: 与 99109 相同：鲜活（xiān huó）的第二音节在韵母和声调上都不同，不是有效的听力干扰项。; variants.A.level_1.options[4]: 与 99109 相同：现货（xiàn huò）的第二音节在韵母和声调上都不同，不是有效的听力干扰项。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「医院的走廊里摆着一棵鲜花」中「棵」的解释不完整：「棵」也用于植株（如一棵花、一棵玫瑰），一棵盆栽花并不算错，因此这一错误并非只由量词造成，有争议。

definition: 一头是两头里的一头，或者是一下子往前冲。
reviewer_notes: 核心失效：本 sense 把「一端」（名词）和「猛然往前冲」（副词）合并为一个义项，违反「每个句子只使用一个义项」的标准。修复需要重新拆分义项、改写定义与指纹，并重新分配句子，因此无法通过局部补丁修复。99122 有相同的混合问题，两者之一应被替代。拆分后请运行 plan 核对块：PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python scripts/fat_seed_runner.py plan RUN --source reviewed --senses <sid>。plan 的 active_levels 为 [1,2,3,6,7]，但文档中没有 level_2 块。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把两个义项合并在一起：「两头里的一头」（名词性的「一端」）与「一下子往前冲」（副词）。同一个 sense 不能覆盖两种语法功能和两个意义。; core.pos: 词性为副词，但「长椅的一头」「竹子的一头」「这条路的一头」中的「一头」是名词性成分，受「的」修饰，不符合副词的标注。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹「两头中的一头；一下子往前冲」同样混合了两个义项，无法用于消歧。; core.sentences: 10 个句子中，第 5、6、7 句（长椅的一头、竹子的一头、这条路的一头）使用的是名词性「一端」义，其余 7 句使用的是副词义，句子与单一义项不匹配。; variants.B.level_3: B 的 level_3 是名词位置的完形填空（「竹子的___放在地上」），干扰项门口、窗户、屋顶都是名词，这暴露了义项混合的问题，无法作为副词义的题目使用。

definition: 事物的一端；也指径直地、猛然地。
reviewer_notes: 核心失效：与 99121 的问题完全相同，两者都混合了名词「一端」与副词「猛然往前冲」。同一词的两个 sense 之间没有可区分的边界，应在词条清单层面合并或重新拆分，保留一个拆分正确的 sense。拆分后请运行 plan 核对块。plan 的 active_levels 为 [1,2,3,6,7]，但文档中没有 level_2 块。
